{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421410789900322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叙自古卜筮之說，莫神扵左氏、春秋。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031125544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫陽朱子謂三代如太卜、太筮，職有專官，故其業精而其應神。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031141928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浚世既廢其官，而占騐之書亦不傳，故鮮有神而明之者。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031158312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然近代如黄金策诸篇，始有以窮夫隂陽之阃𥨩，造化之機缄。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031174696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但其间詮解未諦，","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031191080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358423111462617088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗之占驗者，未能無讹，以致有傳書，而古人之精意不必與之𥁞𫝊，苟有好學深思，神明其故者，不難自為其書，以與之𭛁溦阐幽也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031191080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"林屋王山人垂簾扵吴郡治之東偏，與余居密邇，有疑輙往叩焉，竒验不𤕤，如燭照𢿘計，逺近咸頌之為神，而山人辭其名不受，曰：吾有所受","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031207464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358402953394569250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031207464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新安楊廣含先生，吾師之所授占驗一冊，為坊刻羣書所未及。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031223848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比年以来，増益芟薙，编成券帙，付之梨棗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031240232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余序之曰：夫聖賢言理不言𢿘，而大易實為卜筮之書所設，吉凶悔吝可以前知者，以數測，而實以理㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039880031256616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今山人之書具在，其精捜妙驗，固為𢿘之獨神，而苟非貫","logicSentenceId":"7680040473070665728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421786012188712"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澈扵陰陽變化、五行生剋之理尔，何以為𢿘學哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680040473070665728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故是書為言數之書，而實言理之書也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040473070682112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是以極深研幾，雖古卜筮之神而明之者，亦何以加焉。","logicSentenceId":"7680040473070698496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時康熈已丑𡻕冬十月，吴郡張景崧書扵蓉江草堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680040473070714880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426326216261643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗目錄卷之一卜筮格言啓蒙節要六十花甲納音歌十天干所屬，十二地支所屬。","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710588937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干地支八卦方位圖，五行相生相剋，六親相生相剋，天干相合，地支相合相衝，五行次序，八卦次序，","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710605321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426326216294411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦象例，八宮所屬，以錢代蓍法。","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710605321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四卦名納甲裝卦歌、安世應訣、六獸歌、六獸起例、安月卦身訣、三合會局歌、長生掌訣、祿馬羊刃歌、貴人歌訣，三刑六害歌，八宮諸物、八卦諸身定間爻歌年上起月法，","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710621705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427031622647849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上起時法，定寅時法，通玄賦、碎金賦諸爻持世訣、世應生剋空亡動靜訣，卦身喜忌訣，飛伏生剋吉凶歌，斷易勿泥神煞歌六爻安靜訣、六爻亂動訣，忌神歌、原神歌、用神不上卦訣，用神空亡訣，用神發動訣，日辰訣、六親發動訣，","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710621705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427031622680617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親變化歌，六獸歌斷日月建傳符、八卦相配，六甲旬空起例、月破定例卷之二，卦爻呈象并飛伏神、卦身定例卷之三十八論用神分類定例：第一、世應論用神，第二、用神問答，第三、原忌仇神論，第四、","logicSentenceId":"7680048007710621705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426326216343563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"cont {"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十八問卜者誠心，斷者精明，亦有不驗何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680048007711047689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"計答占驗六卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680048007711064073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗目錄終","logicSentenceId":"7680048007711080457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427031622909993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之一古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒輯","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095399982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午舉人，弟需遵時恭訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095416366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明、謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵、潛菴男。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095432750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095449134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章琢軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮格言：","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095449134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303160356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫卜之爲道，通於神明，所以斷吉凶，決憂疑，辨隂陽於爻象，察變化之玄機，此其義爲至精，而其事爲至大。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095449134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖經曰：至誠之道，可以前知。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095465518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故問卜者不誠不格，占卦者妄斷不靈。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095481902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二語實定論也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095498286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每見世之人，遇事輒卜，而誠之一字，昧焉罔覺，或飲酒茹葷，或淫邪不潔，迨至臨時禱告，遂欲感格神明，不亦惑乎！","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095514670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有富貴之人，視卜爲輕，或托親朋，或委奴僕，不親致其悃忱，故卜而不應，占驗無靈，遂委罪於卜筮之家，而不自知。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095531054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠有未至。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095547438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此問卜者之過也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095563822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於卜筮者流，","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095580206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303193124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心存好利，借卜爲囮。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095580206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如疾病一節，爲問卜莫大之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095596590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃有喪心之輩，勾通僧尼道觀，講定年規，","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095612974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"節禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三七二八常例，妄斷求利。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095612974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看卜者之貧富，爲判斷之多寡，妄斷某寺某觀禮懺幾部，某菴某廟誦經幾","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095629358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日卜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，心慌意亂，無不依從。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095629358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在富者費用猶易，其貧","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095645742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於典衣揭債，棄産賣物，一時有手足無措之苦，以冀其病之痊可。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095645742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究竟禮懺未完而病者已死，誦經","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095662126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甫畢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而病者告殂，則何益哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095662126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此串通僧道之害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095678510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有初學醫生，脉理未諳，囑令引薦，令卜醫者指明住","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095694894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"處姓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427031622942761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名禱告，因而薦舉。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095694894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知卜者所得，不過年規節禮之微，而病者頓遭庸醫殺人之害，此串通醫生之禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095711278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者郡城惡套，處處皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095727662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予垂簾，衛","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095744046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前，遂有若輩來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相蠱惑，予誓絕之，一一照卦細斷，無不響應。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095744046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此非課學之精，實無妄斷之失也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095760430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今幸學稍有得，偶輯卜筮正宗一書，請敎高明，而猶恐問卜者有不誠不格之誤，占驗者有妄斷，不靈之害也，故首識之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095776814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啓蒙節要六十花甲納音歌：","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095793198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858404905"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子乙丑海中金，丙寅丁卯爐中火，戊辰巳已大林木，庚午辛未路旁土，壬申癸酉劒鋒金，甲戌乙亥山頭火，丙子丁丑澗下水，戊寅己卯城頭土，庚辰辛巳白蠟金，壬午癸未楊柳木，甲申乙酉井泉水，丙戍丁亥屋上土，戊子巳丑霹靂火，庚寅辛卯松栢木，壬辰癸已長流水，甲午乙未沙中金，丙申丁酉山下火。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095793198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戍已亥平地木，庚子辛丑壁上土，壬寅癸卯金箔金，甲辰乙巳覆燈火，丙午丁未天河水，戊申巳酉大驛土，庚戌辛亥釵釧金，壬子癸丑桑柘木。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095809582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅乙卯大","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095825966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303225892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"溪水，丙辰丁巳沙中土，戊午巳未天上火，庚申辛酉石榴木，壬戌癸亥大海水。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095825966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十天干所屬，甲乙東方木，丙丁南方火，戊已中央土，庚辛西方金，壬癸北方水。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095842350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二地支所屬：子水鼠，丑土牛，寅木虎，卯木兎，辰土龍，巳火蛇，午火馬，未土羊，申金猴，酉金雞，戌土狗，亥水猪。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095858734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858437673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干地支八卦方位圖。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095875118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303258660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相生相剋，金生水，水生木，木生火，火生土，土生金，金剋木，木剋土，土剋水，水剋火，火剋金，六親相生相剋，生我者爲父母，我生者爲子孫，剋我者爲官鬼，我剋者爲妻財，比和者爲兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095891502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干相合，甲與巳合，乙與庚合，丙與辛合，丁與壬合，戊與癸合，","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095907886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858470441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地支相合相衝，子與丑合，寅與亥合，卯與戌合，辰與酉合，巳與申合，午與未合，子午相衝，丑未相衝，寅申相衝，卯酉相衝，辰戌相衝，巳亥相衝。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095907886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行次序。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095924270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858503209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦象例：乾三連，坤六斷，震仰盂，艮覆碗，離中虚，坎中滿，兌上缺，巽下斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095973422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宮所屬，乾屬金，坎屬水，艮屬土，震、巽屬木，離屬火，坤屬土，兌屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160095989806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以錢代蓍法，以錢三文，熏於爐上，致敬而祝曰：天何言哉！","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096006190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叩之卽應。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096022574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神之靈矣，感而遂通。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096038958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今有某姓，有事關心，不知","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096055342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303291428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休咎，罔釋厥疑，惟神惟靈，若可若否，望垂昭報。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096055342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祝畢，擲錢一背爲单畫，一，二背爲拆畫，一，三背爲重畫，口，三字爲交畫，乂，自下裝上，三擲，內卦成，再祝曰：某宮三象，吉凶未判，再求外象三爻，以成一卦，以決憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096071726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祝畢，復如前法再擲，合成一卦，而斷吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096088110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至敬至誠，無不感應。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096104494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：兩背由來拆，雙眉本是单。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096120878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渾眉交定位，總背是重安。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096137262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"单单单曰乾，拆拆拆曰坤，单拆单曰離，拆单折曰坎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096153646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘卦倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096170030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三背爲重，三字爲交，重交之爻，謂發動。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096186414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重作单屬陽，交作拆屬隂。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096202798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡動爻有","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096219182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858535977"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變重變拆交變单，餘爻倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096219182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四卦名乾爲天，天風姤、天山遁、天地否、風地觀、山地剝，火地晉、火天、大有。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096235566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾宮八卦皆属金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎爲水，水澤節，水雷屯，水火旣濟，澤火革，雷火豐，地火、明夷、地水師，","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096251950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坎宮八卦皆属水。艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲山，山火賁、山天、大畜、山澤損，火澤暌，天澤履，風澤中孚、風山漸。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096251950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"良宮八卦皆属土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震爲雷，雷地、豫，雷水解，雷風恒，地風升，水風井，澤風、","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096268334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858568745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大過，澤雷隨。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096268334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震宮八卦皆属木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽爲風、風天、小畜、風火、家人、風雷益，天雷無妄，火雷噬嗑，山雷頥，山風蠱。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096284718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽宮八卦皆属木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲火火山旅，火風鼎、火水未濟、山水蒙、風水渙、天水訟、天火同人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096301102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"離宮八卦皆属火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲地，地雷復，地澤臨，地天泰、雷天、大壯、澤天夬、水天需、水地比。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096317486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坤宮八卦皆属土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌爲澤，澤水困、澤地萃、澤山咸、水山蹇、他山謙、雷山小過、雷澤歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096333870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兌宮八卦皆属金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303324196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納甲裝卦歌：","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096350254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從下裝起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾金甲子外壬午，子寅辰午申戌，坎水戊寅外戊申，寅辰午申戌子，艮土丙辰外丙戌，辰午申戌子寅，震木，庚子外庚午，子寅辰、午申戌，巽木，辛丑外辛未丑亥酉未巳卯，離火，巳卯外巳酉卯丑亥酉未巳，坤土，乙未外癸丑未巳卯丑亥酉，兌金，丁巳外丁亥，巳卯丑亥酉未。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096350254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安世應訣：八卦之首世六當，巳下初爻輪上颺。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096366638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游魂八宮四爻","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096383022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303356964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立，歸魂，八卦三爻詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096383022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸歌甲乙起青龍，丙丁起朱雀，戊日起勾陳，巳日起螣蛇，庚辛起白虎，壬癸起玄武。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096399406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從下裝起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸起例，今以甲乙、丙丁日附載爲式，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096415790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻五爻、四爻、三爻、二爻初爻","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096432174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙日例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武、白虎、螣蛇、勾陳、朱雀、靑龍、","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096432174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁日例","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍、玄武、白虎、螣蛇、勾陳、朱雀。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096432174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303389732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安月卦身訣隂世則從五月起，陽世還從子月生。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096448558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲得識其卦中意，從初數至世方真。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096464942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身之爻，爲所占事之主。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096481326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無卦身，則事無頭緒，倘卦身有傷，其事難成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096497710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合會局歌：申子辰會成水局，巳酉丑會成金局，寅午戌會成火局，亥卯未會成木局。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096514094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生掌訣長生沐浴，官帶臨官帝旺衰病死、","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096530478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428042303422500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓絶胎養。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096530478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如火長生在寅，","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096546862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"從寅上起，順行卯上，沐浴辰上官帶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依次順行；木長生在亥，從亥上起，餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096546862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858601513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬羊刃歌甲祿在寅卯爲羊刃，乙祿到卯辰爲羊刃；丙戊祿在巳午爲羊刃；丁巳祿居午未爲羊刃；庚祿居申酉爲羊刃，辛祿到酉戌爲羊刃；壬祿在亥子爲羊刃，癸祿在子丑爲羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096563246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰馬居寅，巳酉丑馬在亥，寅午戌馬居申，亥卯未馬在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096579630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右祿馬羊刃，凡卜家宅終身者，從從日辰上起，本人本命上起，亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人歌訣：","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096596014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戊日卜卦，見丑未爻，卽是日貴人。又如甲戊生人見之，爲命貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊兼牛羊，乙巳鼠猴鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096596014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁猪雞位，壬癸","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096612398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858634281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兎蛇藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096612398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛逢馬虎，此是貴人方。","logicSentenceId":"7680049160096628782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑六害歌：寅刑巳，巳刑申，丑戌相刑未並臻。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044767282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子刑卯，卯刑子，辰午酉亥自相刑，六害子未不堪親。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044783666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑害午兮寅巳真，卯害辰兮申害亥，酉戌相穿轉見深。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044800050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宮諸物：乾爲馬，坤爲牛，震爲龍，巽爲雞，坎爲豕，離爲雉，艮爲狗，兌爲羊。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044816434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宮諸身：","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044832818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858667049"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾爲首，坤爲腹，震爲足，巽爲股，坎爲耳，離爲目，艮爲手，兌爲口。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044832818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定間爻歌：世應當中兩間爻，忌神發動莫相交。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044849202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰與用當中動，生世扶身事事高。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044865586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上起月法：甲巳之年丙作首，乙庚之歲戊爲頭。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044881970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之位從庚上，丁壬壬位順行流。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044898354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸之年何方法，甲寅之上好追求。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044914738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427924858699817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日上起時法：甲巳還加甲，乙庚丙作初，丙辛從戊起，丁壬庚子居。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044931122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸何方法，壬子是順行。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044947506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定寅時法：正九五更二㸃徹，二八五更四㸃歇，三七平光是寅時，四六日出寅無别。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044963890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五月日高三丈地，十月十二四更二。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044980274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仲冬纔到四更初，便是寅時君須記。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020044996658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通玄賦，易爻不妄成。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045013042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神爻豈亂發，體象或旣成。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045029426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無者形憂色。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045045810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567272467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始須論用神，次必看原神。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045062194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合會用吉，祿馬最爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045078578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻動始爲定，次者論空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045094962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲主冲併，刑剋俱主傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045111346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱發動，必然有攺張。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045127730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍動家有喜，虎動主有喪。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045144114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳朱雀動，田士與文章。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045160498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動憂尊長，父動損兒郎。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045176882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動男人滯，兄動女人殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045193266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出行宜世動，歸魂不出疆。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045209650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用動値三合，行人立回莊。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045226034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占宅財龍旺，豪富冠一鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045242418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻興旺，爲官至侯王。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045258802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神若持世，官訟定無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045275186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳剋玄武，捕賊不須𢗅。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045291570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父病嫌財殺，財興母不長。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045307954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼病難療，鬼旺主發狂。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045324338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請看考鬼曆，禱謝得安康。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045340722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567305235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚嫌剋用，占産看隂陽。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045357106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若要問風水，三四世吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045373490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生墓絶訣，卦卦要審詳，萬千言不盡，畧舉其大綱。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045389874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分别各有類，無物不包藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045406258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碎金賦子動生財，不宜父擺；兄動剋財，子動能解；財動生鬼，切忌兄摇；子動剋鬼，財動能消。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045422642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動生兄，忌財相剋；鬼動剋兄，父動能泄；鬼動生父，忌子交重。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045439026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動剋父，鬼動能中。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045455410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動生子，忌鬼揺揚。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045471794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動剋子，兄動無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045488178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子興剋鬼，父動無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045504562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然兄動，鬼必遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045520946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財興剋父，","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045537330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567338003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動無憂。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045537330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然子動，父命難留。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045553714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父興剋子，財動無事。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045570098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是鬼興，其子必死。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045586482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼興剋兄，子動可救；財若交重，兄弟不久；兄興剋財，鬼興無礙；若是父興，財遭剋害。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045602866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本文皆言生剋制化之理，以明凶中藏吉，吉内藏凶耳。如金動，本生水也，得火動則制金，而金不能生水矣。如火動可剋金也，得水動，則制火，而火不能傷金矣。如金逢火動，則受剋也，得土動，則火貪生于土忘。剋于金，名爲貪生，忘剋金，反吉也。如火動剋金，而士爻安静，更逢木動，木助火剋金，必凶也。學者宜按五行生剋制化推之，吉凶了然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸爻持世訣世爻旺相最爲强，作事亨通大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045619250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀望諸般皆遂","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045635634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567370771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意，用神生合妙難量。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045635634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空月破逢非吉，剋害刑冲遇不良。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045652018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持世主身勞，求嗣妾衆也難招。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045668402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動財安宜赴試，財摇謀利莫心焦。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045684786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占身財動無賢婦，又恐區區壽不高。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045701170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世事無憂，求名切忌坐當頭。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045717554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避亂許安失可得，官訟從今了便休。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045733938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生無剋諸般吉，有剋無生反見愁。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045750322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻持世事難安，占身不病也遭官。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045766706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財物時時憂失","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045783090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567403539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫，功名最喜世當權。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045783090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八墓愁疑無散日，逢冲轉禍變成歡。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045799474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世益財榮，兄若交重不可逢。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045815858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇子孫明暗動，利身剋父喪文風。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045832242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求官問訟宜財托，動變兄官萬事凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045848626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世莫求財，官興須慮禍将來。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045865010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀并臨防口舌，如揺必定損妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045881394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母相生身有壽，化官化鬼有奇灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045897778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應生剋空亡動靜訣：","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045914162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567436307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應相生則吉，世應相剋則凶，世應比和事却中。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045914162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作事謀爲可用，應動他人反變，應空他意難同。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045930546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空世動我心慵，只恐自家懶動。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045946930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045963314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身喜忌訣：身臨福德不見官，所憂必竟變成歡。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045979698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目前凶事終須吉，緊急還來漸漸寛。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020045996082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身臨原用與靑龍，定期喜事入門中。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046012466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢驛馬身爻動，出路求謀事事通。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046028850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身爻切忌入空亡，作事難成且守常。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046045234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑傷破絶皆爲","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046061618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567469075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，勸君安分守家邦。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046061618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛伏生剋吉凶歌：伏剋飛神爲出暴，飛來剋伏反傷身，伏去生飛名泄炁，飛來生伏得長生。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046078002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢伏剋飛無事，用見飛傷伏不寧。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046094386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛伏不和爲無助，伏藏出現審來因。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046110770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷易勿泥神煞。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046127154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易卦隂陽在變通，五行生剋妙無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046143538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時人須辨隂陽理，神煞休將定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046159922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻安靜訣：","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046176306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428223425740839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇六爻安靜，當看用與日辰。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046176306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰剋用及相刑，作事宜當謹慎。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046192690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更在世應推究。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046209074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神切莫如臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046225458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應臨用及原神，作事斷然昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046241842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻亂動訣：六爻亂動事難明，須向宮中看用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046258226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用若休囚遭剋害，須知此事費精神。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046274610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神歌：看卦先須看忌神，忌神宜靜不宜興。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046290994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神急要逢傷剋，若遇生扶用受刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046307378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428223425773607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原神歌原神發動志揚揚，用伏藏兮也不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046323762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要生扶兼旺相，最嫌化剋及逢傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046340146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神不上卦訣正卦如無變又無，就將首卦六親攻。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046356530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻生用終須吉，若遇交重剋用凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046372914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神空亡訣：發動逢冲不謂空，靜空遇剋却爲空，忌神最喜逢空。","logicSentenceId":"7680050020046389298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉用與原神不可空，春土夏金秋樹木，三冬逢火是","logicSentenceId":"7680051989153054729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428054567501843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真空。","logicSentenceId":"7680051989153054729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空又値真空象，再遇爻傷到底空。","logicSentenceId":"7680051989153071113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上逐卦伏神及卦身定例，因易林補遺有陽伏隂、隂伏陽，卜筮全書有乾坤來往換等法之誤，故以逐卦細陳，以便後學。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610035251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六爻安靜及動變之爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610051635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427375425814566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又無用神者，當推此例。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610051635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦中變爻見有用神，及卦身者，巳有用神，不必再查伏神矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610068019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如天山遯卦，安靜缺妻財，以乾卦二爻寅木伏遯卦二爻午火之下，如遯卦初爻發動，變成天火，同人卦初爻丙辰父，其卽變出己卯妻財，當以卯木妻財爲用神，不必看寅木矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610084403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘卦倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610100787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之二終","logicSentenceId":"7680050697610117171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744377919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之三，古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緖著，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167030308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明、謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵潛𤲅男。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167046692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167063076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章琢軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十八論","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167063076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744410687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神，分類定例第一：凡占祖父母、父母、師長家主伯叔、姑姨，與我父母同軰，或與父母年若之親，反及牆城宅舍、舟車、衣服、雨具、求雨紬布、氊貨、章奏、文章、舘室，俱以父母爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167063076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占功名官府、雷電鬼神、丈夫、夫之兄弟同軰，及夫之相與朋友、亂臣盜賊、邪祟、憂疑病症、尸首逆風，俱以官鬼爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167079460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占兄弟、姊妹、姊妹、丈妻之兄弟、世兄弟、結盟同寅","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167095844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744443455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及知交朋友，俱以兄弟爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167095844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占嫂與弟婦妻妾，及友人之妻妾、婢僕、物價、錢財、珠寳、金銀、倉庫、錢糧、什物噐皿，及問天時晴明 {"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占兒女、孫、姪女壻門生、忠臣、良將、藥材、僧道、六畜、禽鳥、順風、解憂避禍，及問天時、日月星斗，俱以子孫爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167128612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應論用神第二：凡卦中世應二爻，世爲自已，應作他人，世應相生相","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167144996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744476223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，是云賔主相投；世應相剋相冲，可見兩情不睦。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167144996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占自已疾病，或問壽數，或問出行吉凶，諸凡損益自身者，以世爻爲用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167161380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占無尊卑之稱呼，未曾深交之朋友，九流術士、𬽦人敵國，或指實某處地頭，或指此山此水、此寺此塔等類，俱以應爻爲用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167177764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占自已有一地可造坟否，則世爲穴塲，應爲對案。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167194148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如將買他人之地而欲造坟，問此地若葬，益利我家否？","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167210532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以應作穴塲，世是我家也。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167226916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神問答第三，","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167243300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202335798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或曰：僕占主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人以父母爻爲用神，主人占僕不以子。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167243300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孫爻爲用神，而以財爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲用神何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167259684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：一切撫養，","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167276068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庇䕶我身者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以父母爻爲用神，卽如城垣、宅舍、舟車、","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167276068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衣服等類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金銀、物件、婢僕等一切驅使之類，以","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167276068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻爲用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167276068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：占兄弟之妻，妻之姊妹以財，","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167292452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻爲用占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫之兄弟以官爻爲用，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167292452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：兄弟之","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167308836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻妻之姊妹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與妻，同軰人也，旣夫占妻，以財爻爲用，","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167308836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆是財爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167308836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫之兄弟，與夫同軰人也，旣妻占","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167325220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫以官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻爲用，皆是官爻爲用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167325220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：古書俱載兄","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167341604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744508991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟爲風雲，今以官鬼之爻爲逆風，子孫之爻爲順風，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167341604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：貴人以官爲官星，庻人以鬼爲禍祟。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167357988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人以子孫之爻爲惡煞，庻人以子孫之爻爲福神。","logicSentenceId":"7680043957167374372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官乃拘束之星，鬼乃憂疑阻滯之宿。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550225983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如連日風雨，或遇逆風，疾病纒染，官司擾害，盜賊憂虞，人心豈暢。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550242367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神能制官鬼，善解憂愁，故爲之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550258751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原忌𬽦神論第四凡占卦要知原神，先看用神何爻，生用神之爻，卽是原神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550275135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神旬空、月破衰弱，或伏藏不現，得原神","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550291519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744541759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動來生之，或日辰、月建作原神生之，必待用爻出旬出破，得令値日，所求必遂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550291519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神旺相，原神休囚不動，或動而變墓、變絶、變剋、變破、變退，或被日辰、月建剋制，皆不能生用，是用神根蒂被傷矣，是不惟無益而反有損也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550307903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占卦要知忌神，亦先看用神剋用神之爻，卽是忌神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550324287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如忌神動來剋用，而用爻出現不空，則受剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550340671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘卦中又動出一爻，原神生用，則忌神反生原神，是名貪生忘剋，則用神根蒂深固矣，其吉更倍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550357055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如忌","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550373439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744574527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神獨發，而用神旬空，謂之避空；如伏藏不現，謂之避凶；如月建、日辰生用，謂之得救。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550373439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是等仍爲吉兆夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550389823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦何嫌何疑哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550406207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如忌神變回頭之剋，或日辰、月建剋冲之，或動爻制忌之，謂之賊欲害我，是賊先受害也，我又何傷？","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550422591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日辰、月建生扶忌神，或忌神叠叠剋用，卽使用神避空伏藏者，至出空出透時，便受其毒，難免其灾也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550438975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占卦要知𬽦神，先看剋制原神，生扶忌神者，卽是𬽦神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550455359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦中𬽦神發動，則原神被傷，用神無根，忌","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550471743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744607295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神倍力，其禍可勝道耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550471743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛神正論第五飛神有六：凡卦旣有伏神，伏神之上者，飛神一也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550488127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸五類，飛神二也；他宮五類，贅入本宮，取財、官、父兄子，飛神三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550504511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦中上下兩爻一類，內靜外興，外飛","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550520895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"內四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550520895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外靜內興，內飛外，五也；內外皆興，飛去六也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550537279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏神正傳第六。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550553663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫伏神","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550570047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之有缺用神，纔看用神伏于何爻，之","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550570047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有用神現，卽使句空月破，動靜生剋合冲者，皆","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550570047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744640063"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由機𨵿之所發，是有病處，必以藥醫之。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550570047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故空要値日，破要填合，伏待出露，冲待合，合待冲，此乃物窮必變，噐滿則傾。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550586431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以破空爲無用，以乾爲坤之伏，大有五類俱全，又扯否卦爲伏，又爻爻有伏之說，豈非病失藥醫，其傳謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550602815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至千學者無門可入。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550619199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今陳一定不易之理，以便學者易丁陞堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550635583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且乾、坤、艮、兌、坎、離、震、巽，乃八宮之首卦，名曰八純，其爻全金、木、水、火土，其象備官、父子、財、兄木宮下七卦，如缺一者，卽以首卦爲伏。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550651967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令姤、遁無財，須向乾宮借寅木，遁否、晋、觀缺水移","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550668351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202368566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾子水伏初爻，觀、剝少金，乾卦申金爲伏，今以乾卦爲法，他宮他卦皆是，以本宮首卦爲下七卦之伏神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550668351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸評論第七：靑龍最喜，悅而多仁；附忌神，凡謀不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550684735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎最凶，勇而好殺。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550701119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生用神，諸爲則吉；朱雀剋身，口舌是非常有；如來生用，文書音信當回。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550717503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳属土，空則田函欠熟；剛强剋世，公差牽扯拘遲。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550733887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇怪異虚驚，玄武私情盜賊；白虎血神生産，偏宜發動午官；朱雀化水，何忌","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550750271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202401334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550750271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇木鬼欺身，恐自縊難逃枷鎖；玄武官生靜世交，小人莫慮千連；世剋靜靑龍廵捕，戲塲酒肆。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550766655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼動勾陳論祈禱速酬；太歲問病原腫脹黃浮。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550783039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畧舉六神取用，莫將六獸推尊。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550799423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇吉神，般般云吉；持凶宿，件件稱凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550815807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四生逐位論第八：火生于寅也，金生于巳也，水土生于申也，木生于亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550832191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火庫于戌，絶于亥，金庫于丑，絶于寅，水土庫于辰，絶十巳，木庫于未，絶于申。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550848575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此長生墓絶定例，卦卦必","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550864959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428677744672831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用者長生，爻爻須究。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者墓絶，除三者之餘，卦中俱弗","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550864959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重也，假今火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550864959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴于卯，爲相生，火之冠帶于辰，衰","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550881343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"于未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"養于丑爲泄氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550881343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火臨官于巳，爲伏吟；午火臨","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550897727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官于巳爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退神，巳火帝旺于午，爲進神；午火帝旺于","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550897727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午爲伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，火衰于未者，爲相合；午火病于申，巳午","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550897727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火死于酉者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲𬽦神，巳火病于申者爲相合；胎于子","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550897727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者爲相剋午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，胞胎于子，爲剋爲冲，爲反吟。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550897727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，餘神奚足重哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550914111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破論第九：","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550930495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533328403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中月破之爻，乃𨵿因之所現也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550930495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動者亦能生剋他爻，變者亦能生剋本爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550946879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下雖破，出月不破矣；今日雖破，値日不破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550963263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破最喜逢合埴實，遠應年月，近應日時，如破而安靜，再値句空衰弱，遇動爻月建、日辰剋害，此等月破，謂之真破，到底破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550979647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空論第十：凡卦中爻遇旬空，乃神機發現于此也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524550996031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如旺相旬空。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551012415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或休囚發動，日辰生扶，動爻生扶，動爻變空，伏而旺相，此等旬空，到底有用，不過待其出旬値日，有合空","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551028799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202434102"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲起冲實填補之法，後卷占驗註明。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551028799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如休囚安靜，或日辰剋動爻剋伏而被剋靜，逢月破，値此等句空者，謂之真空，到底空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551045183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟卦定例第十一反吟卦有二：有卦之反吟，有爻之反吟。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551061567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之反吟，卦變相冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551077951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之反吟，爻變相冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551094335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻變相冲者，查卦中惟有坤變巽、巽。變坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾卦坐于西北，乾右有戌，乾左有亥。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551110719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽卦坐于東南，巽右有辰，巽左有巳，兩卦相對，有辰戌巳亥相冲，故乾爲天卦變。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551127103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽爲風卦，巽卦變乾天風。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551143487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姤卦變風","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551159871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533361171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天小畜，小畜變姤。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551159871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乾、巽二卦相","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551176255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲反，吟卦也，坎卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐于正北。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551176255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎下坐子，離卦坐于正，","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551192639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南離下坐午兩卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相對有子午相冲，故坎爲水卦變離，離爲火卦變坎。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551192639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火旣濟變未濟，火水未濟變","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551209023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣濟此坎離，二卦相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲，反吟卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551209023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮卦坐于東北，艮右有","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551225407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑艮，左有寅坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，坐于西南，坤右有未，坤左有申，二卦相對，有","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551225407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申相冲，故艮爲山卦變坤。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551225407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551241791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"地卦變艮，山地剝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦變謙，地山謙卦變剝。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551241791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此艮、坤二卦相冲，反吟卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551258175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震卦坐于正東，震下坐卯，兌卦坐于正，","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551274559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"西兌下，坐酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202466870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩卦兩對，有卯酉相冲，故震卦變兌，兌卦變震。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551274559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷澤歸妹變隨，澤雷隨卦變歸妹。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551290943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此震、兌二卦相冲，反吟卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551307327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子變午，午變子，丑變未，未變丑，寅變申，申變寅，卯變酉，酉變卯，辰變戌，戌變辰，巳變亥，亥變巳，亦以此變出相冲，乃爻之反吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551323711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟卦定例第十二。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551340095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏吟卦有三：乾卦變震，震變乾，无妄變大壯，大壯變无妄。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551356479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子寅辰復化子寅辰，午申戌復化午申戌，內外卦之伏吟一也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551372863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202499638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姤卦變恒，恒變姤，遁變小過，小過變遁，否變豫，豫變否，豐變同人，同人變豐，履變歸妹，歸妹變履，解變訟，訟變解，此午申戌復化午申戌，外卦之伏吟二也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551389247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大有卦變噬嗑，噬嗑變大有，屯卦變需，需變屯，大畜變頥，頥變大畜，隨變夬，夬變隨，小畜變益，益變小畜，泰變復，復變泰，此子寅辰復變子寅辰，內卦之伏吟三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551405631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏吟惟乾變震，震變乾，查他卦無伏吟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相休囚論第十三。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551422015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春令木旺火相，夏令火旺土相，秋令金旺水相，冬令","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551438399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533393939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺木相，四季之月，土旺金相，此八者旺相也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551438399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春土金兮，夏金水兮，秋木火兮，冬火土兮，此八者休囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551454783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中旺相之爻，倘被日辰及動爻剋制，目下貪榮得令，過時仍受其毒，此旺相者，暫時之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551471167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中休囚之爻，如得日辰及動爻生扶，目下雖不能逞志，遇時仍然得意，此休囚者，待時之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551487551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合中帶剋論第十四。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551503935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中子爻變丑，戌爻變卯，此子與丑合，卯與戌合，合中帶剋，合三剋七之分。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551520319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如旺相得月日生扶幇比，","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551536703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428809202532406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或卦中動爻生之，是作合論也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551536703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如休囚失令，被月日剋之，或卦中動爻剋之，是作剋論也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551553087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟申金化巳火者，卽無月日與動爻相生，不作剋論，乃化合化長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551569471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘寅月日占之，是三刑會聚，申被寅冲，則不可以吉論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551585855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合處逢冲，冲中逢合論第十五。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551602239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合處逢冲有三：凡得六合變六冲，一也；日月冲爻，二也，動爻變冲，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551618623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中逢合亦有三：凡得六冲變六合，一也；日月合爻，二也，動爻變合，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551635007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合處逢冲，謀","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551651391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005621801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖成而終散；冲中逢合，事已散而復成。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551651391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶處逢生，剋處逢生論第十六。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551667775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
