{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶于寅，木絶于申，水土絶于巳，火絶于亥，譬如寅。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551684159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦金爻絶于寅，如卦中有土爻動而生之，是絶處逢生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551700543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申日占卦，木爻則絶于申，如卦中有水爻動而生之，是絶處逢生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551716927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日占卦，水爻則絶于巳，如卦中有金爻動而生之，是絶處逢生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551733311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥日占卦，火爻則絶于亥，如卦中有木爻動而生之，是絶處逢生。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551749695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也，惟巳日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占卦土爻絶于巳，如月建生扶幇比土","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551766079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533426707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，不謂絶也，謂之日生。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551766079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如土化出巳，有日月幇比，不云化絶，乃云回頭生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551782463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如月日制土，則是絶于日也，則是化絶于爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551798847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉日占卦，寅爻被剋，卦中有水爻動而生之，是剋處逢生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551815231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例如之。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551831615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡絶處逢生，寒谷逢春；剋處逢生，凶後見吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680044524551847999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變出進退神論第十七：凡卦中亥變子，丑變辰，寅變卯，辰變未，巳變午，未變戌，申變酉，戌變丑，乃進神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930207238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神者，吉凶倍增其勢也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930223622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533459475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中子變亥，戌變未，酉變申，未變辰，午變巳，辰變丑，卯變寅，丑變戌，乃退神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930240006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退神者，吉凶漸減其威也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930256390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有驗不驗論第十八。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930272774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人問卦，惟致誠可以感格神明，故齋莊戒謹，指占一事，神前祝告，而後卜之，則是用是原、是忌是𬽦動靜生剋、合冲變化、旬空、月破、月建日辰，研究其理，無不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930289158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卜者不審其本來之心而妄斷之，則理有不通，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930305542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼問幾事，則數有不逮，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930321926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如姦盜","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930338310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533492243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邪淫之事，則天有不容，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930338310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乗便偶占，毫無誠敬，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930354694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如與人代占，必先說明是何名分，方可就其親疎上下，分别用神，以爲占驗，庻無差誤。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930371078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如奴僕代主來占，則以父母爻爲用神，今乃有人自顧。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930387462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體面不說實情，假托親戚，以致用神看差，雖占無益，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930403846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更或求卜之人，心雖誠敬，或阻干他事，令人代卜，而代卜之人心或不誠，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930420230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又或一事而今日占之，明日又占之，或一人連占四五卦，是再三凟，凟則不告，不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930436614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533525011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢增刪卜易之謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930452998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人因事有憂疑，惟卜可決，必致誠求卜神必以吉凶相告，當以生剋制化動靜之理細推，無不應驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930469382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈李文輝作增刪卜易一書，首章云：此書有十二篇秘法，单敎世之全不知五行生剋之士，亦不必念卦書，只要學會㸃課，就知決斷吉凶，知功名之成敗，知財物之得失，知疾病之生死，知禍福之趨避，種種諸事，槪不必念卦書，則知決斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930485766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃吾師野鶴老人苦心于世之秘法，萬兩黃金無處求。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930502150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等語。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930518534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閱其秘法曰：求名","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930534918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533557779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以官爻爲用神，以子孫爻爲忌神，不要念卦書，不要看生剋制化、動靜冲合，只要會裝卦，對神禱告曰：我若有功名，求賜官爻持世，卜一卦，官爻不臨世，再卜再卜，又無，再再卜，或明日再卜。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930534918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得官爻持世，固知有名；倘得子孫持世，固知無名。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930551302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財，見財爻持世則有，見兄弟持世則無。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930567686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜病見有用神持世則生，見有忌神持世則死。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930584070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卜皆以用神持世斷吉，忌神持世斷凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930600454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無用神、忌神持世，必要卜見方止。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930616838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予想李文輝又愚也，何不以笤爿禱告，聖隂陽爲吉凶斷，更㨗","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930633222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005654569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徑于此法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930633222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之厾笤者，豈不値萬萬兩黃金乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930649606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，李文輝侮聖人之易，迷後世之途，予故闢之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930665990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢易林補遺伏神之謬凡卦中用神不出現，查變爻有，不必尋伏神矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930682374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘變爻又無，然後查用神伏于何爻之下，看有提拔，沒有提拔，以定吉凶，無不應驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930698758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法譬如坤宮，坤爲地卦，六爻五類備全，假使用爻旬空月破、刑冲剋害，卽就其本爻有病者論吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930715142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如復、臨、泰、大壯、夬、需、比七卦，倘正卦與變卦皆無用神，卽將坤爲地，卦內用神爲","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930731526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533590547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏本卦某爻之下。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930731526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法乃萬古一定不易，豈如張星元易林補遺總斷所云飛伏在二儀，交換，定然陽伏隂而隂伏陽。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930747910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤來往換，震巽兩邉求。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930764294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮兌相抽取，坎離逓送流等語哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930780678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若據彼將天風姤卦爲地雷復卦之伏神，不知地雷復卦所缺者文書爻，應將本宮首卦爲伏，取坤之二爻巳火文書伏復卦二爻寅木之下，寅木爲飛，巳火爲伏，謂之飛來生伏，如占文書長軰事，屢驗巳日。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930797062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若據張星元以天風姤卦爲復卦之伏，取姤卦第四爻午火伏復卦第四爻丑土下，妄","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930813446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005687337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將午火伏丑土泄氣之下爲凶，竟不以巳火伏長生之下爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930813446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如天山遁卦缺子孫，必以乾卦初爻子水子孫伏遁卦初爻辰土之下，水庫居辰，謂之入墓，于飛爻也，看有提拔者吉，無提拔者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930829830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦萬古不易之法。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930846214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而張星元竟將地澤臨卦第五爻癸亥水伏遁卦第五爻申金之下，則曰用神伏長生之下吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930862598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是扯張甲當李乙妄論吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930878982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又言用神上卦，如遇旬空月破、刑冲剋害，卽當尋伏。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930895366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又言歸魂卦皆將本宮第四卦爲伏，據稱大有卦初爻子水子孫値旬空，該將","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930911750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005720105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地否卦爲伏神，而否卦六爻之內並無子孫，還是以出現旬空者凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930911750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還是以伏卦中沒有用神，無吉無凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930928134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畧闢其伏神一二之謬，以示後學。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930944518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢易林補遺胎養衰病之謬凡卜卦爻，遇長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨官、帝旺、衰病死、墓絶、胎養，卦中所重者長生墓絶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930960902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其沐浴、冠帶等七件，各有合冲生剋、扶拱、進退神分别。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930977286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如申酉金沐浴于午，金化午，乃回頭剋也；或午日占，乃日辰剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041930993670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如申化酉曰進神，如酉化申曰退神，如金化未戌土曰回","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931010054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005752873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭生，如酉化卯曰反吟，申化辰曰回頭生，酉化辰曰化生，合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931010054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生剋制化合冲之間，神機報在。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931026438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈張星元以胎養半吉之祥，以衰病半凶之禍，若以胎養半吉之祥，假令巳午火長生于寅，胎于子，寅卯木胎于酉，子亥水養于未，還是化胎養半吉之祥，還是化回頭剋，沒有半吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931042822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金爻爲用，動化戌土，是回頭生，凡占全吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931059206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若據張星元說衰病半凶之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931075590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如午火化未土，是化合。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931091974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸占欲散者得之見阻，欲成者得之可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931108358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半凶半吉之謬，誤人不淺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931124742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故闢之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931141126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358436251533623315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢卜筮全書世身之謬下筮全書以子午持世，身居初，丑未持世，身居二，寅申持世，身居三，卯酉持世，身居四，辰戌持世，身居五，巳亥持世，身居六。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931157510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其註云：持世之辰是子，卽以初爻安世身。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931173894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世爻旬空月破、日辰刑冲剋害，不必看世，當察身爻，以身爻代世爻之勞。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931190278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身爻吉則言吉，身爻凶則言凶，今人宗之，大誤于事。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931206662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知卦中所重者，生剋制化、空破、刑冲動靜，如占自已吉凶，理當推世。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931223046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以世爲我，以定吉凶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931239430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘世爻逢凶，身爻逢吉，還","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931255814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228277311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是在于世之凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931255814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還是在于身爻之吉乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931272198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，而子午持世，身居初爻，諸謬甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931288582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯天醫星之謬凡占延醫用藥，以應爻爲醫生，以子孫爻爲藥石，此係萬古不易之理。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931304966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今術家不察應爻之有用無用，不看子孫爻之動靜旺衰，竟查天醫星之有無，則曰天醫上卦，服藥有效，醫生可用。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931321350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或查天醫不上卦，服藥無效，醫生不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931337734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘天醫不上卦，而應臨子孫發動有氣，剋鬼生身，竟斷醫生不明，服藥無效，有失先天","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931354118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228310079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931354118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况醫生可寄死生，有關人命，予故辯之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931370502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢妄論本命之謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931386886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡占病，當推用神用神，卽如父占子病吉凶，以子孫爻爲用神類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931403270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今術家竟不叅究用神生剋制化之理，而以病人之本命論吉凶死活，則曰本命上卦斷之生，本命不上卦斷之死。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931419654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如用神受傷無救，而本命上卦，還是斷他用神受傷無救，必死耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931436038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還是斷他本命上卦不死耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931452422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後學不可以病人之本命妄斷吉凶可也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931468806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228342847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯卜筮全書神煞之謬昔京房作卦書，以神煞斷卦，如出行忌往亡、疾病忌喪車、沐浴、哭聲等煞，醫藥看天醫，求財忌劫煞，詞訟看官符，種種星煞，難以枚舉，以致後學宗之，不執定五行生剋制化，一味以神煞爲憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931485190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至明劉伯溫先生作千金賦云：自古神煞之多端，何如生剋制化之一理。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931501574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷易之法，始得歸于正宗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931517958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯貴人祿馬之謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931534342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人多以貴人之爻爲官宦，以祿爻爲俸祿，以驛馬","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931550726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228375615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲來人，槩以此論。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931550726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知貴人祿馬臨原神用神，當以吉斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931567110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如卜終身，白虎官爻持世，得貴人臨之，當以武職功名許之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931583494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無貴人并臨，當以病","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931599878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"患强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931599878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴人之爻臨忌神動來剋害，不可以貴人爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931616262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如貴人臨官鬼爻持世，不可以官鬼爲禍患言凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931632646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如下行人，當察用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931649030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神臨驛馬動，歸期可訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931665414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如驛馬動而用爻受傷，不可以驛馬斷其來。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931681798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡問俸祿，當以財爻爲用神是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931698182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若棄財爻之吉凶，而獨以祿爻爲俸者，亦謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931714566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿係豐足之神，馬係行動之宿。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931730950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931747334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005785641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不過分别人品淸高微賤之神，此三者臨吉神是吉，臨凶宿是凶，學者不可槩推。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931747334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯易林補遺應爲他人之謬凡占交疎之常人，當以應爻爲他人，以應爻爲用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931763718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若異姓兄弟，或父叔之友、子孫之友，必分别稱呼老幼取用神是也，不可槩曰我占他人，以應爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931780102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予因張星元不論父友子友，皆以應爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931796486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚至奴僕妻婢、弟兄父母、叔伯隣長，槩曰我代他占，皆以應爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931812870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今據張星元作妻妾奴僕去留章。","logicSentenceId":"7680045041931829254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子以","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110562340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228408383"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲主，應象爲憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110562340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病章云：代卜他人看應爻，若臨月破最難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110578724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇冲遇剋身難救，逢旺逢生病必消。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110595108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生應原神宜發動，剋他忌象怕重交。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110611492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身有氣還須吉，應位逢官禍必招。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110627876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有闘毆爭競章云：以世應爲主，生剋爲憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110644260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如子姪與人闘毆爭競，惟恐受𧇊，故卜，豈可不看子孫爻生剋，竟以世爻爲主，生剋世應爲憑乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110660644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有詞訟章云：以官爻爲主，父母爻爲憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110677028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文詞相訴至公庭，須看官爻父母興，倘然官父二爻動來。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110693412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋我，還是以官父二爻動說，有主有憑，是吉乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110709796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"還是","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110726180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228441151"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋害我者，是凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110726180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之術家，凡遇代占，則不論尊卑，槩以應爻爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110742564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡爲詞訟，獨用官爻，總不論用神生剋制化，予不得不辯之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110758948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢易林補遺月破旬空之謬凡卦中月破之爻，發動旺相，或遇動爻生合，日神生合，或化回頭生合，不過在月內，不能爲吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110775332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出月値日合補，亦能吉能凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110791716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張星元言月破無可救解，槩以凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110808100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中旬空之爻，或旺相安靜，休囚發動，日辰生合冲之，或變出者，或伏而有提拔者，屢試屢驗，應","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110824484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005818409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在出旬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110824484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不意張星元言旬空之爻，猶如卦中無此一爻也，惟月建臨之，則曰月建不作旬空，日辰不爲月破。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110840868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致後學一見月破，無可解救，一見旬空，沒有此爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110857252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：月建不作旬空，註曰：全空、半空。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110873636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽日遇陽爻，隂日遇隂爻，皆作全空；陽日遇隂爻，隂日遇陽爻，皆作半空。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110890020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試問如人古病，或得全空者，固知其必死；倘得半空者，還是病人死一半，活一半耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110906404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其謬極至此，不得不闢之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110922788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯互卦","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110939172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228473919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古大聖以蓍草演成一卦，推體象、用象、互象、爻辭，定事之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110939172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"體象爲我，用象爲事。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110955556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有內三爻、外三爻，世坐之處爲體，應坐之處爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110971940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如天地否卦，世居內坤第三爻，應居外乾，第六爻，卽以內宮坤卦爲體象，以外宮乾卦爲用象。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042110988324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內坤属土，外乾属金，謂之體去生用不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111004708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看互卦，互卦之法，亦以否卦爲例，除上六爻，单，除下初爻拆，從第二爻起，至四爻見拆拆单卽內宮互成艮卦，從三爻至五爻見拆单单，卽外宮互成巽卦，艮卦属土，巽卦属木，木爲乾宮否卦之","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111021092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005851177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，如求妻財者得之，謂之用來剋體。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111021092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉爻辭者，爻見单属陽曰九，爻見拆属隂曰六。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111037476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽乾卦初爻，易曰：初九潛龍勿用。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111053860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如否卦初爻，易曰：初六，拔茅茹，以其彚，貞吉亨。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111070244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否之四爻曰：九四有命無咎，疇離祉。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111086628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷子仙師因易理浩蕩深遠，恐愚人不能叅透，以錢代蓍，卜定財官父兄子生剋制化，分别原用𬽦忌四神刑冲剋害，生扶拱合、動靜空破之法，使後學易覺，吉凶易剖。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111103012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自後以蓍演易者，不察互體用象爻辭而不靈；以錢卜卦者，用之則不驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111119396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者宜知蓍演錢卜，斷","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111135780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228506687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法不同，闢易林補遺終身大小限之謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111135780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或爲功名而卜終身有無，或因貧賤而卜終身富貴，或爲無子而卜終身有無，或卜壽夭，或習藝業而卜終身可賴，或爲行道而卜終身可行，或爲弟兄子姪之終身如何，種種卜者，各有用神諸書惟增刪卜易有野鶴論，分占終身之法甚妥。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111152164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩總言卜終身吉凶，宜向六親生剋制化、刑冲剋合、動靜空破之間。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111168548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是問神必以吉凶之機現于爻，以成敗之機現于卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111184932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憶","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111201316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005883945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予于戊辰年辰月丙辰日，卜自已終身成敗，得旅之蠱卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111201316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時祖業豐裕，妄想富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111217700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦子孫朱雀持世，官爻入墓于日，顯然功名不可問也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111234084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文書爻伏于世爻隂象之下，顯然早年失慈。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111250468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得六合，財福得合，顯然祖業豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111266852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆卜卦前之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111283236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方上有嚴君新婚未幾，後來興廢刑傷，自然有驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111299620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰知辛未年喪父得子，是年父爻入墓之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111316004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻爲長房，持未土子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111332388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果得長子。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111348772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌年生次子。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111365156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予語一友曰：奇哉！","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111381540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦五爻持水，長子属羊，四爻化戌，次子属犬，初爻持辰，必","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111397924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434540005916713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"末子属龍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111397924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：土主五數，該有五子。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111414308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111430692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一重土數主五，以衰旺爲之增減。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111447076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今子孫多現，理當見一有一。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111463460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至丁丑年生一子。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111479844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友曰：汝言後子属龍，今属牛者何來？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111496228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：雖得此子，不在數中，恐難養耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111512612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果次年卽天。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111528996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至庚辰年果得子。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111545380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲戌歲，予年二十六，家業漸廢。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111561764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已卯遠行，壬午二月歸，妻巳故矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111578148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節年顛沛，竟以賣卜爲生。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111594532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：因何廿六歲顛沛起？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111610916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：交甲戌年，應財値年旬空，財臨白虎化月破世位逢冲之年，謂合處逢冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111627300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年冲應主財爻，以致夫妻遠","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111643684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861537873961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别，妻死不面，妻財爻又受午年之剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111643684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月妻財爻又逢月建冲之，至于賣卜爲業。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111660068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀持世，卦属離宮，斯文之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111676452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次子無成，白虎戌上子孫値年月日三破，甲申年始得安穩。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111692836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此卦觀之，黃金策云：若問成家，嫌六冲之爲卦；要知創業，喜六合之成爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111709220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子之先成後敗者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111725604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以易林補遺，初爻起，每爻各𬋩五年，是大限；初爻起，每爻各値一年，是小限。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111741988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予廿一歲至廿五歲，大限在五爻，臨未土，子孫廿三歲何致父故？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111758372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十一歲至三十五歲，大限在初爻，臨辰土，子孫，三","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111774756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861537906729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十四歲，何致剋妻？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111774756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大限如是，小限可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111791140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：變卦𬋩三十歲後，何于廿六歲已先破家？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111807524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三十五歲至四十歲，大限在第二爻兄弟勾陳處，何以反得安穩？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111823908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以互卦","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111840292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内見巽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲文書，外見兌金爲妻財，而卦中旣互有文書妻財，何至雙親早喪？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111840292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中年失偶，若依張星。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111856676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元之法不過惑人曰：終身卦要如是推筭，大限小限，不比尋常小卦，酧謝宜多，究竟禍福吉凶，並無絲毫之驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111873060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後人欲卜終身者，當知興廢大局報于卦，刑傷剋害，際遇機緣報于爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111889444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年年如是，月月照常，而爻","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111905828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228539455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中不及報應，妄推無准。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111905828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫若名利禍福、壽天，逐件分占，便可顯而易見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111922212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當用意推詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111938596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢易林補遺家宅之謬斷家宅之謬者，惟易林補遺之說。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111954980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如其以卦分旺相死沒，立春後艮旺震相，巽胎離沒，坤死兌囚，乾休坎廢，春分後震旺巽相等說。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111971364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又子凡看人宅六者，內外二卦皆臨旺相爻內，總無財官，也主興隆；如臨死囚休廢，總有財官，靑龍天喜，亦無佳兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042111987748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試問倘立春後卜得頥、小過、蠱、漸、恒、益等卦，俱値旺相胞胎，必㫁","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112004132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861537939497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其皆貴無窮之好。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112004132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卜得晋、明夷、臨、萃、北師等卦，必斷其敗壞不止之凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112020516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由此論之，生剋制化之理，烏有竟爲吉凶禍福㨗徑之法，其謬猶可。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112036900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其大謬者，以官爻爲家主之爻，又以五爻爲家主之爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112053284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遇官爻壞，五爻好，則家主之吉凶何分？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112069668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據云：子孫動則廣進家資，此一句係古法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112086052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖則不謬，然以官鬼爲家主，則子孫不可動，動則剋傷官爻矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112102436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若據張星元之論，欲要進家業者，反欲剋傷其父乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112118820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又據云：初爲兒女，與雞鵝井連基地，試問初爻逢凶兒女、雞鵝井泉地基","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112135204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861537972265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"槩凶矣，豈死雞鵝之家，兒女亦必死乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112135204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井必頺乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112151588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"基必破乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112167972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二言妻妾兼猫犬竈及華堂，試問二爻逢凶妻妾猫犬竈與華堂槩凶矣，豈死猫犬之家妻妾亦？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042112184356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必至于死乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660016191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死，妻妾之家，乃囚竈與華堂之碍乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660032575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"止陳兩爻之謬，其餘不及盡述。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660048959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜家宅，當以用神分别明白。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660065343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後卷有家宅六爻分斷，學者詳之，庻無誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660081727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闢易林補遺婚姻嫁娶之謬一、婚姻嫁娶，惟易林補遺之說最謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660098111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以內外卦世應爻爲主，以隂陽財鬼爻爲憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660114495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡男卜女家，內卦爲夫，","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660130879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538005033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦爲婦，又以世爲夫，應爲婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660130879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女卜男家，以外卦爲夫，內卦爲婦，世爻爲婦，應爻爲夫等說，使後學無定見。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660147263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如男家卜婚姻，或遇外卦凶而應爻吉，此婚姻亦好亦不好，究竟可配不可配耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660163647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人宗之，不問父母叔伯，爲卜子姪女婚，不問兄弟母舅爲卜甥弟女婚，一槩以世應論夫婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660180031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼妻財爲夫婦，不以用神生剋制化之理，定其夫婦之吉凶，大失先天妙㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660196415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰知世應財官各有分别，世爻爲我家，應爻爲彼家。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660212799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人自卜嫁此郎爲夫，當以官爻爲夫；世爲自已官","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660229183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538037801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世相生相合，官陽世隂，此謂之得地。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660229183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男人自卜娶此女爲妻，當以財爲婦；世爲自已財世相生相合，財隂世陽，亦謂之得地。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660245567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或父母尊長軰爲子孫婚，欲配某家女爲媳，以子孫爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660261951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世上子孫或陽象子孫，皆指言我家之男也；應上子孫或隂象子孫，皆指言彼之女也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660278335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無冲破，有生合，自然可配，夫婦和諧；無生合，有冲剋，自然夫婦不睦；或休囚或受剋，自然不壽。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660294719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父爲子婚，世位而受傷者，自然悖逆而刑翁；財爻而受生者，自然孝順而益姑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660311103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或爲弟娶妹嫁者，皆以兄","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660327487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437722228572223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟爻爲用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660327487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曾于午建乙卯日父爲女，擇壻得否？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660343871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦安靜一人執此卦問予曰：世隂應陽，官星旺令，卦得六合，日辰持財，財官相生，六爻安靜，是必佳偶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660360255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：若依張星元論，是佳偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660376639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫伏而旬空，是必無子息也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660393023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據予斷，子水子孫伏隂爻未土之下，惟恐令愛不壽耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660409407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人不然而去。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660425791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後成姻不久，此女病故。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660442175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一人申月甲午日，父爲子擇媳，得復之噬嗑卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660458559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：應爻合成，子孫局生世，不但嫁資豐厚，更可享其孝順之福。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660474943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至巳年完婚，果孝順賢淑，贈嫁不凡。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660491327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660507711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820004393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據張星元之說，官爲夫，此卦寅木夫星月破，又被金局剋，是必剋夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660507711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何完婚已及二十年，翁姑在堂，夫婦和諧，不惟子多，近已得孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660524095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後學當如是斷，庻無棄吉就凶，以致誤人婚配也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660540479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辯六爻諸占之謬天玄賦以六爻定諸占之例，惟占國事以五爻爲天子之位，家宅以二爻爲宅，五爻爲人，坟墓以五六爻爲氣絶之位。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660556863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三者稍近乎理，然亦宜以用神生剋制化斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660573247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其天時、産育、行人、田禾、求謀、疾病、買賣、詞","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660589631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538070569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訟、盜賊、闘毆、蠶桑、六畜、出行、鬼神等種種定位，槩不以用神生剋制化之理推斷，惟以定例而決事之吉凶，大失先天之玄妙。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660589631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽就其天時，以六爻爲曰，以五爻爲雨，試問晴雨不以子孫、父母爻推之，竟以五爻、六爻爲可決乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660606015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如初爻爲産母，二爻爲胎孕，試問産母不看用神，胎孕不察子孫，竟以初爻、二爻爲可決吉凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660622399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘種種之謬，難以盡辯，望後學詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660638783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之三終","logicSentenceId":"7680045042660655167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820037161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820069929"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之四，古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711311899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明門人","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711328283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謝朝柱巨材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同較任用淵、潛菴男其","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711328283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章琢軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃金䇿總斷千金賦直解：","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711328283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655684849715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜隂陽，反覆遷變。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711328283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動就是交重之爻，靜就是单。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拆之爻，交折之爻属隂，","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重单之爻，属陽若爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是单","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"折，這謂之安靜安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜的爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沒有變化的理。若爻是交重，這謂之發動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發動的爻","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"然後有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變，故此交交交原是坤卦属隂，因他動了，就","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"變作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"单单单是乾卦属陽了。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711344667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡物動就有個變頭，","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711361051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲甚麽？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交就變了单，重變了拆，該把那個動字當做","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711361051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一個極字的意思，解說古云物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極則變，噐滿則傾，假","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711361051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如天氣熱極，天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就作起風雲來，倘風雨大極就可晴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711361051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"息了。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故古註譬以穀春之成米，以米炊之成飯，若不","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711377435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以穀春，不以米炊，是不去動他了。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到底，榖原是榖米","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711377435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"原是米，豈不是，不動則不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變了，發動之內也有變好","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711377435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦有變壞陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極則變隂，隂極則變陽，這個意思，就是動靜隂陽反覆遷變了。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711377435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖萬象之紛紜，須一理而融貫，","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711393819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538103337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此一節只講得一個理字，那象字當作般字解，理就是中庸之理。卦中刑冲伏合、動靜生剋制化之間，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一個一定不易之理在裏頭。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711393819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拿這個卦理評到中庸之極至處，雖萬般紛紛，論頭一理可以融貫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711410203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人有賢不肖之殊，卦有過不及之異。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711426587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過者損之斯成，不及者益之則利。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711442971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢不肖之殊，人生之不齊也；過不及之異，卦爻之不齊也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711459355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人以中庸之德爲至，卦惟中和之象爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711475739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德至中庸，則無往而不善；象至中和，則無求而不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711492123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故卦中動靜生剋、合冲、空破、旺衰、墓絶、現伏等處，就有太過不及的理在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711508507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡卦理，只論得中和之道。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711524891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如亂動要搜獨靜之爻，安靜要看逢冲之一日月","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711541275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出破填合，旬空要出旬値日，動待合，靜待冲，剋處逢生，絶處逢生，冲中逢合，合處逢冲，這些法則，就是太過者損之斯成，不及者益之則利。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711541275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註以用神多現爲太過，以用神只一位不値旺令爲無炁，謂不及。","logicSentenceId":"7680037555711557659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336702474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539462179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"意淺矣。不知卦中無不有太過不及者，就是動靜生剋合冲、旬空月破，旺衰墓絶，伏藏出現，個個字可以。當他太過，亦可以當他不及。此活潑之中，白有玄妙，學者宜加意叅之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶拱合，時雨滋苗；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336702474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生我用爻者謂之生，扶我用爻者謂之扶，拱我用爻者謂之拱，合我用爻者謂之合。生者，卽金生水類。五。行相生也。扶者，卽亥扶子，丑扶辰，寅扶卯，辰扶未，巳扶午，未扶戌，申扶酉。拱者，卽子拱亥，卯拱寅，辰拱丑。午拱巳，未拱辰，酉拱申，戌拱未，合有二合、三合、六合。二合者，卽子與丑合類；三合者，卽亥卯未合成木局。類六合者，卽卦得六合卦也。此節亦承上文而言，不及者宜益之耳。倘若用爻衰弱冲破，得了生扶拱合。就如旱苗得雨，則苗勃然興之矣。倘若卦中忌神衰弱冲破，得了生扶拱合，謂之助桀爲虐，其禍愈甚矣。學者宜别之。下三條傲此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655684882483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋害刑冲，秋霜殺草。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336702474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋者，相剋，卽金剋木類是也。害者，六害，卽子害未，丑害午，寅害巳，卯害辰，申害亥，酉害戌是也。刑者，卽寅巳申等類是也。冲者，子午相冲等類是也。此亦結上文而言。倘用神衰弱，並無生扶拱合，反見剋害刑冲。故喻之秋霜殺草也。大凡刑冲、剋三者，卦中常驗，六害並無應驗，尤當辨焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生帝旺，爭如金谷之園；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336718858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長生卽火長生千寅類也。帝旺卽火帝旺于午類也。用神遇之，雖衰弱者，亦作有氣論，故以金谷譬焉。此節論用神長生帝旺在日辰上頭，不言長生帝旺于變爻𫟚邉。若以變爻遇帝旺而言，誤矣。假如午火又化出午火來，這是伏吟卦了，有甚麽好處，安得以金谷喻之？六凡用神帝旺于日辰上，主速長生于日辰。上主遲。葢長生猶人初生，長養以漸，帝旺猶人此時其力方銳，所以長生遲而帝旺速也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538136105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死墓絕空，乃是泥犂之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336718858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"死墓絶，皆從長生數起空，是旬空。死者，亡也，猶人病而死也。墓者，蔽也，猶死而葬于墓也。絶者，厭絶也，猶人死而根本斷絶也。空者，虗也，猶深淵薄水之處，人不能踐履也。泥犂，地獄名，言其凶也。這四者與剋害。刑冲，意思相倣，又引有過不及之意。倘用神無生扶拱合，反遇死墓絶空，故以泥犂喻之。大凡卦中爻象只講得長生、墓絶三件向日辰是問，就是變出來的，也要看。惟沐浴、𠜍帶、臨官、帝旺、𡋡、病死、胎養不可向。變出之爻是問，若化出來的，當以生剋冲合、進神、退神、反吟、伏吟論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰爲六爻之主宰，喜其滅項以安劉，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336735242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰乃卜筮之主，不看日辰，則不知卦中吉凶輕重了。葢日辰能冲起冲實、冲散，那動空靜旺的爻象，能合能埴月破之爻，衰弱的能扶助幇比，强旺的能抑挫制伏，發動的能去制得，伏藏的能去提拔，可以成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655684915251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得事可以壞得事，故爲六爻之主宰也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336735242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如忌神妄動，用神休囚，倘得日辰去剋制，那忌神，生扶了用神，凡事轉凶爲吉，故日滅項興劉。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336751626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建乃萬卦之提綱，豈可助桀而爲虐。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336768010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建乃卜筮之綱領，月建亦能救事壞事，故言萬卦之捉綱。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336784394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是卦中有忌神發動，剋傷用神，倘遇月建生扶那忌神，這是助桀爲虐了。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336800778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘忌神剋用神，如遇月建剋制，忌神，生扶那用神，就是救事了。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336817162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看月建，只論得生剋，與日辰相同。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336833546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡月建的禍福，不過司權于月内，不能始終其事。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336849930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而日辰不論久遠，到底有權的，就是長生、沐浴、冠帶。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336866314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"這十二神與日辰固有千係，與月建上不過，只論得月破休囚、旺相生剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336882698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今有人說衰病死墓于月建上不好，長生帝旺于月建上好。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336899082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"種種誤傳，不可信也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336915466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最惡者，歲君宜靜而不宜動；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336931850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820119081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽本年太歲之爻，日嵗君係天子之象，旣能最惡，豈不能最善？旣宜安靜，豈不宜于發動乎？若是太歲那一爻臨忌神發動，來剋冲世身用象，主火厄不利。一歲之中，屢多駁雜，故日最惡，故宜安靜。此言歲君若臨忌辰，則宜靜而不宜動也。若是太歲那一爻動來生合世身主象，主際遇頻加，一歲之中連增喜慶當。言最善，亦宜發動。若用神臨之，其事必午朝廷。若日辰動爻冲之，謂之犯上。母論公私，皆宜謹愼可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最要者，身位喜扶而不喜傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336931850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身，卽月卦身也。陽世還從子月起，隂世還從午月生。其法見啓蒙節要篇内。大抵成卦之後，看卦身現與。不現與月建日辰動爻，有無千渉，則吉凶便知。占事爲事體，占人爲人身，惟喜生扶拱合，不宜剋害刑冲。凡占卦，以卦身爲占事之主，故曰最要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲已，應爲人，大宜契合，動爲始，變爲終，最怕交","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336948234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427375425847334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交重爲動，動則陽變爲隂，隂變爲陽。卦中遇此，當以動父爲事之始，變爻爲事之終。發動之爻變剋變冲。謂之交爭。凡世應宜生合，用神怕變剋冲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應位遭傷，不利他人之事；世爻受制，豈宜自已之謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336948234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應位者，該當一個用神解說。如占他人，亦各有用神分别。或占交疎之人及無尊卑之人，是應爲他人也。倘占父友家主、師長軰，這是父母爻爲用神，是了。子孫之友，這是子孫爻爲用神了。妻妾奴婢，這是妻財。爻爲用神了，那父友、自友及子孫之友，雖是他人，當分别老幼稱呼名分取用，不可一槩以應位誤㫁。如卜損益自己之事，以世爻爲自己也。世若受制，豈宜于自己之謀乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，人無准實；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336964618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此節亦引上文而言世應也。但凡謀事，勢必托人，世空則自己不實，應空則他人不實。若世應皆空，彼此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820151849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆無准實，謀事無成。或世應空合，謂之虗約而無誠信。如托尊長軰謀事，而得父母爻生合世爻，托之自然有益。倘或應空，縂得長軰之力，而那一邉不實，亦難成事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内外競發，事必翻騰。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336964618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"競者，冲剋也。發者，發動也。凡占的卦，内外紛紛亂動，亂冲亂擊，是人情不常，必主事體反覆翻騰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世或交重，兩目顧瞻於馬首；應如發動，心似托於猿攀。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336981002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬有是瞻，或東或西。猿猱攀木，自心靡定。世以巳言，應以人言。書日應動，恐他人有變；世動自已遲疑。皆言其變遷更攺，不能一其思慮耳。此引上文世應爲彼我之意，又引競發有翻騰而言，其事之吉凶縱不外乎生扶拱合、剋害、刑冲空破間耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神有氣無他故，所作皆成；主象徒存更被傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114336997386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡謀","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337013770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358423111462846464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遂，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337013770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神者，如占文書長軰以父母爻爲用神之類是也。主象者，亦卽用神也。故字該作病字解。何謂之病？凡用神遇刑冲剋害，就是病了。如卦中用神旺相，遇了病，可待去病日期，亦能成事。如旺相而又無刑冲剋害等病，凡謀必從心所欲，無不可成矣。倘用神衰弱無氣，而又遇月建日辰刑冲剋害，猶如一個天元，不足痩弱不堪的人，豈可再加之以病乎？故爻弱而又受刑冲剋害者，凡事枉費心力，終無可成之理。葢用爻雖然出現，别無生助，而卦中又無原神，縱有而値空破壞者，謂之主象徒存。徒存者，徒然出現也。謀事焉能遂意哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有傷須救；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337013770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷，傷剋用神之神也。救，救䕶用神之神也。如申金是用神，而被午火發動來剋，則申爻有傷矣。若得日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820184617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是子，或動爻是子，子去冲剋午火，或亥日亥爻制伏午火，則午火有制，而申金豈非有救乎？倘月建冲剋用神得日辰去生合用神，又或日辰去剋用神，卦中動出一爻生他，這便是有傷得救了。凡遇有傷得救。每事先難後易，先凶後吉，用神得救，仍爲有用耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無故勿空，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337013770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故者，謂受傷的意思。勿字該當他，不字解說。大凡旬空之爻安靜，又遇月建、日辰剋制，這是有過之空了。卽使出旬値日，亦不能爲吉爲凶，這樣旬空，到㡳無用之空矣。若旬空之爻發動，或得月建、日辰生扶拱合他，或日辰冲起他，或動爻生合他，這是無故之空。待其出旬値日得令之時，仍復能事，故日無故之空。爻勿以爲空也。雖値旬空而沒有受月建、日辰剋傷的，不可當他真空論。又如用神化回頭剋，又見會局。來剋來剋太過，豈不是有故了？若是日月不傷，他，用神一空，則不受其剋，亦稱無故矣。古有避凶之說，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421786012385320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近乎無故之理。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337013770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註誤以無傷剋之爻不可空，日月二建剋他又宜空，大失先天之妙㫖，又失是篇之文理矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337030154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空逢冲而有用。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337046538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇卦爻旬空，今人不拘吉凶，槩以無用㫁之，殊不知見日辰冲，亦有可用之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337062922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢冲則必動，動則不空，所以空逢冲而有用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337079306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合遭破以無功，此節獨言合處逢冲，葢卦爻逢合，如同心協力，事必克濟。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337095690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡謀望欲成事者，得之則無不遂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337112074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘合處遇冲刑破剋，惟恐奸詐小人，兩邉破説","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337128458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必生疑惑猜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之心。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337128458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅與亥合，本相和合，若見申日，或遇申爻動來冲剋寅木，則害了亥水矣，故曰合遭破以無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337144842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合者，成也，和好之意。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337161226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破者，散也，冲開之意。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337177610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲成事而","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337193994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820217385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得合處逢冲之卦者，事必臨成見散。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337193994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲散之事而得合處逢冲之卦者，必遂意也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337210378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中逢合者反是。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337226762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有空化空，必成凶咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337243146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自空者，用爻値旬空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337259530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化空者，亦言用爻化値旬空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337275914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶咎，言不能成事。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337292298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節亦引上文謀望之事而言。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337308682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡謀望無不欲成事。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337325066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘用爻空，或","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337341450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻動化空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則動有更變，空有疑惑，事必無","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337341450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"成故。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰凶咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337341450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合剋合，終見乖淫。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337357834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合者，和合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337374218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占見之，無不吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337390602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然人不知","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337406986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合中有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑有剋合而有剋終，見不和合而有刑終。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337406986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見乖戾且。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用未字爲財爻，午字爲福爻，午與未合，然午帶自刑，名爲刑合。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337423370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如子字爲財爻，子與丑合，丑土能剋子水，謂之剋合。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337439754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337456138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"始和終背，諸事終垂戾也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337456138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動値合而絆住，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337472522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539494947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡動爻不遇合，然後爲動。若有合，則絆住而不能動矣。既不能動，則不能生物剋物矣，如日辰合之須待冲其本爻日至，可應事之吉凶。如旁爻動來合之，須待冲那旁爻之日至，可應事之吉凶矣。假如用丑王財而子日合之，待未口應事；子爻合之，待午日應事。又如子孫爻動而被日辰合住，則不能生財待冲。動，子孫期至，方有財也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜得衝而暗興，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337472522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡不發動的爻，不可便言安靜，若被日辰冲之，則雖靜亦動，謂之暗動。猶如人臥而被人呼喚，卽不能。安然而睡，旣是卦中發動的爻，也能冲得安静的爻。且爻遇暗動者，猶人在私下作事也。暗動之爻生扶。我定叨私下一人幫襯；倘或剋害，我定被一人在私下謀損。其理深微，應事在于合日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入墓難剋，帶旺匪空。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337472522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426717918330931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入墓難剋者，言動爻入墓，不能去剋他爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337488906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又言他爻入墓，不受動爻所剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337505290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如寅木發動，本去剋土，倘遇未日占卦，那木入墓于未日，或化出","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337521674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是未是入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓于未爻也，則不能去剋土矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337521674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅動剋","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337538058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，爻遇辰日，則入墓于日辰，或化辰爻，入墓于變爻，皆不受寅木之剋，故日入墓難剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337538058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相者，卽如春令木旺火相，夏令火旺土相，秋令金旺水相，冬令水旺木相，四李之月，土旺金相，古謂當生者旺，所生者相是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337554442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此父空亡，不作空論。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337570826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：旺相之爻過一旬，過旬仍有用，故曰匪空有助有扶，衰弱休囚亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337587210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節獨指用神而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337603594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如春天占卦，用爻属土，是衰弱休囚，本爲不美，倘得日辰動爻生扶拱合，雖則無氣，不作弱論。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337619978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如貧賤之人，而得貴人之提拔也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337636362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神倘無氣，則不宜扶助也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337652746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
