{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪生貪合，刑冲剋害皆忘。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337669130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483329061"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此節亦指用神而言也。倘用神遇刑冲剋害，皆非美兆。若得旁有生爻、合爻，則彼貪生貪合，自不爲患矣。故曰忘冲忘剋。假如用神是已，卦中動出寅字來，寅本刑已，但寅木能生已火，故已火貪其生而忘其刑。也。又如卦中動出亥字來，冲剋已火，又得動出卯字來，則亥水貪生于卯，而忘剋于已也。如寅字動，則亥水貪合于寅，而忘冲于已也，此乃貪合、貪生、忘剋、忘冲、忘刑之例，餘皆倣此推詳可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别衰旺以明剋合，辨動靜以定刑冲，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337685514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此節分别衰旺動靜、生剋制化隂陽之理。若獨别衰旺，不辨動靜，則膠于所用矣。如旺爻本能剋得衰爻。若安靜，縱旺而不能去剋衰爻了，衰爻本不敢去剋旺爻，若發動了，就剋得旺爻了。葢動猶人之起，靜，猶人之伏，雖則旺相，不過目下一時旺；雖則衰弱，亦不過目下一時衰。俟旺者退氣，衰者得扶，而衰爻可剋。旺爻矣。如旺爻動剋衰爻，而無日辰救護者，立時受其剋也。惟是日辰能冲剋得動靜之爻，卽如動爻生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358437861538168873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋不得那日辰，若是月建載在卦中，那動爻也能剋得他了。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337685514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，則衰旺動靜之理明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337701898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併不併衝不衝，因多字眼；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337718282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"併者，謂卦中之爻，日辰臨之也。冲者，謂卦中之爻，日辰冲之也。不字，言所併之爻不能，併所冲之爻不能。冲也。何謂不能併？假如子日占卦，卦中見有子爻作用神日辰併之。倘子爻衰弱，已有日辰併之，便作旺。論，然亦不可子爻化墓、化絶、化剋，此謂日辰變壞，不能爲善于爻，而凶反見于本日也，故日併不能併也。何謂不能冲？又如子日占卦，卦中見有午字，作用神日辰冲之。如子爻在卦中動來冲剋午爻，若得子爻。化墓、化絶、化剋，此謂日辰化壞，不能爲害于午，而其吉反見于本日也，故日冲不能冲也。此二者皆因子日占卦，卦中多這個子爻變壞了，所以如此。餘如此例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑非刑，合非合，爲少支神。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337718282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483361829"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑，三刑也。合，合局也。如寅、巳、申爲三刑，五戌、未爲三刑，子卯爲二刑，辰午、酉亥爲自刑。假如卦中有寅、巳。二字而無申，有寅申二字而無巳，有巳申二字而無寅，爲少一字而不成刑也。如亥卯未爲三合，申子辰。爲三合，巳酉丑爲三合，寅午戌爲三合。假如有亥卯而無未，有未卯而無亥，有亥未而無卯，爲少一字而不成合也。三刑三合之法，必須見全有兩爻動，則刑合得一爻起，如一爻動，則刑合不得兩爻起了。如卦中刑合，縱見合，倘俱安靜，便不成刑合了。如此占驗，就明白曉暢矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻遇令星，物難我害；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337734666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"令星者，月建之辰也。物者，指卦中動爻而言。倘用神是月建之辰，而月建乃健旺得令星也，卽使動爻來。傷，何足懼哉！故日物難爲我之害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏居空地，事與心違。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337734666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260807209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏者，伏神也。六爻之内而缺用神，當查本宮首卦用神爲伏卦，上六爻爲飛，飛爲顯，伏爲隱。若六爻之中並無用神，而伏神又值旬空，倘無提拔者，謀事決難成就，故日事與心違。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏無提拔終徒爾，飛不推開亦枉然。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337751050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦引上文之意。伏者，言用神不現而隱伏于下也。如無日月動爻生扶拱合，謂之伏，無提挈飛者，是用神。所伏之上，顯露神也。推者，冲也，言冲開飛神，使伏神可出也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空下伏神，易於引拔，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337767434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言伏神在旬空飛爻之下，葢本爻旣空，猶無攔絆，則伏神得引拔而出也。引者是拱扶併之神，拔者亦生。扶拱，合冲飛引伏之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制中弱主，難以維持。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337767434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539527715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制者，言月建日辰制剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337783818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱主者，指衰弱之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337800202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337816586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神衰弱，而又被日月二建制剋，縱得動爻生之，亦不濟事。葢衰弱之爻，再遇日月剋者，如枯枝朽樹，縱有如膏之雨，難以望其生長新根。此指用神出現而言也。如伏神，如是縱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇併引，亦無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337816586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰傷爻，眞罹其禍；爻傷日，徒受其名，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337832970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰爲六爻主宰，總其事者也；六爻爲日辰臣属，分治其事者也。是以日辰能刑冲剋害，得卦爻、卦爻不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能刑冲剋害于日辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337832970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建與卦爻亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337849354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓中人不冲不發，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337865738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵用爻入墓，則多阻滯，諸事費力難成。須待日辰動爻冲之，或冲剋其墓爻，方有用也。古書云：冲空則起，破墓則開。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260839977"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身上鬼不去不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337865738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身，借用而言世也。但凡官鬼持世爻上，如自已若非職役之人，以官鬼爲憂疑阻滯之神，須得日辰動爻。冲剋去之，方可安然無慮矣。或忌神臨于世上亦然，但不可剋之太過，恐我亦傷先聖日人而不仁，疾之。已甚，亂也，惟貴得其中和耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德入卦而無謀不遂，忌臨身而多阻無成。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337882122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"德，合也。和合中自有恩情德義。故凡謀爲，用神動來合世，或用神化得生合，或日辰臨用合世，或日辰生合用爻皆德入卦中，而無謀不遂矣。但合處見冲，恐有更變，倘忌神如是，則多阻而無成矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇凶星，避之則吉；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337898506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶星卽是忌神。凡用爻被月建、日辰傷剋，不論空伏，始終受制，無處可避。如無月日傷剋，獨遇卦爻中忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539560483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神發動來傷，若用爻値旬空，伏藏不受其剋，謂之避。待冲剋忌神之日，其凶可自散矣。如用爻出現不空。便受其毒，難免其傷也。故曰避之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢忌殺，敵之無傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337898506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻者，用爻也。如求財以財爻爲用之類是也。敵，救護之意。譬如求財，卦中財爻属木，倘有金爻動來剋財。凶也。或得火爻發動剋金，則金爻自治不暇，焉能剋木？木爻無患矣，故曰敵之無傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象休囚，怕見刑冲剋害；用爻變動，忌遭死墓絶。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337914890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337931274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主象亦言用神也。如値休囚，巳不能爲事矣，豈可再見刑剋？如用神發動，猶人勇往直前，豈可自化墓絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用化用，有用無用；空化空，雖空不空。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337931274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神化用神，有有用之用神，有無用之用神。有用者，用神化進神，無用者，用神化退神。并伏吟卦也，故以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539593251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有用無用分别之。空爻安靜則不能化，空爻發動則能化。旣發動，動不爲空也。化出之空，亦因動而化凡。動爻値空，或動爻變空，皆不作真空論，出旬有用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"養主狐疑，墓多暗昧。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337947658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化病兮傷損，化胎兮勾連。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337964042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長生沐浴、冠帶臨官、帝旺、衰病死、墓絕、胎養，此十二神，卦中惟是長生、墓絶三件卦卦須看爻爻要查其。餘沐浴冠帶臨官、帝旺衰、病死、胎養各神，俱另有生剋冲合，進神、退神、伏吟、反吟論，不可執疑于養主狐。疑病主傷損，胎主勾連，十八論内已明論之，學者宜自詳辨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶化長生，熾而未散，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337980426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻化入長生者，吉。如凶神化入長生者，則其禍根始萌，日漸増長也，必待墓絶日，始鋤其勢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉連沐浴，敗而不成。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337980426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260872745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴，其名敗神，又稱沐浴煞，乃無廉無耻之神，其性淫敗。然而有輕重分别。卽如金敗于午，敗中兼剋寅。木敗于子，敗中兼生卯；木敗于子敗中兼刑，水敗于酉敗中兼生，上敗于酉敗中兼洩氣；火敗于卯敗中。兼生，惟占婚姻，最宜忌之。倘夫擇妻姻，得財爻而化沐浴，兼生者，必敗門風；兼剋者，因姦殺身，卽如諸占。倘世爻化之，生者因色壤名，剋者因姦丧命，有救者，險裏逃生。故曰吉神不可化沐浴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戒回頭之剋我，勿反德以扶人。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114337996810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"回頭剋，乃用神自化忌神，如火爻化水之類是也。諸占世爻、身爻、用爻遇之，不吉也。凡用神動出生合世爻，是有情于我，謀爲易成也。或用神發動，不來生合世身，而反生合應爻及旁爻者，皆謂反德扶人。凡占遇之，所求不易，是損已利人之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜孤寒，怕日辰之併起；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338013194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421786012418088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"惡曜，指忌神言也。孤，孤獨無生扶拱合也。寒，衰弱無氣也。凡占遇忌神孤寒，則永無損害我矣，惟怕日辰。併起，而孤寒得勢，終不免其損害，如値月建，真可畏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻重叠，喜墓庫之收藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338013194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如卦中用爻重叠太過，最喜用神之墓持臨身世，謂之歸我收藏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事阻隔兮間發，心退悔兮世空。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338029578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻者，世應當中兩爻是也。葢此二爻居世應之中，隔彼此之路，動則有人阻隔。要知何等人阻。以五類。推之，如父母動，卽尊長之軰是也。凡世爻旬空，其人心怠意懒，不能勇往精進，以成其事，故日心退悔兮。世空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦爻發動，須看交重；動變比和，當明進退。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338045962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421786012450856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凢卦發動之爻，須看交重，交主未來，重主已往。如占逃亡，見父母并朱雀發動，若爻是交，當有人來報信。如値重爻，則信已先知，他倣此。動變比和者，指言進退二神也。如寅木化卯，是進神，卯變寅，是退神。十八。論内詳明進主上前，退主退後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞生身莫將吉斷，用剋世勿作凶看。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338062346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢生中有刑害之兩防，而合處有剋傷之一慮。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338078730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，忌神也。生者，生合也。身者，如自占，以世而言也。如卦中忌神發動，則有傷于用神矣。卽使生合，我有何益哉？况生合之中，有刑、有害、有剋，如忌神生世，兼有刑剋者，不但謀事無成，所求不得，恐因謀而致咎。卽如一人鄕試，于辰月癸酉日，卜得節之坎卦。世爻已火化寅木，忌神生中帶刑，又卯木忌神暗動生世。後至臨塲病出，此是忌生身也，生中帶刑也。害者相同，剋者猶重。又如用神動來剋世，謂之物來尋我。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655684948019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"易就勿因剋我當做凶，看得用神剋世，本是吉也，不宜又去生合應爻，謂之厚于彼而薄于我，則雖用。神剋世，亦作凶看，不可不知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害不宜臨用，死絶豈可持身。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338095114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用神身世遇日辰相刑，必主不利，占事不成，占物不好，占病沉重，占人有病，占婦不貞，占文卷必破綻。占訟有刑害爻，不過壞事，大槩相倣化者亦然。須推衰旺生剋，分其輕重詳之。死絶于日辰之爻臨持世。身用神者，諸占不利，變動化入者亦然。然有絶處逢生之辨，學者宜知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動逢衝而事散，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338111498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"葢冲之一爻，不可一例推之。如句空安靜之爻逢冲日起，旬空發動之爻逢冲日實安靜不空之爻逢冲。日暗動發動不空之爻，逢冲日散，又日冲脫。凡動而逢冲散脫者，吉不成吉，凶不成凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358421786012483624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶逢生而事成。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338111498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大凡用神臨千絶地，不可執定絶于日辰論之，用神化絶皆是也。倘遇生扶，乃凶中有救，大吉之兆。名曰：絶處逢生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢合住，須衝破以成功；","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338127882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中用神忌神，遇日辰合，或自化合，或有動爻來合，不拘吉凶，皆不見效。須待冲破日期，可應事之吉凶。假如用爻動來生世，凡事易成；若遇合住，則又阻滯，須待冲之日，事始有成。此下皆㫁日期之法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇休囚，必生旺而成事，","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338127882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斷日期之法，不可執一，當以活法推之，庻無差誤。如用爻合住，固以冲之日期㫁矣。或用爻休囚，必生旺。之期，能成其事。故無氣當以旺相月日㫁之。如用爻旺相不動，則以冲動月日㫁之。若用爻有氣發動，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655684980787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以合日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338127882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有氣動合日辰，或日辰臨之動，或日辰臨之動，來生合世身，卽以本日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338144266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻受制，則以制煞月日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338160650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻得時旺動而又遇生扶者，此爲太旺，當以墓庫月日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338177034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻無氣發動而遇生扶，卽以生扶月日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338193418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻入墓，當以冲墓冲用月日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338209802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻旬空安靜，卽以出旬逢冲之日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338226186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻旬空發動，卽以出旬値日斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338242570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻發動，旬空被合，卽以出旬冲日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338258954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻旬空安靜被冲，卽以出旬合日㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338275338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻旬空發動逢冲，謂之冲實，卽以本日斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338291722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已上㫁法，撮其大要，其中玄妙之理，學者自當融通活變，分其輕重，别其用忌，㫁無差矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338308106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"速則動而剋世，緩則靜而生身，此亦㫁日辰之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038114338324490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占來人，定其遲速。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605216302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用神動而剋世，來期甚速，如動而生世則遲，如靜而生世，則又遲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605232686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更宜以衰旺動靜推驗，則萬無一錯。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605249070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如衰神發動，剋世比旺，動來剋者，又緩矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605265454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605281838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084579930127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父亡而事無頭緖，福隱而事不稱情。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605298222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此一節指言公事當看文書。文書者，卽父母爻也。凡私事須看福德。福德者，卽子孫爻也。凡占功名公門。公事以父母爻爲頭緖，當首賴文書，次尊官鬼。如文書爻空亡，恐事未的確，故日父亡而事無頭緖。凡占私事以子孫爻爲解憂喜悅之神，又爲財之本源，豈可伏而不現？故日福隱則事不稱情也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼雖禍灾，伏猶無炁；","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605314606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼一爻，雖言其禍灾之神，然六爻之内，亦不可無。宜出現安靜，不宜藏伏，藏伏了謂之卦中無炁。况那官爻諸占，皆有可賴之處，故此要他。卽如占名以官爻爲用占，文書以官爻爲原神，占訟以官爻爲官占。病以官爻爲病，占盜賊以官爻爲盜賊，占怪異，以官爻爲怪異。占財，如無官爻，恐兄弟當權，不無損耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子雖福德，多反無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605314606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483394597"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多多現反受剋，惟占名子孫爲惡煞，除此皆以子孫之爻爲福德神也。占藥以子孫之爻爲用神。若卦中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多現必用藥雜亂，服之無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605330990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占求財，遇子孫爻受傷，不惟無利，恐反致𧇊。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605347374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本究父母推爲體統，論官鬼斷作禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605363758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財乃祿神，子爲福德，兄弟交重，必至謀爲多阻滯；","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605380142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此雖槩言五類之大畧，然亦有分别用之。假如占終身，以父母爻論其出身，如臨貴人有炁，是宦家之後。如臨刑害無氣，乃貧賤之兒；如占禍殃，當推官鬼附臨何獸，或値玄武，卽盗賊之殃財，乃人之食祿，故日祿神子孫可解憂剋鬼，故日福德兄弟爲同軰刦財，動則剋財爭奪，故日凡謀多阻滯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身重叠，須知事體兩交關。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605380142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦身卽月卦身也。其法陽世還從子月起，隂世還從午月生，啟蒙節要論明矣。凡卦身之爻，爲所占事之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084579962895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"體也。若六爻中有兩爻出現，必是鴛鴦求事，或事于兩處。若帶兄弟，必與人同謀。兄弟剋世，或臨官鬼發。動必有人爭謀其事也。卦身不出現，事未有定向。出現生世、持世、合世，其事已定，宜出現，不宜動，動則須防有變，如變壞，則事變壞矣。若持世，知此事自可掌握。若臨應，知此事權柄在他，或動他爻變出者，卽知。此人亦属其事，如子孫爲僧道子姪軰類，或伏于何爻之下，亦依此類推詳。如六爻飛變伏，皆無卦身，其事根由未的，空亡墓絶，諸事難成。大扺卦身當作事體看，人可誤作人身看。若占人相貌美惡，以卦身看。可知矣。凡遇身剋世，則事尋我吉，世剋身則凶。若得身爻生合世爻，更吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎興而遇吉神，不害其爲吉；龍動而逢凶曜，難掩其爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605396526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武主盜賊之事，亦必官爻；朱雀本口舌之神，然須兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605412910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病大宜天喜，若臨凶煞必生悲；出行最","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605429294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084579995663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕往亡，如係吉神終獲利。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605429294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故吉凶神煞之多端，何如生剋制化之一理","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605445678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵卜易當執定五行六親，不可雜以神煞亂㫁。葢古書神煞，至京房先生作易，亂留吉凶星曜以迷或後學如天喜、往亡、大煞、大白虎、大玄武之類皆是。今人宗之，無不敬信。然神煞太多，豈能辨用？合以六獸而言其法，莫不以青龍爲吉，白虎爲凶，見朱雀以爲口舌，見玄武以爲盜賊，不分臨持用神原、神忌、神仇。神槩以六獸之性斷之，大失先天之妙㫖。何則？白虎動固凶也，若臨所喜之爻，生扶拱合，于世身則何損。于吾，故日凶不害其爲吉。青龍動固吉也，若臨所忌之爻，刑冲剋害乎用神，則何益于事，故雖吉而難掩。其爲凶，朱雀雖主口舌，然非兄弟倂臨，則不能成口舌也。玄武雖主盗賊，若非官爻併臨，則不能稱盗賊。也。葢六獸之權，依于五行，六親生剋故也。又如天喜，吉星也。占病遇之，雖大象凶惡，竟不以死斷，因天喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260905513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605445678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨忌神，我必以爲悲而不以爲喜","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605462062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"往亡凶煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605462062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出行遇之，雖大象吉利，竟㫁其","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605478446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶㐁死之故也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨所喜之爻，動來生扶拱合世身用爻者，","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605478446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吾必以爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利而不以爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605478446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢神煞之權輕。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605494830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605511214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行之權重故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"由是觀之，遇吉則吉，遇凶則凶，係于此而不係于彼，有驗于理而不驗于煞，何必徒取幻妄之","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605511214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"說哉！不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾，見其紛紛繁劇，適足以害其理而亂人心","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605511214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"豈能一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一中節耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605511214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢神煞無憑，徒爲㫁易之多岐，而","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605527598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不若生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋制化之一理爲妥。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605527598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能明其理，則圓神活變，","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605543982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自有條。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理而不惑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605543982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親本也，六獸末也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605560366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于天喜、","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605576750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"往亡天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫、喪、車等吉凶神煞，末中之至末也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605576750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605593134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用之者惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸可也，必當急于本而緩其未然。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605593134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六獸","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605609518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"但可推其情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性形狀，至于吉凶得失，當專以六親生剋爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605609518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學能如此，則本末兼該，斯不失其妙理而一。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605625902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以貫之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605642286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜易者知前則易。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605658670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世人卜易，皆泥古法，能變通者鮮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605675054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有龍虎推其悲喜，水火㫁其甫晴，空亡便以凶看，月破皆言無用，","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605691438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367779363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身位定爲人身，應爻槩稱代卜。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605691438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡此之類，難以枚舉。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605707822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劉伯溫先生作是書，取理之長，舍義之短，闌古之幽，正今之失。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605724206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡世之執迷于前法者，亦莫不爲之。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605740590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"條解","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有志是術者，苟能究明前說，自知通變之道矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605756974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其于易也何有？","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605773358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求占者鑒後則靈，推占者固當通變，而求占者亦不。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605789742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不知求卜之道也後誠心是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605806126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筮必誠心，聖人作易，幽贊神明，以其道合乾坤故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605822510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故凡","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605838894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卜易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必須真誠敬謹，專心求之，則吉凶禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605838894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605855278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無不驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人求卜，多有科頭跣足，短衫露體，甚至有不焚香、不洗手者。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605855278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有富貴自驕，差家人代卜，或煩親友代卜，孰不知自雖發心，而代者未必心䖍，忽畧如此，而欲求神明之感格者，未之有也。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605871662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可不愼歟！","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605888046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580028431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何妨子日","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605904430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽曆書中有子不問卜之說，故今人多忌此日。劉國師謂吉凶之應，皆感于神明，神明無往不在無時。不格，能格其神，自無不驗矣。故凡卜易，惟在人之誠不誠，不在日之子不子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上全篇總說㫁易之法，乃通章之大㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605904430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不如此，則諸事難決。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605920814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有志於是者，當先觀此篇。","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605937198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能沉潛友覆，熟讀玩解，此理旣明，則事至物來，迎刃而解矣，其於卜易也何有？","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605953582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之四終","logicSentenceId":"7680038845605969966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820250153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260938281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之五古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708582962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵、潛菴男。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708599346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708615730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章𤥨軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708615730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327260971049"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天道杳冥，豈可度思。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708615730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫旱潦易爻微渺，自能驗彼之隂晴。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708632114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當究父財，勿憑水火。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708648498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天玄賦、易林補遺皆以水火爲晴雨之主，而不究六親制化，葢執一不通之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708664882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如以水爻爲雨，其言旺動驟雨，休囚微雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708681266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然水居冬旺，則雨豈獨驟于秋冬，而輕微於春夏耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708697650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知乎此，不攻自破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708714034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜天時，當看父財，勿論水火也。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708730418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財發動，八方咸仰晴光；父母興隆，四海盡沾雨澤。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708746802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以父母爻爲雨財，動則剋制雨神，所以主晴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應乃太虚，逢空則雨晴難擬；占天時應空則雨晴難擬，須憑父財及日辰斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708763186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438073820282921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲大塊，受剋則天變非常。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708779570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爲天，萬物之體也；世爲地，萬物之也。主。若世受動爻刑尅，必有非常之變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰主一日之隂晴，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708795954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如父母爻動，被日辰剋制者，不雨。倘父母爻動，日辰生扶，主大雨；財爻動，日辰生扶，主烈日日辰爲主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫管九天之日月。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708795954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽象子孫爲日，隂象爲月，旺則皎潔，衰則晴淡，空伏蒙蔽，墓絶暗晦。墓宜逢冲，絶宜逢生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論風雲，全憑兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708812338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風雲當看兄弟爻，以旺動衰靜論風雲大小濃淡。若問順風、逆風，莫看兄弟，以子孫爲順風，官鬼爲逆風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知雷電，但看官爻","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708812338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327261003817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在震宮動，有雷旺相，霹靂化進神亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708812338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或卦無父母，雖雷不雨，父母値日方有雨也，更隨四季推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708828722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節引上文而言，冬令不可以雷斷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708845106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須配五行叅決。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708861490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各有時旺，春冬多霜雪氷雹，夏秋多雷電朝露，晴或逢官，爲烟爲霧，卦得晴兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708877874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼若動，有濃烟重霧，惡風隂晦，冬或大寒，夏或大熱，雨而遇福，爲電爲虹，卦得","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708894258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雨兆子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫若動，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708894258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有閃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"電彩虹。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708894258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子孫主彩色，虹與電亦有其象，故以類而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708910642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327261036585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應値子孫，碧落無瑕疵之半點；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708927026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡應臨子孫動者，日必皎潔。或財臨應動，化福亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨土鬼，黃沙多散漫於千村。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708927026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或父母爻空伏，而世臨土鬼發動，是落沙天也。待父爻出空出透日，方有雨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合成財問雨，那堪入卦，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708943410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有三合成財局，有彩霞，無雨，三合父局，有雨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五鄕連父求晴。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708943410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怪殺臨空。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708959794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五鄕者，金、木、水、火、土五行也。惟父爻爲雨，以財爻爲忌煞，若求晴，最怪財爻句空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化鬼，隂晴未定；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708976178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516187684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財主晴明，鬼主隂晦。如遇財鬼互化，或鬼財皆動，必主隂晴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化兄，風雨靡常；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708976178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父主雨，兄主風，兩爻互化，或俱發動，皆主風雨交作。凡論先後，當以動爲先，變爲後，俱動則以旺爲先衰。爲後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母化子孫，雨後長虹垂螮蝀，弟連福德雲","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708976178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中日月出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蟾蜍。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708976178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月虹霓，皆属子孫，若遇爻爻化出，必然雨後見虹；兄爻化出，則是雲中日日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父持月建，必然隂雨連旬；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708992562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如求晴，豈宜父持月建？若無子孫同財爻齊發，是必連旬隂雨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516220452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄坐長生，擬定狂風累日。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637708992562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長生之神，凡事從發萌之始。如父爻逢之，雨必連朝；兄爻逢之，風必累日；官逢之，隂雲不散；財逢之雨未可朢，須至墓絶日，然後雨可止，風可息，雲可開，隂可晴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父財無助，旱潦有常；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709008946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼父母無氣而財爻旺動者，必旱；子孫妻財無氣，而父母旺動者，必潦。遇此最怕，日月動來生扶則潦。必至淹沒，旱必至枯槁。如父財二爻雖旺動，却有制伏，又無扶助，縱旱有日，縱潦有時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德帶刑，日月必蝕。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709008946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫帶刑化官鬼，或官鬼動來刑害，或父帶螣蛇來剋，皆主日月有蝕。陽爻日，隂爻月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨嫌妻位之逢冲，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709025330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327261069353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占雨，若財爻暗動，則父母受其暗傷，雨未可朢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晴利父爻之入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709025330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發動父爻入墓，而無日辰動爻衝開墓庫，則雨止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子伏財飛，簷下曝夫猶抑鬱；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709041714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻主晴，不主日，得子孫出現發動旺相，然後有日。倘無子孫，則財爻無根，官鬼必專權，非久晴之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父衰官旺，門前行客尚趦趄。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709041714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雨以父爲主，得官爻旺動有雨。如父爻居空地，仍爲無雨，必宻雲凝滯不散之象。待父爻出旬逢冲，當有。雨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福合應爻，木動交而游絲漫野；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709058098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438327261102121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫乃曠達之神，若臨木動，與應交合，或在應上生合世身，必是風和日暖，游絲蕩颺之天也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼衝身位，金星會而隂霧迷空。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709058098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼臨金爻，動來冲剋世身，或冲剋應，或臨應上發動，皆主有濃烟重霧，蔽塞郊野之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦値暗衝，雖空有望；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709074482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如占雨，父空，占晴財空，若日辰冲之，則冲空不空。欲定日期，過旬有望。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢合住，總動無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709074482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父動雨，財動晴，理固然也。若被日辰合住，雖動猶靜，待日辰冲父之日可雨，冲財之日可晴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合父鬼冲開，有雷則雨；合財兄剋破，無風不晴。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709090866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如動爻合住父爻，得官爻去冲動爻，先雷後雨。財被動爻合住，得兄弟剋破動爻，無風則不晴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516253220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎巽互交，此日雪花飛六出；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709107250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坎巽者，指言父兄兩動，在冬令占，有風雪飄揚之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽各半，今朝霖雨慰三農。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709107250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂陽者，言官父二神也。如求雨，見官父皆旺動，而無冲合傷損，當日有雨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟木興，係巽風而馮夷何其肆虐；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709123634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇兄弟属木，在巽宮旺動，刑剋世爻，當有颶風之患。如父亦旺動，主風雨交作也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財發動，屬乾陽而旱魃胡爾行凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709123634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻發動，或變八乾卦，而又遇月建、日長動爻生扶合助者，必主大旱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六龍御天，秖爲蛇興震卦；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709140018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929068068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震爲龍象，若見靑龍，或辰爻在此宮旺動者，必有龍現。從父化辰，先雨後龍。如辰化父，先龍後雨，父爻安。靜或空伏，龍雖現而無雨，化財亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五雷驅電，葢緣鬼發離宮。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709140018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有聲日雷，無聲日電。若鬼在離宮，動，當以五雷驅電斷之，葢離爲彩色之象故也。火鬼亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星依父，雲行雨施之天；木德扶身，日暖風和之景。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709156402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土主雲，父主雨，故土臨父動，有雲行雨施之象。木主風，財主晴，故木臨財動，有日暖風和之景。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"半晴半雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709172786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財父同興，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709189170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻財父母財動，必然半晴半雨。父衰財旺，晴多雨少；父旺財衰，雨多晴少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多霧多煙；爻上財官皆動，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709189170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516285988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動主晴，鬼動主隂。官旺財衰，大霧重如細雨；鬼衰財旺，烟迷少頃開晴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身値同人，雖晴而日輪含曜；世持福德，總雨而雷鼓藏聲。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709189170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡兄弟持世，動則剋財，財若旺相，亦非皎潔天氣。子孫持世，動則剋官，官若發動，雖雨必無雷聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父空財伏，須究輔爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709205554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋日取期，當明占法。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709221938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輔爻者，卽原神也。占雨，以父母爻爲用神，以宫鬼爻爲原神；占晴，以財爻爲用神，以子孫爻爲原神。如用神空伕衰旺動靜，出現、墓絶合冲、月破，當以病藥之法決斷日期。今以用神爲法，原神之例如之，卽如用神伏藏，俟用神出透之日應事。如用神安靜，俟冲靜之日應事。如用神旬空安靜，俟出旬逢冲之日應事。如用神靜空逢冲，謂之冲起，俟出旬逢合之日應事。如用神靜空逢合，俟出旬逢冲之日應事。如用神發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516318756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動而無他故者，俟逢合之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709238322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神旬空發動，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709254706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢冲，謂之冲實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本日應事；如用神發動，逢合動空、逢","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709254706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合及静而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢合者，皆俟冲日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709254706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神入墓于日辰者，俟冲用神之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709271090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神自化入墓者，俟冲","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709287474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"開墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709287474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神被旁爻動來合住，或自化，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709303858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出作合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俟冲開合我之爻之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709303858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神月破，俟","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709320242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出月値日，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢合之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709320242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神絶于日辰，或化","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709336626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絶于爻者俟長生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709336626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如原神會局來生而用神","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709353010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏藏俟出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709353010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如旬空，俟出旬之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709369394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709385778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌神會局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來剋而用神伏藏者，俟出透之日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709385778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709402162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旬空俟出旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之日應事，故合待冲，冲待合，絶待生，墓","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709402162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"待開破待。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"補空出旬衰待旺等法，遠斷月日，近斷日","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709402162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"時故。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709402162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋日取期，當明占法也雨宜察父爻之空不空。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709418546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"晴宜察。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻之伏不伏，旣知用神，還宜兼察原神。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709434930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故日父空財伏須。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究輔爻須字當作兼字解，而古註","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709451314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"疑以占雨而父空，不必宗父爻，當以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔爻推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709451314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占晴而財爻伏，不必宗財爻，當以輔爻斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709467698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以辭害義。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709484082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故子𤨏陳","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709500466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929100836"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要盡其詳，别隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709500466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可推晴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨，欲知其細。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709500466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明衰旺以決重輕。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709516850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此節言其大畧而已。隂陽動變之意。重，大也。輕，小也。以旺衰可決雨之大小也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能窮易道之精微，自與天機而脗合。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709533234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年時","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709549618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂晴寒暑，天道之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常水旱兵災，年時之變。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709549618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲決禍福於一年，須審吉凶於八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709566002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年時，一年中四時事也。國家官府、天道人物，皆在六爻內也。初觀萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫居死絶之鄉，次察羣黎，喜在旺生之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709582386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516351524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬物屬初爻，臨財福吉，臨官鬼凶。二爻爲人民之位，遇子孫，四時安樂；逢官鬼，一嵗多災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三言府縣官僚，兄動則徴科必迫；四論九卿宰相，冲身則廵警無私。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709598770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三爻以有司官斷，生合世爻，有仁民愛物之心。若臨子孫，淸廉正直；臨官鬼，殘酷不仁；臨兄弟發動剋世。徴科急迫，若九卿上司，皆看四爻臨子孫生合世身，必然治國憂民，正直無私。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爲君上之爻，六是昊天之位。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709615154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五爻爲天子之位，最不宜動來刑剋世爻，其年必受朝廷剋剝。若臨財福生合世爻，必有君恩化出父母。當有赦宥。空動，有名無實。六爻爲天，若空，其年必多怪異事。葢天無空脫之理，所以主有變異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應亦爲天，剋世則天心不順；世還爲地，逢空則人物","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709631538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929133604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多災。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709631538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻又作外郡，世爻又作本境看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲逢凶乗旺，有溫州之大颶；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709647922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲乃一年主星，惟遇子孫、妻財爲吉，其他皆非所利。如臨兄動，其年多風剋世，必有風災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年値鬼，帶刑成漢寢之轟雷。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709647922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲臨官鬼動，多雷多灾。六爻無官，年月不帶，或衰絶，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發動妻財，旱若成湯之日，交重父母，潦如堯帝之時","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709664306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若止占年時水旱，財臨太歲發動，而父爻衰弱者，主亢旱。若父持太歲發動，子孫衰弱者，主大水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猛烈。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709664306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火官回祿興灾於熈應，","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709680690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929166372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火鬼發動，主有火灾。若與世無干，而與應爻關碍者，隣人被灾也。以内外論遠近耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汪洋水鬼，玄冥作禍於江淮。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709680690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水鬼發動，主有水灾。在外卦動，他處渰沒；在内卦動，近處河決；若不剋世，雖溢無事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尤怕屬金，四海干戈如鼎沸；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709697074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼發動，恐刀兵冲剋應爻，生合五爻，是朝廷征討。如在外卦，又属他宮，剋五爻，或剋太歲，是外番侵犯。中華。或兩鬼俱動，必非一處作亂，或化回頭，剋月建、日辰，動爻剋制，雖反叛不妨。如休囚動，乃是盜賊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌値土，千門疫厲若符同。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709697074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土鬼發動，或臨白虎，皆主瘟疫。若剋世人，多病死，有制不妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢朱雀而化福爻，財動，則旱蝗相繼；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709713458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516384292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼帶朱雀，動刑剋身世，主有蝗虫之灾。葢朱雀能飛故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇勾陳而加世位，兄興，則饑饉相仍。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709713458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勾陳職專田土，官鬼逢之，必非大有之年；持世剋世，定是歉收之歲。財化兄或與鬼俱動，則當饑饉相仍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莽興盜起，由玄武之當官；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709729842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼加玄武動剋世爻，其年必多盜賊。若臨金冲剋歲君，或五爻者，謀動干戈，擾亂四海以犯上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾沴異多，因螣蛇之御世。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709729842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇乃怪異之神，在第六爻上動，雖非官鬼，主有變異；鬼在六爻上動，雖非螣蛇，亦主變異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在乾宮，天鼓兩鳴於元末；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709746226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇官鬼動，若在乾宮，主有天鼓鳴之異。以五類分别。如金爻子孫或化入兌卦者，有星月之異。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516417060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如當震卦，雷霆獨異於國初。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709746226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼動在震宫，有雷霆之異，如夏秋間無雲而雷霆震也。震卦爲龍，若臨辰或化辰，主有龍現之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮主山崩，臨應則宋都有五石之隕；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709762610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼在艮宫，動者，主有山崩之異，如元統間山崩䧟爲地之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤爲地震，帶刑則懷仁有二所之崩。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709762610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼在坤宮，動者，主有地震，逢金則有聲，帶刑則崩裂。坤卦爲牛，鬼臨五動，必有牛異。乾坤二卦是人。有異事，非物也。如婦生鬚，男孕子，元末有此異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎化父爻，雨血雨毛兼雨土；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709778994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坎卦螣蛇鬼動化父爻，皆以雨斷，雨血、雨毛、雨土，皆元末之異事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516449828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽連兄弟，風紅風黑及風施。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709778994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼動巽宮，化兄，主有異風。元順帝時有黑風，若不化兄，勿作風，斷是草木禽獸之異。春秋時六鷁退。飛唐庫中，金錢化蝶類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生黑子，宋恭驚離象之反常；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709795378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼動離宮，主有日異。如宋恭帝時，日中有黑子，若臨午爻，有火異也。如大德間，火從空降，延燒禾稼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沼起白龍，唐玄遭兌金之變異。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709795378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兌爲澤，主井池沼。若螣蛇鬼在宮動者，如唐玄宗時，沼中白龍乗空而起，元順帝太子寢殿後新甃一井。中有龍出，光燄爍火，變幻不測。宮人見之，莫不震懾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發動空亡，乃驗天書之詐；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709811762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929199140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳上螣蛇發動，不臨空化空，其怪異或者有之。如遇冲、遇空，是詐說非真，如宋真宗時天書下降之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居臨內卦，定成黑眚之妖。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709811762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇鬼在本宮内卦，妖怪見于家庭。宋微宗時，有黒眚見掖庭之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知天變於何方，須究地支而分野。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709828146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇變異之象，須看見于何方，以所傷之方定之，如子爲齊域，丑爲吳域，寅爲燕域之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身持福德，其年必獲休祥；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709844530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲福德生財，剋鬼神也。若得旺動，年必豐熟，國正民安，官淸太平，萬物咸亨之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世受刑傷，此歲多遭驚怪。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709844530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世乃年時主爻，三農百姓，五榖六畜，皆係于此。臨財福旺相，必然稱意。如受歲月日及動爻剋，必多驚險。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358438473516482596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年豐歲稔，財福生旺而無傷；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709860914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫得地，財爻有氣，不空，兄鬼衰靜，必是豐年熟嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬暖夏凉，水火休囚而莫助。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709860914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以財父爻看水旱，水火爻看寒暑，若水居空地，冬必暖，火居死絶，夏必凉；若旺動剋世，暑必酷，寒必嚴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他宮傷剋，外番侵凌；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709877298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"他宮爲外番，無他外宮則看外卦，若來傷剋本宮，其年番必來侵犯，外生内卦，必多進貢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本卦休囚，國家衰替。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709877298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本宮爲國家，無本宮，則看内卦旺相，國家强盛；無氣則國家衰替。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相合，定然雨順風調；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709893682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929231908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇世應相生，六爻相合，其年必主雨順風調，更得安靜，財福不空，必是豐登之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼皆亡，必主民安國泰。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709893682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟乃剋剝破敗之神，官鬼係禍患灾殃之主，二者空亡，或不上卦，必主國泰民安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推明天道，能知萬象之森羅；識透玄機，奚啻一年之休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709910066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國朝君恕則臣忠，共濟明良之會；國泰則民樂，當推禍福之原。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709926450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖天地尚知其始終，况國家豈能無興廢。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709942834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本官旺相，周文王創八百年之基；大象休囚，秦始皇遺二","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709959218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929264676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世主之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709959218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如臣卜，以本宮爲國爻，以太歲爲君爻，嵗合爲后爻，月建爲臣爻，日建爲東宮，子孫爲黎庻，父爻爲國卜。得本宮旺相，如周文王，子孫享國八百年之久。若本宮体囚，大象又凶，則如秦始皇二世亡國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九五逢陽，當遇仁明之主；四爻値福，必多忠義之臣。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709975602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五爻爲君位，逢陽象，遇靑龍、財福，是仁明之君。四爻爲臣位，臨旺福，乃敢諫直臣；臨兄鬼，乃阿諛佞臣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲剋衰宮，玉樹後庭花欲謝；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709991986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本宮衰弱，遇太歲剋國，有亂亡之兆。陳後主𨕖宮女，曲有玉樹後庭花，君臣酣歌，旦夕爲常。後爲隋所滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年傷弱世，鼎湖龍去不多時。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637709991986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳下指言國君自卜。如太歲刑冲剋害世爻，主疾病，或内難將作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622499369"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨沐浴，合妻財，夫差戀西施而亡國；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710008370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆指言帝自卜也。如世臨沐浴合財爻、應爻，或沐浴動剋合世，必是好色。如夫差戀西施之美，爲越所滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應帶咸池臨九五，武后革唐命而爲周。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710008370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君自卜以應爲皇后，若帶咸池，其后必淫，更居九五，尊位剋世，如唐武后廢中宗爲廬陵王，革唐命爲周。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂遇空，虞舜南廵不返；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710024754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦遇遊魂，不宜遷都廵狩。若加凶煞剋世，或世爻動化墓絶，如虞舜南廵，崩于蒼梧之野。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸魂帶煞，始皇返國亡身。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710024754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若歸魂卦遇動爻剋世身，如始皇求仙海上，返國崩十沙丘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子發逢空，張子房起歸山之計；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710041138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929297444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"他宮子孫爲臣，若逢空動，被世剋害，必是君欲害臣，如漢張良棄職從赤松子遊也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將星被害，岳武穆抱𥸤天之冤。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710041138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"將星如寅午戌日，卜午爻爲將星，其餘類推。若將星臨財子，必得忠良智勇；値官鬼白虎，必强悍之將。若將星持鬼，剋害世爻，恐有造謀之變。若將星被動爻剋害，如岳武穆遇秦檜之害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應旺生合世爻，聖主得椒房之助；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710057522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爲皇后，若旺相合世爻，更臨財福，主后智畧仁慈，導君以善，如漢馬后、宋宣仁稱爲女中堯、舜是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰拱扶子位，東宮攝天子之權。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710057522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若本宮子孫生旺，更得日辰扶助，欲傳位太子當國，攝天子事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋福爻，唐玄宗有殺兒之事；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710073906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622532137"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若世剋本宮之墓，絶子孫，太子遇讒被害，如唐玄宗信李林甫譛，將太子瑛、鄂王瑶、光王琚皆廢，復賜死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子傷君位，隋楊廣有弑父之心；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710073906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本宮子孫旺動，剋害世爻，乃太子有篡位之兆。如隋楊廣弑父，目立爲帝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦無孫，宋仁宗有絕嗣之歎；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710073906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中無子孫，或子孫休囚，動入墓絶，必是國無太子，如宋仁宗無子而嘆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四爻剋子，秦扶蘇中趙相之謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710073906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四爻乃臣位，若旺動傷剋本宮子孫，則如秦太子扶蘇被趙高矯詔賜死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身値動官，唐太宗禁庭蹀血；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710090290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身世持官帶殺旺動，必至殺剋兄弟，如唐太宗伏兵玄武門，射死建成、元吉血流禁庭，馬蹀踐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622564905"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世安空弟，周泰伯讓國逃荆。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710090290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世持空弟，與應爻生合，有吉神動剋，是兄弟推讓天位之象，如周泰伯託爲採藥，逃之荆蠻，讓位季歷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶神生合世爻，玄宗信林甫之佞；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710106674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若鬼煞動來生合世爻，必是佞臣阿諛，人君信任。如唐玄宗信在李林甫，一十九年，養成天下大亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君位剋傷四位，商紂害比干之忠。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710106674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四爻爲臣，持財子，而被世爻動剋，如比干之盡忠，而被紂王之誅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宮變入坎宮，帶凶煞，而徽欽亡身於漠北；","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710123058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦象凶，世又遭剋，或動入墓絶，乃死亡之兆。離南坎北，離化坎，山南入北，如宋徽欽被金所擄，死于漠北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾象化爲巽象，有吉曜，而孫劉鼎足於東南。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710123058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622597673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pin
