Yin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾變巽官，大象皆凶，若有吉曜，如劉先主與吳、魏三國鼎足而立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國之治亂興衰，卦理推詳，剖決征戰。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710139442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫不執方，兵不執法，堪推大將之才能。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710155826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀事在","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710172210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事在天，當究先師之妙論。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710172210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀世應之旺衰","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710188594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以決兩家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之勝負，將福官之强弱，以分彼我之","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710188594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"軍師。世爲我，應爲彼。世旺剋應則勝，應旺剋世則負。子爲我之將，鬼爲彼之師。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母興隆，立望旌旗之蔽野；金爻空動，側聽","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710188594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鼓之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喧天。","logicSentenceId":"7680056637710188594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622630441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爲旌旗，金動則閒，金鼓聲，金空則響故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲糧草之本根，兄乃伏兵之形勢。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653917210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爲糧草，旺多衰少，空爲無糧，兄爲伏兵，又爲奪糧之神，不宜旺動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水興扶世，濟川宜駕乎輕舟；火旺生","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653933594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身立寨必安於。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勝地，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653933594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水若動來生扶世身，或水爻子孫動，宜乗舟決戰以取勝。火若旺動，生扶世身結寨，必得形勝之地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母興持，主帥無寛仁之德；子孫得地，將軍有","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653933594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"決勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之才。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653933594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"持世動，乃主帥不恤士卒，上下離心。若帶兄弟、父母里官鬼，須防自變。若子孫持世旺動，将軍必決勝干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622663209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爻剋子，子孫强，韓信背水陣而陳餘被斬；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653949978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世持水動，或水爻剋子孫，若子孫亦動，得日月生扶，可效韓信背水戰而反勝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂象持兄，兄剋應；李愬雪夜走而元濟遭擒；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653949978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄爲伏兵，在内象，動，剋應，乃我之伏兵；剋世，是他之伏兵。若在陽象，宜日間伏，在隂象，宜夜間伏。如唐憲宗朝，李愬雪夜銜枚，直𢷬蔡城，以擒吳元濟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持子而被傷，可效周亞夫堅壁不戰；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653949978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世持子孫，將必才能，可以剋敵。若被動剋，宜固守，不宜速戰。如漢景帝時，七國反，帝使周亞夫屯細柳，以攻之，中夜，軍驚擾亂至帳下，亞夫堅臥不起，深溝高壘，數日乃定。遂破七國之兵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨官而遭剋，當如司馬懿固壘休兵。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653949978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622695977"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應持官旺，彼將才能，我難與敵，雖有子孫動，不能大","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653966362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勝如三國時司馬懿，自料不能如孔明甘受巾幗堅壁不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戰也。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653966362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持衰，福得生扶，王翦以六十萬衆而勝楚，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653982746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身世雖持，子孫衰弱亦難勝。若得月建日辰生扶，可效始皇時，王翦以六十萬衆而成勝楚之功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有衆官臨旺子，謝玄以八千之兵而破秦。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653982746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官父雖多而安靜，子孫雖少而旺動，必寡可勝衆也。如晉謝玄、劉牢以八千兵破秦王苻堅九十萬衆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩子合世扶身，李、郭同心而興唐室；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653999130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有雨子旺動生世，主有二將合謀勝敵，如唐李弼、郭子儀二人同心，以忠義自勵，終能靖亂，復興唐室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二福刑衝化絕，鍾、鄧互隙而喪身家。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306653999130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622728745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩重子孫旺動，皆化入死墓絶空，雖勝敵将，必爭權奪寵，兩相殘害。如晉鍾會、鄧艾領兵平蜀，蜀平而嫌。隙互生，乃至自相屠戮，身家俱喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化死爻，曹操喪師於赤壁；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654015514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲我軍卒，若動入死墓，絶敗應臨鬼父，動傷身世，必致損兵折將。如曹操爲周瑜、黃葢火攻所敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世逢絶地，項羽自刎於烏江。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654015514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爲國主，三軍之帥，宜旺動剋應。若衰世而被應爻刑冲剋害，動入死墓空絶者，如項羽自刎于烏江也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼剋身，秦苻堅有淝水之敗；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654031898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水鬼旺動，傷剋世身，敵兵必得舟楫渡江之利，如秦苻堅敗于謝玄八千渡江之兵也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火官持世，漢高祖遇平城之圍。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654031898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929330212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火官帶鬼，賊寨必近。火爻持世，須防困圍。子孫旺動，被圍得勝。若子衰官旺，如漢高被圍平城，七日乃觧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應官剋世卦無財，張睢陽食盡而斃；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654048282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻持鬼剋世，卦中無財，乃食盡死亡之象，如張廵被圍睢陽城也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世鬼興隆生合應，呂文煥無援而降。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654048282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺鬼持世，乃困圍之象，卦又無財，子孫又弱，世又生合應爻，乃兵少食盡，降敵之兆。宋呂文煥守襄陽。元兵圍久，賈似道隱蔽不援，城中食盡，遂降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外宮子動化絶爻，李陵所以降虜；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654064666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子在外宮動，世被應剋，終必有敗，又化絶爻，不免降虜，如漢武帝時李陵之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦福興生合應，樂毅所以背燕。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654064666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439246929362980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫發動，反去生合應爻，傷剋身世，是我將卒有背主降敵之兆，如燕將樂毅背燕投趙是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼雖衰而遇生扶，勿追窮冦；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654081050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻雖衰，若遇動爻日辰生扶拱合，是敵兵雖少，必有救援。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子雖旺而遭剋制，毋急興師。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654081050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫雖旺，若被日辰動爻剋害，彼必有計，不可急攻，攻之必被摧折，雖不大敗，亦損軍威，宜緩圖之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻暗動傷身，吳王被專諸之剌；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654097434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺官暗動，剋害世身，如吳王被專諸之刺，世剋暗動之鬼，或子動來救，如荆軻剌秦王，不中，自反被誅也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化官爻剋世，張飛遭范張之誅。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654097434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫化官鬼，生合應爻，反來剋害身世者，是我兵卒殺主降敵。如後漢張翼德被部卒范疆、張達之剌帳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622761513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下因之而投孫權也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識用兵之利器，五行卦象併推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654113818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土爲砲石，金爲刀箭，水木爲舟，火爲營寨。又乾、兌爲刀，震、巽爲弓馬，火爲鎗，坤爲野戰類若有剋應之神。宜用此器敵之。如應爻剋世，須防敵人用此器也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仁智勇嚴之將，豈越於此；攻守克敵用兵，當審於時。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654130202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命乾坤定位，人物肇生，感隂陽而化育，分智愚於濁清。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654146586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣富且壽。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654162970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻旺相更無傷，非天卽貧；身位休囚兼受制。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654179354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440209622794281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人生一世，貧賤高低。欲知何等人物，但看世爻爲主。旺相又得日辰動爻生合，必主具人富貴，福壽若休。囚無氣，而被日辰動爻剋制，其人非貧卽天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世居空地，終身作事無成；身入墓爻，到老求謀多戾。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654195738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占身命，大忌世身空亡，主一生作事無成。如世身入墓，主其人如醉如痴，不伶不俐，諸謀少就。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦宮衰弱根基淺，爻象豐隆命運高。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654212122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"葢人之根源係于卦，命之吉凶係于爻，故卦宮無氣根基薄，爻象得時命運高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問成家，嫌六冲之爲卦；要知創業，喜六合之成爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654228506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇六冲卦，必主作事有始無終。得六合卦，爲人交游謙善，基業開拓。冲中逢合後成，合處逢冲後敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動身自旺，獨力撑持；衰世遇扶，因人創立；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654244890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984195091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻不遇生扶，而自强旺發動者，必白手成家，無人幇助。若無氣而遇日月動爻生扶，必遇人提㧞成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時合助，一生偏得小人心；嵗月剋冲，半世未沾君。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654244890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子德：","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654261274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻遇年月日生合，得貴人親愛，小人忠敬；如見冲剋，不免欺凌。如父來合，定得父䕃；兄來剋，受兄弟累。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇龍子而無氣，總清高亦是寒儒；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654261274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靑龍子孫持世，必然立志高遠，不慕功名富貴，如邵康節、陶淵明軰，子孫無氣，是絶俗超羣之寒士也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢虎妻而旺强，雖鄙俗偏爲富客。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654261274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎臨旺財持世，其人雖不知禮義，然必家道殷實，如李澄、蕭寵之徒，旺財有制伏，亦粗知文墨也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持身，辛勤勞碌；鬼爻持世，疾病纒綿。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654277658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇况則財","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654294042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984227859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫能聚，見子則身不犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654294042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母持世，主辛苦勞碌，動則剋傷，子孫官鬼爲禍殃，遇之，則主帶疾，或招官訟。若貴人并臨，則貴兄乃破。敗之神剋妻，破耗多端，一生不聚財物，遇子孫不能求名；一生官刑不犯，安閑自在，衣祿豊盈，大怕休囚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿薄而遇煞冲，奔走於東西道路；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654310426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以財爲祿，若臨死絶無氣，則祿薄，而世爻又被惡神衝動，無吉神救助，是至下之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福輕而逢凶制，寄食於南北人家。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654310426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子爻若遇死墓絶空，謂之福輕，而世爻又被剋制，是受制于人，必主倚靠寄食于他人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子死妻空，絶俗離塵之軰；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654326810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以福爲子，財爲妻，二爻若臨死墓絶空之地，乃是刑妻喪子之兆，必絶俗離塵軰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984260627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴臨祿到，出將入相之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654326810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人祿馬旺臨身世，而官鬼父母又來扶助，或月建、日辰生合，必是將相之兆，富貴非常之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀與福德臨身，合應，乃梨園子弟；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654343194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫是喜悅之神，朱雀又善言語，若臨身世，生合應爻，是合歡于他人，故爲子弟之兆，不然，伶俐人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎同父爻持世，逢金，則柳市屠人。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654343194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母属金，帶白虎持世，是宰猪羊之軰。葢白虎臨金爲刀，而父母又剋子孫之神，子孫爲六畜，故日屠人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世加玄武官爻，必然梁上之君子；身帶勾陳父母，定爲野外之農夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654359578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"玄武鬼主盜賊，如臨身世，乃梁上君子也。勾陳職專田土，加父母勤苦之神，持世者，乃耕種耘耨之軰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030071337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福司權，榮華有日；官兄秉政，破敗無常。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654375962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若得財、福二爻旺相發動，總目下淹蹇，終須發達。若見官兄當權旺動，雖目下亨利，亦有破敗貧窮之時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦卜中年，凶煞幸無挫折；如占晩景，惡星尤怕攻","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654392346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲如卜中年運，或問財福，必須財、福二爻旺相發動生身，或持世，得日月生合，又無動爻刑冲剋害身世，是。必妻財子孫無刑剋破耗也。倘占中年功名運，不可。子孫發動，世持官爻，並無日月動爻刑冲剋害，得日。月動爻生扶拱合，又得九五之爻生合，是必官上加官也。如占生子，不宜子孫爻空伏墓絶，日月動爻剋。之。如有日月動爻生扶提㧞，卽㫁其生扶提㧞之年生子。後卷占驗註明，兹不細述。如占晚景，結局最怕。世爻休囚，被日月動爻剋冲，如得子孫動來生世，當主晚年有子有孫，享孝順之福。如財爻相合無冲，許。夫婦和諧如子孫剋世，世爻旺相，縱有夀而子孫悖逆。如子孫空絶無救，財爻無氣，老年孤獨不堪也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030104105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問夀數，生世之爻爲夀，如生世之爻被何年刑冲剋害，又看何年月傷剋世爻，卽此年夀數止矣。易林補遺定大小二限，小限一爻，管一年，正卦管前三十年，互卦管後三十年，互卦又互管六十歲。後子屢卜無驗，敢刪其謬，以示學者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654392346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內不利李宻髫齡迍邅，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654408730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正卦者，卜卦前之事。如正卦凶，巳前多苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支卦有扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654408730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬援期頥矍鑠，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654425114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支卦者，變卦也，管卜卦後之事。如變出生扶，將來旺健享福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦和同；張公藝家門雍睦，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654425114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占身得六爻安靜，無冲破剋害，相生相合，則家門歡好，如張公藝九世同居，上和下睦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030136873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻攻擊，司馬氏相殘骨。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654425114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"肉。六爻亂動，卦又冲剋，或三刑六害者，必主親情不和，骨肉相殘。如晋司馬氏八王樹兵，俱遭誅戮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閔子騫孝孚內外，父獲生身，孔仲尼父友家邦。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654441498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世合","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654457882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爻爲生我之親，若世能生合父母爻，如閔子騫之孝父母也。若世爻與兄弟生合，如孔仲尼之內和。兄弟，外信，朋友也。兄爻在本宮，以兄弟言；在他宮，以朋友言。看内外應爻，以别親疎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應相生，漢鮑宣娶桓氏少君爲婦，晦貞相剋，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654457882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唐郭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曦招升平公主爲妻，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654457882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世是一生之本，應爲百歲之妻。若見生合，必然夫唱婦隨；若見冲剋，必然琴瑟不調。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030169641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箕踞鼓盆歌。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654457882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世傷應位，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654474266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世持虎蛇臨兄弟，乗旺發動，刑害應爻，應爻臨無氣之地，必主剋妻。如春秋時莊子妻死，鼓盆而歌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河東獅子吼；應制世爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654474266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻剋冲世爻，其人憑妻言語，如宋陳季常河東獅吼之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世値凶而應剋，願聽雞鳴；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654474266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"倘世爻自帶兄、官、虎、蛇等凶神者，反喜應來剋世，謂之剋我之凶，去我之病，主有賢妻。如齊襄公荒怠慢。政得陳賢妃有夙夜警戒相成之道，故詩有雞鳴篇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身帶吉而子扶，喜聞鶴和。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654474266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世帝吉神旺動，子孫又來生扶者，主有賢子，共成事業，以濟其美。易曰：鶴鳴在隂，其子和之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984293395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福遇旺而任王育子皆賢；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654490650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫若旺相不空，及無傷害者，主有賢子，如任遥之子昉，王渾之子戎，見稱于阮籍諸賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化凶而房杜生兒不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654490650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫動變月破官鬼，與兄弟爻相合，或動變臨玄武，或與玄武官合，其子必不肖。蓋兄弟乃破敗之神官。鬼多灾惹禍之宿，玄武奸險盜賊之星，月破無成之神故也。李英𡮢日：房、杜平生辛苦，又皆生子不肖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伯道無兒，葢爲子臨空位，卜商哭子，皆因父帶刑爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654507034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫若臨空地，必主無子，如鄧伯道棄子而不生。若父帶虎蛇動剋子孫，如子夏哭子喪明也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父如値木，竇君生丹桂五枝芳；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654523418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若問子多少，當以五行生成數論之。若父爻属木，則子孫属土，土數五。如竇燕山生五子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030202409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼或依金，田氏聚紫荆三本茂。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654523418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如鬼爻属金，則兄弟属木矣，主有兄弟三人。如田真、田廣、田慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄持金旺，喜看荀氏之八龍；弟依水强，驚睹陸公之雙璧。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654539802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六親類當以生成數推之，然不可不别衰旺。如逢生旺者倍加，休囚者減半，故兄持金旺，如荀淑子兄弟。八人以八龍似之。若臨水旺相，如陸暐與弟陸恭之雙璧。若旺相有制，休囚有扶，又當以本數㫁。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若也爻逢重覺，須現在以推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654556186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若卦中只有一位，可以五行數推，如兩重、三重，卽以現在幾爻，斷其二位、三位、幾位是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動剋親於早歲，兄衰喪偶於中年。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654572570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030235177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動傷剋父母，兄動則剋妻財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化父生身，柴榮拜郭威爲父；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654588954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有父母，又化出父母來生合世身者，必重拜父母身，爲他人子，如五季時柴世宗之于周太祖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化孫合世，石勒養季龍爲兒。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654588954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有子孫，又外宮化出子孫，與身世生合者，主其人必有螟蛉之子，如晉時後趙石勒子季龍是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世隂父亦隂，賈似道母非正室；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654605338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父與世皆属隂者，必是偏生庻出，如宋賈似道是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺官亦旺，陳仲舉器不凡庸。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654605338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻旺相，身世亦旺相，又逢貴人、祿馬、文書生合世爻者，必主異日金榜標名，如陳仲舉，爲不凡之器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984326163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化子合財，唐明皇有祿山之子；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654621722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子從他宮化出，乃螟蛉子也。若與財爻相合，帶咸池、玄武，必與妻妾有情，如安祿山與楊貴𡚱之通也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內兄合應，陳伯常有孺子之兄。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654621722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄爻在內卦，乃兄弟，非朋友也。若與應爻或財爻相合，其妻必與兄弟相通，如陳平之盜嫂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應帶勾陳兼値福，孟德耀復產於斯時；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654638106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勾陳主黒醜誠實，子孫主賢淑，應爻爲妻，旺相臨之，而無傷損者，妻如孟光，貌雖不揚，而德甚美也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨玄武更逢刑，楊太真重生於。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654638106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"今日玄武乃淫亂之神，若臨財爻，妻不貞潔。發動與應爻相合，或與他爻相合，如楊貴妃汚行尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合多而衆煞爭持，乃許子和之錢樹；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654654490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030267945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應位財爻見合過多，再加玄武刑害臨持者，乃娼妓也。如許子和爲妓，臨死，謂其母日：錢樹子倒矣是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官衆而諸凶皆避，如隋煬帝之綵花。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654654490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡月日動變見官鬼爻太過合財，而財爻不臨玄武等煞者，必主其婦重婚再醮。如隋煬帝西苑剪綵爲花也。若本宮官鬼衝剋財爻者，乃生離活别之兆，非夫死再嫁者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎刑臨，武后淫而且悍；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654670874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎乃强暴之神，婦人見之，必然凶悍，更加刑害，臨財爻，如武，則天凶悍且淫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍福到，孟母淑而又慈。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654670874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靑龍主仁慈，子孫主清正。若財臨青龍化子，或子臨靑龍生財，其婦必慈祥愷悌，賢德如孟母也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢龍而化敗兄，漢蔡琰聰明而失節；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654687258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984358931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財遇靑龍，本主聰明，如化兄弟及沐浴，皆主不貞潔，兼不夀，如蔡琰文章絶世，失節胡人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化子而生身世，魯伯姬賢德而無疵。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654687258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動化出子孫生合世身者，必有懿德。如魯莊公夫人伯姬，言行皆善無疵，可議之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而遇空，竇二女不辱於盜賊；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654703642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若他爻動來相合，或玄武、咸池動來剋合，若財爻値空，如唐奉天竇氏二女被盜刦投崖，寕死不受辱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜而衝動，卓文君投奔於相如。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654703642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池玄武持財，若衰空不動者，無碍。如日辰動爻冲之，如相如以琴挑動，卓文君夜奔，相如後當壚賣酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福引刑爻發動，衞共姜作誓於栢舟；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654720026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫旺動，主剋夫。然子乃貞潔之神，主守節之象。如衛共羑作栢舟詩，以死自誓也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984391699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身遭化鬼剋刑，班媫妤感傷乎秋。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654720026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"扇如卦象六合，而世爻化官鬼刑剋，以動爻爲始，以變爻爲終。如漢班姬于成帝始親愛，後疎絶，所以見秋。扇而感傷作詞，以寓其凄楚之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二鬼爭權，水父冲錢玉蓮逢汝權於江滸；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654736410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若有二鬼發動，俱來生合財爻，又遇水父來刑冲，而財爻値空者，必有兩夫爭權之象，父母逼勒之兆，自有守節之操，故入于空，如孫汝權之于錢玉蓮類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻競合，隂財動。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654736410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秦弱蘭遇陶榖於郵亭，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654752794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男帶合則俊秀聰明；女帶合則澆浮淫佚。若六合卦而財爻又属隂者，不動猶可，動則淫濫無耻，如秦弱。蘭遇陶學士也。如財爻與世相合，不可此斷。如女人自卜，以世爲自已，發動合旁爻，亦此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030300713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼弱而未獲生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654752794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱淑貞良人愚蠢，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654769178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡女人身命，以鬼爲夫星，不宜旬空，空則難爲夫主；又不宜衰弱，弱則招夫不肖。若衰弱而無生扶合𦔳。兼帶勾陳、螣蛇等煞者，必如朱淑貞之夫愚蒙不正，人物侏儒，因有斷膓之詩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官强而又連龍福。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654769178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳孟子，夫主賢明。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654785562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若鬼爻旺臨靑龍祿馬貴人，主有貴顯賢明之夫。如吳孟子得魯昭公爲夫也。若衰弱而逢生助，亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卜嬰孩之造化，乃將福德爲用爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654801946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜小兒生長難易，所喜兄弟興隆，最忌父母旺動。若父母動則傷剋，兄弟動則生扶，葢有生扶則易養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨官入墓，未爲有子有孫；助鬼傷身，不免多災多病。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654818330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若見子孫入墓，或化官墓，或化官鬼，必死。故日未爲有子有孫。若遇鬼傷剋兄弟爻，致子孫爻無根，必然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984424467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多病難養。財動助鬼剋兄，或鬼持世臨身，亦主多病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎連官鬼，曾經落地之關；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654834714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫之胎爻臨鬼，或化出鬼爻，或鬼來冲剋者，臨盆時絶而復甦，俗所謂落地關是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子帶貴人，自有登天之日。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654834714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子爻若帶祿馬貴人，主此子他日必然貴顕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇令星如風摇幹；逢絶地，似雨傾花。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654851098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡父動剋子，若得子孫値日辰月建，雖見小悔，猶㣲風揺幹無妨。若逢墓絕，一有剋戰，如驟雨傾花有損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫化鬼，孝殤十月八冥途；祿貴臨爻，拜住童年登相位","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654867482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984457235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫休囚，化鬼化父，皆死之兆。似漢殤帝生纔十月卽亡，若臨貴人祿馬旺相，如元拜住，年十四卽爲相。凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞來攅震卦，李令伯至九歲而能行，","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654867482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震爲足，若遇官鬼凶神刑剋，走必遲。如李魏公九歲方能行，葢爲凶神纒足也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神皆聚乾宮，白居易未週年而識字。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654867482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾爲八卦，首，属金，卦數一，純陽之象。陽主上達，金主聰明，一則數之始也。若遇龍德及子孫在此宮者，必然幼敏如白樂天，生甫七月便識之，無二字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八純頑劣，晉食我狼子野心；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654883866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八純卦六爻相冲，小兒見之，必主頑劣性悍，如晉食我，心野不馴，猶豺狼之子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合聰明，唐李白錦心繡口。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654883866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030333481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵六合卦必然隂陽相半；小兒遇之","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654900250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聰明智慧他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日文章，必有擲地金聲之妙，如李太白之文才也。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654900250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽象陽宮，后稷所以岐嶷；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654916634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽主高明上達之象。子臨陽宮陽爻，如后稷生于姜源，克岐克嶷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂卦隂爻，晉惠所以戅騃。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654916634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隂主卑汚下達之象。子臨隂宮隂爻，主癡愚。如晉惠帝聞蛙聲日：爲公乎？爲私乎？見人飢死日何不食肉？糜，故史以戅騃譏之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍父扶身，效藏燈於祖瑩；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654933018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靑龍爲吉神，父母爲詩書學舘，若臨身世，或生合世身福德者，主此兒好學。如祖瑩八歲躭書，父母恐其成疾，禁之，乃宻藏火，待父母寢，復燃燈讀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440599030366249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君値福，希投筆於班超。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654933018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲君乃君象也，子孫臨之，此兒必志大如漢班超爲兒時，𡮢投筆歎日：大丈夫當立功異國，安能久事筆。硯乎。後出使西域，果萬里封矦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼無傷，曹彬取印終封爵；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654949402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲君値福，固有大志。然官鬼受制，或落空亡，則志雖大，而終莫能遂。官鬼無傷，斯能稱意。如曹彬週歲時。提戈取印，後出將入相，終封爵也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父身有氣，車胤嚢螢卒顯名。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654949402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍父扶身，固知好學，然身世用神及官父臨墓，絶徒取辛勤，必有氣，方有成朢，如車胤勤學，卒以成業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爻動合，啼必無聲；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654965786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440304984490003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五行中惟金有聲，五臓中惟肺有聲，故以金爻爲人之聲音，或冲或空，聲必響喨，如動被合，啼哭無聲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母靜衝，兒須缺乳。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654965786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若子孫旺相，乳必多，休囚空破，乳必少。最怕父動，或靜而逢冲，若非缺乳，定剋子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用旺兒肥終易養；主衰兒弱必難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654982170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫旺相無傷，兒肥易養；子孫休囚有剋，多灾，痩弱難養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身臨父母，莫逃鞠養之辛勤。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306654998554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母持世，兒多災悔，故鞠育之勞，所以不免。葢父爲辛勤勞碌之神，故爲小兒之惡煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遇子孫，終見劬勞之報效；","logicSentenceId":"7680057306655014938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫持世，見必孝順，故劬勞之恩，必然報效。葢子孫臨于世者，以其有親親之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610081831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問榮枯，全在六親之決斷；要知夀夭，必須另卜以推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680057306655014938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一卦六爻，管人一生之榮枯得失，可將財、官、父兄子決斷。如卜夀夭，須另占一卦，可知後卷占驗註明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901342920716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之六，古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181278242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181278242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵潛菴男其","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章𤥨軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610114599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女合婚契","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於前定，朱陳締結，分在夙成。","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181294626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然非月老，焉知夫婦於當時；不有宓羲，豈識吉凶於今日。","logicSentenceId":"7680046577181311010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲諧伉儷，須定隂陽。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889172992052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽奇隂耦，配合成婚。如男家卜，宜世属陽，應属隂，用神隂陽得位。女家卜，宜世隂應陽，隂陽相得乃成夫。婦之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽交錯，難期琴瑟之和鳴；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173008436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如男卜女，遇世隂應陽，世隂財陽者，是隂陽交錯，後主夫妻欺凌，終朝反目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內外互揺，定見家庭之撓括。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173008436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占婚姻卦宜安靜。安靜則家庭雍睦無爭。若財動則不和公姑；鬼動則不不妯娌；父動則不和子姪兄動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655685013555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則不和。妻妾動加月建、日辰，不惟不和，更有刑剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合則易而且吉，六冲則難。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173024820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173041204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又凶。六合卦一隂一陽，配合成象，世應相生，六爻相合，占者得之，必主易成而又吉。六冲卦非純隂則純陽也。其象猶二女同居，兩男並處，志必不合。占者得之，必主難成，總成亦不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂而陽，陽而隂，偏利牽絲之舉；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173041204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世與用宜陽反隂，應與財宜隂反陽，占娶妻多不利，惟入贅最吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世合應，應合世，終成種玉之緣。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173041204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男家卜世爲男家，應爲女家，若得相合，是兩願之象，必主易成，後亦吉利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲求庚帖，豈宜應動應空，若論聘儀安可。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173057588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世蛇、世弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539626019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲求庚帖，須得應爻安靜，生合世爻者，必然允諾。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173073972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173090356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻發動，或空或冲，皆主不允。世臨蛇弟，主男家慳吝，禮必不多。應爻臨之，主女家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妝奩澹泊，如旺動主剋妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173090356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應生世，悅服成㲔；世剋應，用强劫娶。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173106740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻生合世爻，主女家貪求其男，則易成。若世爻生合應爻，主男家貪求其女。如旺世剋衰應，乃恃富歉。貧，用强劫娶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日合而世應比和，因人成事；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173123124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應比和，得日辰合世應者，或間爻動來合世應者，是賴媒人之力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父動而子孫墓絶，爲嗣求婚；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173123124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若因無子而娶，遇父旺動，或子孫墓絶，主無子息，父持身世者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367812131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官動合，先私而後公；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173123124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫占以財爲婦，世與動合，是必先通後娶。財與世爻動合亦然。財爻動與旁爻合，與他人有情財遇合多。亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應化空，始成而終悔。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173123124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世動生合應爻，男家願成；應動生合世爻，女家願嫁，皆易成之象，但怕變入空亡，必有退悔之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合而動象刑傷，必多破阻；世冲而","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173139508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰扶助，當有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吹嘘，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173139508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應逢生主吉，若遇動爻日辰冲剋，兩邉必有阻隔難成。世應冲剋本凶，若遇動友，日辰生合，兩邉必有。吹嘘可成。要知吹嘘破阻之人，依五類推之，如父母爲伯叔尊長類外宮，他卦以外人而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901342953484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼剋世爻，果信綠牕之難嫁；用合身位，方知綺席之易婚。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173139508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如鬼煞剋世，不獨不願爲婚，更防禍殃。如用神生合世位，不但易成，後必恩愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼如無刑害，夫妻定主和諧；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173155892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財鬼刑冲剋害，夫妻必然不睦；如無此象，到老和諧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文書若動當權，子嗣必然蕭索。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173155892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母旺動，子孫旬空，反可得子，至子孫出空之年，亦難免剋。若不空，現受其傷，主無子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在一宮，當有通家之好；若加三合，曾叨會面之親。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173172276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應生合比和財鬼又同一宮，是親上親也。不帶三合，雖親未認；若帶三合，必曾會過矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426717918363699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢財鬼空亡，乃婚姻之大忌；苟遇隂陽得位，實大命之所關。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173188660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫卜女以財爻，女卜夫以鬼爻，爲占婚姻之用神也。若値空亡，必不吉利，然不可執法推。財空妻失，鬼空。夫亡葢男占女，以財爲主，鬼空不妨；女占男，以鬼爲主，財空不妨。如父母伯叔卜子、姪女婚姻，必要看子。孫爻何如？若兄占弟婚，必看兄弟爻，遇吉則吉，逢凶則凶，當從用神斷，不可一槩而言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應財世鬼，終須夫唱婦隨；應鬼世財，不免夫權妻奪。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173205044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世持鬼，應持財，如男自占，是隂陽得位之象，必然夫秉男權，妻操婦道，能夫唱于前，婦隨于後。若應持鬼。世持財，是隂陽失位也，必然夫權妻奪，惟贅壻反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妯娌不和，只爲官爻發動，翁姑不睦，定因妻位交重","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173221428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427655685046323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫占婚，以兄爲妯娌，父爲翁姑卦。有官動則剋兄弟，主妯娌不和；有財動則剋父母，主公姑不睦。若旺而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無制，父爻衰弱，不能敵與，親有刑剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173221428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父合財爻，異日有新臺之行；世臨妻位，他時無就飬之心。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173237812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占婚遇財父二爻帶玄武動合者，有翁淫子媳之事。若財臨世身，玄武不動合者，其婦必不善事公姑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空鬼伏財，必是望門之寡婦；動財値虎，定然帶服之𭒀娘。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173254196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中財爻伏于空鬼之下，其女先曾受聘，未婚夫死，俗謂之望門寡。若加白虎發動，則是已嫁而夫死。帶。孝。若鬼伏財下不空者，必是有夫婦女。如被日辰動爻提起，刑剋世爻者，後防爭訟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483427365"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，難遂百年之連理；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173270580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世空自不欲成，應空彼不欲成，勉强若成，終不遂意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官叠見，重爲一度之新人。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173270580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男占女卦有兩財，女占男卦有兩鬼，必是再續再嫁，重爲一度新人。兩鬼發動，必有兩家爭娶。鬼伏財下。男必有妻在家，財伏鬼下，女必有夫在身。鬼不空，而動爻日辰冲剋妻財，必是生離攺嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫若才能，官位占長生之地；妻如醜拙，財爻落墓庫之鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173286964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"要知男女情性，容貌，財鬼二爻取之，旺者身肥，衰者弱瘦，加虎蛇、勾陳、玄武属土火，貌醜加青龍属木金。貌美衰而有扶，醜有才能；旺而入墓，美偏愚拙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483460133"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命旺則榮華可擬，時衰則發達難期。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173303348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命者，卽求卜人之本命爻是也。旺衰二字，古註以四季論之，謬矣。倘木命人擇于春季占，必發達乎，豈富？貴貧賤由人自取耶？予之屢驗者，惟本命爻臨財福、靑龍、貴人等吉宿，或遇日辰動爻生扶拱合者，固荣。華有日如命臨兄鬼、日虎等凶神，或遇日辰動爻刑冲剋害者，固發達無期。如命臨父母，主好技藝，若加靑龍，主好詩禮，臨兄弟則愛賭好費，臨財福，必善作家。臨官鬼帶凶神，主疾病官刑，不加凶神，乃公門。人役帶貴人則貴，學者宜以類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化財，一舉兩得；鬼化鬼，四覆三番。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173319732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占婚遇財化進神，有婢僕同來，謂之贈嫁遇冲終必","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173336116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"走失財化子，有兒女帶來，謂之他有名，逢空雖來不夀。如化退神逢冲，日後必背夫攺嫁，或退母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173336116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺鬼化鬼，不論進退神，凡事反覆不定。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173352500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483492901"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動而爻臨玄武，須防劫騙之謀；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173368884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟臨玄武螣蛇來刑冲身世者，須防其中奸詐，設計騙財。若世應生合，隂陽得位，亦必大費而可成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應空而卦伏文書，未有執盟之主。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173368884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爲主婚人，若不上卦，或落空亡，必無主婚。如卦身臨財，乃其婦自作主張。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩父齊興，必有爭盟之象；雙官俱動，斯爲競娶之端。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173385268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中動變見有兩重父母，主有兩人主婚，不然，主兩家庚帖。若兩鬼俱動，則有兩家爭婚，多變。若卦中見有父化官，官化父，或父官皆動，恐有爭訟之患。兄臨朱雀，動，必有口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日逢父合，已期合𢀿於三星；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173401652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰與父爻作合，或日辰自帶文書，主成婚日期已𨕖定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901342986252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世獲財生，終得籹奩於百兩。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173401652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占籹奩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當看財爻，若財爻生合世爻","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173418036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又得日。辰動爻扶助，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有籹奩；如臨勾陳，必有奩田。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173418036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲通媒妁，須論間爻","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173434420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占庚帖以間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻爲媒人；如獨指媒人占，又非間爻論，必以應爻爲媒妁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173434420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應或相生，乃女家之瓜葛；世如相合，必男室之葭莩。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173450804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻與世生合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言我家親與應生合，言彼家親與世","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173467188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應俱生合，兩家皆有親也。旺相至親，他新親休。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"囚。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173467188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊眷本宮宮外親。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173483572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀卦象之隂陽，則男女可決；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173499956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽男媒，隂女媒，以衰動旺靜取之是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580061199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次看卦爻之動靜，則老幼堪推。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173499956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交重二爻，或衰弱者，是老年人；单折二爻，或旺相者，是少年人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論貧富當究身命，決美惡可驗性情。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173516340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"男問婦，看財爻，女問夫，看鬼爻，女問男家，男問女家，皆看應爻。若應旺財衰，女家雖富，女貌不揚。餘類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀値兄臨，慣在其中得利；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻如値螣蛇、朱雀及兄弟者，其人慣賴媒妁獲利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應冲合，凂他出以爲媒；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻安靜，被世應冲合起，及日辰冲併起者，其人無心作伐，必央他說合也。間爻自動者，勿如此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩間同發，定多月老以爭盟；二間俱空，必無通好以","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580093967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲禮；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩間俱動，必有兩媒。或動出兩鬼，主有爭競。爲媒須看衰旺及有制無制，可知那個執權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應不和，仗氷言而通好；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應相冲相剋，若得間爻生合，動世動應，須賴媒人，兩邊說合方成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻受剋，總綺語亦無從；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲求親，必得應爻生合間爻，必然聽信媒言。如間爻反被應爻冲剋，雖甜言亦不從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官冲剋，反招就裏愆尤；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻若被日辰動爻，或財官冲剋，其媒必然取怨于兩家。世爻剋冲，男家有怨；應爻剋冲，女家有怨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應生扶，必得其中厚惠。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173532724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483525669"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻遇世、應日辰帶財福生合，其媒必有兩家酬貺。旺相多，休囚少。世旺男家多，應旺女家多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦吉凶，須察精微委曲；百年夫婦，方知到","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173549108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"底團。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圞。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173549108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此章惟論男卜女婚，女卜男姻之意，今術家不辨其詳，凡擇壻擇媳，嫁妹娶嫂，竟不以用神斷，槩以官爲夫，財爲婦，大誤於人。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173565492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况章內有云：妯娌不和，只爲官爻發動；翁姑不睦，定因妻位交重。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173581876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二句可證矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173598260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當憑用神吉凶推斷，不可槩論財、官是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173614644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"產育","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173631028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"附老娘乳母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610147367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"首出，渾沌判乾坤而生；人物繼興，太昊制嫁娶以合。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173631028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻迄今數千百年，化生不絶；雖至幾億萬世，絡繹無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173647412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢得隂陽交感，方能胎孕相生。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173663796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看子孫，便知男女。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173680180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽爲男子，掌中探見一枝新；隂是女兒，門右喜看弧帨。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173696564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173712948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲占産用神，旺相单重爲陽爻，是男，休囚交拆爲隂爻，是女也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主星生旺，當生俊秀之肥兒；命曜休囚，必產委靡之弱子。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173729332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫生旺，子必肥大，異日主俊秀不凡；休囚無氣，子必弱小，異日主委靡不振。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483558437"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無福德，莫究胎爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173745716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神不出現，查伏于何爻之下，當以伏神吉凶斷之，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雙胎雙福必雙生，一剋一刑終一夢。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173762100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有兩重子孫爻，又有兩重胎爻，總不發動，亦主雙生。若子化子，又見胎化胎者，如化退神，主雙胎不收。隂陽動靜，可定男女，一動一靜，一隂一陽，主一男一女，類卦無子。若胎爻又被月建、日辰動爻刑剋，大凶。之兆，一塲春夢，言其子必亡也。子孫衰弱，受剋者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎臨官鬼，懷姙便有採薪憂；財化子孫，分娩","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173778484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽當勿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藥喜。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173778484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼臨胎爻，主孕婦有疾，或財化福爻，則分娩安泰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483591205"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財一位，喜見扶持；胎福二爻，怕逢傷害。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173794868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫占妻財爲産母，胎爲胞胎，福爲兒女，三者皆喜月建、日辰動爻生扶合助，則産母安，胞胎穩，子易養。若見刑冲剋害，産母多灾，胞胎不安，生子難養。如化入死墓、空絶亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎作血神，値子交重，胎已破；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173811252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎爲血神，若臨子孫，或臨胎爻發動，其胎已破，臨財動亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍爲喜氣，遇胎發動，日將臨；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173811252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占産以靑龍爲喜，若在胎福、財爻上動者，生期已速，必然當日臨盆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福遇龍空胎動，乃墮胎虗喜；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173811252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福臨靑龍空亡受制，又見胎爻發動，或被日辰動爻冲動者，乃墮胎虚喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428582483623973"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官當虎動福空，乃半產空娠。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173811252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎臨官發動，或臨財化官，或臨鬼動空化空，或被冲散者，當小産，其子不育之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福已動而日又冲胎，兒必預生於膝下；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173827636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福神發動而日辰冲胎者，其子已生膝下矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福被傷而胎仍化鬼，子當","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173827636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96atdo3a/1-1714980787289.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1%2FAozn%2Fv3shtBgfuN55WRAGartA%3D","uri":"read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96atdo3a/1-1714980787289.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7680046889173827636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死於腹中。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173827636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫墓絶，又被月日動爻刑冲剋害者，大凶。或胎臨官鬼，或動化鬼，必是死胎。如財爻受傷，防母子有難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動兮不利其妻；父興兮難爲厥子。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173844020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄動則剋妻財，父動則剋子孫。如夫卜妻産，見兄動則産母不安；見父動則難爲厥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用在空亡逢惡煞，何妨坐草之虞；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173860404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343019020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父爻發動，本爲剋子，如福爻有月建、日辰生扶，或避空不受剋，故云無慮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻臨玄武入隂宮，果應夢蘭之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173860404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽、離、坤、兌四宮属隂，如財、子二爻皆居此象，必生女。如財臨玄武，或與玄武應爻旁爻作合，是野合得孕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋世剋身，誕生日迫；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得子孫胎爻冲剋身世，生期已速，當以日時斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不冲不發，產日時遲，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎福不動，又無暗冲者，必然遲緩，須待冲月日時，可分娩也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎福齊興，官父合臨，產難生","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎福二爻發動，本主易生，若被官鬼、父母動爻合住，或日辰合住，皆主臨産難生，待冲破日時，方得分娩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177075226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子財皆絶，日辰扶將危有救；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如遇子、財二爻在墓絶之地，固凶，若得日辰動爻生扶，此乃將危有救之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間合間生，全賴收生之力；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"老娘收生，以間爻推之，若動而生合財爻，必得老娘收生之力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官空官伏，定然遺腹之兒。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如旁人及孕婦來占，遇卦無官鬼，或在眞空墓絶之處，主産婦之丈夫巳死，是遺腹子也。如官爻伏而旺相有提拔者，其夫遠出，乃背生兒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂卦官鬼空亡，乃背爹落地；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173893172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦遇遊魂，官鬼値空，若非過月，定主其夫出外而産，謂之背生也。若其夫自占，勿論官爻，以世爻言之，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610180135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻空遇遊魂，主出門後生。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173893172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"産發動爻父兄刑害，必携子歸泉。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173909556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父兄爻若當權，旺相動來刑剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財子孫，而財福二爻又無救助者，主母子俱亾。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173925940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化福，胎前多病；財化鬼，產後多灾","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173942324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼化出子孫，主胎前有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173942324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化官鬼，恐産後多灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173958708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合成兄兒缺乳；六冲遇子，婦安然。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173975092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有三合成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟局者，生子必然乳少；夫占更防剋，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173991476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻若得福神發動，或安靜，得日辰冲動，則財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有生所氣","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173991476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以産母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安然也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889173991476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應若逢空，外家無催生之禮物。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174007860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177107994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以應爲外，家若逢空，必無催生禮物。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174024244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世如値弟，自家絶調理之肥甘。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174040628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄値世衰，則家貧而少將息，産婦必難强健。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽福會靑龍，無異桂庭之秀子；隂孫非月建，何殊桃洞之仙姬。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174057012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨月建靑龍，或月建帶靑龍生合","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174073396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫者必是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男喜後主俊秀聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174073396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子孫爻不是月建日，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174089780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰又無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建日辰生之，臨隂象隂爻者，必是女。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174089780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卜有孕無孕，須詳胎伏胎飛。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174106164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占胎孕有無，耑取胎爻爲主，不看子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174122548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦中六爻上下及年月日時皆無胎爻者，俱主無。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174138932
