","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孕卦中有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580126735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻化出者，目下無胎，後必有胎，惟遇胎爻出現，便爲有胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出現空亡，將衃而復散；交重化絶，旣孕而不成。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174155316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衃，音肧，凝血也。衃者，陽精隂血，凝聚成胎之謂。葢未成形日衃，已成形日孕，胎爻出現，如遇空亡，主雖有胎不能成形而散，若得發動，其胎已成，惟怕變入墓絶，則胎孕雖至成形，不能産育，是亦不成而巳矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姅必逢官，妉須遇虎，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174171700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"姅音半，孕，傷也。胎臨官，或被官爻、月建、日辰刑冲剋害，皆主胎孕有傷。娠婦旣孕，月事又通，日妉若未及。月胎臨白虎，必是漏胎，如遇煞冲，或發動化鬼者，必小産。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶令星而獲助，存沒咸安；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174171700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡胎爻旺相，又有生合扶助，不臨官鬼、父母及空亡者，其胎必成。臨陽爻則生子易養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896781875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隂地而無傷，緩急非益。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174171700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎爻臨隂休囚，而得月建日辰動爻生合，再無凶神刑剋者，其胎亦成，但生女故日，緩急非益也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢玄武，暗裏成胎；若遇文書，此前無子。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174188084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎臨玄武，所受之胎，非夫妻正受也。若臨父主，此前未曾有子，今始成胎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孕形於內，祗因土併勾陳，胎隱於中，端爲迎龍合德。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174204468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎臨勾陳，懷胎顕露；胎臨靑龍，其胎不露。更逢三合，六合必隱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問收生之婦，休将兩間而推。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174220852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占代養","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174237236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之娘，須以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一財而斷","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174237236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如占胎產，以卦中間爻爲老娘也。今人獨占老娘，吉凶，槩以間爻論者，則失于理矣。故凡单占老娘及乳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610212903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母，俱以妻財一爻爲用神，不可又以間爻推之是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174237236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動兮手低乳母須防盜物；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174253620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟發動，占老娘乳母，則主此婦見財起意，又主貪食，臨玄武必濫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父興兮乳少，老娘竊恐傷胎。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174253620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母發動，加刑害，兒必爲其所害，切不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174270004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占乳母亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174286388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發動，乳多手叚更高能；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174302772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫旺相發動，不受制伏生扶財爻，老娘手叚必高，乳母必主乳多也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼交重，禍甚事機猶反覆。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174302772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼發動，必有禍患，不傷身世，雖凶亦淺，一遭剋害，禍不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610245671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財合福爻，善能調護；身生子位，理㑹維持。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174319156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦身與財合，子孫最吉。占老娘慣能救死回生。占乳母，主其婦善撫小兒，乳亦必多也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢相剋相冲，決見多灾多咎","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174335540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫被財與卦身刑冲剋害，最忌，兒亦必被其所害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進人口：獨夫處世，休言無子卽忘情；君子治家，難道一身兼作僕。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174335540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必須便嬖，乃足使令於前；若不螟蛉，焉繼宗支於後？","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174351924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"老而無子，日獨過繼他人之子，日螟蛉，如詩所謂螟蛉有子，蜾蠃負之是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539658787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須别來占，方知主用。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174368308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"過繼小兒，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫爲主，買妾婢僮僕及收留迷失之","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174384692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人皆以財爲主，若窩藏有難之人，則看其何相，人與我識。若如朋友，以兄弟爲主。尊長以父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174384692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人以妻財爲主，類用不宜動，動必難留","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174401076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻發動，其人難託，若遇遊魂，或化入遊。魂異日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主逃竄。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174401076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若來生合世爻，不致連累，主不可傷，傷須夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174417460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象衰弱，而被日辰動爻乗旺來刑傷剋害，更無解救者，必然夭折，","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174433844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰入墓中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擬定委靡不振。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174433844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺臨世上，決然幹蠱有成；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174450228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻入墓，其人性慵懶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰弱無氣空絶，主委靡不振。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174450228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若得旺相臨身持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世或生合世爻者，乃大吉兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174466612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610278439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化空亡，有始無終之軰；蛇合官鬼，多謀少德之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174482996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻發動，變入空亡，主其人有頭無尾。若臨螣蛇，動合官鬼，其人雖多謀，然奸詐不實，婦人不貞潔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨玄武而化兄爻，門戸須防出入；遇靑龍而連福德，貲財可付經營。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174499380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用臨玄武動化兄弟，主其人貪財好色，莫用出入。用臨靑龍動化子孫，生合世爻，主其人至誠忠厚，托以財物則守而不失，使之經營，則利歸于主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢太過及空亡，反主少誠兼懶惰。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174515764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中用爻見有三四重，或旬空者，皆主其人暗藏機巧，反覆不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻生合世爻，必得其力；主象剋冲身象，難服其心。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174532148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367844899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻生合世爻，其人可用。凡有事幹，必然用心，大怕合處逢冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化子，携子偕來；世合身終身寵用。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174548532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占妻婢，財爻化出子孫，有小兒帶來。若動財生合世爻，而化子反來刑剋者，其婢可使，子必頑劣卦身。一爻占事爲事之體，占人爲人之身。若遇世爻生合，主其人必得寵用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受動變之傷，向後終難稱意；得日月之助，他時定見如心。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174564916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月建日辰動爻剋世，其人不可用。世爻衰，必被其害。若得變動日月生扶合助，然後爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與卦身，以和爲貴；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174581300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世身二爻相合相生，比和爲吉，相剋相冲，刑害爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358426431539691555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄同官鬼，惟靜爲佳。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174581300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄動爲破財口舌，官動爲禍患、疾病，故二爻皆不宜動，靜必稱意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄鬼交重，誠恐將來成訟；三合絆住，須知此去徒勞。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174597684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄與官爻發動，或官與文書互變，主日後興詞成訟，縱遇合住，日後亦成徒勞之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在間爻，乃是牙人作鬼；","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174614068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"買賣交易，以閒爻爲牙行人若臨兄弟官鬼發動，必是牙人作鬼爲謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如居空地，不過賣主爭財。","logicSentenceId":"7680046889174614068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼一爻空動，而與應爻相合，必賣主牙人作鬼論財。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139067427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦象兩官兩父，須知事係兩頭；","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139083811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894113947683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父母官鬼俱有兩爻，恐重叠交易；兄鬼一動一冲，切莫財交一手。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139083811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦遇應爻剋世，而兄官發動，須防設謀誆騙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應生世，他來就我；世生應，","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139100195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"我去求人。占買僱奴婢托人等事，以應爲主。如生來合就世我是他，成事最易；若世生應我，去求他，成事難也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和合易成，最怕日辰冲破，","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139100195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如得應來生合世爻，凡事易成。若是合處壞主逢冲，有人破剋阻，要知何等人，以破合之爻定之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相冲難就，偏宜動象生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139100195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應相冲相剋，凡事難成。若得動爻日辰生扶合助，必有貴人維持，事亦可成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896814643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻發動，爲詐爲虚；卦象亂興，多更多變。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139116579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟爲反覆不定之神，亂動則事不定，故多更變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻無父，定無主契之人；","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139132963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以父母爲文書主契之人。若六爻皆無父母，必無主契之人。若動爻變出者，則旁邊有人作主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩間俱空，未有作中之子。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139132963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻爲媒中，如空，須凂人居間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世獲間生，喜媒人之護向；","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139149347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻生世合世，媒人必然向我；如臨子孫，卽係子姪軰人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶弟出，防賣主之合謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139149347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610311207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兄鬼動剋世爻，而應爻又來刑冲剋害我者，則是間來生合，假意合謀，非真心也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139165731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化兄，契虚事假；","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139182115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇父母化兄弟者，決主事體不真，文契不實。卦無父母而從兄弟化出者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄持世，財散人離。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139182115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟持世，必然徒費錢財，事亦千衆。一應托人買婢不得力，更帶凶神旺動，必主人離財散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應若空亡，我欲成交徒費力；世如發動，彼來謀合亦難成。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139198499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應空則他意難同，世動則自多更變，故不成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟因財乏，鬼必疑心。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139214883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343051788"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟持世者，必因資財欠缺；鬼爻持世，則自心多疑，或進退不定，故難成也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四覆三番，事機不定；千變萬化，卦象無常，能求不見之形，自喻未來之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139231267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占收留遺失子女，最怕鬼臨玄武發動，必是盜賊；用臨玄武，或化出鬼爻亦然，刑剋世爻，必被其害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之六終","logicSentenceId":"7680048896139247651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894113980451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610343975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之七古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緖註，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548168227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵潛菴男。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548184611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548200995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章琢軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病症：","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548200995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440842610376743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人孰無常，疾病無常，事，孰爲大，死生爲大。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548200995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占病症，以官爻爲輕重，得病根由，獨發之爻亦可推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548217379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火屬心經，發熱咽乾口燥；水歸腎部，惡寒盜汗遺精。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548233763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金肺木肝土乃病侵脾胃，衰輕旺重，動則煎迫身軀。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548250147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻屬火，心經受病，其症必發熱，咽乾口燥；類屬水，腎經受病，其症必惡寒盜汗，或遺精白濁，類屬金，肺經受病，其症必咳嗽虚怯，或氣喘痰多，類屬木，肝經受病，其症必感冒風寒，或四肢不和，類屬士，脾經受病，其症必虚黃浮腫，或時氣瘟疫類。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548266531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼爻衰弱則病輕，旺相則病重，安靜則安臥，發動則煩躁之類也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548282915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤腹乾頭兌必喉風咳嗽；艮手震足巽須癱痪膓風。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548299299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在坤宮，腹中有病，火鬼必患腹癰；水鬼腹中疼痛，動化財或化水鬼，必患瀉痢。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548315683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼則是食積癖塊，或","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548332067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343084556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沙脹蠱症；木鬼絞腸沙痛，或大腸有病；金鬼脇肋疼痛，在上胸痛，在下腰痛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548332067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此鬼在坤宮㫁，餘卦類推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548348451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇心驚，靑龍則酒色過度，勾陳腫脹，朱雀則言語顛狂，虎有損傷，女子則血崩血暈；玄武憂鬱，男人則隂症隂虗。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548364835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇鬼則坐臥不安，心神不定；靑龍鬼則酒色過度，虗弱無力。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548381219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳鬼胸滿腫脹，脾胃不和。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548397603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀鬼狂言亂語，身熱面赤。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548413987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎鬼跌打氣悶，傷筋損骨，女人血崩而暈，産後諸症。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548430371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢白虎血神故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548446755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武鬼色慾太過，憂悶在心，在本宮主隂虚。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548463139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化子孫，男子隂。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548479523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"症隂虗，葢玄武暗昧之神故也，斷宜通變。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548495907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼伏卦中，病來莫覺；官藏世下，病起如前。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548512291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇官鬼不出現，必隱然得病，不知何由。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548528675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼伏在世下，必是舊病復發；","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548545059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136727924762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏妻財，必是傷飢失飽；如藏福德，定然酒醉躭淫。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548545059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父乃勞傷所致；兄爲氣食相侵，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548561443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼伏財下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必是傷食，或因財物起因，或因婦女得病，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548561443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼伏子下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必是酒醉過度，或恣行房事，夏或過于風凉，冬或多着裘帛，或過服補藥所致。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548561443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼伏父下，必是","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548577827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勞心勞力，憂慮傷神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或因動土所致，或因尊長得病。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548577827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼伏兄下，必因口舌爭競，停食感氣，或有呪詛得病。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548594211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化官，新舊兩病；鬼化鬼，遷變百端。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548610595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中現有官爻，而又變出官爻，主新舊兩病","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548626979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。又如官爻化進神則病増，化退神則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病減。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548626979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出父書，在五爻，則途中遇雨；變成兄弟，居三位，則房內傷風，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548643363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580159503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出父母，必在修造之處得病，若在五，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548643363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻属水，則在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"途中冒雨而得也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548643363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如化兄弟，必因口舌毆氣，或是傷食；若在三爻，必房中脫衣露體，感","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548659747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冒風寒，若化子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則在僧道寺院，或漁獵游戲，化財傷食，或","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548659747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"因妻奴或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因買賣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548659747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已上六親化出官鬼爻，亦依此㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548676131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮爲在家得病，下必內傷；他卦爲别處染灾，上須外感。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548692515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在本宮，家中得病，在下三爻，必是內傷症候，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548708899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外宮外方得病；更在上三爻，必是外感風","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548708899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"邪，上下有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，內傷兼外感，症侯不一。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548708899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上實下空，夜輕曰重。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548725283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在內宮，病必夜重；鬼在外卦，病必","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548741667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日重若卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有二鬼，一旺一空，或一動一靜，必","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548741667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日輕夜重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244242468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動生變剋，暮熱朝凉。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548741667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡動爻爲始，變爻爲終，若動爻生扶用爻，而變爻刑剋用爻者，必朝凉暮熱，日輕夜重。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548758051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動剋變生，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548774435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"反此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水化火、火化水，往來寒熱；水化火，火化水，不拘鬼爻，但有干犯主象者，皆是寒。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548774435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"熱往來之症，卦有水火二爻俱動亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548790819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺火衰，寒多熱少，倘水受傷，火得助，則常熱乍寒也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548807203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎宮火動，內寒外熱；離宮水動，皮寒骨熱。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548823587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶日","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548839971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是瘧疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548839971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上冲下，下冲上，內外感傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548856355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下有鬼，病必內外兩感。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548872739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱動俱靜者，一同受病；二鬼自冲者，適感而適愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548889123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鬼冲財上臨，則嘔逆多吐。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548905507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火性炎上，財爲飲食，故占病遇火鬼動剋外財，必是嘔吐，重則反胃不食。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548921891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244275236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水官化土下値，則小便不通。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548938275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水官化出回頭土，剋在本宮初爻，是小便不通；属隂是大便不通。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548954659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽宮隂象，隂宮陽象，二便俱不通。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548971043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若加白虎，陽爻是尿血，隂爻是瀉血。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651548987427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎，血神故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549003811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刑害，是痔漏症，若患牙疔。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549020195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌鬼金連火煞，鬼在兌宮，口中有病。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549036579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金鬼化忌神，或忌神化金鬼，必患牙疔；不化忌神，則是齒痛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549052963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜鬼逢冲，齒必動揺。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549069347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如生脚氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549085731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震宮土化木星，鬼在震宮，病在足，加勾陳，足必腫，加白虎，必折傷破損。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549102115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼化木，則患脚氣，木鬼酸疼麻木。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549118499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼是𣺯氣，火鬼必生瘡毒；金鬼是脚骱膝疼骨痛，或刀刃所傷類。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549134883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在離宮化水，痰火何疑；官來乾象，變木，頭風有準。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549151267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580192271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震遇螣蛇仍發動，驚悸顛狂。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549167651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮逢巳午又交重，癰疽瘡毒。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549184035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宮鬼化水爻，痰火症候，水動化鬼亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549200419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾宮鬼化","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549216803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木爻頭風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眩暈，木動變鬼亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549216803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震在外卦，勿以脚㫁，","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549233187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"可言其病坐臥不安，心神恍惚，葢震主動故也。更加螣蛇發動，必是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顛狂驚癎之症，小兒乃驚風也，逢冲則有逾墙上屋之患。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549233187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮逢火鬼，必生癰疽。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549249571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇變出土鬼，可言浮腫蠱脹等症，餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549265955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦內無財，飲食不納。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549282339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財主飲食，若遇空亡，飲食不納；若不上卦，不思飲食，間中有鬼，胸膈不寛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549298723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應中間卽病人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胸隔處也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549315107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼臨之，必然痞塞，不通","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549331491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼胸𦝛骨痛，土官飽悶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不寛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549331491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木鬼心痒嘈雜，水","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549347875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367877667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼痰飮食塞；火鬼多是心痛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549347875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化財爻，或財爻化鬼，必是宿食未消，以致胸膈不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549364259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼絶逢生，病體安而復作。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549380643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼逢絕，其病必輕；如遇生扶，謂之絕處逢生，其病必將復作。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549397027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世衰入墓，神思困而不淸。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549413411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻入墓，病必昏沉。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549429795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相有氣，則懶于行，動衰則不言不語，是怕明喜暗，不思飲食，愛眠怕起，懶開目。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549446179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更坐隂宫，必是隂症。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549462563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻入墓，鬼墓臨用，原神入墓，皆依此法斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549478947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應鬼合身，纒染他人之症。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549495331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨官鬼刑剋合用爻，必因探訪親友，病而纒染也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549511715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻属士，是時行疫症；用爻臨應，必然病臥他家。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549528099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世官傷用，重，發舊日之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549544483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427084580225039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺官爻持世，必然原有病根，傷用，必是舊病再發，否則必難脫體。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549560867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身持鬼，亦是舊病。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549577251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用受金傷，肢體必然酸痛；主遭木剋，皮骨定見傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549593635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火爲仇，則喘欬之災；水來害，則恍惚之症。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549610019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金動來剋，則木爻受傷，支節酸痛；木動來剋，則土爻受制，皮骨傷損。","logicSentenceId":"7680055651549626403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529471540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空及第三，此病須知腰軟。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529487924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三爻如値旬空，爲腰軟，或旺相而空，爲腰痛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529504308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不空而遇動爻日辰官鬼剋冲者，乃閃腰痛也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529520692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動空亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529537076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在此爻者，亦主腰痛。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529553460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官傷上六，斯人當主頭疼。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529569844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟官鬼剋傷上六，而主頭疼。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529586228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如官鬼所臨之處，亦有病也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529602612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官鬼剋間爻，或臨間爻，皆主胸膈不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529618996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367910435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌神亦然，餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529635380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動卦中，非吐則瀉。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529651764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻動臨上卦主吐，動臨下卦主瀉，若逢合住，則欲吐不吐，欲瀉不瀉。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529668148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木興世上，非癢卽疼。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529684532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯二爻属木，寅木主痛，卯木主癢，病體。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529700916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣明症候，當決安危，再把爻神，捜索箇中之玄妙；重加叅攷，方窮就裏之精微。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529717300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看子孫，最喜生扶拱合，子孫能剋制鬼煞，古人謂解神又名福德，占病又爲醫藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529733684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中無此，則鬼無制，服，藥無効驗，禱神不靈，所","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529750068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367943203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以先","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529750068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宜看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529750068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占父母丈夫病，不宜子孫發動，動則傷剋夫星，又剋傷父母之原神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529766452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次觀主象，怕逢剋害刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529782836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象卽用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529799220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占夫以官爲用神，占妻以財爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529815604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神類，如遇刑冲剋害，卽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病人受病磨折，故怕見之剋害處。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529831988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得生扶，必不至死。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529848372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持鬼爻，病總輕而難療。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529864756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占自病，怕鬼持世，必難脫體。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529881140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身臨福德，勢雖險而堪醫。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529897524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月卦身乃一卦之體，子孫臨之，決然無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529913908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總然病勢凶險，用藥可以痊愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529930292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用壯有扶，切恐太剛則折。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529946676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177140762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用神臨月建，又得日辰生扶拱合，再遇動爻生扶者，乃太剛則折之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529963060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕用神又値日建，必凶，若有日辰動爻刑剋，則不嫌其旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529979444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂太過者，損之則利也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652529995828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主空無救，須防中道而殂，非獨指空而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530012212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡主象墓絕空破，有救者無妨，無救者必死。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530028596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救者，生扶拱合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530044980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿係妻財，空則不思飲食；壽屬父母，動則反促天年。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530061364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病以妻財爲食祿卦，若無財，或落空亡，乃是不思飲食。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530077748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻動，占病所忌，以其剋制福神、官煞，能肆其虐故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530094132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主服藥無效，故云反促天年。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530110516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占兄弟病，反宜動也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530126900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象伏藏，定主遷延乎日月。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530143284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻不上卦，縱有提抜扶引者，必待其値日出露，或久病，必値年値月病方愈，故日定主遷延日月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530159668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114013219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫空絶，必乏調理之肥甘。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530176052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫固爲藥，又爲酒肉，若臨死絶，或在空亡，或不上。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530192436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦病中必無甘肥調理，或日辰或應爻帶子孫生合用爻者，必有人餽送食物資養。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530208820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世上鬼臨，不可隨官入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530225204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占自己病，若世上臨鬼，入墓于日辰，或化入墓庫于爻，固非吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530241588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻持鬼墓發動者亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530257972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身臨福德，豈宜父動來傷？","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530274356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病以子孫爲解神，身若臨之，大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530290740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父母動來剋傷，仍爲不美。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530307124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父母有制無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530323508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化長生，日下正當沉重；鬼爻發動，病勢必重。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530339892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼化入長生，乃一日重一日之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530356276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136727957530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用連鬼煞，目前必見傾危。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530372660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連字當作變字解。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530389044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今術家以用神變出官鬼者，㫁其病必死，是以辭害義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530405428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孰知鬼煞者，是","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530421812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌神也用連。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞，卽指用化回頭剋耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530421812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神變回頭剋，而無月日動爻解救者，目前立見其危也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530438196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福化忌爻，病勢増加於小愈；子孫發動，制伏官鬼，其病必減。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530454580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化父母回頭剋壞子孫，必因病勢少愈，不能謹愼，以致復加沉重。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530470964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530487348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化官爻亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世撓兄弟，飲食減省於平時；兄弟持世，飲食必減，其病亦因多食而得。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530487348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用絶逢生，危而有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530503732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343117324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用爻逢絶，如得卦中動爻相生，謂之絶處逢生，凶中回吉之象，雖危有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530520116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主衰得助，重亦何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530536500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神不宜太弱，弱則病人體虚，力怯難痊。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530552884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得日辰動爻生合扶助最吉，總有十分重病，亦不至死也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530569268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼伏空亡，早備衣冠防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530585652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此兩句惟言父母、官府丈夫病。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530602036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇官爻伏而又空者，須防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530618420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰帶鬼，亟爲祈禱保無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530634804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日辰帶官鬼生合世爻或用爻者，當爲祈禱，看其生合者是何等神。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530651188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如生合靑龍父母是，花幡香願勾。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530667572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陳則土地城隍，朱雀則香燈口愿，螣蛇則百怪驚神，","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530683956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎則傷，司五道玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武則玄帝北隂。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530683956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽象陽爻是神，隂象隂爻是鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530700340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今陳大畧，後有鬼神章，𥁞細閱之，照斷方是，切不可妄斷有費民財。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530716724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114045987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化父來冲剋，勞役堪憂。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530733108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父母爻動來冲剋用爻，或用爻動變父母不冲剋者，宜自在少勞碌，不然病卽反覆，爻加沉重矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530749492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰加福去生扶，藥醫則愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530765876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰辰臨子孫，生扶拱合用爻，必得藥力而愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530782260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身上飛伏雙官，膏肓之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530798644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身者，卦身及用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530815028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身爻上已臨官鬼，又他爻動而飛入身上來者，或身之前後夾有官鬼，或用爻前後夾有官鬼，或世上有鬼，而身上又有鬼，皆謂之雙官，夾用夾身，大象不死，亦是沉困考終之疾也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530831412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如占子病，吉凶，得恒卦三五爻皆是官爻，午火子孫居其四爻鬼之中是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530847796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530864180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命入幽明兩墓泉世之人，","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530880564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132787746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦看有鬼墓，以世看有世墓，以用神看有主墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530880564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇此三墓出現卦中者，人皆見之，其墓爲明；變入墓中者，","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530896948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人所不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見其墓爲幽。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530896948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘幽明，病主危困。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530913332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或世爻","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530929716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻被官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩頭夾之，或見有兩重鬼墓夾身者，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530929716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得日辰動爻冲破墓爻，庻幾無事。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530946100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應合而變，財傷勿食饋來之物。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530962484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻動來生合用爻，當有問安之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530978868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶財福，必有饋送兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530995252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則淸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訪而已。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652530995252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若應雖生合，而用爻或變妻財","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531011636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或被財爻刑冲剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害用神者，倘有饋送，切宜戒食，否則反生傷害。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531011636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占長軰，尤宜忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531028020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動而逢日破，何妨見險之虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531044404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻發動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或忌神發動，其禍成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531060788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得日辰動爻冲之，謂己冲散，主其病雖凶而不死。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531077172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲決病痊，當究福神之動靜；要知命盡，須詳鬼煞之","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531093556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896847411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺衰。","logicSentenceId":"7680055652531093556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"讀是篇者，不可以辭害義。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494346752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福神者，其義輕於子孫，而重於原神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494363136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞者，其理在於忌神，而不在於官鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494379520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜病，如遇原神旺動，卽使用神空破伏藏者，其病可痊；如遇忌神旺動，卽使用神出現，不空破者，祿命當盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494395904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫藥病不求醫，全生者寡，藥不對症，枉死者多。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494412288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲擇善者而從之，須就蓍人而問也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494428672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應作醫人，空則瞷亡而不","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494445056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132820514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇；子爲藥餌，伏則扞格以無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494445056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫藥以子孫爻爲藥餌，以應爻爲醫生。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494461440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子孫受傷，或墓絶，或官爻生旺，是藥不對症，必不能去病。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494477824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如應爻旬空，醫人非他出不來，定用藥無効。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494494208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動卦中，眼下速難取效，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494510592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占藥要鬼爻安靜無氣，若遇發動，雖有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙藥一時難以取效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494510592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"待鬼爻墓絶日，用藥方始有功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494526976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空臨世上，心中强欲求醫。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494543360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻空亡，必不專心求醫，或自不相信，他，雖請彼看，亦不用其藥石。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494559744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺福衰，藥餌輕而病重；","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494576128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣子孫旺相，藥能勝病，服之有效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494576128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494592512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孫休因官爻旺相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，乃是藥輕病重，服之無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494592512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244308004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應衰世旺，病家富而醫貧。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494608896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲病家，應爲醫家，相合相生，非","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494625280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"親則友，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應旺世衰，病家貧乏，醫必富。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494625280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應衰世旺，反此斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494641664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母不宜持世，鬼煞豈可臨身，卦身與世爻皆不宜臨官臨父，遇之則藥不效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494658048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化官，病變不一；子化子，藥襍不精。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494674432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言官爻化進神，症候不一，或病勢不定；化退神，反此斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494690816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫乃占藥用神，如子孫化進神，而藥有效；如化退神及伏吟卦，不可服此劑。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494707200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福化忌爻，誤服殺身之惡劑。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494723584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢有動則有變，變出父母，回頭來剋，難傷官鬼，必致因藥傷命。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494739968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132853282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨官鬼，防投增病之藥湯；應臨官鬼，必非良醫。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494756352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更來刑剋身世用神，須防誤。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494772736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藥損人或臨忌爻，或化官鬼，皆不宜用此人之藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494789120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼帶日神，定非久病；鬼帶日神動出卦中者，必是目下暴病。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494805504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日辰雖是官爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494821888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不現卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中則不然，可言其病，眼下正熾，必須過","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494821888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此方可用藥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨月建，必是官醫；應持太歲，必是世醫；持月建日辰，必是官醫。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494821888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得月日臨子孫，用藥神效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494838272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨子孫，乃專門醫士，可托之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494854656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世下伏官子動，則藥雖妙而病根常在。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494871040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵自占病遇鬼伏世下，或占他人病，遇鬼伏用爻下，其病不能㫁根，日後恐再發也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494887424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132886050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰中坐鬼身臨，則病雖輕而藥力難扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494903808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身雖臨衰弱之鬼，纒綿難愈之象，或主象身臨官墓者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494920192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父若伏藏，名雖醫而未諳脉理。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494936576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父動，子孫不能專權，固非吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494952960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然又不可無，宜靜不宜動，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494969344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人氣脉皆属父母，故占醫若無此爻，必是草澤醫人，雖然用藥，而脉理未明也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203494985728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼不出現，藥總用而莫識病源。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495002112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼爲病出現，則易受剋制，用藥有效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495018496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不上卦，其病隱伏根因，不知症候莫決，率意用藥，亦難取效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495034880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主絶受傷，盧醫難救。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495051264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象若遇休囚墓絶，或變入墓絶，再有剋傷者，雖良醫不能救也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495067648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132918818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父興得地，扁鵲無功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495084032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母發動，子孫受傷，藥必不效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495100416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得子孫有氣，日辰動爻剋父母，必須多服有功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495116800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察官爻而用蒹，火土寒凉","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495133184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火土官爻，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病必熱，宜用凉藥攻之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495133184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水官爻，其病","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495149568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多寒必温。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"熱之劑治之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495149568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然火必寒，土必凉，水必熱。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495165952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495182336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必温等劑是也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如火鬼在生旺之地，又遇生扶者","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495182336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必用大寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之藥攻足。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495182336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼在生旺之地，又遇合助者，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495198720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"須用大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"熱之藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495198720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大鬼在隂宮隂爻，乃是隂虗火動，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495215104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之症，可用滋隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"降火之藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495215104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼在陽宮內卦，乃是血。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495231488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣虗損之症，可用補中益氣之藥，宜通變，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495247872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗福德以迎醫，丑寅東北","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495264256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占服藥須看子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫何爻，便知何處醫人可治。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495264256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495280640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子爻宜北方醫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人丑爻，東北方醫人類。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495280640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如寅爻子","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495297024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244340772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫，五行属木，其醫是木旁草頭，姓名，或是虎命者，雖非東北，皆能醫治。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495297024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495313408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水帶財興，大忌魚鮮生冷。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495329792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲飲食，資以養生，然動則生助鬼爻，反爲所害。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495346176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若更属水，必忌魚鮮生冷等物，藥始見功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495362560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如値木爻，忌食動風之物；値火忌炙煿熱物，値金忌堅硬鹽物，値土忌油膩滑物。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495378944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財如不動，不可妄言，又忌鬼爻生肖物，如丑忌牛，酉忌雞類，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495395328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木加龍助，偏宜舒暢情懷。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495411712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍爲喜悅之神，更臨木爻，生合世爻主象，病人必抛却家事，放寛懷抱，然後服藥有功。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495428096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財合用神居外動，吐之則痊。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495444480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財在外宮主吐，若得生合用爻，以藥吐之則愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495460864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244373540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子逢火德，寓離宮，灸之則愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495477248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫属火，又在離宮，宜用熱藥療之，或用艾炙則愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495493632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎卦子孫，必須發汗，木爻官鬼，先要疎風。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495510016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫属水，或在坎宫發動，皆宜表汗。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495526400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼属木，先散風邪，用藥有效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495542784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用旺有扶休再補，鬼衰屬水莫行針。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495559168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻休囚墓絶，必是補藥方效。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495575552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻得時旺相，又","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495591936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶合助，須用剋伐之藥治之，若再補，則反害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495591936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫属金，利用刀針；鬼爻属水，而用刀針，則金能生水，反助病勢。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495608320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼忌用熱藥，木鬼忌用寒藥，火鬼忌","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495624704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用風藥，金鬼忌用丸藥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福鬼俱空，當不治而自愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495624704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子官皆動，宜內補而外修。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495641088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177173530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占病子官二爻俱空，乃吉兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495657472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或俱衰静，無冲無併者，其病自愈，不用服藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495673856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若二爻俱動，此非藥不對症，乃是神崇作禍，故曰無功，必須祈禱。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495690240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"服藥方得病痊，俗所謂外修內補也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495706624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦動兩孫，用藥須當間服。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495723008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有二爻子孫發動，用藥不必連服，以其分權故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495739392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或用兩般湯藥，間服之則效矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495755776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼傷二間，立方須用寛胸。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495772160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼動來冲剋間爻，或鬼在間爻動，必然胸膈不利，須用寛胸之藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495788544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢兄弟發動，則是氣逆，治宜調氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495804928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父合變孫，莫若閉門脩養。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495821312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中福官衰静，若有父母動來生合世身主象者，不須服藥，宜居僻静，閉門脩養。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495837696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
