{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五興化福，可用路遇醫人。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495854080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114078755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如卦中第五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻變出子孫，不須選醫，服藥不如路遇，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495870464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"草醫能治，若子孫不現。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而日辰臨子孫生合者意外。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495870464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自有醫生可治也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應比和無福德，須用更醫。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495886848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應比和，卦無福德，此藥無損無益，須更換醫人，方可得痊。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495903232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官發動，子孫空，徒勞服藥。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495919616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官俱動，其勢已凶，子孫又空，服之無益。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495936000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫藥者須誠心黙禱，用何人藥，有效無效，不必說明姓氏。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495952384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜家據此章而斷，自無薦醫之弊，則誠無不格，卦無不驗矣，豈非彼此心安乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680059203495968768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343150092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神徼福，鬼神乃當今之所尚禱爾上下在古昔而皆然，不質正於易爻，亦虚行乎祀典。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557261346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看卦內官爻，便知鬼神情狀。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557277730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼能爲禍福，故觀此可知其情狀也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557294114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺神衰鬼方隅，乾巽堪推隂女陽男老幼旺衰可決。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557310498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡鬼爻旺相是神，休，因是鬼，陽爲神爲男，隂爲鬼爲女。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557326882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾宮西北方，巽宮東南方之鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557343266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在乾宮，必許天燈斗願；如居兌卦，定然口愿傷神。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557359650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎是北朝，艮則城隍宅土；離爲南殿，坤則土地墳陵。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557376034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896880179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震恐樹神，或杖傷之男鬼，巽必縊死，或顛仆之隂人。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557392418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦仔細推詳，諸鬼自能顯應。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557408802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以八卦推之，乾象爲天神在。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557425186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此宮属火，宜許㸃天燈斗愿類，更値勾陳，必有土神見礙；如臨朱雀，定然呪詛相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557441570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎血神，玄武則死於不明之鬼；靑龍善願，螣蛇則犯乎施相之神。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557457954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以六神推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557474338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陣職專田土，鬼爻臨之，乃是土神爲禍類，金乃傷司，火定竈神香願，术爲枷鎖，水爲河泊江神。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557490722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以五行推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557507106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金乃刀兵所傷之鬼，旺是傷神，衰是傷鬼類。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557523490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869367975971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見土爻，當分厥類。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557539874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土鬼隂爻是隂土，陽爻是陽土，或從木化，是樹頭土，臨應冲世，是飛來土。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557556258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月動變者，五方土類也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557572642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼墓乃伏屍爲禍，財庫則藏神不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557589026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻属金，卦有丑動，是鬼墓；妻財属木，卦有未動是木墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557605410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557621794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"修造動土，必然煞遇勾陳，口舌起因，乃是土逢朱雀，此亦土鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557638178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如勾陳必因修造動土以致不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557654562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或犯井神。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557670946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水在初爻遇鬼，或干司命；火臨二位逢官，若在門頭，須犯家堂部屬；如臨道上，當求五路神祗。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557687330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四遇世衝，鬼必出門撞見；六逢月合，神須遠地相干。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557703714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343182860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鬼臨于初爻㫁井神；火鬼臨于二爻㫁司命；如鬼臨三爻㫁家堂；如臨五爻斷路頭；五聖臨四爻㫁出。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557720098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"門橦祟臨六爻，㫁，遠處染邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼剋身，𡨚家債主；身剋鬼，妻妾隂人。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557736482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我去生他卑幼兒童僧道，他來生我祖宗尊長爹娘。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557752866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無生合剋刑，必是弟兄朋友。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557769250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以卦身推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557785634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼生卦身爲父母，卦身生鬼爲子孫；鬼剋卦身爲𡨚仇，卦身剋鬼爲妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557802018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者比和，爲兄","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557818402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弟，朋友姊姝之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，不善終，絶則無祀。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557818402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼帶刑爻，必非善終之鬼，當以五行所属推其何死。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557834786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼不上卦，看伏何爻下，便知是鬼祟。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557851170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如伏父下爲家，","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557867554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177206298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"先伏福下，爲小口類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨日月，定然新死亡靈。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557867554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無官鬼，而日辰是鬼者，必然新死亡靈爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557883938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日辰是鬼，而卦中又有鬼，是近日新許之愿未酬也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557900322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自入墓刑，決是獄中囚犯。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557916706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如未日占卦，得木爻，官鬼入墓，必是死于囹圄囚獄之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557933090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相發動，則是廟神。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557949474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁爻財合，必月下之情人；應位弟生，乃社中之好友。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557965858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財父動合鬼爻，或財化鬼，鬼化財，自相作合者，必與病人私通之人爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557982242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出鬼爻，臨玄武，則穿窬之鬼，變成父母，遇螣蛇，則魘魅之精。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203557998626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177239066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動化出六親，卽以化出者㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558015010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如化兄爲朋友、兄弟、妯娌類。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558031394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化鬼加玄武，必是盜賊，化又","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558047778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ate0qe/1-1715387227445.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=cguKv6syVFdlJI%2B6MaMQ2%2BI1p3Y%3D","uri":"read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ate0qe/1-1715387227445.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7680059203558047778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是伯叔六親。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558047778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加騰蛇，乃其家因匠人造作魘魅，以致人口不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558064162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化官，雖非螣蛇，亦是匠人作獘。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558080546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲鬼臨，乃祖傳之舊例；日辰官併，是口許之初心。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558096930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太歲、日辰俱官，則目下許酧祖先例未完；持世則未酬舊愿。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558113314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏爲有口無心；變財乃不了心。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558129698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齊空則有頭無尾。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558146082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼爻持世，有舊愿，宜酧類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在宅中，住居不穩；官臨應上，朝向不通。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558162466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦第二爻爲宅，若動鬼臨之，住宅不安，常有疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558178850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若應爻臨鬼，其宅朝向不利，宜攺作。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558195234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869368008739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌卦金龍千佛像，坎宮木動犯划舟。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558211618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金在兌宮發動金身佛像；木在坎宮發動，舟楫之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558228002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水土交加，在乾宮，則三元大帝，火金互動，於兌卦，爲五道傷官、三官、天地水三官，乾宮土水互化，遇官爻者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558244386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五道乃刀劍之神，在兌宮互相發動，而遇官鬼者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558260770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三空無香火之堂，怪動有不祥之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558277154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻空，其家不奉香火。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558293538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怪爻四季月，初六爻是仲月，二五爻是孟月，三四爻是，臨父母，必有怪噐。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558309922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加玄武。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558326306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是盜人之物。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558342690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇此爻，動，雖非鬼爻，必是怪事。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558359074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇又動臨鬼爻，然後可言妖怪。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558375458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍遇文書獨發，經文可斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558391842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136727990298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父母獨發，乃祖宗求祀；臨靑龍，則有善願經文。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558408226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇逢官鬼屬隂，夢寐當推。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558424610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨螣蛇，必有虚驚怪異。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558440994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在隂宮隂象，則有夢寐。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558457378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲剋世爻用爻，必夢中所見神祟。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558473762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動入空中値鬼，恐失孝思之禮。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558490146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻動空化空，皆主先亡中有失祀禮。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558506530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在他宮外卦，則是眷属中曽有祀禮不設。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558522914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其位靜居宅上，臨木，家停暴露之棺。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558539298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本爻官鬼静臨二爻，或木鬼伏于父母下，其家必然停柩不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558555682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之七終","logicSentenceId":"7680059203558572066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358440901343215628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之八古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註，吳庠鍾英子燦叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799280169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡鑑升明門人","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799296553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謝朝柱巨材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同較。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799296553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任用淵、潛菴男其龍、雲客、其章、𤥨軒種作：","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799312937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896912947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"農爲國本，食乃民天。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799312937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五穀不同，孰識異宜而佈種；一年關係，全憑卦象以推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799329321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相妻財，豐登可；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799345705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卜。妻財爲農之本，凡占種傷作，先看財爻現與不現有無傷，便知吉凶。然此一爻雖不可無，亦不宜動，動則官鬼有氣，終有損耗，若變出福爻則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡福德，損耗難憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799345705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲原神，最喜生旺發動爲吉。若遇空亡，則財無生氣，官鬼當權，定多損耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母交重，耘耔徒知費力；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799362089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爲辛勤勞苦之神，動則必主費力，收成亦減分數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻發動，年時莫望全收。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799362089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244406308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟劫財，大怕發動，倘得子孫亦動，反許全孰。年時如子孫之爻衰静，莫望全收，又主工木欠缺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在旺鄉，遇水神而禾苗渰腐；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799378473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼爻發動，若臨水爻冲剋身世，禾苗必爲渰腐。更逢月建、日辰動爻生扶，當有洪水橫流之灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居生地，加火煞而稼穡焦枯。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799378473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼在生旺之地，而臨火爻動者，必主缺水，冲剋刑剋，恐有焦禾殺稼之禍。若有制服，雖旱不妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土忌剋身，水旱不調之歲；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799394857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土鬼發動，必主水旱不調，又主里社興灾，否則田禾欠熟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金嫌傷世，螟蝗交括之年；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799394857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼發動剋世，主有蝗虫。若不傷身傷世，財爻靜旺者，不爲害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896945715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木則風摧，靜須穀粃，生扶合世，方許無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799394857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木爻發動，傷剋世身，所種之物，必遭惡風摧挫。若化水爻，或與水爻同發，當有風潮顛没之患。木鬼不動。亦主虗粃。葢木爻乃五榖主星，更若福静財衰，必主秀而不實。財、福動空化空，俱是虚粃空好看之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻坐鬼，必難東作於三春；五位連官，定阻西成於八月。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799411241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二爻爲內卦之主，五爻爲外卦之主。内卦有官，種作時多阻；外卦有官，收成時多阻。若二、五爻日辰刑傷。更看何爻受傷，便知何事阻節。如兄弟爲口舌，如官爻爲官訟、疾病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初旺則種子有餘，四空則耕牛未辦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799427625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初爻旺相，種子有餘，空則欠少。四爻旺相，牛必强壯，衰空則無。空動化岀子孫，或化丑爻，而與應爻作合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303558719"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱租佃他人之牛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻生合世，天心符合人心；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799444009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當以應爲天，以世爲地。應爻生合世爻治田，遇好天冲剋世爻，則凡有所作，非風卽雨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦象叠財爻，多壅爭如少壅；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799444009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中財爻重叠太過，不宜多加埡壅。財爻不空，兄弟不動，而遇子孫發動者，多壅則多收也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日帶父爻，一倍工夫一倍熟；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799444009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母若臨日辰，或坐世上，必主辛勤勞苦，若非勤作，決然少收。葢一倍工夫，則有一倍熟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨帝旺，及時耕種及時收。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799444009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇財在生旺爻上，不宜種作太遲，遲則少一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728023066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知始終吉凶，但看動爻變化，","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799460393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻變財福吉，變兄鬼凶。父化兄鬼，辛勤不熟；父化財福，辛勤有收；財化兄，子化官，始則暢茂，終則空虚。兄化財，官化子，先遭傷損，後必如意。若然財旺化子孫，五糓豐登也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識栽培可否分詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799460393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子位持臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799476777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜種植，當指實種子分占。得子孫持臨身世財爻，無刑傷剋害者，此種是必多收。如官鬼持身世，或父動或財爻動變兄鬼，定主此種無收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世値三刑，農須帶疾；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799493161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爲治田之人，被日辰動爻刑冲剋害，最爲不利。若帶白虎三刑，農夫必然帶疾。世持官爻，亦然如朱雀。恐涉是非。持兄弟，必欠工本，或種作不精，持財福，或得財生福合，皆大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303591487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻逢兩鬼，地必同耕。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799493161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卦有兩鬼出現，或鬼臨應上，動來作合，或日辰帶鬼爻合世，或被兄一合，併皆是包攬與人合種也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父在外爻水輔，地雖高而潮濕；父居内卦日生，田固小而膏腴。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799509545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爲田，在外卦，共田必高，在內卦，其田必低。生旺田肥，墓一田痩，臨木田形必長，臨土，田形必短，臨火。是乾旱地，臨水，是潮濕地；臨金，是白沙地。日辰冲剋，人不顧戀；日辰生合，必是好田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化父，一丘兩叚，","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799525929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有兩父，或化出父爻，見兩重，或卦身出現重叠，皆出兩處耕種。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲併冲七坎八坑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799525929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177271834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰動爻冲剋父爻，其田必坦七不平，高八非低，或六畜傷損，或行人踐踏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽象陽爻，此地必然官斗；則","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799542313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母在陽官宮陽爻，是田斗則也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或空或動，其田還恐屬他人","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799542313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母空亡田種。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不成；否則必非巳産。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799542313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨世發動，其田","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799558697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必有變更，化入空亡，或空合應爻，陳當動賣，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與人主世臨勾，田有更變；坐落胎養，開闢未久","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799558697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胎養，言其衰弱也。如父母安静，若者遇衰冲弱，乃是之新爻闢動之田父。來爻自値衰弱動，新者置者亦若然。父持太歲或月是建，乃是祖遺産業，卦無父母。從世化出自己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"續置。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799558697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財化出者，乃妻家奩田；從兄","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799575081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303624255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弟化出合戸之田，從鬼化出官家田地，不然，乃官斗則也。應爻化出，必是他人之田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變成福德，溝洫分明。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799575081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母化出福財，必然溝洫分明，其地亦善，其田必得高價。化兄田不值錢，或未分析，或與他家之田合叚。若係卦身，則是與人合種化官，其田不美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是坎宮，必近江湖之側；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799591465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父在乾宮，其田必高，總在內卦，亦非洼下低田。父在坎宮，田必傍汀河。父在離宮，田邉遭旱；父在震巽宮。田邉必有樹木。父在坤宮，田在郊外，田，心之田也。父在兌宮，田邉有官溝，或近池沼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏兄弟，乃租鄕隣之田。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799591465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此指租種而言。若父爻出現，看父爻，則知何人家之田。卦無父母，須看伏在何爻，如伏兄下，是鄰家之田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325896978483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若無父而動爻有化出者，是卽其人之田也。如財爻化出，是婦人之田，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶桑旣言種植，合論蠶桑。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799607849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"採飼辛苦，只爲絲綿而養育；吉凶懸惑，因憑卜筮於蓍龜。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799624233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"諸家以水爻爲忌，以火爻爲用，孰知卜蚕以子孫爲蚕，卜絲以財爻爲絲，卜葉以財爻爲葉價。至于水火。何喜何忌之有？倘財爻臨應，或合應，或與動爻相合之財，皆爲養蚕婦女，非絲非價，也宜通變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初論子孫得地，則蠶苗必利；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799640617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占蚕，獨以子孫爲用，如子孫旺相得地，無刑冲剋害，必蚕苗盛利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次憑財位當權，則絲繭多收。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799640617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303657023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占絲繭，獨以財爻爲用。如財爻旺相，有生合，無剋冲，自然絲繭多收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德要興，更喜日辰扶助。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799657001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲蚕身也，旺相發動，蚕必興旺。若衰弱，偶得日辰動爻生扶拱合，大吉之象。惟怕父爻及日辰傷剋。蚕必有損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財怕絶，尤嫌動象刑冲；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799673385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占絲綿，如財爻休囚死絶，或日辰動爻刑冲剋害，必無好繭，亦無好絲。得生旺有氣，不受傷剋，大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟臨身，葉費而絲還微溥；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799673385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦身如臨兄弟，必主多費桑葉；剋世傷世，必然缺飼，絲綿少收。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持世，心勞而蠶必難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799673385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728055834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父一爲子孫之忌神，若臨身世，雖或安靜，必費收拾，倍加勤勞，然後可望。故言蚕必難爲，日月不宜値之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行如遇官爻，必遭傷損；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799689769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼發動，属金，主有霧露，以致蚕多殭死；属木，主門窓不謹，蚕冐風寒；属水，主食濕葉，以致蚕瀉。属火剋。世須防火灾，不然火倉太熱，不通風氣属土，寒煖失宜，飼葉不勺，眠起不齊，或分檯遲緩，致蚕沙發熱蒸。傷等類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦皆無鬼煞，方始亨佳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799689769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜蚕事，一卦無官，眠眠無變，故云亨隹。曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主冲身，切忌穢人入室；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799706153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇日辰相冲身世，或應爻動剋，須防穢汚人帶魔入室，觸犯蚕花，以致變壞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244439076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財合應，必然汚婦臨蚕；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799706153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻爻爲養蚕婦，臨太歲財爻必是慣家。化子孫，必然精製，化父母，難爲蚕苗；化官鬼有病，財爻化兄弟墓。絶蚕姑，當有大難。臨子孫胎，或化子孫胎，必有孕。若與鬼爻應作合者，蚕婦必與外人有情，遇有冲剋，其事巳露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子受暗冲，每遇分擡須仔細；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799706153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲蚕身，出現不動，而被日辰動爻暗冲者，主分擡時，不加仔細，蚕恐傷損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財無傷剋，凡占葉價必騰增。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799706153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"獨占葉價，貴賤惟重財爻，若遇動爻，日辰相生，後必葉貴。或財衰無氣，或化入墓絶，皆主葉賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟入空亡，絲番白雪；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799722537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177304602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如遇兄弟死絶空伏不動，利有所望。獨占絲必好，獨占葉必貴，獨占蚕反不旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福身臨已午，繭積黃金。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799722537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡養春蚕，在清明後收蚕苗，立夏後收絲繭，比時末、春、夏初，最宜子孫臨已午二爻。已午者，言其旺相也。若子孫與財會局，大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動化財，不枉許多辛苦；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799738921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父動剋子，此非吉兆。如化財爻，回頭剋制，不能傷剋子孫矣。故日不枉許多辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官興變福，亦遭幾度虚驚。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799738921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼發動，育蚕必有損耗。若化子孫，回頭剋制，庻無幾事，然亦有虛驚。如買出火蚕養，比自收蚕苗更好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦出乾宮，若養夏蠶偏吉利；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799755305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303689791"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蚕有春蚕、夏蚕。春蚕者，俗名頭蚕也，清明後收蚕苗，立夏後收絲繭。夏蚕者，俗名二蚕也，芒種後敢蚕苗。夏至後收絲繭，比時夏火炎炎，如得子孫爻属水，反吉。因乾、兌二宮子孫属水，故日若養夏蚕偏吉利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母居刑地，如言蚕室定崩摧。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799755305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蚕房以父母論，生旺有氣，修治整齊，死絶刑害，崩摧破敗，帶水自刑，蚕室必漏水化父，父化水，皆作前㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶絸獻功，三合會財局而旺相；卦宮定位，六爻","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799771689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隨動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜以推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799771689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有三合，最怕會成父官局，大爲不利。葢會局之爻，不論四時，皆爲五論。如會父局，則傷子孫，如會鬼局。則傷兄弟。兄弟乃子孫之原神也，故占蚕得三合財福二局，可作十分吉㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799788073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728088602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道形萬物，理總歸於一心；易盡三才，占豈遺乎六畜。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799788073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟能精以察之，自得明而蓍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799804457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占六畜，不可以其本命論之，當以指實一畜而卜，以子孫爻爲用神，以財爻爲身價斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命在福神，若遇興隆須長養；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799820841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禽虫六畜之命，皆属子孫旺相，有氣不空，必然長養易大。休囚墓絶，決然不濟。若不上卦，或落空亡，皆不可畜養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利歸財位，如逢囚死定輕微。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799820841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵此占惟牛馬爲力，其他爲利而占，然力與利同歸財爻，如逢休囚墓絶，財利必薄，氣力不多，旺相方爲大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303722559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者不可相無，一般皆宜出現。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799837225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無福則難養，無財則利少。財福不空俱出現，六畜相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺福衰，雖瘦弱而善走；財空福動，總遲鈍而可觀。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799853609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占牛馬等物，子孫爻旺相主肥，休囚主瘦，動則强健。財爻旺相，則主有力，又主善走，後亦有力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若空亡，雖利暫時無遠力；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799869993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻發動，但不宜化入空亡，必無久逺力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福臨刑害，若非𪙿鼻定凋疤。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799869993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爻帶刑敗等爻，其畜主有破相𪙿音葉，缺齒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相合相生，必主調良且善；相冲相剋，定然頑劣不馴。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799886377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177337370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫生合世爻，六畜馴善，于我有益。若來形冲剋害，必主性劣不馴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知蹄足身形，須看臨持八卦，欲别靑黃白黑，須叅生剋六神。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799902761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾爲頭，坎爲耳，震爲前足，艮爲後足，巽爲腰，離爲目，坤爲腹，兌爲口，靑龍色靑，白虎色白，朱雀色赤，玄武。色黑，勾陳、螣蛇色黃。凡占以子孫所臨爲本身顔色，以他動來生剋者㫁。别處有異色。如子孫臨玄武在乾宮而被坤宮動剋之，乃是黑身黃足。若被艮宮自虎動剋，可言黃身白足。他倣此。凡剋處多，干生處衰。處少，于旺處，自宜通變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽有雌雄牝牡之分；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799919145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禽曰：雖雄獸白化牡，以予孫属隂属陽，如陽爻干孫，古牛爲牡，占馬爲雄之類也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303755327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養爲駒犢羔雛之類。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799919145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬子日駒，牛子日犢，羊子日羔，雞、鴨子日雛。凡遇子孫之貽養臨一世爻上，必是此類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身坐子胎，必是受胎之六畜；如子孫之胎爻臨干身爻上，則是有胎之畜。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799935529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化出胎爻，亦是。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799951913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福臨鬼墓，須知有病於一身；福臨鬼墓，畜必有病，或被鬼冲，皆主有病也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799968297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動有傷，子絕則徒爲勞碌；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799984681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母發動，則傷子孫，六畜必有損失。更子孫受絶無氣，必主死亡，牧養亦徒勞䂹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄興不長，福興則反有生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042799984681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358435214177370138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟發動，六畜不長。若得子孫亦動財爻，則反叨其生扶，主易養利厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若空亡，到底終須失望；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800001065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻空亡，必不稱意，畜之亦有始無終。逢金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺當慮嚙","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800001065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土交重，須憂病染。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800001065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼發動，有蹼脾之患；若剋世爻，必難觸犯。世絕爻，必吏被傷人。木鬼發動，主有結草之病；水鬼發動，主有寒病，火鬼發動，必主畏熱；土鬼發動，須防瘟病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官加蛇雀，必因成訟成驚；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800017449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日帶螣蛇，發動異日，此畜必有怪異驚駭。若臨朱雀，必致口舌爭訟。臨玄武，防偷盜；臨白虎，防跌蹼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子變兄財，可驗食粗食細。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800017449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303788095"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫化出兄弟，主口嬌食細；化出財爻，主食粗口襍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財連兄弟，乃芻豢之失時；","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800033833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子化兄是口嬌不食，財化兄乃人之豢養夫時，以致飢餓，非不食也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子化父爻，必勞心之太過。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800033833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫發動，其畜必良。若化父回頭來剋，是人不愛惜，過勞其力，以致于傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福連官鬼，須防竊取之人；鬼化子孫，恐是盜來之畜。","logicSentenceId":"7680045042800050217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫化鬼，日後必被人盜，否則病死。若官化子，恐人盜來者，生合世必有利，冲剋世必有害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官兄交變，難逃口舌之相侵，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410095635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中鬼變兄，或官兄俱動，必因此畜起是非口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728121370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月並。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，豈免死亡於不測。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410095635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰、月建動爻俱來刑剋子孫，不免病死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若占置買，亦宜福動生身，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410112019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占置買六畜，子孫發動，出産必合，多要來世爻生，必然好買易成，與世冲剋，定難置買。若問。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利時最怕；財興化絕，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410112019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻出現，不空有氣，持世生合，世不受不變兄傷鬼卽剋爲有利，或化絶化剋，皆主無利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或賭或闘，皆宜世旺財興，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410112019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"北人好闘鹌鶉，雞羊，南人促。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"織黃頭。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410112019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇占此，要世","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410128403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻有氣剋應，子孫發動，卽是我勝。得月刑剋應爻勝建，亦日辰若動，世爻被應剋，子孫空伏官。鬼發動日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月動爻，反來刑剋，必是他勝；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410128403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303820863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或獵或漁，總怕應空福絕。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410128403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占漁獵，要應生世福神旺相，生合世身爲吉。倘或空絕，不能得意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乳抱者宜胎福生旺而無傷；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410144787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占畜養母猪羊，要胎、福二爻生旺，不受刑剋，便無損害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"醫治者要父官衰絕而有制","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410144787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六畜有病，占醫治療，要子孫旺相有氣，不遭刑剋，而父母官鬼休囚墓絶，或雖動而有制者無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求名。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410144787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書讀五車，固欲致身於廊廟；胸藏萬卷，肯甘遯跡於丘園。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410161171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要相國家，當詳易卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410177555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻旺相，文成擲地；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410193939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480818909194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼位興隆，家報泥金喜捷。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410193939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占功名，以父爻爲文章，鬼爲官職。二者一卦之主，傷，一則不成。若父爻旺相，文章必佳，官鬼得地，功名。有望泥金喜報，總言金榜題名，功名成就之意，非以鬼爲音信也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若交重，休望靑錢之中選；福如發動，難期金榜之題名。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410210323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"惟卜功名，以財福反爲惡煞，葢財能剋父，子能剋鬼故也。如財爻持世，若得官動來生，而財無忌也。子孫固爲忌客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟同經，乃奪標之惡客；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410226707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"同類者爲兄弟，求名見之，乃是與我同經之人。如遇發動，或月建、日辰俱帶兄弟，則同經者多，必能奪我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244471844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之標總大象，可成名，亦落後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰輔德，實勸駕之良朋。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410226707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如父母官鬼無氣，若得日辰扶起，剋制惡煞，仍舊有望，故曰輔德。或世爻衰靜空亡，得日辰生扶冲實，主。有親友資助盤費，輔其前往求名也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩用相冲，題目生疎而不熟；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410243091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以官父爲用爻，喜合而不喜冲，若見官父相冲，主出題生澁不熟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻競發，功名恍惚以難成。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410243091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六爻皆喜安靜，止要父母官鬼有氣不空，月建日辰不來傷剋則吉。凡動則有變，變出之爻又有死墓絶。空、刑剋等論，皆爲破敗。故凡亂動卦，其大槩不吉可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728154138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月剋文書，程式背而不中；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410259475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父旺而得動爻日辰生合，其文字字錦繡；妻財傷剋，必多破綻；月建冲剋，其文必不中試官之程式也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世傷官鬼，仕路窒而不通。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410259475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、乃求名之人，若持官鬼，或得官鬼生合，功名有望；若臨子孫，則剋制官鬼，是仕路未通，徒去求謀無濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財助鬼父爻空，可圖僥倖；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410275859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母空亡，若得財爻發動，生扶官鬼，僥倖可成。若財官兩動，而父爻旬空，反不宜也。父爻不空，有望。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德變官身位合，亦忝科名。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410275859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正卦無官，若得子孫變出官鬼，與世身生合得文書有氣，功名有望，但不能高中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出現無情，難遂靑雲之志；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410292243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441320303853631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中官父若不臨持身世而反臨應爻，或發動而反生他爻，不來生合世身，或破壞墓絶，皆謂出垷無情。雖在卦中，與我無益，所以難遂靑雲之志也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏藏有用，終辭白屋之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410292243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻不現，但觀其所伏何處，如得有用之官爻，俟値年當辭白屋矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建剋身當被責；財如生世必幇糧。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410308627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月建若在身爻發動，刑剋世爻，而官父失時者，必遭杖責。卦中官爻持世，而財爻發動，生合世爻者，必有幇糧之喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父官三合相逢，連科及第；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410325011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦有三合，㑹成官局者，必主連科及第，㑹成父局亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325897011251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎二爻俱動，一舉成名。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410325011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靑龍白虎，俱在卦中，動來生合世爻，必中魁𨕖。若持官父，或持身世，尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺化生身之鬼，恐發靑衣；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410341395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以丁孫爲煞，乗旺發動，必遭斥退。若得化鬼爻生世，終不脫白，無過降靑衣而已。卦有財動，合住子孫，可。用資財謀幹，能復舊職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲加有氣之官，終登黃甲，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410341395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲之爻，最喜有情，若臨鬼爻，是人臣面君之象，更得生旺有氣，必然名姓高標。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病阻試期。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410341395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無故。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410357779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空臨於世位，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410374163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻日辰來傷世爻，而世爻落空，大凶之象。試前占去不成，强去終不利，輕則病，重則死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147551870995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜添塲屋，有情；龍合於","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410374163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身爻若大象旣吉，更得龍動生合世身，不但名成，必然别有喜事，空動出空之月日見喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財伏逢空，行糧必乏；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410374163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六一、無財伏財，又居空地，必乏行糧，盤纒欠缺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身興變鬼，來試方成。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410374163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦遇不成之兆，而得身世爻變，官鬼有氣，而父母不一者，下科可中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦値六冲，此去難題雁塔；爻逢六合，這回必","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410390547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占鰲頭。占功名，得六冲卦必難求，六合卦必易得也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺官衰，可惜劉蕡之下第；父衰官旺，堪嗟張奭之","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410390547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728186906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登科。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410390547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母官鬼皆宜有氣無損，功名可成。若父爻旺相，官鬼空亡，或不上卦，文字雖好，不能中式，如劉蕡之錦。繡文章，竟不登科也。若父爻衰弱，得官爻旺動扶起文書，文字雖平常，可許成名。如張奭之文章雖欠精。美反，登高第也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應合日生，必資鶚薦；動傷日剋，還守雞窓。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410406931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父官化絶，名必不成。若應爻動爻，或月建、日辰扶起官鬼，必須凂人推薦，或用財買求可成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動化空，用旺則豹變翻成蝴蝶；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410423315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若得必中之卦，如遇世爻發動，變入墓絶，恐名成後不能享福。游魂死干途中，歸魂卦到家而死，墓絶是。太歲踰年而死也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147551903763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身官化鬼，月扶則鹏程連歩蟾","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410423315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宮。卦身爲事體功名，尤宜一之，怕臨財福。如得官爻臨之，必有成望。更若發動化官爻而得月建生合者，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主連科及第。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410423315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更詳本主之爻神，方論其人之命運。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410439699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本主者，本人之主爻也。自占以世爻論。占子姪看子孫爻類，此爻最怕傷剋變壞，如此捜索，吉凶自應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖賦數言，總論窮通之得失；再將八卦重推","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410456083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"致用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410456083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仕宦爲國求賢，治民之本；致身輔相，祿養爲先。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410472467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410488851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439136728219674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必得千鍾之粟；興隆官鬼，定居一品之尊。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410488851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未仕求名不要財。一已仕貴人要見財爻。葢有爵必有祿，未有無俸而得官者。故凡占官員，得此爻旺相。俸祿必多。若財爻休囚，或空或伏，未得俸祿；財動逢冲，因事減俸。或日辰月建冲財，而刑害世爻及官爻。者，恐有停俸罷職之患。官鬼旺相，官高爵大；休囚死絶，官小職卑。若發動生合世爻，或得月建、日辰生扶。必有陞擢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子若交重，當慮剥官削職；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410505235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫若在卦中發動，所謀必不遂意，已任者恐有褫職之禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄如發動，須防減俸除糧。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410505235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟發動，不免費財，多招誹謗。如與子孫□發，或化子孫，必有除糧減俸之事。持身臨世，皆不吉利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147551936531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母空亡，休望差除宣勅；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410521619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爻爲印緩，文書、誥牒、宣勅、奏疏、表章。卦中不可無，宜旺不宜衰，扶世最吉。若持太歲有氣，生合世爻。主有朝廷宣召，如加月建，乃上司奨勵之類，若空亡，則休望也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻隱伏，莫思爵位陞遷。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410521619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻臨持身世，或動來生合世爻，不受月建、日辰冲剋者，凡有謀望，必然稱意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建生身，當際風雲之會；歲君合世，必承雨露之恩。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410538003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲乃君象，月建是執政之官，若得生合世身，必有好處，惟怕冲剋世身，必遭貶謫。如月建扶出官爻，世爻者，必是風憲之職。太歲加父母，扶出官爻及世爻者，必有天恩，更得生旺尤美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動逢空，官居不久；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410554387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480818941962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若是出廵之職，世動逢空，反利已任，遇日辰動爻相冲，必不久任政事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身空無救，命盡當危。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410554387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世臨無救之空，不拘巳任、未任，必有大難，甚至死亡。若欲求謀幹事，則主不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化福冲當代職，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410570771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出廵官宜鬼爻發動，牧守官宜官爻安静，若鬼動化子，必有别官替代。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨虎動必丁憂。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410570771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占官不可無財，亦不可發動。若鬼爻無氣，而得動財扶起，必須用財謀幹，方得陞遷。若父母衰弱而遇此爻加臨自虎旺動者，必有丁夏之事。日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲剋定然誹謗之多招。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410587155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147551969299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰刑冲剋世，必招誹謗。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410603539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依五","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410619923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一推之如帶兄弟因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪賄賂，或徵科太急；帶財爻","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410619923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"因財賦不起，帶子孫嗜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒好游，怠於政事；帶父母因","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410619923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事繁劇，不能料理帶官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼非酷刑，則同僚不協。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410619923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若世臨月","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410636307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"建雖有誹謗，不能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲害，鬼煞傷身，因見災殃之不免。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410636307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼動來生合世者，爲用神；如動來剋傷世爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410652691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞生扶合世，必有進取之兆；刑冲剋世，必有凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410652691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄爻化鬼無情，同僚不恊。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410669075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟爲僚属，卦中鬼動，化出兄弟冲剋世","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410685459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻主同僚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不和，或兄弟刑害傷世皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410685459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋兄爻是我欺。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410701843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"他也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲加刑不順，貶責難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410718227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲動傷世爻，必遭貶責，更加刑害虎蛇，必有鎖鈕擒拿之辱也。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410734611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480818974730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦靜世空，退休之兆；身空煞動，避禍之徴。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410750995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已任世爻空亡，若六爻安静，日月歲君來傷，乃是休官之象。若動鬼同日月、歲君傷剋世爻者，如世爻旬空，急宜避之，可免禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身邉伏鬼若非空，頭上烏紗終不脫；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410767379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或得鬼爻臨身持世，或本宮鬼伏一下，雖見責罰，官職猶在。若不臨持身世，或不伏于世下，或雖伏仍遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡者必遭黜革。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410767379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財空鬼動，聲名震而嚢篋空虚；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410783763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡得官動生合世爻，日月動變，又無冲剋者，爲官必有聲名聞望。更得財爻生扶合助，則內實貪賂，外不喪名。若財爻空伏死絶，聲名雖有，賄賂却無也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244504612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺父衰，職任高而衙門冷落。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410783763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母旺相，衙門必大；休囚則衙門必小。若官旺父衰，又非小職，乃閑静冷落衙門。官父俱衰，職卑衙小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"職居風憲，皆因月値官爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410800147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼不臨月建，定非風憲之職。若臨月建，又得扶出世爻，決是風憲之任，必非州縣之官。如帶白虎刑爻。主鎮守邉陲，職掌兵權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官在貳司；只爲鬼臨傍位，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410800147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官臨子午卯酉，是正印官也；官臨寅申巳亥，乃佐貳職官；臨辰戌丑未，乃襍職官；如臨月建日辰，乃掌印。之官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撫綏百姓。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410800147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動則難化愚頑，","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410816531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325897044019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡任牧民之職，要財爻旺而不動，父母扶而不空，方是善地。若財爻空絶，父爻受制，則地瘠民貧，父母動。臨世上，政必繁劇，见弟持世，財賦不起，或貧民難治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廵察四方；路空則多憂驚怪。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410816531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欽差出廵，𢙆世應逢空。若世在五爻空，須防日月刑剋，恐途中有患難莫測之禍耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出征勦捕，福德興而宼賊殱亡；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410832915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"几任將帥之職，或征討之官，平居卜問，不宜子孫發動，主有降調貶謫。如臨卜問，則喜子孫發動必成勦。捕大功，更得歲君、月建生合世爻，主有陞賞。官鬼不作爵位，當作宼賊論，世剋應亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鎭守邉陲，卦爻靜而華夷安泰。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410832915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鎮守地方，不拘文武官職，皆宜六爻安静，日辰月建不相冲剋，則安然無驚。若遇官鬼發動，世應冲剋，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358441220244537380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多侵擾，宜通變推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏陳諫諍，那堪太歲刑冲；","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410849299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡欲奏對陳疏、上章諫諍，及赴召面君類，皆忌動爻冲剋，亦忌太歲刑剋世爻。若太嵗、月建生合世爻，必見俞允如來冲剋，須防不测之禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道醫官，豈可文書發動。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410849299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"僧道醫官，皆以子孫爲用。如父動則傷僧道醫官，則用藥不靈，反爲不美。生世則吉，剋害刑衝，須防是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但隨職分以推詳，可識仕途之否泰。","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410865683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之八終","logicSentenceId":"7680045784410882067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424534880307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552002067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之九","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661932084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緖註，吳庠鍾英子燦叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661948468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡鑑升明謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵、潛菴。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661964852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男其龍、雲客、其章、𤥨軒。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661981236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財：","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661997620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554311721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居貨曰賈，行貨曰商，總爲資生之計。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884661997620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍所以筮，龜所以卜，莫非就利之謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662014004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要問吉凶，但看財福。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662030388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲本，福爲利，二者不可損壞。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662046772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中子孫之爻，稱日福神，財旺福興，無問公私皆稱意；財空福絶，不拘營運總違心。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662063156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻旺相，子孫發動，不拘公私之謀，皆得稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662079540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或傷剋，或臨墓絶無救，不拘買賣，皆違心之所願。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662095924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有福無財，兄弟交重偏有望。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662112308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有者，言其發動之意；無者，言其伏藏之意。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662128692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜求財，卦中子孫爻動，而","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662145076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則財源豐厚固吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662145076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如再見兄弟爻發動，生扶子孫，則財愈加根深蒂固，故曰兄弟爻重偏有望。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662161460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆爲子孫亦動也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662177844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552034835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財無福，官爻發動亦堪求。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662194228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫藏伏，財無生氣，一遇兄弟便被劫。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662210612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奪，須得卦中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻發動，或日辰是鬼，剋制兄弟，亦可求謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662226996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有子孫而官鬼動，則有阻滯，反不易矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662243380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福俱無，何異守株而待兎；有財無福，財必艱難，豈可財福俱無？","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662259764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守株待兎，喻𡚶想也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662276148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄皆動，無殊緣木以求魚。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662292532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
