{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母能剋，子孫能生，兄弟父","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662308916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，猶如綠木求魚，言必不可得也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662308916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月帶財神，卦雖無，而月中必有月建爲提綱。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662325300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶財爻，雖正卦無財，而伏財亦叨月建拱扶，所伏之神値日，必有","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662341684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554344489"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日傷妻位。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662341684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財雖旺而當日應無，亦爻旺相生合持世，乃是必得之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662358068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若被日神剋制，須過此日，然後可得。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662374452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須財反覆，必須墓庫以收藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662390836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中財現三五重爲太過，其財反覆，難求須有。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662407220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財之庫爻持世身，謂之財有收藏，必得厚利也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662423604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼分爭，又怕交重而阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662439988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼兄必專權，財雖有氣，亦多虚枆。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662456372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄更發動，必有爭奪分散財物之患。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662472756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼又不宜動，動則必有阻隔。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662489140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄如太過，反不剋財。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662505524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟乃占財忌煞，日月動變，俱帶兄弟，重叠太過，一見子孫發動，反不剋財，其利無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662521908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫安靜多不吉；身或兄臨，必難求望。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662538292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552067603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身一爻，占財體統若持兄，不拘作何買賣，問何財物，皆無利益。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662554676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662571060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財來就我終須易，我去尋財必是難。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662587444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻生合世爻，持世剋世，皆謂財來就我，必然易得。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662603828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財爻而與世爻不相于者，謂我去尋財，必難望也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662620212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身遇旺財，似取囊中之物；世持動弟，如撈水底之針。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662636596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲求財之人，若臨財爻，雖或無氣，必主易得，旺相更美。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662652980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨兄弟，雖或安静，亦主難得，發動尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662669364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福變財生，穣穣利源不竭。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662685748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占財得子孫發動，利必久遠。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662702132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼財爻","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662718516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世身，乃綿綿不絶之象，儘求儘有。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662718516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化子亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662734900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄連鬼剋，紛紛口舌難逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662751284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊註言兄弟變官鬼來剋世，是有口舌紛紛。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662767668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以爲謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662784052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡卦中兄弟動剋世爻，化官鬼，回頭剋制，則","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662800436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552100371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能口舌損耗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662800436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予之屢騐者。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662816820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中官鬼兄弟皆發動，固有口舌是非。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662833204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄連鬼剋者，此謂兄弟與官鬼也，非謂兄弟化官鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662849588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化財，必辛勤而有得；父化財，不能自然而得，必勤勞可有。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662865972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄化財，先散後聚，或利于後，不利于前。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662882356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化財爻，生合世身，最利公門謁貴，及九流藝術之人，求財十分有望。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662898740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官來剋世，謂之助鬼傷身，公私皆不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662915124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化鬼，防耗折而驚憂。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662931508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化官或化兄，最凶，主損折駁耗。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662947892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更見世爻有傷，恐因則致禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662964276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財局合福神萬倍，利源可許。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662980660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有三合，會成財局，而在卦中動來生世，主財利綿綿不竭，更得財旺，可計萬倍，財利㑹成。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884662997044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福局。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663013428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動來生","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663029812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552133139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合世爻者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲，君逢劫煞，一年生意無聊。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663029812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占久遠買賣，最怕太歲臨持兄弟，主一年無利；持官鬼，一年驚憂；持父一年艱辛；持財福，一年順利也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663046196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應二爻空合，虚約難憑。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663062580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空有財難得，應空難靠他人。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663078964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663095348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應俱空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀無凖。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663095348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實空動帶合，謂之虚約。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663111732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化空亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663128116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人一位刑傷，往求不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663144500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主人如求貴人財，鬼爲主；求婦人財，財爲主類。若主爻遇日辰動爻刑剋，或自空，或化空，皆主不遇，遇亦不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持空鬼，多因自己遲疑。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663160884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554377257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻持世，財必相生，凡求必易。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663177268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇空亡，乃自不上前，遲疑退怯，故無成也。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663193652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持空財亦然，日合動財，却被他人把住。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663210036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻動來生合，固是易得之兆。若被動爻日辰合住，其財必有人把持，不能與我。要知何人把持，以合爻定之，如父母合住，爲尊長把持類。要知何日到手，必待逢冲之日，方可有也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知何曰：得財不離旺衰生合。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663226420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動入墓，或被合，皆待冲日得。或動財遇絶，必待生日得。逢冲，合日得，動逢月破，塡實逢合日得；或安靜，逢冲日得；旬空，出旬得；伏藏，出現日得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲決何時有利，但詳春夏秋冬。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663242804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占貨𤘽何時得價，不可槩以財臨五行㫁之。如木財斷春冬得價，又宜以冲待合、合待冲、絶逢生、墓待","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554410025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"開等法斷，又宜以子孫爻斷。又如財坐長生之地。一日得價一日；若坐帝旺，目下正及時，遲則賤而無利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合夥不嫌兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663259188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占合夥買賣，若世應俱財爻，必然稱意，兄臨卦身，必至分財故也。静者無嫌，動則不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公門何慮官爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663275572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占財皆忌官動，主有阻隔。惟求公門之財，必然倚托官府，必得旺相生合世身則吉。刑剋世爻，禍害立至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九流術士，偏宜鬼動生身。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663291956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九流求財，以鬼爻爲主顧。出現發動，生合世爻，必然稱意。忌刑剋世爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六畜血財，尤喜福興持世。","logicSentenceId":"7680047884663308340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜販賣生口、蓄養六畜，皆要子孫旺相持世臨身則吉。父母發動，則有傷損。化出土鬼，須防瘟死。福旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450147552165907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財空，六畜雖好而無利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應同人，放債必然連本失。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496596020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡放私債，最忌世應値兄弟，必無討處。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496612404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻更絶，連本俱無。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496628788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496645172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應値空亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月相合，開行定主有人投。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496661556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"開行人占財，世應要不空，財福要全備，官鬼要有氣，父兄要衰靜，斯爲上吉。更得月建日辰動爻生合世。爻，則近悅遠來，財利必順。動出官兄，常有是非口舌。應空，主開不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應落空亡，索借者失望，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496677940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求索假借，不宜應空，空則不實，必得物爻不空，緩圖庻可有望。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496694324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如衣服經史，看父母，六畜、酒噐看福爻，其餘財物、食物，皆看財爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496710708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879109695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遭刑剋，賭博者必輸。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496727092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占賭博，要世旺應衰，世剋應，我勝；應剋世，他勝。兄鬼動來刑剋世爻，或臨兄弟，或世爻空，皆主不勝。世應静空，賭博不成。世坐官爻防他合謀騙我，間爻動出官鬼兄弟，多致爭闘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼剋身爻，商販者必遭盜賊。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496743476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"買賣經商，若遇官臨玄武動來剋世，必遭盜賊之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496759860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間興害世，置貨者當慮牙人，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496776244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"買貨要應爻生合世位，必然易成，刑剋世必難。置物爻太過，貨多；物爻不及，貨少；空伏，貨無。物爻者，六畜看子，五穀看財爻類。最怕兄鬼交重，須防光棍誆騙。在間爻傷剋世爻，當慮牙人謀劫財物。出路買貨應空多不順利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879142463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"停塌者，喜財安而鬼靜。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496792628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"積貨不宜財動，動恐有變，亦不宜空，空，恐有。更官鬼。若動興灾，作禍莫測。卽如父母化官鬼，刑剋世爻貨。被雨水渰腐，故榻貨者宜六爻安靜，惟子孫喜動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫貨者宜財動而身興，財動則主易脫，世動亦主易賣也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496809012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如財在外動，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496825396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜往他處賣；如在內動生世，就本地脫之。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496825396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496841780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也倘財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻持世，有子孫爻在外動，亦宜往他處脫。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496841780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者宜通變。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496858164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路上有官休出外。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496874548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻爲道路，臨官發動，途中必多驚險，不宜出外。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496890932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知有何灾咎，以所臨六神㫁，如白虎爲風波，玄武爲","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496907316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"盗賊類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879175231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅中有鬼勿居家。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496923700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二爻爲住宅，在家求財，鬼動，此爻必然。不利以所臨。五行斷火鬼忌火燭類。得子孫持世發動，庶幾無害；如無子孫發動，宜遷移店鋪可解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內外無財，伏又空，必然乏本。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496940084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動變無財，又伏空地，其人雖欲經营，必無貲本。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496956468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄有氣財還絶，莫若安貧；父兄二爻有氣，恐防折本，故不若安貧守分爲高也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496972852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生計多端，占法不一，但能誠敬以祈求","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496989236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自可預知其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得失。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334496989236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879207999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家宅創基立業，雖本人之經緯；關風斂氣，每由宅以肇端。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497005620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故要知人宅之興衰，當察卦爻之內外。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497022004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內爲宅，外爲人，詳審爻中之眞假。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497038388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內者，內卦也，內卦第二爻爲宅舍；外者，外卦也，外卦第五爻爲人口。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497054772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占家宅，最重者，宅舍、人口、財、","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497071156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子、世應、日辰、月建、嵗君。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497071156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡內卦二爻尅五爻，謂宅去尅人凶；或外卦五爻尅二爻，謂人來尅宅吉；或內卦二爻生五爻，謂宅去生人吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497087540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合爲門，冲爲路，不論卦內之有無。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497103924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合二爻爲門，冲二爻爲路，卦爻內不必明現冲合，且如天風姤卦二爻辛亥水爲宅，寅與亥合，以寅爲門。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497120308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879240767"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳亥相冲，以巳爲路，卦內本無寅、巳二爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497136692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"姤，属金，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木爲財，巳火爲鬼，寅爲財，卽是門。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497136692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利巳爲鬼卽是。路不吉也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍德貴人乘旺，嶽嶽之侯門；官星父母長生，潭潭之相府。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497153076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍者，靑龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497169460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德者，年月日建謂之德。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497185844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星卽官鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497202228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人，卽天乙貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497218612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如靑龍文書、官鬼貴人臨","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497234996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日建臨宅，臨身臨命，主有官職之家也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497234996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門庭新氣象，重交得合，青龍交重，靑龍不空，在日辰旬內，得生旺，主鼎新；","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497251380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"創造倘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値休囚，主修舊合新門之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497251380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨財新修舊厨臨父新修舊堂臨兄新修門戸臨子新修房舍臨官，新修㕔堂屋宇、","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497267764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879273535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂宇舊規模宅舍重侵曰虎，白虎交重，休囚空絶，主遠年遷造，破舊不整。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497267764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土金發動，開闢之基；父母空亡，租賃之宅。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497284148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土化金，金化土，爲開聞之基。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497300532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爲房屋，逢空無氣，更逢應爻日辰動爻，化文書，與宅相生相合，主是租，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497316916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賃之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門庭熱閙。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497316916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官臨帝旺之鄕，財鬼龍德貴人乗旺長生之位，臨宅生命世爻，主家庭熱閙。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497333300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家道與隆，福祿在長生之地，交重生剋，重新，更換廳堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497349684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879306303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福卽子孫，祿卽妻財，在生旺之位，臨宅臨人，生身生世，主家道興隆。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497366068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二爻發動，或生或剋，主攺造㕔堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497382452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應比和，一合兩般門扇。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497398836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比和者，兄弟也，或臨兄弟，或世應化，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497415220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或臨宅爻，或合宅爻，主一合兩般。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497415220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"門扇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門路與日辰隔斷，偏曲往來。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497431604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅基與世應交臨，互相換易。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497447988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如巽卦辛亥水爲宅，以寅合爲門。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497464372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497480756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與動爻如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨子，子與寅虗有丑字隔之；如臨辰，辰與寅虚有卯字隔之，謂之隔門。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497480756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如巳冲亥爲路，日辰與","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497497140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，卯與巳，虚有辰字隔之。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497497140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨未，未與巳虚，有午字隔之，謂之隔路。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497513524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇隔斷者，門路曲折也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497529908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世與日辰剋宅，破祖不寜；","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497546292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554442793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻與日辰同去剋宅爻，主破祖不寜。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497546292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅臨月破剋身，生災不已。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497562676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月破之爻動剋世爻及身命爻，主生災不已。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497579060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應飛入宅，合招異姓同居。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497595444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨之爻，與宅爻相同，謂之應飛入宅，主有異姓同居。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497611828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅動生身，決主近年遷住；宅爻動來生世生身，必主近年遷住。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497628212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門逢三破，休敗崩頽。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497644596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三破爲年月日冲破也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497660980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨兄弟，主門戸破，墻垣毀；臨子財，主房舍廂廊、烟厨破壞類也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497677364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879339071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅遇兩空，荒閑虚廢。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497693748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宅爻在日辰旬之空，又在當家木","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497710132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之空亡，主荒閑虚廢，或是逃亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497710132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"死絶之屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨外宅，離祖分居。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497726516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅爻與正卦世臨之爻相同，或與變卦","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497742900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世臨之爻相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同，如明夷卦二爻己丑爲宅，世臨四爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497742900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲世臨外宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497742900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動則離祖分居，不動則主偏宅。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497759284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應入中庭，外人同住。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497775668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨之爻與宅臨之爻相同者是。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497792052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如剝卦","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497808436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"井卦應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨宅爻，亦爲應入中庭，主外人同居。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497808436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰同臨爲寄。居也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅合有情之玄武，門庭柳陌花街；木臨無氣之螣蛇，","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497824820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554475561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅舍茅簷蓬戸。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497824820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅爻合玄武，又逢沐浴爻動，主女人淫慾，如花街柳陌人也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497841204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇木爻死氣臨宅，主甕牖繩樞之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497857588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼有助而無制，鬼旺人衰。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497873972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如納音木命人占乾兌卦，以火爲官，木能生火，謂之本命助鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497890356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦體無水生命，又謂鬼無制，主人衰鬼旺。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497906740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若金命人助離宮水鬼，水命人助坤宮木鬼，火命人助坎宮士鬼類。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497923124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅無破而逢生，宅興財旺，歳月日三破不臨宅爻，更逢三件動爻生宅爻，與財爻旺相有氣，爲宅興財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497939508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財無鬼，耗散多端。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497955892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無鬼爻，則兄弟無制，恐兄弟當權之時，財物破散，妻宮亦有","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497972276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"駁雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497972276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879371839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼無財，灾生不已。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334497988660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼不宜動，財不可無。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498005044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官鬼動剋世爻，剋宅爻，主連生。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498021428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灾咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人制鬼，鬼動無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498037812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如木命人占得坎卦，以土爲鬼，木命人剋土鬼，金命人則制坤宮木鬼，但以本命剋鬼爲制，乃無害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498054196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助鬼傷身，財多何益。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498070580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金命人占得乾卦，以火爲鬼，以木爲財，木","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498086964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火火能剋金，有財爲助鬼傷身，總然財多無益。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498086964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌鬼爻交重臨白虎，須防人眷刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498103348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌鬼爻併白虎發動冲剋何納音命，卽指其人有灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498119732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"催屍煞，身命入黄泉，大忌墓門開合。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498136116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554508329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動剋人命，爲催屍煞。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498152500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命逢死絶，爲黄泉路。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498168884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌人命爻冲合墓爻，日辰動爻冲合墓爻，爲墓門開合。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498185268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卦中必見鬼墓爻，便是。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498201652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木金年命，最嫌乾兌卦之火。","logicSentenceId":"7680048334498218036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又木金年命人占得乾兌卦之火鬼，木命生火，謂之助鬼，火鬼剋金爲傷身，金爻木命皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159663616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火命人不怕震巽宮之金鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159680000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡本命納音是水火，占得震巽卦金鬼，金能生水，火能剋金，故水火命人不怕震巽二宮之鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159696384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星佩印居玉堂，乃食祿之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159712768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有官有貴、有祿有印，并太歲生身命，登金門而歩玉堂之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159729152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴刃加刑控寶馬，必提兵之將。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159745536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554541097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴貴人刃羊刃，刑三刑，貴人同吉星相輔，刃加三刑，臨貴人之位，受太歲之生。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159761920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁爻有","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159778304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"馬乃提兵將帥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化福爻，入公門，多致淹留。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159778304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻持世，財來生吉也，化福","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159794688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倍有。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159794688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"力更吉也。倘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世，化子孫，反生他爻之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159811072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡仕","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159827456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宦，公門之人。反，不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴印加官，在仕途必然遷轉。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159827456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父帶貴人臨世，併日","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159843840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中發動，在仕途必有遷轉之喜兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159843840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子承父業，子有跨","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159860224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ateddi/1-1715395155977.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RYiOuhHdQU7VX6BQ6TGj%2FpNSf8w%3D","uri":"read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ateddi/1-1715395155977.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7680049945159860224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之風。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159860224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子命爻臨五爻之位，相生相合，主子有跨灶之風，相剋相冲，主悖逆不肖，不克紹箕裘之業。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159876608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻奪夫權，妻有能家之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159892992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450921879404607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻命臨夫五爻之上，與夫相生相合，得內助能家之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159909376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若妻剋夫爻，主妻凌夫，或破夫家也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159925760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟紾乃兄之臂，身命相傷，弟爻起臨兄之命爻，或兄爻起臨弟之命爻，若刑剋，主不友不恭；若生合，主兄弟怡怡如也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159942144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦僣姑嫜之爻，家聲可見。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159958528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爲媳婦之爻，與姑之命爻相刑相冲，主凌上悖逆不孝；相生相合，主能敬順，𥁞婦道也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159974912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻犯夫家之煞，妻破夫家。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945159991296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻命臨月破兄弟加白虎發動，主破夫家。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160007680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫臨妻祿之爻，夫食妻祿。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160024064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻年甲子生祿在寅，夫命臨之，生旺有氣者，主夫食妻祿。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160040448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢羊刃空鬼耗破，雖食妻祿，亦無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160056832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046749225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交重兄弟剋妻身，再理絲絃。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160073216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟之爻發動，剋傷妻命，或夫命臨兄弟動，主琴瑟再續也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160089600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內外子孫生世位，多招財物。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160105984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內外子孫發動生命世之財爻，必多招財物也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160122368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲日辰飛入宅，鳩踞鵲巢。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160138752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世併日辰與鬼飛入宅爻，主他人之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160155136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"屋或租賃之宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160171520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大過卦內巽辛亥爲宅，外兌丁亥持世，","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160187904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發動是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨父母動生身，龍生蛇腹。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160187904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨父母之爻，占者命爻臨之，得","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160204288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻生之或動生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子命，主婢生庻出。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160204288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或前後父母所生身命俱臨父母。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160220672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必主重拜雙親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554590249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應隔異，兄弟多因兩姓。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160237056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如晉卦己酉兄弟持世，乙未臨應，隔","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160253440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申字又如遯卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應臨壬申金，世持丙午火，有未隔斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160253440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但申爻是本宮兄弟，是眞兄弟，或日月","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160269824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"建動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻隔斷，亦依此斷，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160269824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻就妻相合，外人入舍爲夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160286208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻飛入宅，與妻命生合，主招外人入舍爲夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160302592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假宮有子飛來，異姓過房作嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160318976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如子孫在假宮飛來，伏在身命爻下，主有異姓過房之子，本宮飛動，應爻過房與人也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160335360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻帶子臨夫位，引子嫁人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160351744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻命帶子孫動臨夫位，并日辰，主妻引子嫁來是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160368128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445616554623017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫身起合妻爻，將身就婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160384512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻動臨妻命爻，或自命爻動臨合妻命爻，定然將身就婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160400896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本命就中空子，見子應遲。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160417280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫在命旬之空，主得子遲。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160433664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身爻合處逢妻，娶婚必早。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160450048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫身爻起合妻之命爻，娶妻必早；妻身爻起合夫之命爻，婦嫁無遲。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160466432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦合爻見鬼，婚配不明。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160482816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合之爻，妻合之爻見鬼，主婚配不明。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160499200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有合爻見鬼是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160515584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫絶處刑傷，兒多不育。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160531968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759485451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫逢絶，更受刑傷剋害，主子多不育難招。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160548352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻反目，互見刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160564736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟無情，互相凌制。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160581120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫身爻并日辰動，刑妻命，主夫不和妻。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160597504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻身爻并日辰動刑夫命，主妻不和夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160613888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或妻命冲夫身，或夫命冲妻身，主夫妻反目。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160630272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟目辰剋弟身命爻，或弟帶日辰剋兄身命爻，主兄弟不和，互相凌虐。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160646656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日將與世身相生，當主雙胎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160663040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命與世應同爻，多應兩姓。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160679424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身世與日辰動爻同位，兩生命者，主雙胎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160695808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命臨應上，世亦臨之，主有兩姓。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160712192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財發動不堪。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160728576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父値休囚父母交重，最忌子臨死絶上，有父母不堪。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160744960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻發動，主有剋害之患。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160761344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動則剋子也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160777728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759518219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻剋世，身重合應，妻必重婚。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160794112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻動剋夫命，或妻命動剋夫爻，并日辰，又與應相合，主妻再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160810496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶咸池與應爻相合，剋夫身命爻，主妻與外人謀殺夫主。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160826880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨交爻，主未來之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160843264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫刑妻命兩逢財，夫當再娶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160859648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫刑剋妻命，或刑剋財爻，更逢剋處兩財，主夫剋兩妻，併日辰合旁爻之財，主再娶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160876032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併日","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160892416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰動爻帶刄刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等煞傷妻命爻，主遭夫毒手也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160892416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻與應爻相合，外有私通；妻命財爻與應相合，咸池玄武，主妻有外情。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160908800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫併日辰剋妻，與應爻，主獲妻奸。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160925184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男臨女子，互爻，內多淫慾。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160941568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759550987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命爻起合女命爻，女身爻起臨男命爻，爲互合，尊卑失序，主有淫亂之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160957952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫妻互相合，主先姦後娶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160974336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍水木臨妻位，多獲奩財。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945160990720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如財臨水木有氣，夫命臨之，主得妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161007104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武桃花犯命，中荒淫酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161023488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命帶玄武咸池，主貪酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161039872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女同論。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161056256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應妻爻相合，當招偏正之夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161072640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲世應財爻三合，逢兩鬼合妻命，主有偏正之夫。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161089024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻世應六冲，必是生離之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161105408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻命値鬼爻，與世應併日辰破合，重重相冲，與財兩合；或妻命爻與世應動爻相冲，或日辰相冲，主是生。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161121792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759583755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"離之婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應爲妻爻，相隔逢冲，必招外郡之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161138176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應在日辰旬中隔斷，妻爻與夫爻相隔，在日辰旬外逢冲，主夫是外郡之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161154560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻與福德相逢帶合，必近親隣之女。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161170944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻二命爻俱在本宮，就中合見子孫，主因親致親。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161187328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢死炁，最嫌煞忌當頭，主象逢死絶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161203712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日辰動爻臨忌煞來剋，或剋本命，主有死亡之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161220096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼入墓鄕，尤忌身爻濺血。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161236480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命爻帶鬼入墓，怕身爻再帶煞受制，最不吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161252864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046781993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡莫惡於三刑迭刄，刑無刃，不能傷人；刃無刑，禍亦不大。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161269248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若刑刃兩全，剋身臨官，主犯官刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945161285632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨玄武劫煞，盗賊圖財動命，世併日辰動爻剋應，主我殺他人；應併日辰動爻，帶煞剋世，主他人傷我。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945532956687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇子孫發動，凶中有吉；凶莫凶於四虎交加。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945532973071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四虎者，年月日時建也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945532989455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶鬼煞重重，舉家遭禍死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533005839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦中福德動，主悲喜相半之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533022223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四鬼貼身，防生灾咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533038607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四鬼者，亦謂年月日時値官鬼持世，臨身臨命，主有災咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533054991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳剋世，易惹灾危。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533071375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳，年月日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533087759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶煞剋世，身命，主宅丁人眷災危。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533104143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲主一年之禍，月建主數月之災也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533120527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759616523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫亡兩賊傷身，靑草墳頭之鬼；身命兩空遇煞，黃泉路上之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533136911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命逢絶，在旬中空亡遇鬼，傷身剋命，主有死亡之患。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533153295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳傷玄武之妻財，女多凶禍；白虎損靑龍之官鬼，夫忌死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533169679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新増家宅搜精，分别六爻斷法：初爻非水休言井，酉金干涉道雞鵞。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533186063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻如臨亥子水爻，方可以井㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533202447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値財福以吉，","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533218831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論値","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼忌神以凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533218831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若初爻與酉爻刑冲剋害生合，卽是于涉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533235215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有于渉，方可言畜養雞鵞鴨之吉凶，不可混而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533251599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759649291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨土逢冲基地破。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533267983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻臨辰戌丑未，土爻被月日冲破者，其宅基必有挖開破缺之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533284367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無官無鬼小兒和。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533300751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻臨官鬼白虎父母發動，其家主傷小口。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533317135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非官鬼忌煞臨持，小口必平和無恙也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533333519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅邉若有墳和墓，須知鬼墓値爻初。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533349903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼墓者，𢫾卦中官鬼之墓庫爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533366287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得震巽宮卦金，","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533382671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金庫在丑，如丑爻臨于初爻，則宅邊必有古。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533382671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水臨白虎將橋斷，如初爻臨子亥水附臨白虎，主有橋梁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533399055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨財福則吉，逢冲，橋必壞也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533415439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759682059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木猫良䑕耗無。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533431823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如初爻臨寅木吉神，主其家有好猫能捕鼠。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533448207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武水乗溝利瀹，木爻官鬼樹爲戈。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533464591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如初爻臨亥子，水附玄武，不可","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533480975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論橋論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井，當以溝渠之通塞斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533480975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木爻官鬼値此，主其家左近有樹根穿。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533497359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破宅基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻木鬼梁橫竈言二爻如臨木爻官鬼，主竈上有橫梁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533513743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母持之，主堂奥。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533530127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻臨父母爻，不論金木、水火土，皆以房屋之堂奥推斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533546511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨旺相安靜則吉，如逢休囚破剋，主房屋。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533562895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046814761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破漏不堪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀火官持慮火灾，土金變化宜興造。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533579279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如朱雀並火官在二爻，主有火灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533595663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻土化金，或金化土，主有興造。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533612047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木被金冲鍋盖摧，金局摧殘鍋破壞。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533628431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻臨木爻，被金日金爻冲之，知其鍋蓋破碎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533644815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"摧者，壞也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533661199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘二爻會金局被冲，其竈上必有破鍋。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533677583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武土乗竈不潔，土逢冲剋，竈崩敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533693967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻玄武同土持之，主竈前不潔。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533710351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻値土，被日月動爻冲剋，則竈必坍頺。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533726735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世鬼並臨非祖屋，福財遭剋苦相逐。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533743119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨官鬼在二爻，此屋決非祖産。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533759503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如福德財爻在二爻，旺相有氣，主其家安享豐足。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533775887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘遭休囚破剋，主其","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533792271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046847529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"家窮苦相逐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土干連以犬言。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533792271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻與戊爻生剋冲合，當以防家犬㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533808655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨財福吉臨忌煞凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533825039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應飛此地人同宿。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533841423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如應臨之爻，飛入二爻，主有外人同住。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533857807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同宿者，言同住也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533874191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爻不獨斷宅母，各分名分安危卜。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533890575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以二爻爲宅母之位，斷其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533906959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以爲謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533923343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人家祖母、母嫂、弟婦、姊妹、妻女，同居一室，各有名分，宜以用神觀其生剋，卜其吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533939727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻亥水斷猪牲，兄弟臨爻方論門。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533956111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046880297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三爻非臨亥爻，不可便斷猪牲吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533972495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如兄弟爻臨于三爻上，方可以門戸㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945533988879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨財官、父子，不可槩推。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534005263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟卯爻床榻論。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534021647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如兄弟是卯爻，不可言門戸，當以床榻論之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534038031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡卯爻兄弟臨第三爻，必神堂前有床榻，或樓上做房関。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534054415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"碍神堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無官莫妄斷家神。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534070799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三爻若臨官爻，方可寔指神堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534087183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非官爻臨持，不可便斷神堂也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534103567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金官臨主香爐破，木鬼靑龍牌位新。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534119951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三爻臨金官，主香爐破損，或値木鬼、靑龍旺相，神牌自然新彩畵也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534136335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四爻若動來冲剋，門門相對似穿心。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534152719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759714827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若第四爻動來冲剋三爻，主家中門門相對，或穿心走破，不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534169103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三四互臨兄弟位，門多屋少耗傷金。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534185487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三四爻俱臨兄弟爻，主其家屋少門多，耗散金銀之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534201871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若被動爻冲本位，出入不在正門行。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534218255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如本爻被日月動爻冲剋，主其家旁門出入，不走正門。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534234639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻臨卯木主床帳，木臨蛇鬼婦虛驚。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534251023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如第三爻臨卯木，是床帳也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534267407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨財福，則床帳新鮮。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534283791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨螣蛇官鬼，其婦女在床，有意外虗驚。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534300175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻不是弟兄位，官揺父陷始難寜。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534316559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以第三爻爲兄弟之位，謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534332943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻發動，剋害兄弟爻，又遇父母空陷，不來救䕶，方可論弟兄之有患","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534349327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046913065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難不安寜也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534349327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四爻兄弟方言戸，四二相合主大門。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534365711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三門四戸，是古法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534382095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然無兄弟臨之，不可便言門戸。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534398479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨兄弟，方以户㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534414863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四爻或動或靜，與第二爻相合者，當以大門決斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534431247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未變鬼臨第四位，畜羊不利見灾迍。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534447631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未爻臨于第四爻上，當以羊斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534464015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如變鬼爻，畜羊有損。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534480399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武官鬼門破漏，靑龍財福喜更新。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534496783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四爻上如臨玄武官鬼，門主破陋。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534513167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨靑龍財福，與二爻生合者，可知其門楼有更新之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534529551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀臨官主獄訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534545935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046945833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀臨官爻，在四爻上，土有官非訟事。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534562319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武乗兄有水侵。","logicSentenceId":"7680049945534578703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如玄武臨兄弟，不可以兄弟爲戸論，必有池潭水侵住宅。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325680180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如冲剋二爻，有碍住居也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325696564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟螣蛇臨爻位，隣人坑厠碍家庭。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325712948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
