{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四爻弟兄臨螣蛇，不可以兄弟爲戸論，當主隣家有破坑相碍。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325729332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空月破當爻見，不是無門是破門。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325745716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若第四爻値旬空月破，當以無大門或破門斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325762100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲剋相乗旁出入，外族不應將此論。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325778484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇冲遇剋，必主旁門出入。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325794868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至于外族之論，係易林之謬，不可爲憑也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325811252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505046978601"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財剋子臨傷父母，隂陽兩斷內中分。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325827636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動剋父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若再得子孫爻動而助財來，","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325844020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母有傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325844020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父母爻臨陽象則剋父，隂象則剋母，卦中六爻內見之皆如此。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325860404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古以四爻爲母位，而論其剋母，此說大謬。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325876788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻剋二人口寜，五","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325893172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人口之爻剋二爻，則人口安寜。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325893172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如動來剋宅，","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325909556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又宜以六親生剋論之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325909556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如二爻動來剋五爻，此屋居之不安穩也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325925940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官連蛇鬼長房迍，五爻爲長房長子，如官鬼同蛇虎持之，主長房長子多悔也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325942324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遭白虎刑冲剋，主有驚癎不得生。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325958708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759747595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘五爻被白虎爻動來刑冲剋害，又不可以長子長房斷，主其家有驚癎之疾者，不能醫治而難生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325975092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨隂位女爲政，財爻持世贅爲姻。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946325991476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世居五爻，父是隂位，主其家內閫爲政。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326007860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主持。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326024244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"家事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻持世居此位，其人贅去爲婚，又非女人主事也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326040628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是二爻冲剋破，當家夫婦少恩情。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326057012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻如逢冲破，主夫婦乖張，又非贅婚之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326073396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水臨世合水遶屋，兄弟臨時墻有坑。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326089780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻臨水，與二爻生合，或與世爻生合，主宅邊有水環繞。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326106164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨兄弟，主墙內有坑碍。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326122548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土剋冲牛不利，椿庭休咎父爻尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326138932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丑爻發動剋五爻，或與五爻刑冲，畜牛不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326155316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以五爻爲父，謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326171700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問父之吉凶休咎，應向父爻論其。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326188084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451326759780363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生剋可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻財位論奴丁，父母相臨祖軰人。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326204468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木棟梁隂是柱，官庫侵之乃是墤。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326220852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六爻若臨財位，方言奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326237236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇旬空月破，則奴僕","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326253620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無力，倘遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日冲爻冲，主有逃亡之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326253620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨父母，當論𥘲輩的休咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326270004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘陽爻臨木父，不可以祖輩言，當以棟梁斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326286388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨隂木，父母爻，當以庭柱論。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326302772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宫爻之庫臨于六爻上，當以坟墓論。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326319156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其生剋合冲，分别吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326335540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父臨屬土，主墻壁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326351924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父母属土，當以墻壁斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326368308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木籓籬定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326384692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934138409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨卯木，不論隂陽，當以籓籬㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326401076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以生剋合冲定其吉以。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326417460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卯爻旬空，向有籓籬。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326433844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如動來剋世，當以凶推；如逢生合，當以吉㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326450228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身世相臨第六爻，離祖成家斷可必。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326466612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卦身臨于第六爻，或世爻臨之，主來卜之人，必離祖業，方可成家。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326482996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位臨於酉動爻冲，鍋破懸知在此中。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326499380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如第六爻臨有酉金破月日動爻冲之，主家中有破鍋不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326515764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀鬼臨爻顛女斷，爻爻分别不相蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326532148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如朱雀官鬼臨爻，主有女人染風癲之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326548532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒙者，蒙昧不明也。","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326564916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗巻之九終","logicSentenceId":"7680049946326581300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505047011369"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451505047044137"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229152296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註壬","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229168680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午舉人。弟雲遵時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229168680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦、蔡鑑升明、謝朝柱巨材門人同較任用淵、潛菴男。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229185064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229201448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍雲客章𤥨軒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳墓","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229201448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424534913075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬理之理乃先王之所定，雖爲送死而然，風水","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229201448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特後世之所興，禍福吉凶攸係。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229201448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229217832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墳占三代穴有定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻一世二世，子孫出王矦將相之","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229217832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"英世四世三後嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主，富貴繁華之茂，絕嗣無人，端爲","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229217832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世居五六，爲商出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外祗。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229217832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因世在游魂，八純凶兆，歸魂亦作","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229234216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶推吉兆相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生相合，凶兆相剋相冲，內卦爲山頭，外卦爲朝向，世爻爲穴塲，世臨初二爻穴場，乃得山頭之生氣，後代當產王侯將相之","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229234216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"英世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨三四爻穴塲乃得山頭之餘氣，故後嗣不過","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229234216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繁華。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229234216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨五、六兩位，乃山頭生氣","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229250600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已脫，是不合山形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地勢，故至絶嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229250600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游魂好動爲商歸魂氣，","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229266984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"滯，不吉，世得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生相合，自然環繞多情。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229266984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇相剋相","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229283368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲，自然沙飛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934171177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴騎龍，龍入穴穴嫡龍眞，","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229283368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以亡人本命納音爲穴，或世臨穴爻，或世穴相生相合，或動爻月日生合世爻、穴爻，謂之穴騎龍、龍入穴。穴嫡龍眞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山帶水水連山，山環水抱，","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229283368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山者，内宫也。水者，亥子水也。如亥子水臨財福吉神，在內宫，與世爻相合相生，或與穴爻相合相生，謂之。山環水抱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交重逢旺氣，聞雞鳴犬吠之聲；","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229283368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺相之爻發動，臨水火，穴近民居，故曰聞雞嗚犬吠之聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819007498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應拱穴爻，有虎踞龍蟠之勢。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229283368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應生扶拱合于穴爻，或龍虎生合于穴爻，或穴居于世應之間，或穴叼世應，龍虎拱扶，皆是虎踞龍蟠。之勢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合更兼六合，聚氣藏風，","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229299752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爲主山，應爲賔山，世應與穴爻三合成局，或得六合卦，或龍虎二爻與穴爻三合成局者，皆聚氣藏風。之地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來山番作朝山，回頭顧祖。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229299752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來山者，內卦之世爻也；朝山者，外卦之應爻也。如世臨之爻，與應爻同，謂之回頭顧祖也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶之鬼，邉有荒墳，長生之爻，中有夀穴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229316136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934203945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中官爻休囚死絶，知穴旁有荒坟古塜。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229332520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼爻遇長生于日，或化長生者，知有夀穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229348904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合處與應爻隔斷內外之向不同。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229365288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡人本命納音爲穴，納音之墓爲墓，合納音之爻爲向。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229381672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如己未納音属士，卽以土爲穴，土庫千辰，卽以辰爲墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229398056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千與未合，卽以午爲向，辰與酉合，酉亦爲向。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229414440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰、申二日，或應臨辰、申，謂之隔㫁午；或未、亥二日，或應臨未亥，謂之隔㫁酉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229430824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當知金井墓門之向不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229447208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴中爲世日冲開，左右之穴相反，穴臨己未二爻，世併日辰臨午爻，午居己未之中，謂之分開己未二穴，知左右之穴相反也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229463592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229479976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴道得山形之正，重逢本象之生穴，卽亡人本命納音臨內宮世爻，皆得山形之正。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229496360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如穴爻臨水，遇內属金，或水爻在于金宮內，皆謂之本。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229512744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424534945843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象之生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應把山水之關，宜見有情之合。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229529128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六爻爲水口之爻，應爻臨之，若帶合，則有関鎖。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229545512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或第六爻與世相合，亦是坐山有氣，怕穴逢空廢之爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229561896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如坎山属水，坎山者，坎居內宮也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229578280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得穴逢申爻，而水長生于申，最怕申爻逢旬空月破。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229594664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且本命逢生，忌運入刑傷之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229611048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占生墓，要看本人年命，亦將本人年命納音爲穴運，卽穴爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229627432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌穴爻與內宮及卦爻刑剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229643816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如穴爻得生有氣爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229660200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇旬空，而亡人且忌生人，却不畏空反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229676584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍擺尾，就中逢泄氣子孫；白虎昂頭，落處逢生身","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229692968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330527243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229692968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若靑龍子孫有氣生穴，謂之一尾多情。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229709352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如白虎臨父母爻生穴者，謂之昻頭有勢。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229725736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後來龍餘氣未盡，有玄武吐舌之形。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229742120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前朝案動爻逢冲，爲朱雀開口之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229758504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入穴臨玄武，謂餘氣未盡，有吐舌之形。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229774888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後者，玄武也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229791272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世前一位爲案，被日辰、月建冲破，朱雀臨之，有開口之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229807656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前者，朱雀也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229824040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世坐勾陳之土局，破坎田園；應臨玄武之水爻，溝坑池井。","logicSentenceId":"7680037041229840424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世坐穴爻，并臨勾陳，値辰戌丑未之土局，或被冲剋，乃破坎田園之所也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604890164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應臨亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水爻加臨玄武，或㑹","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604906548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358428325897093171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水局乃溝坑池井之所也。白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎，在破耗之位。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604906548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古墓墳塋，螣蛇臨父母之爻，交加産業。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604922932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若白虎再加月破持世持穴持身者，知是古墓坟塋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604939316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604955700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸魂卦：或鬼飛入穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂還魂之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604955700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇爲勾絞之神。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604972084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爲文書契字，非重理叠賣，卽衆分交加之産也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622604988468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳土鬼，塜墓纍纍。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605004852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605021236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陳臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳辰戌丑未土鬼逢死絶之爻，爲古墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605021236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游魂鬼","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605037620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動逢冲空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁有","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605037620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"攺墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605037620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰大剋，白虎穴爻，有崩頺之墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605054004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍臨土鬼，主有新坟；若𡽢魂卦，或土鬼飛人穴爻，主有攺墓之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605070388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武金神，巖泉滴滴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605086772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934236713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲石，玄武爲水，主淋漓自出之泉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605103156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨穴爻，或伏穴爻之下，或白虎臨金，皆主有石有水。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605119540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍發動，臨子孫，決主新遷。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605135924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀飛來帶官鬼，必然爭訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605152308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若靑龍發動，或值子孫，必主遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605168692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀官鬼并動爻，日辰飛入穴，主奪地爭訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605185076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻加木臨玄武，前有溪橋；日辰冲土鎮螣蛇，邊通道路。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605201460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若應爻併木爻臨玄武，主墓前定有溪橋。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605217844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇爲路，臨辰戍丑未之爻，與日辰動爻冲剋，主近道路。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605234228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇土爻飛入穴爻，或與穴爻相冲，主有道路穿坟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605250612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀火爻發動，厨庭炊爨之旁；靑龍財庫相生，店肆","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605266996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543027721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庫倉之畔。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605266996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀火爻發動臨財，必近厨庭烟竈之所。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605283380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍臨四墓，逢財相生有氣，必近店舖酒肆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605299764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇庚申癸酉，","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605316148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉金爲倉庫之畔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武世飛入穴，暗地偷埋；勾陳土動落空，依山淺葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605316148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武世爻併日辰動飛入穴，主偷埋盜葬，或者暗地瞞人出殯。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605332532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳土動，或空，或發動，必是依山淺葬也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605348916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日合鬼爻有氣，近神廟社壇之旁。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605365300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺有氣，或臨靑龍貴人，與日辰相合，主近神廟，或古跡靈壇之所。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605381684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動臨華葢逢空，傍佛塔琳宮之所。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605398068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢穴爻併鬼動逢空，乗旺有氣，主近寺觀，不然爲匠藝。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605414452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人家有響應之聲。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605430836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934269481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應逼左右之山欺穴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605447220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎磕頭，世應逢靑龍辰爻、白虎寅爻，爲龍虎磕頭，剋穴則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605463604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交重併旬內之水傷身，溝河揷脚。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605479988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水爻動在日辰旬中，居穴之前，主有溝河挿脚之水。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605496372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生生福合三傳上，百子千孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605512756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重墓在一爻中，三墳四穴三傳，卽年月日三建也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605529140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或福德逢穴爻，更在三傳之位，相生相合，主百子千孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605545524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親世應日辰動爻重重墓在一爻之內，主有三坟四穴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605561908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻鬼爻，墓歸一爻之內，主有外人同葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605578292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神不入墓，游魂之鬼逢空，鬼已歸山；本命之爻逢合，","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605594676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543060489"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡命并鬼爻逢空，穴爻化鬼逢空，及臨游魂卦，皆主鬼不入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605594676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游魂世居外卦，空穴空墓，主無埋葬之地，或葬他鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605611060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶凶煞剋卦身者，必主惡死亡命。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605627444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴爻相生相合，或鬼爻逢墓，謂鬼已歸山。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605643828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在外卦應父","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605660212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦主附葬也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日帶應爻劫煞入穴，劫塜開棺。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605660212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用併世象動爻剋應，侵入作穴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605676596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰辰併玄武，應爻帶煞飛入穴，或動爻破穴破墓，主劫塜開棺；冲剋亡命，主暴棄尸骸。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605692980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應升日辰之煞，動破穴爻，主自家起墓開棺，盜财移葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605709364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若剋亡命，必主暴露不葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605725748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爲世爻併日辰動爻剋應，主侵人坟地。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605742132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作穴動與應爻併日辰，剋世剋穴，主他人侵自己坟地而埋葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605758516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客土動而墓爻合，擔土爲墳，朝山尊而穴法空，貪峯","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605774900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330560011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失穴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605774900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"客土者，外卦土、應土是也，與穴爻墓爻發動，相合相生，主是擔土爲坟，或旁土爲左右臂。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605791284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝山在長生貴人位，主前有貴峯聳秀。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605807668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若穴空，主有貪峯失穴之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605824052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟或不空，却朝由聳秀之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605840436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫空在日辰之後，穴在平洋；兄弟爻落世應之間，墳遷兩界。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605856820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫在日辰之後，逢空，或勾陳親戌巳辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605873204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，或爻在明堂寛大之地，多主平地作穴，世應同臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605873204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴爻更臨兄弟之爻，或在世應之閒，皆王坟遷兩界，或在日辰前後兩間之爻亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605889588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰與動爻，破穴破墓，定合重埋。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605905972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應併穴道，冲屍冲棺，當行攺葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605922356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424534978611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰發動，冲破墓爻，世應冲屍冲棺，或父化父、兄化兄、鬼化鬼、財化財，皆主重埋攺葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605938740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：金爲屍首木爲棺，士爲墓兮仔細看。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605955124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重交生穴，經營非一日之功；龍德臨財，遷造爲萬年之計。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605971508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交重二爻發動，併日辰皆生穴爻，主加工","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605987892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用事并一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日之可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622605987892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍臨財爻，子孫生旺有氣，與穴相合，相","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606004276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生主所造之坟，美麗悠乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應飛入穴，必葬他人；煞動臨爻，凶逢小鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606004276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如應爻飛八穴爻，主外人同葬，或是他人舊墓","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606020660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之旁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶煞犯亡人本命，或亡人本命臨死絶之地，主亡人不得善終，或不得善疾而死。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606020660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934302249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯天地六空亡之煞，骸骨不明。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606037044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴遇三傳刑刃之空，屍首有損。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606053428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六空，卽六甲旬空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606069812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三傳乃太歲、月建、","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606086196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰也。三刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606086196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如巳卯日古得坤卦，甲子亡命，穴臨上六，癸酉金乃甲戌旬中空，金乃甲寅旬之空。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606102580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子三傳帶刑刃凶煞，傷剋本命穴爻，或又在日，","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606118964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰旬之空亡，主骸骨不明，屍首有損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢冲逢剋，怕犯凶神，相合相生，眞爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606118964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻逢凶神相剋，相冲相刑，爲凶惡之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606135348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍福德爲吉神，生合扶拱，爲吉祥之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606151732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻生之子孫逢官逢貴，臨三傳，必作官人。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606168116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴生之爻臨子孫，逢官星、貴人臨三傳，生本命作印殺，主官職之榮。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606184500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535011379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴中之象數，合祿合財，若兩全，當爲財主。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606200884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴臨旺氣，有子孫財官爻在五爻之下，若子孫相生相合，如財祿兩全，乃富家之子也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606217268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"游魂福德空冲，主流蕩逃移；惡鬼凶神變動，見死亡凶橫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606233652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫逢空冲，在游魂卦，主逃離之人；空亡主流蕩不歸鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606250036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎、螣蛇凶神併鬼剋身世，主有死亡橫禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606266420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損父母子孫之財鬼，鰥寡孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606282804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦內父受損，兼不上卦，王出孤兒；子孫受傷，兼不上卦，主絶嗣；財爻受傷，兼不上卦出鰥夫；鬼爻受傷，兼不土卦出寡婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606299188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要指引明白，不可槩論。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606315572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面刃刑鬼破之劫亡，疲瘞殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606331956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330592779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨月破，兼三刑六害，同剋用爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606348340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乾宮主頭而喘、脅心之疾；艮宮主鼻瘡、手指腿足之疾；震宮主骨足肝腿、三焦顛狂之疾；巽宮主額鬂膝血氣風邪之疾；離宮主脾胃","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606364724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ateq0m/1-1714461405120.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JSGnVRscXHHA8hUIIpeuY%2FW5oQk%3D","uri":"read/HY0057/1/ref/1lpfk96ateq0m/1-1714461405120.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7680037622606364724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疽、眼目心痛、熱症湯火之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606364724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤宮主肚腹嘔叶與血瀉痢黄腫之疾；兌宮主口齒缺唇掀","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606381108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皮膚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之疾，金","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606381108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼痨嗽木鬼，風邪火鬼，熱症水鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐瀉、士鬼黃腫之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606381108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中間不可盡述，依理推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606397492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武遇咸池之劫煞，旣盜且娼；靑龍臨華葢之空亡，非僧則道。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606413876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武歲破、月破共位臨世爻，在坎出奸盗，或因盜至","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606430260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"死吉武咸池帶合，主女墮風塵，或滛奔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗化世爻併胎被受剋，主有墮胎産難之厄。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606430260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍、華蓋孤神値空亡有氣，是爲僧道之類。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606446644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月卦勾陳之土鬼，瘟疫相侵；陽宮朱雀之凶神，火灾","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606463028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819040266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頻數。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606463028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月卦是月將，勾陳、士鬼臨世身爻，主時灾瘟疫相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606479412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀怕逢火，更在火位，主有火灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606495796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母臨子孫之絶氣，嗣後伶仃；福德臨兄弟之旺宮，假枝興旺，父母以爲孤煞。","logicSentenceId":"7680037622606512180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如子孫爻属火，火絶在亥，若父母臨亥爻動，主後嗣伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183936040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子孫爻臨亡命，或在兄弟","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183952424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻臨旺相，自假宮來，主假枝興也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動，併旬中之凶煞，立見灾危。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183952424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴臨日下之進神，當臻吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183968808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劫刃","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183985192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑害、月破等煞，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰旬中發動，若被刑冲傷","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183985192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋身命，主見灾危劫殺之事，穴逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰，進神値財福，","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183985192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934335017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主臻吉慶康寧。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814183985192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例如戊寅日占得巳卯，穴爻逢財福是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184001576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看巳形之旣往，察過去之未來。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184017960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀可往可見之形，察吉凶過去未來之兆，無不驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184034344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事與世應互同，可見卦中之體用。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184050728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲體，應爲用，有體用發動，係于事體如何也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184067112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動與日辰相應，方知爻內之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184083496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事與日辰生合者吉，日辰與事剋冲者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184099880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求師捐金饌食，敎養雖賴乎嚴君；明善復初，啓發全資于","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184116264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819073034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先覺。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184116264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡求師傳，須究文書。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184132648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文書卽父母爻，爲書籍，爲學館，爲學分。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184149032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用居弱地，必不範不模；若在旺鄉，則可矜可式。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184165416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所請之師，無尊卑稱呼者，以應爻爲用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184181800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有尊卑名分，不可看應爻，當以名分論之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184198184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如門人卜投師，不論老幼，皆以父母爻爲師長。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184214568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神休囚，其師必然畏懼局促，不能爲人之模範。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184230952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相有氣，則魁梧雄。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184247336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偉，堪爲學者矜式。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨刑臨害，好施賈楚之威；賈楚儆頑之杖。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184263720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶刑害白虎，其師性暴少慈，必好笞撻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184280104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺動尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184296488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢歲逢身，業擅束脩之養。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184312872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934367785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻卦身或持太歲，其師專以嚴訓爲業，務得東脩以爲養。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184329256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家者：兌金震巽，襍學堪推；離火乾坤，專經可斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184345640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推師之專經雜學，當以父母在","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184362024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震、巽、艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、兌五卦爲襍學，離、乾、坤三宮爲","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184362024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"專經。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184362024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同鄕在内則離家不遠；他宮異地，在外","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184378408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則隔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"属須遙。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184378408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用象在本宮而居外卦，是本處人，其","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184394792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"住居必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺；在他宮而居內卦，是外郡人，其住居却近。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184394792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與世相生，非親則友；與世爻生合，必有親道。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184411176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與世爻不同宮者，是相識朋友。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184427560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與官交變，不貴亦榮。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184443944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543093257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用化官爻，其師異日必貴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184460328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加白虎帶刑","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184476712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"害則是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有病之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184476712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如持月建，更加青龍，必有前程。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184493096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在身靜合福爻，喜遇循循之善誘；動加龍德，怕逢","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184509480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凛凛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之威嚴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184509480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神與子孫作合最吉，必能博文約禮，循循善誘，甚得爲師之道，必主師徒契合。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184525864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕父動則剋子孫，更加白虎刑害，必然難爲子。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184542248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弟主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其師嚴毅方正，凛然不可少犯。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184558632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父八墓中邊孝先愛眠懶讀；父爻入莫，其師惟愛安逸，懶於敎訓。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184575016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"學分欠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通逢空化墓皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184591400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日辰冲破墓爻，又主聰察。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184607784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文臨身上，李老聃博古通今。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184624168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡求師，以文爲師之才學。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184640552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻無父，必久學問。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184656936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得靜臨卦身，或居生旺之地，其師","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184673320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"才學非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330625547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母化子孫，必主能詩能賦；父化福，其師善作雜文。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184673320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刑害病敗等爻，雖能作文，必多破綻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184689704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子帶月建，又加靑龍，必然出日成章。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184706088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與父作合，其師或有小兒。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184722472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶來。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184738856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼連兄煞，定然多詐多奸。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184755240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇兄動化鬼，鬼動化兄，皆主奸詐。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184771624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑剋世爻，必有是非口舌，口是心非。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184788008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨空亡而發動，用爻宜静不宜動，宜旺不宜空，動空不誠實，静空懶敎訓；化空亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184804392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼延此請，持世應而興隆，世應俱動，主有兩家延請；兩爻俱空，皆不能成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184820776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543126025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應値母而生世，須知假館；父臨應上，而世爻動來生合者，必館於他家，而欲附學也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184837160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父在外而福合，必是擔嚢。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184853544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜求師，若子弟自占，以世爲徒，不看福爻；父兄來占，以子弟爲徒，不看世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184869928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父在外卦，又係他宮安靜，而子孫動去相合，必遊學他方，擔嚢從師也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184886312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化文書剋世，則訟由乎學。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184902696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動若化出父母，刑剋世爻，異日必主爭訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184919080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化鬼爻，或官父皆動，有傷世者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184935464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月扶福德、日生，則靑出于藍。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184951848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏得子孫有氣不空，又遇日月動爻生合，則學有進益。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184968232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻反衰，則弟子反勝於師，如靑出於藍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814184984616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934400553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑剋同傷，父子必罹其害；合生爲助，官鬼莫受其扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185001000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父卜延師訓子，以世爲自，以子孫爲兒，以應爲師。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185017384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世與子孫皆受刑剋，日後父子必遭其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185033768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻動來刑剋世爻，子孫，不可，又加財動，生合助之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185050152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或擊或冲，父母逢之不久。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185066536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母雖要有氣，然不宜動，變動則傷剋子孫，必不能久。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185082920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或空或䧟，世身見之不成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185099304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應身爻空亡冲剋，皆見難成之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185115688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化父爻，妻族薦之于不日。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185132072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦有父母，遇本宮財爻，又化出一重者，不日間妻家又薦一師來也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185148456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟化出，則朋友薦來。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185164840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻是重。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185181224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535044147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已薦過矣，動爻是交將薦來也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母藏福德，僧家設帳于先年。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185197608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如父爻伏在子孫爻下，其師必前年設帳于僧房道觀。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185213992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父伏世下，乃是舊師。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185230376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捜索六爻，無過求理，思量萬事，莫貴讀書","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185246760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡求師，不可專指道學之師，如欲投學，百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"工枝藝及拜僧道爲師類皆是。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185246760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但師之主象自占，不異父母，而學者主象自占，當以世爻看之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185263144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如隔手來占，須問是","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185279528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何人如朋？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"友。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185279528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟則以兄弟爲主，類皆要師弟相生","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185295912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相合則吉，相冲相剋則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學館學得明師，可繼程風于滿座；師非良館，難期賈粟之","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185295912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330658315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盈倉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185295912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故欲筆耕，先須蓍筮。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185312296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爲西席，如逢父母必明經。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185328680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡占書舘，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻爲西席之位，如臨父母，自必明經。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185345064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世在離乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三宮亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185361448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帶鬼，或本宮官伏世下，","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185377832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多是秀才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應乃東家，若遇官爻須作吏。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185394216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻爲占舘東家主人若臨官，必是官吏戸役人家加白虎，則是病人，應臨父母勾陳種。田人家加朱雀，讀書人家加白虎，宰殺人家；加螣蛇，工藝人家。應臨子属金，僧道作主，應臨財，在隂宮隂爻，而卦無官鬼者，必是婦人作主。若應爻臨官，又帶貴人，則是富貴人家；財化財、財化子，做買賣人家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官兮少壯休囚，則貧乏之家；墓庫兮高年旺相，則","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185410600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535076915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富豪之主","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185410600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應爻臨旺爻，主人必然强壯；如臨墓庫，必是老年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185410600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財福必然富貴，欲論其德性，當以五類六神叅斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185426984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値土火空無父母，逢金水絶少兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185443368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得坤、艮属土，如火爻旺空，動空冲空，主父母不全。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185459752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰空，必無父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦得乾兌，属","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185476136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無水爻，水又絶于飛爻，或絶于日辰，則主無子孫，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185476136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拱不和，決定主賔不協；相生相合，必然情意相投。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185492520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應刑冲剋害，異日賔主不合；若得生合比和，情意相投。生而化剋，始和終不睦；冲而化合，始疎後宻。應與子孫生合，師弟則多恩義，若見冲剋，亦多不睦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財作束脩，不宜化弟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185508904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451819934433321"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占舘以妻財爲束修，獨怕兄弟發動，或財爻化兄，主束脩有名無實。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185525288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻無氣，而遇日神動爻生扶拱合者，束脩雖則不多，而四季節禮反周俻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185541672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爲書館，豈可逢空。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814185558056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占館以父母爻爲書館，旺相則有好書館。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267805731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無父或落空，必無書館，事亦難成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267822115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動合身，須得貴人推薦。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267838499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼發動，當有閒阻；若來生合世身，必得貴人推薦可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267854883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄興臨應，決多同類侵謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267871267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡應持兄動，必有同道之人爭謀其館。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267887651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨卦身亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267904035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在間爻動來冲剋世爻，主有人破說也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267920419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官如藏伏，應無督集之人；","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267936803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535109683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼能生扶父母，故占館以此爻爲糾率子弟之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267936803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不出現，或出現旬空，主無人聚生徒以成學舘也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267953187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應若空亡，未有招賢之主；應爻空亡，無人延請，更若父不出現，或落空，必難成就。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267969571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻動空化空，是假言作主也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814267985955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動象臨財難稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268002339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文書爲占舘用神，若遇財動，則被剋壞，未成者不能成，已成者不能遂意。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268018723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空爻持世豈如心。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268035107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父母出現，應來生合，而世爻空亡者，求舘不成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268051491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身位受傷，雖成不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268067875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世身被日建、月建動爻刑剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268084259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖成而日後有官，非疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268100643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947046923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻有動，總吉難成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268117027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻動剋，事多阻隔，故難成也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268133411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼或化兄，備禮先酬乎薦館。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268149795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇鬼爻動出兄弟，必得禮物，先酬薦舘之人，則可成就。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268166179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄臨世身亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268182563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世如變鬼，央人轉薦干東家。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268198947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻出現，而世又化出者，再得推薦可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268215331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無官而動爻有化出者，初無人薦，亦必央人薦之，可成也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268231715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世無生合，謾看白眼之紛紛。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268248099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應不剋世，父母不空，兄鬼不動，而月日動爻並不生合世爻者，其事總成，但主人不欽敬，故白","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268264483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眼待。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268264483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福或興隆，會見靑衿之濟濟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268280867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543158793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占舘以福爻爲門，生旺相多休囚少。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268297251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰逢扶起，日加負笈之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268313635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫衰弱，得日辰動爻生合，扶起學徒，始雖不多開舘，後日漸増益也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268330019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動遇冲開，時減執經之子。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268346403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫爻動，若被日辰動爻冲散，其徒必有背師而去者。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268362787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如被世冲，是先生叱退其徒也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268379171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢龍則俊秀聰明，遇虎則剛强頑劣。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268395555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨靑龍，逢月建生合，而又臨金水，必有潁悟非常之徒；若臨白虎，則多頑劣之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268411939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卦陽爻居養位，座前有劉恕之神童；隂宮隂象化財爻，帳後列馬融之女樂。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268428323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330691083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫在陽宮陽爻，而臨金水，旺相不空，有拱扶者，其徒必有出類拔萃。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268444707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如劉恕之神童在門。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268461091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在隂宮隂","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268477475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻主有女徒受學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩福自冲，鬼谷値孫臏、龎涓之弟子，子孫皆合，伊川遇楊特、游酢之門生。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268477475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有兩爻子孫俱動相冲，弟子中必多不合；若來傷世，必然責及先生。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268493859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇二爻俱來生合世爻，則門生","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268510243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自盡弟子之禮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動妻爻，決主親操井臼。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268510243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
