{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨財動，乃自炊爨，非供膳也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268526627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應生財値，定然供膳饔餐。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268543011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543191561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻臨應，生合世身，定主供膳。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268559395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建日辰動爻俱帶妻財，乃諸生輪流供膳。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268575779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相欵待厚，休囚欵待薄。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268592163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如索束脩，可把妻財推究；若居伏地，還求朋友維持。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268608547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占取索束脩，以財爻爲主，若不出現，必須凂求朋友取討，可有出現不傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268624931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相生身，名曰吉，入空無救；休囚死絶，號爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268641315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占束脩得財爻出現旺相，月建日辰動爻，不來傷剋，則不欠缺。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268657699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財出現被剋或絶，或空或墓，皆不遂意。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268674083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變出父爻，書債必然償貨物。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268690467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動化父，或父動化財，主束脩以貨物准折。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268706851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化成兄弟，硯田，定主欠收成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268723235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947079691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爻化兄，有名無實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身空應空財福空，必然虛度。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268739619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占束脩，遇卦身、應爻及子孫、妻財皆空，或不上卦者，主束脩無得。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268756003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月剋日剋，動變剋，恐受刑傷；月建日辰動變諸爻皆來刑剋世爻者，占舘有不測之凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268772387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化財生，非訟則學金休矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268788771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中無財，而遇兄鬼文書化出財爻生合世爻者，必須訟訴公庭，束脩可有，子連父合，因學而才思加焉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268805155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若衰絶無氣，而遇子孫動化生合世爻者，主子弟之才日加進益也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268821539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535142451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小忿不懲，必至爭長競短；大虧旣負，寜不訴枉申𡨚。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268837923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲定輪嬴，須詳世應。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268854307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中世應卽狀中原被，看此則兩邊勝負可知。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268870691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應乃對頭，要休囚死絶；世爲自己，宜帝旺長生，不拘原被。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268887075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"告占，以世爲自己，應爲對頭。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268903459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應旺世衰，他强我弱；世旺應衰，他弱我强。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268919843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相剋相冲，乃是欺凌之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268936227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻刑剋應爻，未爲我勝，乃是欺他之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268952611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必得鬼剋應爻，方爲我勝。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268968995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動爻與月建日辰剋之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814268985379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相生相合，終成和好之情。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269001763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330723851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應生合，原被有和釋之意。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269018147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生應，我欲求和；應生世，他欲求和。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269034531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應動空化空者，俱是假意言和也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269050915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應比和，官鬼動，恐公家捉打官司；世應比和，是和釋之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269067299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘官鬼動剋，主官府捉打官司，不依和議。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269083683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫亦動，終成和議也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269100067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦爻安靜，子孫興，喜，親友勸和公事。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269116451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻安静，世應雖不生合，而子孫發動者，必有親隣勸和也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269132835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空則我欲息爭；世空我欲息爭；應空，他欲息爭。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269149219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，兩願銷息。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269165603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應動則他多機變；世動則我必使心用謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269181987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化官兄，囘頭剋制，反爲失計；應動則他必有謀，若加月建，必有貴人倚靠。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269198371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋世","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269214755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819105802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則爲不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間傷世位，須防硬証同謀；鬼剋間爻，且喜有司明見。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269214755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻爲中証之人，生世合世，必然向我；生應合應，必然向他。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269231139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與世冲剋，與我有仇；與應冲剋，與彼有𨻶。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269247523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺爻生應，衰爻合世，是助彼者；有","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269263907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"力助我者無功。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静生應，動剋世，是向彼者，雖不上前，怪我者偏來出面。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269263907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若冲剋我之爻，反去生應合應，須防中証人同謀陷害。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269280291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得鬼爻剋制，或被日辰冲剋，是官府不聽其言，我得無事。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269296675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻若受刑剋，中証必遭杖責。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269313059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近世必是我之干証，近應爲彼之干証。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269329443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身乃根因事體，空則情虚。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269345827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身係詞訟根由，旺則事大，衰則事小，動則事急，静則事緩。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269362211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如空伏皆是虗揑事故。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269378595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛伏俱無，毫釐不實。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269394979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爲案卷文書，伏須未就。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269411363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330756619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無父母，文書未成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814269427747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶刑臨敗病，必多破綻。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938894370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化財亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938910754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化兄有駁，月建作合，上司必吊卷有冲，一不依允。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938927138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼作問官，剋應則他遭杖責。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938943522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爲聽訟，官動去剋應，訟必我勝，剋世我敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938959906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日爲書吏，傷身，則我受刑名。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938976290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰能救事，能壞事。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814938992674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼動剋世，自必有刑，得日辰制鬼冲鬼，必得旁人一言觧釋，問官必寛宥于我也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939009058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢財則理直氣壯，以財爲理。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939025442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨世我有理，臨應他有理。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939041826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼來刑害，雖有埋而官府不聽；兄動不容分辨。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939058210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如下狀則財爲忌爻，遇兄則財散人離。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939074594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟若在世身爻上，事必千衆，動則廣費資財，或加白虎，必主碩家蕩產。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939090978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨應爻則以被斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939107362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543224329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世入墓爻，難免獄囚之繫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939123746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻入墓化墓，或臨鬼墓，卦象凶者，必有牢獄之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939140130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨白虎，在獄有病。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939156514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官逢太歲，必非州縣之詞。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939172898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居第五爻，若値太歲，此事必干朝廷；逢月建必渉臺憲，內外有官，事渉一司，終不了。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939189282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官不上卦，無官主張，內外有官，權不歸一，主事體反覆，必經兩司。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939205666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"然後了事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下有父，詞興兩度始能成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939222050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父二爻，不宜重見，主有轉變不定之象，其事必主纒綿，卒難了結。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939238434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占告狀，遇此象，必再告方成也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939254818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父兩强，詞狀表章皆准理。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939271202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財一動，申呈訴告總","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939287586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947112459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒勞。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939287586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939303970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"欲上表申奏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申呈告訴，","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939303970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"等事，皆要官父兩全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣不空，則能准理。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939303970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕財動傷父，必不可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939320354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父旺官衰，雀角鼠牙之訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939336738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母旺相，官鬼休囚，情詞若大，事實細故，乃雀角䑕牙之訟。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939353122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變衰動旺，虎頭蛇尾之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939369506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡世應旺動，是有併吞六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"國之勢，若變入墓絶空亡","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939385890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃先强後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，虎頭蛇尾之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939385890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世以己言，應以彼言也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939402274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若逢生，當有貴人倚靠；應衰無助，必無奸惡刁唆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939418658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻衰弱，遇月建日辰","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939435042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻生合，必有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人扶持，彼亦無可奈何。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939435042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻遇之，反是無合無生，總旺何如獨脚虎，有刑有剋，逢空當效縮","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939451426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358445424535175219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭龜。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939451426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻旺動，無生合者，彼雖剛强，是獨脚虎不足畏世。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939467810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無生合，又遇日月動爻刑剋，當效縮頭龜，勿與對理。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939484194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄在間中事必干衆。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939500578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟在間爻，詞內干犯衆多，動則中証人貪索賄賂，剋應索彼之財，剋世，須用財託爲妥。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939516962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父臨應上，彼欲興詞；父母爲文書，臨世，我欲告理；臨應，他欲申訴。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939533346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動則欲行，静則未舉。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939549730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動而官化福爻，事將成而偶逢兠勸；父空而身臨刑煞，詞未准而先被笞刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939566114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占告訴，遇官父兩動，訟事可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939582498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父有氣，或官化子孫，則主身到公門，將投詞而有人兠勸。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939598882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若父化空","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939615266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947145227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡墓絶官鬼刑剋世爻，或被日辰刑冲剋害，告狀且不准，先遭杖責也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939615266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻動生官，須用貲財嘱託。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939631650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若訟已成，卦有財動，必須用財嘱託官吏。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939648034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇子孫冲官，雖費貲財，亦無所益。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939664418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世興變鬼，必因官訟亡身。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939680802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世持鬼，我失理；應持鬼，他失理；世變鬼，恐因官事而䘮。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939697186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身應變鬼，以彼斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939713570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子在身邉，到底不能結証。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939729954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官伏世下，訟根猶未芟除。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939746338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦身臨福德，出現發動，隨卽消散。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939762722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕官鬼伏世下，則訟根常在日下，雖不成訟，至官旺出透時舉發也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939779106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓逢日德刑冲，目下卽當出獄；歲挈福神生合，獄中必遇天恩。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939795490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819138570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世墓鬼墓爻動，皆是入獄之象，若得日辰刑冲剋破，目下卽當出獄。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939811874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在獄占卜，最喜太歲生合世爻，主有天恩赦宥。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939828258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建生合，上司審出；日辰生合，有司饒恕；父母生合，必須申訴，可得免也。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939844642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問罪名，須詳官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939861026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜罪名輕重，以官爻定之，旺則罪重，衰則罪輕。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939877410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加刑白虎旺動剋世，火受極刑，金主充軍，木主笞杖，水土徒罪，須以衰旺有制無制㫁之，不可執滯。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939893794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知消散，當看子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939910178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若福動鬼靜，以生旺月日㫁；鬼動福靜，以官墓月日㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939926562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦象旣成，勝負了然明白；訟庭一剖，是非判若昭彰。","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939942946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十終","logicSentenceId":"7680037814939959330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869368041507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十一古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緖註，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307694643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦，另其龍雲客任用淵、潛菴門人謝朝柱巨材同較。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307711027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡鑑升明男其章琢軒","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307727411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543257097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"避亂。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307727411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有窮通，世有否泰，自嗟薄命，適當離亂之秋；每嘆窮途，聊演變通之易。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307743795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因錄已驗之卦爻，爲決當今之倭寇。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307760179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼之方并官鬼所剋之處休往；子孫之方并生我之處宜去。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307776563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占守舊處，得子孫獨發生我，終無驚恐；占往他方亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307792947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此註是一篇之大㫖也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307809331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼位興隆，賊勢必然猖獗；官爻墓絶，人心始得安康。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307825715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼旺相發動，賊必猖獗；若得休囚安靜，日辰動爻制他，則安臥無驚。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307842099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路上若逢休出外，宅中如遇勿歸家。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307858483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114111523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦爲宅，外卦爲路。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307874867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在外動，出外必遇，宜守家中；若在內動，宜避于外。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307891251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動來刑害，總敎智慧也難逃；變入空亡，若被拘留猶可脫。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307907635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼動不傷世，任彼猖獗，不遭其禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307924019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如被刑冲剋害，必難逃避。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307940403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官爻變入死墓空絶，則是虎頭蛇尾，雖凶無咎之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307956787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰制伏，何妨卦裏刑傷；月建臨持，勿謂爻中隱伏。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307973171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼動來刑剋世爻，固是凶兆，若得日辰動爻剋制冲散之，皆謂有救，必不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970307989555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟怕月建、日辰帶鬼刑剋世爻，雖卦中無鬼，不免遭害。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308005939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所惡者提起之神，所賴者死亡之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308022323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819171338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻伏藏固吉，若被動爻日辰冲開，飛神提起，伏神仍被其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308038707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼爻眞空眞破，方許無灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308055091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自持鬼墓墳中，不可潜藏；或値水神舟內，猶當仔細。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308071475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼墓庫之爻，動來刑剋，或持世身是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308087859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇此象，不可避于墳墓內木鬼，不可避于草木叢中，水鬼不可避于舟船，金鬼不可避于寺歡，火鬼不可避于窑冶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308104243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爻福德北宜行，午象官爻南勿往。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308120627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼所臨之方，乃冦出入之處，宜避之；子孫所臨之方，乃賊不到之地，宜往之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308137011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼逢冲散，何須剋制之鄉；福遇空亡，莫若生扶之地。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308153395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫之方固吉，以其制鬼故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308169779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若發動則取之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308186163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若福静官動，而卦內有冲散官爻者，卽以冲散之方爲吉，以其爲得用之神故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308202547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若子孫空伏衰静受制，而鬼爻又無冲散者，宜取生世合世之方爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308218931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114144291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺興內卦，終來本境橫行。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308235315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占倭冦到我境否？","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308251699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官在本宮内卦，發動，","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308268083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必來在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他宮外卦，則不侵境也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308268083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若持世臨","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308284467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"內宮直。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"到我，","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308284467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"家臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦持應，雖來不入我室，卦身亦忌臨之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308284467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化退神，必往他鄉摽掠。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308300851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻發動，若化退神，將往他處刼掠也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308317235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如化進神，倭必速到，宜早避之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308333619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官連旺福合生身，反凶爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308350003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻發動剋世，必遭毒手。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308366387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得化出子孫制鬼，或動子財反來生合世身者，必然因禍致福。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308382771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽化隂財刑剋世，弄假成眞。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308399155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻發動，不傷世爻，而被動財反傷世爻者，必因貪得財物而惹禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308415539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543289865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊興三合爻中，必投䧟穽。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308431923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕動會鬼局，必主倭冦四邉合來，雖欲避之，前遭後遇，不能脫離。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308448307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有兩鬼俱動，剋世亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308464691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308481075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合兄局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身雖無事，財物失散。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308481075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合父局，小兒仔細；三合財局，生合世爻，反主得財，刑剋世爻，則主父母失散。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308497459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合子局，剋制鬼爻，爲最吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308513843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身在六旬空處，終脫樊籠。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308530227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身世空亡，避之爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308546611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼臨身，任爾潜踪，猶撞見。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308562995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官爻持世，乃是倭賊臨身，如何可避。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308579379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如被捉去而占，亦不能脫彼而回。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308595763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，總然對面不相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308612147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733132967970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，不動亦吉，發動尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308628531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨月建，或帶日辰，或在旁爻旺動，皆吉卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308644915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中雖有鬼，動不足畏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄變官爻，竊恐鄕人劫掠。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308661299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中無鬼，而遇兄動變出者，須防隣人乗機劫盜財物，非眞賊冦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308677683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄在內卦，是近隣，在外卦，遠方人也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308694067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財連鬼煞，須防臧獲私藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308710451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中無鬼，財變官爻者，是奴婢假籹賊冦劫物，或在亂中，被其藏匿也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308726835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在外卦，乃隣里婦人。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308743219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰冲剋財爻，妻孥失散；動象刑傷福德，兒女抛離。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308759603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動必有驚險。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308775987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘日辰動爻，被其傷處，卽不太平。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970308792371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如冲剋財爻，主妻孥失散；冲剋子孫，主兒女抛離。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395250714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火動剋身，恐有燎毛之苦；水興傷世，必成滅首之凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395267098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中火鬼動來剋世，主有火燒之禍；若水鬼剋世，主有水患。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395283482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443480819204106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父若空亡，包裹須防失脫；妻如落陷，財物當慮遺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395299866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爻空亡，非包裹失脫，須防父母有不測之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395316250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財空，防失財物，否則妻妾有殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395332634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫空","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395349018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則憂小口類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395349018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五位交重，兩處身家無下落。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395365402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇五爻發動，東奔西走，避亂不暇，身宅兩處，更遇日辰動爻，冲散世爻，必無安身下落之所。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395381786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻亂動，一家骨肉各東西。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395398170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六冲卦及六爻亂動者，主父","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395414554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弟夫妻骨肉各自逃命，不能聚汙一處。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395414554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福臨鬼位，刑冲帶煞，則官兵不道。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395430938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動固是吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395447322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶刑害虎蛇，而又變出官鬼者，乃是官兵乗亂刦掠。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395463706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官變兄爻，剋合傷財，則妻妾遭淫。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395480090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733133000738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動刑剋世爻，合住財爻，則身被擒，妻遭淫汚。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395496474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不傷世而但合財爻者，自身雖無事，妻必被辱也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395512858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更化兄爻，被姦而難望放回。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395529242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻去生扶，只爲貪財翻作禍；鬼動最喜衰絶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395545626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有財動生扶，必因貪財惹禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395562010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世以己言，應以人言。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395578394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子來冲動，皆因兒哭惹成灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395594778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼静最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395611162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若被子孫冲動，必有小兒啼哭，因而知覺，乃被其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395627546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福旺官衰，不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395643930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得値六親生旺，雖險何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395660314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨四絶刑傷，逢屯卽死，用爻遭剋，必有灾咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395676698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若受傷之爻，如値生旺，不致傷命，惟怕臨于絶地，若遇衰弱，一剋卽倒，必致䘮命也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395693082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世遇亂離，旣已逐爻而決矣，時遭患難，亦當隨象以","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395709466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439276041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395709466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平居無事，何暇占卜？","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395725850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或刑罰所加，戸役所累，或官府捉拿，仇家報復，或禍起于無辜，殃生于不測，苟不避之，終爲所害，是以不能無避害之占也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395742234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然大槩與避亂相似，故併附列于此。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395758618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕官爻剋世，則必難廻避。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395775002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡脫役避禍，遇鬼動傷世，皆不能避。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395791386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"持世亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395807770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼空絶静，如伏于世下者，目下無事，後當令恐復發覺。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395824154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大宜福德臨身，則終可逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395840538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395856922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫能制鬼爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解神若臨身世，或在旁爻發動，或値月建日辰，雖遇官鬼，亦不妨事。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395856922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大怕空亡墓絶受制。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395873306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官化父冲，必有文書挨捕。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395889690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺父發動，名已入冊，或有官批在外，鬼爻亦動，事體緊急。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395906074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化官，官化父，刑剋世爻者，必着公差挨捕；","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395922458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358427869368074275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日冲官散，必多親友維持。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395922458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官動固難逃避；若得","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395938842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰動爻冲散剋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之，必有心腹親友與我。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395938842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"周旋解釋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼伏而兄弟冲提，禍由骨肉；官伏而被兄弟冲飛，提㧞者，","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395955226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或兄弟冲動鬼來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑剋者，是自家骨肉，搜踪捕跡，恐難逃避也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395955226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官靜而旁爻刑剋，事出吏書；鬼静而卦中動爻刑剋世爻者，乃是下役及仇家陷害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395971610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若化兄爻，彼欲索詐財物；應若遭傷，當累衆。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970395987994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼傷剋應爻，必然累。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396004378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及他人月建日辰亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396020762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻如受剋定傷財，","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396037146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358443931543322633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇兄動，必主破費財物。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396037146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏喜六爻安靜，六爻不動，官爻無冲併者，患難可避，戸役可脫。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396053530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又宜一卦無官無鬼，則無官主張，事必平安，空亡亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396069914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或身世之逢空，世身空亡，百事消散，總有鬼動，亦不妨事。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396086298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或用神之得地，用神旺相，而無刑冲剋害，不化死墓空絶，皆爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396102682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216680994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天來大事也無妨，海樣深仇何足慮。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396119066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二句總結上文四節而言，卦中有一吉神，決然無事也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396135450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事有百端，理無二致。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396151834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潜心玩索，若能融會貫通，據理推占，自得圓神，不滯逃亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396168218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛以禦衆，侮慢斯加；嚴以治人，逃亡遂起。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396184602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故雖大聖之有容，尚謂小人之難養。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396200986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須察用爻，方知實跡。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396217370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻者，如占奴婢妻妾逃亡，看財爻類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396233754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨午地，必往南方；或化寅爻，轉移東北。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396250138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759398949"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻安静，以所臨之地爲逃去之向，故云臨午是南方。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396266522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用爻發動，以變爻定方向。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396282906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"轉移者，轉往一方也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396299290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如午變寅爻，定然先往正南，後往東北也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396315674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木属震宮，都邑京城之內；金居兌象，菴院寺觀之中。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396332058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神如臨震宮，木爻必在郡邑；如臨九五，必往京城。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396348442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用臨兌宮，金象，必避在菴院寺觀之中。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396364826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼墓交重，廟宇中間隱匿；休囚死絶，墳陵左右潜藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396381210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用持鬼墓，其人必隱廟宇之中；用臨死絶，必藏身于墳墓左右也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396397594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢四庫，當究五行。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396413978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四庫，卽辰戊丑未四支。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396430362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用爻属木，卦有未動類。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396446746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰爲水士庫，必在水邉；戌爲火庫，在寺廟側；丑爲金庫，在銀鐡匠家；未爲木庫，在園林柴草間，或木工篾。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396463130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匠之家，凡占逃下盜賊，若遇墓爻，决難尋見，直待冲","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396479514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114177059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破墓爻日月，方可得見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396479514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘伏五鄕，豈宜一類。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396495898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無用神，湏看伏在何爻下，便知其人在於何處。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396512282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如伏鬼下，在官倉官庫之中；旺加月建，在官戸家；休囚無氣，在公吏家；伏父母下，在叔伯父母家；不然，在手藝家。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396528666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏兄下，在兄弟姊妹及相識朋友家；伏財下，在奴婢妻妾隂人處；伏子下，在寺觀及卑㓜處也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396545050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如伏於鬼墓下，不在廟宇中，則在寺菴內。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396561434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如伏於財庫爻下，不在倉庫中，則在富豪家也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396577818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木興水象，定乗舟楫而逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396594202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻属木，在坎宮動者，必乗舟逃去。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396610586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木化水，水化木，或木在水宮動，或水動木宮者皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396626970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動合伏財，必拐婦人而去。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396643354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378759206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻動來，與本宮財爻作合，其人必拐婦人逃去。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396659738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若伏於世下，必是妻妾，在應爻下，乃是鄰家婦女。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396676122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內近外遠生世，則終有歸期。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396692506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻在本宮內卦，人在本地，在本宮外卦，在本府别縣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396708890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他宫內卦外縣交界處，他宮外卦外府州縣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396725274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在六爻遠方去矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396741658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最喜生世合世持世，其人雖去，日後當自歸來，尋亦易見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396758042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜易動難坐，空則必無尋路。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396774426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻不動，其人易尋；動則遷移無常，指東言西，或更名攺姓，必難尋獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396790810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若落空亡，杳無踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396807194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合起合住，若非容隱卽相留。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396823578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用静逢合則合起，用動逢合則合住。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396839962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日辰動爻合起用神，必有窩藏容隱相留。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396856346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知相留容隱之人，以合爻定之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041970396872730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在子孫爲僧道，父母爲尊長類，合爻與世冲剋，決不來報。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205026842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216713762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲動冲開，不是使令當敗露。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205043226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静爻逢冲爲冲動，動爻逢冲爲冲開。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205059610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻遇動爻日辰冲動，家中必有人使令逃亡者，如父母是尊長類，動父刑剋，有人阻彼登程；日建生扶，有伴糾他同去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205075994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻逢冲，被人喝破；遇剋，被人捉住；有扶、有併、有生，有人糾他同去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205092378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已上刑剋等爻，與世有情，必來報我。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205108762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻作合，原中必定知情。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205125146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻爲原保人無保，以鄰里㫁之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205141530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如與用爻相合，必知其情。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205157914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更與世爻冲剋，必是此人誘去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205174298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應相冲，路上須常撞見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205190682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱動相冲，在途撞見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205207066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻與世動冲亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205223450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻動剋用爻，或世旺應衰，必然擒拿；應旺世衰，或用爻剋世，雖能遇見，不能捕之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205239834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439308809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無冲無破，居六位則一去不回；有剋有生，在五爻則半途仍走。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205256218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻不受刑冲剋害，又不生合世爻，而世爻不剋用爻者，是逃者不思歸，尋者不得見，乃一去不回之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205272602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若動爻日辰剋制用爻，是可擒之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205288986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇變岀之爻，反生合用爻者，主捕後仍被逃走。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205305370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象化出主象歸亦難留。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205321754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有用爻不宜化退神，謂之化去，必難捕獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205338138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若被世爻動爻日辰剋制，縱捉回之後，亦難乆留。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205354522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮化入本宫，去應不遠。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205370906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮仍化本宮卦者，譬如乾卦化入姤、遁、否、觀等本宮卦也，主其人逃在本處地方，必不遠出。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205387290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用爻在他宮動而又化入他宫者，遠去又轉方也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205403674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733133033506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸魂卦用仍生合，不捕而自回；游魂卦應又交重，能潛而㑹遁。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205420058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得歸魂卦，彼意歸切。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205436442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生合世爻者，彼必自歸，尋之易見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205452826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇游魂卦，其人必無歸意；能潛會遁，尋必難見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205469210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋應爻，任爾潛身終見獲；應傷世位，總然對面不相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205485594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋用，是我制他，去不甚遠，尋之易見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205501978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用剋世，是他得志自由之象，尋之難見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205518362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母空亡，杳無音信。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205534746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母主信，逢空則無信。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205551130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如動來生世合世，定有報信人來也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205567514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發動，當有維持；","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205583898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378791974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫臨身世，自然去必順利。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205583898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得日辰生台世爻，必有維持，總有逆事，不能爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205600282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言逃人自卜也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205616666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞傷身，竊恐反遭刑辱。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205633050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動變日月刑冲，剋害世爻者，謂衆煞傷身也，反遭刑辱，不逃者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205649434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動兄持世，必然廣費貲財。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205665818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟持世，費財可尋，費財可逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205682202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若加玄武旺動剋世，湏防有人动騙。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205698586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動變宮，必得公人捕捉。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205714970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父化官，官化父，或官父俱動，必湏與詞告官，差捕可獲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205731354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世投入墓，須防窩主拘留。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205747738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇世爻入墓者，反被拘留人之辱，或後有灾病。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205764122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114209827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應比和不空，必潜于此。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205780506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜逃人在此處否，須得世應生合比和，用爻出現不空，必潜於此處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205796890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應空亡獨發，徒費乎心。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205813274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世空則去尋不緊，用空，尋亦不見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205829658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應俱空，必主無可尋處空回。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205846042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟獨發，虗詐不實，亦尋不見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205862426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但能索隱探幽，何慮深潜遠遁失脫","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205878810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"附盜賊，捕盜、捉賊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"民苦飢寒，每有穿窬之軰；勿忘檢束，亦多遺失之虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205878810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識其中之得失，須詳卦上之妻財財爻，爲所失物之主。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205895194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得冲中逢合，失必可得；如合處逢冲，旣失不能復得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205911578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439341577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自空化空，皆當置而勿問；日旺月旺，總未散而可尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205927962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻自空，或動化空，皆難尋見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205944346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財值月令，或在日辰生旺之地，此物未散可尋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205960730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦本宮搜索家庭，可見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205977114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他宮外卦，追求隣里，能知財在本宮。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721205993498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦其物未出家庭，可見財在他宮。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206009882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦物已出外，難得，在間爻隣里人家，可尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206026266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五路四門，六乃棟梁閣上。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206042650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此指六爻言。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206059034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其大畧用神在五爻道路可尋，在四爻門戸可𡬶，在第六爻梁閣上可尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206075418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者不可執泥，宜","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206091802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當活潑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初井二竈，三爲閨閫房中。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206091802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用臨初爻子亥水，井中可尋，在二爻灶前可尋，在三爻房内可尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206108186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如伏三爻官鬼下神堂內可尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206124570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439733133066274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水失于池，术乃柴薪之內，土埋在地，金爲磚石之間，財臨水爻，物在池沼；財臨木爻，竹木𣗳林柴薪內。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206140954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨金爻，旺相，在銅鐡錫器中；休囚缸甏罐瓶。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206157338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206173722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦旺相，磚石內；休囚，瓦礫中類。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206190106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動入墓中，財深藏而不現。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206206490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘用爻入墓化墓，或伏墓下，必在器物中。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206222874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知何日見，湏待冲墓之日。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206239258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜臨世上，物尚在而何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206255642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占失脫，用爻不宜動，動有更變，若得安靜持世，生世合世，其物皆主未散，必易尋得，生旺不空尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206272026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼墓爻臨，必在墳邉墓側；用臨鬼墓，其物必在寺廟中；無氣則在墳墓內。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206288410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如係本宮內卦，則在柩傍，或在坐席上。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206304794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更加螣蛇，𢙢在神","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206321178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759431717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖佛像之前，在三爻香火堂中類。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206321178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰合住，定然器掩遮藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206337562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用爻發動，遇日辰合住，必然有物遮藏。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206353946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中逢合必得；合處逢冲，難尋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206370330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206386714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福變妻財，須探䑕穴；酉地財逢福德，當檢雞栖。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206403098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化福，福化財，其物必在禽獸巢窟中。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206419482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如値子爻，是鼠啣去，更在初爻，在地穴，寅是猫啣，丑在牛欄，午在馬廐，未在羊牢，酉在鷄栖，亥在猪圈類也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206435866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有合則在内，無合則在旁。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206452250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼在空中，世動則自家所失。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206468634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦無官或落空而世爻動者，乃自遺失，非被人偷去也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206485018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財伏應下世合，則假貸于人。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206501402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358434894114242595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼或空或伏，或死絶不動，而財臨應上，或伏應下，乃自借於人也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206517786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知何人假借，以應臨六親定之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206534170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨子爲卑纫類，若伏子孫，當在僧房道院；如伏父母，必遺衣笈書箱。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206550554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用不上卦，湏尋伏于何處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206566938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏子孫爻下，物在寺院或卑纫處；如伏父母下物在正屋中，或在尊長處，無合衣服書卷中，有合衣箱、書箱內。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206583322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏兄下，本宫兄弟姊妹處，他宮相識朋友處，在內則家中失脫，在外則他處遺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206599706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用父在內卦，失于家中；用爻在外卦，失於他處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206616090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財伏逢冲，必是人移物動。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206632474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財伏卦中，遇動爻日辰暗冲者，若鬼爻衰靜，其物被人移動，非人偷也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721206648858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378824742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼興出現，定爲賊竊人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288912942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼不上卦，或落空，或衰絶不動，皆不是人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288929326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂卦多是忘記，若鬼爻變動，方是人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288945710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂女陽男，內卦則家人可決；生壯墓老，他宮則外賊無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288962094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻属陽，男子偷，属隂女人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288978478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂化陽，女偷與男；陽化隂，男偷寄女。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721288994862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，壯年人，墓絶老年人胎養，小兒偷，帶刑害，有病人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289011246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本宮內卦，家中人偷，他宮內卦，宅上借居人偷，或家中異姓人偷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289027630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾宮鬼帶螣蛇西北方，瘦長男子；巽象官加白虎東南上，肥胖隂人。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289044014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此指八卦以定方向，六神以定賊形。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289060398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼在乾宫西北方，人在巽宮東南方，人帶螣蛇，身長而瘦，加白虎","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289076782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894249506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相，賊必肥大，休囚痩小，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289076782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與世刑冲，必是冤仇相聚；與福交變，必然僧道同謀。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289093166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻與世刑冲，其賊向有仇隙者，與世生合，乃是兼親帶故之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289109550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼化子，子化鬼，必有僧道雜在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289125934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼遇生扶，慣得中間滋味。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289142318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻無氣，又臨死絶，若遇動爻日辰扶起者，此賊慣得其中滋味。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289158702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶月建是强盜，加太嵗是積賊。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289175086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官興上下，須防裏外勾連。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289191470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有兩鬼，偷非一人，俱動，是外勾禋連；內動外靜，是家人偷與外人，外動內靜，家中人有知情。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289207854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木剋六爻，窬墻而八；金傷三位，穿壁而來。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289224238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木鬼剋土，窬墻掘洞；金鬼剋木，割壁鑚籬；火鬼剋金，劈鐶開鎻；水鬼剋火，灌水滅燈；土鬼剋水，涉溪跳澗；","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289240622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759464485"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火交化，明燈執杖，要知何處進入，以鬼剋處定之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289240622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如木鬼剋六爻，踰垣而入，剋初爻，後門掘洞而進也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289257006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世去冲官，失主必曾驚覺；世衝鬼爻，失主知覺；應冲鬼爻，他人知覺；旁爻冲鬼，旁人知覺。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289273390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰來剋鬼，賊心亦自驚疑。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289289774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼被日辰動爻刑剋，彼時賊心驚疑，賊必補獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289306158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
