{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動丑宮，問牧童，必知消息。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289322542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福興酉地，見酒客，可探情由。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289338926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動必有人撞見，詢之可知消息。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289355310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在子爻，可","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289371694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問科","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭男子，或捕魚人，在丑爻，可問牧童、築墻等人，在寅爻是木客、木匠、擔竹、木噐等人，在邜爻問織蓆、賣屢、挑柴砟草等人，在辰爻問開池鑿井、傍河鋤地等，","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289371694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216746530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳爻問穿紅女子；或弄蛇乞丐人，在午爻問燒窑、乗馬、討火、提燈等人，在未爻問挑灰、耕種、牧羊等人，在申爻問銅銕匠；或弄猴人，在酉地問針工，酒客、捉鷄等人，在戌爻問挑泥鋤地、牽狗等人，在亥爻擔水踏車、洗衣沐浴等人。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289371694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄動劫財，若卜起賍無處覓；卜起賍及尋物，若見兄動，皆主財物失散，終難尋覔。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289388078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官興剋世，如占捕盜反傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289404462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占捕盜，要世旺鬼衰，世動鬼静，則易于捕獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289420846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼爻乗旺動來刑剋世爻，湏防反被其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289437230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世値子孫，任彼强梁何足慮。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289453614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲捕賊之人，若旺動或臨世，或日月臨之，則鬼有制，賊必可獲，總凶惡强盜，不足畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289469998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439374345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨墓庫，總能巡捕亦難擒。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289486382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻入墓，及化入墓，或伏墓下，皆主其賊深藏難捕，得動爻日辰破墓可獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289502766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日合賊爻，必有窩藏之主。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289519150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爲賊爻，捕盗遇合，賊必有人窩藏，不能得見，待冲合之日可獲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289535534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動冲鬼煞，還逢指示之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289551918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼爻遇冲動及受剋，必有人指示。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289568302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賊隱之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289584686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦若無官，理當論伏。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289601070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財如發動，墓處推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289617454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捕盜無官，賊必隱跡，湏看伏在何爻之下，便知賊在何處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289633838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如伏財下，在妻奴家類。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289650222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若動爻有化出者，卽以變爻論之，不湏看伏。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289666606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卜起賍，見財爻發動，看其墓在何處，便知藏固何方。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289682990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894282274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏若剋飛，終被他人隱匿；飛如剋伏，還爲我軰擒拿。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289699374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此伏只論鬼爻，此飛只論世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289715758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如鬼伏世下剋飛，終難擒獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289732142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如世剋，","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289748526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏，必可擒挐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏空爻，借賃屋居非護賊；鬼伏空爻下，賃屋居住，非是窩藏，或潜住他家，亦非容隱，後終敗露。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289748526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如藏世下，隄防竊盜要留心。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289764910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占防盜，最要鬼爻衰静及空，或日辰冲","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289781294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"散或子孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋制，皆爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289781294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼爻無制，動剋世爻，當受其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289797678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼伏世下，目下雖無事，至其出透時，宜隄防累及。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289814062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘失舟車衣服，不宜妻位交重，或亡走獸飛禽，切忌父爻發動","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289830446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439407113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失脫，不可專以財爲用神，若失","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289830446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舟車衣帽，文書章奏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則以父母爲用爻，故忌財動。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289830446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若失；飛禽","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289846830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"走獸則以子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孫爲用爻，故忌父動。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289846830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受剋則難尋覔。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289863214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學宜通變，卦爻子細捜求，盜賊難逃捉獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289879598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"新増痘疹六氣司天，寒暑灾祥之感應，五行迭運痘","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289895982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"痧，瘡疹之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流行，欲問安危，須憑易卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289895982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先察用象。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289912366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺衰","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289928750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"次究忌神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動靜，生扶拱合，痘長靈根。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289928750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋害刑冲，花","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289945134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遭妬雨父動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則護持乎兄弟，兒孫安得云宜；兄興則爲難","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289945134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"于妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴，子姪喜其相遇。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289945134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最吉者官安用旺，最凶者","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289961518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼旺忌興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894315042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜痘痧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必先分别用神，原神旺衰，次究忌神仇神。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289961518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動静如卜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟出花，以兄弟爻爲用神，父母爻爲原","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289977902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"神動而生之，是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289977902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘卜子姪，以子孫爻爲用神，父動","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289994286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則剋子是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721289994286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卜妻奴婢妾，以財爻爲用神，兄動則","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290010670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋財矣。凡卜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于姪喜遇兄弟動也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290010670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼爲痘花，不宜","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290027054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷損亦不宜動，動恐變壞。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇刑冲剋害、伏藏等象。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290027054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是險逆之症也，卽勉强起發，亦難收功。如用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神旺相","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290043438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静而得生扶拱合者，是順症而無憂慮也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290043438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用得長生，百年之內保無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290059822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神長生於日辰，或化長生者，雖百年之內無憂，目下何必慮之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290076206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原臨死絶，一月之外終有害","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290092590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如用神休囚，再受傷剋，又遇原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神臨於死絶之處日。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290092590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夕難延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用神出現旺相，而原神静逢死絶，或動化傷剋者，目下","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290108974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得令。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見收功","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290108974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退炁，仍有不測之害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290108974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439439881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官强而痘難開朗，福旺則花必稀疎，","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290125358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼爻爲痘症，宜靜不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動動則有變，静而衰","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290125358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者痘。稀旺而動者痘宻，福神爲痘花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，主亦宜安静有氣，最忌動化傷剋，若得福旺官衰，痘花定然稀朗，必好收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290125358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓庫不宜臨用，痘喜起發，既發又喜神淸，若用神入墓庫，初難起發，後必神思昏倦，主難收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290141742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚豈可持身，出花之人，宜於體旺，則易收功。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290158126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神休囚，必是體弱，再無原神日月生扶者，後亦有變卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290174510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現官多防賊痘之爲禍","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290190894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290190894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現多則痘分粗細。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290207278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無了孫出現，恐痘宻之中，間有毒痘，其名日賊痘。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290223662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如不去之，則害一身。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290240046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216779298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"痘矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻臨福衆，慮進補以招殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290256430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫之爻不宜多現，只要旺相有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290272814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如多現，不宜用補藥食補物，若用補，反恐有害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290289198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亂動皆非吉，伏吟亦是凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290305582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸卦皆怕亂動，何况于痘花。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290321966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占皆畏伏吟，豈獨于痘症乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290338350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫發現，當勿藥而自痊；父母交重，縱延醫而難治。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290354734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子孫發動，不遇日月動變傷剋者，倘卜用藥，當許立效，故喻之不藥而能愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290371118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財動卦中，宜調脾胃。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290387502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲飲食，宜旺不宜空，空則不思飲食；宜静不宜動，動則生助官鬼，恐因多食而傷脾胃，故須調養。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290403886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378857510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄興象內，須理胸懷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290420270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲調理之物，兄爲氣悶之神。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290436654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇兄弟爻發動，動則傷剋財爻，主飮食少進，或乏于調理。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290453038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在間爻，宜寛胸理氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290469422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨朱雀，必感怒而不思飲食，貪口腹而増憂，多爲幇官傷世。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290485806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻發動，則生官鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290502190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦中又見官鬼發動而剋世身主象者，必因貪口腹以致増病。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290518574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或未出痘之前，已","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290534958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"停食也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛滋味而進食，定因助福生身。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721290534958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟本是剋財，動則不思飲食。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721376993318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得子孫亦動，動來生世身用象者，謂之助福生世，主出痘之人，初不思食，因愛一味引開胃口，始能進食也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377009702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216812066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦遇六冲難起發，爻逢六合好收功。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377026086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡卜近病，喜遇六冲，謂之冲散灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377042470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟卜痘症則不然，謂之花逢冲則敗，猶如妬雨侵花，初難起發，後不收功。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377058854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇六合卦，或用神逢生合，則易起發，必好收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377075238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悶而不發，皆緣用伏加傷；發而不槳，只爲官空増制。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377091622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神出現，不遇日月動爻刑冲剋害，是大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377108006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神伏藏，再受日月動爻刑冲剋害者，必是悶症，難過四五朝者，屢驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377124390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻旬空月破，又遇日辰動爻剋害者，痘縱起發，在七八朝，恐不灌漿，難于收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377140774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原神若壞，縱用現兮不祥；主象受傷，得救護兮無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377157158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原神者，生用神之爻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377173542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如原神旬空，或伏藏而無傷剋者，主症虚體弱，非補不能起發。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377189926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣起發，主無力灌漿。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377206310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若原神値眞空眞破，或伏而受傷太過，或化回頭剋傷，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377222694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"原神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受傷，用神無根，焉能得生，非吉祥之","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377222694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378890278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377222694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如主象逢傷剋，而遇原神臨月建、日辰動爻救護者，痘症雖險，可㫁不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377239078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者宜變通。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377255462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福鬼若値靑龍，方宜種痘。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377271846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或子孫爻臨靑龍，或官鬼爻臨靑龍，不遇日月動爻刑冲剋害者，如卜種痘，爲大吉之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377288230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻旬空，或伏藏福神，不値靑龍，縱種痘而不出也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377304614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用煞如臨白虎，且慢栽花。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377320998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或用神臨白虎，或忌神臨白虎，用神受日月動變爻刑冲剋害者，不宜種痘，恐反被害耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377337382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武冲世冲身，汚婦魘而作變。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377353766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武臨財爻動，來冲世身用象者，主因汚婦冲魘，以致痘花作變。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377370150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如玄武臨應爻動，來冲世身主象者，因外人𨶠魔作變也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377386534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358446669974732840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎臨官臨用，火毒甚而未淸。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377402918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎是血神，如臨官鬼，或臨用神，而遇日月","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377419302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動爻刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲剋害，若非生痰，定是結毒。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377419302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如在乾宮，毒結","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377435686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"頭面。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤腹、震足、巽股、艮手、離目、坎耳、兌口等類推之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377435686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身上虎，須向五行言帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377452070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡卦身一爻，主痘人始終之事。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377468454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377484838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨福德，吉神主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無痘毒，如臨官鬼，必有結毒成疾之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377484838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377501222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼係","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肺經火毒未淸，鼻孔内生瘡，或左耳帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377501222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨木鬼，係肝經火毒未淸，主兩目内出痘，或右耳帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377517606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇水鬼，係腎經火毒未淸，主兩耳乾枯。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377533990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘴","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377550374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唇帶疾如官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼属火，係心經火毒未淸，舌上乾焦，主帶目疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377550374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官鬼属上，係脾經火毒未淸，主日如魚口、鼻梁帶疾已。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377566758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上官鬼所属臨持卦身，如値休囚，見福神發動者，用藥可愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377583142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無福神剋制，反加","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377599526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附持，則有損矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377599526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃終身之疾","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377615910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759497253"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻中煞，當憑八卦諭週身。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377615910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如虎鬼居乾宮，則帶疾在頭；如居兌象，","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377632294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則帶疾在面。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如居震卦，帶疾在足；如居巽宮，則帶疾在股；如居坎卦，則帶疾在耳；如居離卦，則帶疾在","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377632294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目如居艮卦，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"带疾在手；如居坤卦，則帶疾在腹。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377632294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377648678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上八宫所值鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻如遇福神剋制，則醫治易，","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377648678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"愈如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再加白虎持臨，定成終身之疾也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377648678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金爲肺腑，增疼增嗽非宜；火属心經，發嗆發斑大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377665062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼属金，毒發肺部，主身體作痛或咳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377681446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"嗽苐防鼻搧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官鬼属火，毒發心經，乃火毒之症，初起防發斑，繼防發嗆，及舌頭縮硬。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377697830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰静者輕，旺動者重。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377714214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木鬼乃風邪未表水官，而寒食尚停，木能生風，故主風邪。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377730598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻属木，必因未表風寒，肝經受毒，防嗆喘發癢，及兩目直視。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377746982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377763366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爻属水，毒發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216844834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腎經防腰疼，及兩耳焦乾，尚有寒食停積，發熱縮漿麻面。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377763366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官乘四上破碎位遇三冲官鬼爲痘花。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377779750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨辰、戊、丑未四土，土属脾經，脾經主痘粗扁多宻，故云麻面，防口如魚口。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377796134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官爻遇年、月、日三建冲者，灌槳後防破碎洩氣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377812518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武主隂虛黑縮，勾陳應脹悶黃浮。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377828902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武臨官爻，或臨忌神，乃隂虗之症，防縮漿黑陷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377845286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳若附鬼爻，主服悶黃浮。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377861670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇木擺似驚風，朱雀火炎眞血熱。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377878054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇臨木爻官鬼，主初起未見點時，似乎驚風。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377894438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦中官鬼属火，又臨朱雀，是血熱火毒之症，須用大黃、黃連等劑，必淸火瀉毒，方能有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377910822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遲服，則斑甚痘隱焦黑，不能挽回也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377927206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439472649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎同忌煞交重，哭聲將至。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377943590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自虎臨忌神發動，剋傷用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377959974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又無原神救護者，立見其危。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377976358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍會恩星發動，慶賀齊來；青龍臨原神發動，生合用神，痘必收功也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721377992742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定死活于五行生剋之中，決輕重于六神臨持之上，生死全憑生剋，輕重兼看六神。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721378009126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此節乃一章之大㫖也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721378025510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫滿目未出花，躭許多憂慮；金玉滿堂失敎訓，枉費𥁞心機。","logicSentenceId":"7680042721378041894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十一終","logicSentenceId":"7680042721378058278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947177995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十二古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒註，壬午","logicSentenceId":"7680051471328985140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舉人，弟需遵時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"叅訂吳庠鍾英子燦，男其龍、雲客、任用淵、潛𤲅門人謝朝柱巨材同較蔡鑑升明男其章、琢軒","logicSentenceId":"7680051471328985140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439505417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出行：人非富貴，焉能坐享榮華；茍爲利名，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471328985140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寜免奔馳道路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然或千里之迢遥，夫豈一朝之䟦。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471328985140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"渉途中，休咎若箇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能知就裏灾祥，神靈有準。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329001524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爲行","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329017908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李帶刑則破損不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，妻作盤纒，生旺則豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329017908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足用。母爲行李，旺相多休，因少類旺空，雖有而出行，以父舊物妻財爲財物本錢類旺相充不多，帶刑害破損。滿休囚微少，若從兄弟化出，必是合本，或是借來，非巳之物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世如衰弱，那堪水宿風餐；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329034292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爲自巳，生旺則健，休囚則倦，所以不堪勞碌于風霜中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759530021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應若空亡，難望謀成事就。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329034292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爻爲所往之處，最怕空亡，主地頭寂寞，謀事難成，不能得意而回。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329050676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻安靜，往來一路平安；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329067060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"□爻爲往來經歷所在，動則途中阻滯，若得安靜，則往來平安無阻。臨財福動，途中謀望，勝如地頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲剋冲，行止終年撓括。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329067060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太歲發動，冲剋世爻，其人出外，終年不利。更加白虎凶煞，尤非吉兆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世傷應位，不拘遠近總宜行；應剋世爻，無問公私皆不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329083444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世剋應，是我制他，所向通逹，去無阻節。應剋世，所向閉塞，更遇動爻日辰刑剋，更不吉利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439538185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八純亂動，到處皆凶；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329099828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八純乃六冲之卦，六爻不和，又遇亂動，何吉之有？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩間齊空，獨行則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329099828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間爻若空，主無阻滯，又爲伴侶。若二間皆值句空，宜自獨行，庻免同伴之累。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世動訂期，變鬼則自投羅綱；官臨畏縮，化福則終脫樊籠。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329116212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻不動，行期不定，動則期巳訂矣。世應俱動，宜速行。若世動變出鬼爻，去後必遭禍患，或鬼持世乃是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逡廵畏縮，欲行不行之","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329132596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化子孫，雖有灾患，不足畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329132596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜遇日冲，必爲他人而去；動逢間合，定因同伴而留。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329148980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358446669974765608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻安靜，遇日辰動爻暗冲者，他人㻊去，非爲自巳謀也。日辰併起，合起皆然。若世爻發動，遇日辰動爻。合住者，是將行而有羈絆，未能起程；間爻方是同伴覊留，欲斷行期，湏逢冲日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世若逢空，最利九流出往；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329165364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世空去不成，强去終難得意，徒劳奔走。若九流藝術及公門等人，是空拳間利，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土如遇福，偏宜陸地行程。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329165364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中火上爻是陸路，水木爻是水路，若臨財福吉，兄鬼凶。鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地墓鄕，豈堪踐履；財方父向，却可登臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329181748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼地墓鄕，財方父向，如自占卜，皆以世位而言。官鬼之方，及鬼之墓方、世之墓方，并剋世之方，此等凶方。不可踐履，宜往財福之方及生世之方，爲大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759562789"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官挈玄爻刑剋，盜賊驚憂；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329198132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官鬼臨玄武，本是盜賊，若與世爻刑剋，不免盜賊之憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄乗虎煞交重，風波險阻。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329198132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄加白虎及忌神動，或鬼在巽宮，動來剋世，皆有風波險阻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻來剋世，莫貪無義之財；財合變官，勿戀有情之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329214516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財動刑剋世爻，恐因財致禍。若世與財爻相合，而財爻變出鬼來刑剋者，故言勿貪無義之財，恐因色招。殃勿戀，可免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父遭風雨之淋漓，舟行尤忌；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329230900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父爲辛勤劳苦之神，動則跋渉程途，不能安利。刑剋世爻，必遭風雨所阻。父爲舟，剋世，行庫不利，故尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378923046"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福遇和同之伴侶。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329230900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謁貴反凶，子孫持世最吉，主逢好侶，行路平安。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329247284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若爲謁貴而出行，則爲不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329263668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子動謂之傷官，反不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329280052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮宮鬼坐寅爻，虎狼仔細；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329296436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"艮爲山，寅属虎，若艮宮見寅鬼，是虎狼也。若不傷世，與我無害，倘或傷應，卽噉他人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦見兄逢蛇煞，光棍宜防。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329296436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄主刼財，若加螣蛇動，必有光棍刼拐財物無制宜防，有制無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼動間中，不諧同侶；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329312820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼在間爻動，若非伴侶不和，卽是伴中有病，剋世主自有悔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄興世上，多費盤纒。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329312820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358446669974798376"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟爻主耗費貲財，持世則自多虚費，不臨世上，動自他人損耗我也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329329204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦如無鬼煞，方得如心。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329345588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼主禍灾，故不宜見之卽如出。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329361972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現或得安静，或有制伏，總見無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329378356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻不見福神，焉能稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329394740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子爲福德，又爲解神。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329411124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不上卦，或落空亡，不能制鬼，則鬼煞專懽，恐有灾禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329427508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人動遇空亡，半途而返；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329443892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隔手來占，湏看何人出行。如卜子姪，則看子孫主人者，用神也。餘倣此。如動遇空亡，行至半途復回動化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退神亦然，財氣旺臨月建，滿載而回。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329443892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216877602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出行若得財爻旺臨月建，生合持世，不受刑剋，定主滿載歸家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但能趨吉避凶，何慮登高涉險。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329460276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行人人爲利名，忘却故鄕生處樂；家無音信，全憑周易；卦中推。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329476660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要決歸期，但尋主象。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329493044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主象者，用神也。卜官員看官爻，幼軰看子孫爻，妻奴看財爻，兄弟，朋友看兄爻，尊長看父爻，不在六親之中者看應爻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主象交重，身巳動；用爻安靜，未思歸；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329509428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主象卽用爻也，動則行人巳行。如用爻安靜，又無日辰動爻冲併者，安居異鄕，未起歸念。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378955814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋速生遲，我若制他難見面；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329509428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用動剋世，或世落空亡，人必速至；生合世爻，人必歸遲。最忌世爻動剋用爻，乃未能歸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三門四户，用如合世卽還家；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329509428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三、四爻爲門戸，臨用爻動，歸程巳近，而用爻又無制伏，動來生合世爻者，可立而待也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化退神，人旣來而復返；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329509428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻若化進神，行人急回，不日可望。化退神，行人雖來仍返，或又往他處，旣來而復返者，總言不能歸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜生世位，身未動而懷歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329509428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六爻安静，人不思歸。若用爻生合世爻，身雖未動，巳起歸意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇暗冲，睹物起傷情之客况；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329525812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894347810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻安靜，本無歸意，若遇日辰冲動，必然睹物思鄕，將欲回家。倘月建動爻剋之，亦難起程也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢合住，臨行有塵事之覊。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329525812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329542196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神發動，本是歸兆，若遇動爻，日辰合之，因事絆住，不得歸來。須待月日冲之可到。遠斷年月，近斷日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋用而俱動，轉往他方；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329542196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜世剋用爻，若安静受剋者，原在舊處。若發動人巳起程。如被動世剋之，而用爻亦動者，則轉往他處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用比世而皆空，難歸故里。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329542196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻旬空者，速至；如用爻亦値旬空，縱世空而不能來也，不可一概而言，故日用比世而皆空，難歸故里。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠行最怕用爻傷，尤嫌入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329558580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜遠行，若用神出現，不受傷剋，不値真空真破，主在外吉利，歸遲無妨。若逢墓絶，及日月動變刑剋，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894380578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋速生遲，我若制他難見面。用動剋世，或世落空亡人必速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至生合世爻，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329574964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人必歸遲，最忌世爻動剋用爻，乃未能歸也。三門四戸，用如合世卽還家。三、四爻爲門戸，臨用爻動，歸程巳近，而用爻又無制伏，動來生合世爻者，可立而待也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動化退神，人旣來而復返；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329574964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759595557"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻安靜，本無歸意，若遇日辰冲動，必然睹物思鄕，將欲回家。倘月建動爻剋之，亦難起程也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢合住，臨行有塵事之覊；身","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329574964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神發動，本是歸兆，若遇動爻，日辰合之，因事絆住，不得歸來。須待月日冲之可到。遠斷年月，近㫁日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世剋用而俱動，轉往他方；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329574964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜世剋用爻，若安静受剋者，原在舊處。若發動人巳起程。如被動世剋之，而用爻亦動者，則轉往他處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用比世而皆空，難歸故里。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329574964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世爻旬空者，速至；如用爻亦値旬空，縱世空而不能來也，不可一概而言，故日用比世而皆空，難歸故里。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遠行最怕用爻傷，尤嫌入墓；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329591348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜遠行，若用神出現，不受傷剋，不値真空真破，主在外吉利，歸遲無妨。若逢墓絶，及日月動變刑剋，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947210763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近出何妨主象伏，偏利逢冲；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329591348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"近出若用爻伏藏，必因事故不歸，値日便到。如安静至冲動日到。如句空安静，至出旬逢冲日到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若伏空鄕，須究卦中之六合；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329591348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用神若伏不空之飛爻下，須待冲飛之日可來。如伏空爻之下，得日辰動爻合之卽出，速則當日來，遲則値日到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如藏官下，當叅飛上之六神。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329591348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于官爻下，必爲凶事所覊。臨勾陳、蹼跌損傷，臨螣蛇、勾連驚恐，臨白虎，或官鬼属土，臥病不㱕。臨玄武盜賊所阻，或貪色不㱕，其餘下文引証類推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947243531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟遮藏，緣是非而不返；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329607732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于兄弟下，必因賭博，加朱雀，是口舌爭闘；臨白虎，爲風波所阻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫把持，由樂酒以忘歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329607732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于子孫下，必爲遊樂飮酒，不然因僧道或六畜或子孫幼軰之阻，不得㱕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父爲文書之阻滯，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329624116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏干父爻下，必爲文書阻節，或因尊長手藝人拘留。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財因買賣之牽連。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329624116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于旺財下，必爲經营買賣，得利忘家。財若空亡，或遇兄動，多因折本；若加咸池，定然戀色而忘㱕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用伏應財之下，身贅他家；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329640500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330789387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于應位，隂財之下，必贅他家；若臨陽象生合世身，必代他人掌財不返。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主投財庫之中，名留富室。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329640500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻㐲于財庫下，其人必在富家掌財伏神，如遇墓絶，則是依傍度日耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五爻有鬼，皆因途路之不通；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329656884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻伏于五爻官鬼之下，必因関津不通而阻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦無財，只爲盤纒之缺乏。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329656884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中動變日月皆無財爻者，爲無路費不㱕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓持墓動，必然臥病呻吟；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329673268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻入墓化墓，或持鬼墓，或伏于鬼墓爻下者，皆主病臥不同。若伏官爻下，或臨白虎，必在獄中，非病也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759628325"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世合世冲，須用遣人尋覓；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329673268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用爻安靜而世動，衝起之、合起之，用爻伏藏，提世起。若去用爻入墓，世去破墓，皆宜自去尋覔方回。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合逢玄武，昏迷酒色不思鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329673268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或用臨玄武動，而遇財爻合住，或用伏玄武財下，主皆貪花戀色，不思鄕也。待冲破合爻，庻可歸來。若用伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武鬼下，而財爻不相合者，其人在外爲賊不歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329689652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦得遊魂，漂泊他鄕無定；跡","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329706036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遊魂卦用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻發動，行人東奔西走，不在一方，遊","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329706036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"魂化遊魂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行跡不定，遊魂化㱕魂，遊徧方歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329706036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日併忌興休望到，身臨用發必然歸；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329722420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌神臨身世，或日辰剋用，皆主不歸。若得用臨身世，出現發動，或持世動，立可望歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216910370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父動卦中，當有魚書之寄。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329722420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占書信，卦有父母爻動，主有音信寄來；財興世上，應無雁信之來；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329738804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"獨占書信以父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻爲用神，若世持財動，則剋父矣，故無雁信之來也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329738804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲決歸期之遠近，須詳主象之興衰。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329755188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斷歸期全在合待冲，冲待合，空待出旬破待待補合，絶逢生墓待冲開等法，當以如是推詳，要知遠近兼。決于旺衰可也。動處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靜中含蓄許多凶吉象；天涯海角，羈留多少利名人。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329771572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358439647216943138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舟船凡卜買船，斷同船户。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329787956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡卜買船，與僱船斷法相同，如舟子自卜，當以船家宅斷之，又非此斷法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親持世，可推新舊之由；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329804340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡推船之新舊，當以六親持世決之。財福是新，父母是舊，兄弟是半，新舊官鬼多灾驚，兼以衰旺決之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸鬼動臨，可識節病之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329804340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金鬼釘少，土鬼灰少，木鬼有縫，水鬼有漏，火鬼有燥裂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初二爻爲前倉，要持財福；五大爻爲後舵，怕見官兄。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329820724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初二爻爲前倉，三、四爻爲中倉，五六爻爲後舵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451771330822155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父作梢公，不宜傷剋；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329837108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卜船以父母爲舟船，卜駕掌以父母爲梢公，要旺相生合世爻爲吉，如發動傷剋世爻爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍爲船尾，豈可空刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329837108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"青龍爲船尾，臨財福旺動持世，生合世，皆主利益稱意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇辨索䌫之堅牢，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329853492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"螣蛇爲索䌫，休囚値旬空則枯爛；旺相持吉神則堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎爲帆檣之順利。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329853492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎属風，故取爲風帆。若生旺帶財福吉神動持生合世身，則船有好帆，使風順快。若白虎帶凶鬼惡煞。旺動剋害世身，或卦得反吟，主遭失風傾覆之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894413346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻皆吉不傷身，四海遨遊無阻滯。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329869876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六爻生合財福吉神，又生旺持世持身，動爻又不來傷剋，則無往不吉，雖遠遊于四海五湖，亦皆順利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娼家養身于花柳之家，日娼日妓；識禍福于幾微之際，惟蓍惟龜。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329886260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花街托迹，柳巷安身。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329902644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門外紛紛，總是風流子弟；窓前濟濟，無非歌舞佳人。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329919028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若要安寜，必得世無衝剋，欲求稱意，還須應去生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329935412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡娼家卜住居家宅生意，類皆以世爲主娼之人，應爲宿娼之客。若月建、日辰動爻俱不刑冲剋世，必主。家宅吉利，入口安寧。更遇應來生合，十全之好，凡事遂意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554150454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦見六冲，往來亦徒迎迓。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329951796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲者，散也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329968180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如得六冲卦，或合處逢冲，不但往來之客無惠，更防驅逐不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471329984564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻當六合，晨昏幸爾盤桓。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330000948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得六合卦最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330017332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢合則情分相投，必主人多顧戀；內外和同，家門雍睦。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330033716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財若空亡，錢𣗳子愼防傾倒；","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330050100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財爲娼妓，若值真空，或衰絶受剋，主妓女䘮亡。財若重叠，妓女必多。旺相則顔色美麗，衰弱則容貌不妍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑則有病。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330050100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月動爻，無生無合，主人不眷戀。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330066484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官如墓絶，探花郞那得棲遲。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330082868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官爲宿客之主，若動來生合世爻，必多商客下顧，更得日辰生扶，必有貴人招接，惟不宜空亡墓絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358450763439570953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財官鬼，二者不可相無。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471330099252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無財，主無出色之女；無官，主無貴客招接，錢財破耗。若財官俱無，或一空三伏，是時運不濟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財鬼、父兄子孫皆宜不動。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479706152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"常人占宅，宜子孫動，惟妓家動則傷官，若鬼動，子孫亦宜動也。最喜六親安静，故日皆不宜動也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞傷身，火盜官灾多恐怖；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479722536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼爻生合世爻，是宿客顧戀之象，雖動亦吉。若冲剋刑害，則是鬼煞爲禍，重則官灾火盜，輕則是非口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日辰冲父，住居屋宅有更張；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479722536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父母爲住居屋宅，或被日辰冲剋，或父母化出財爻，當有更變，必住不久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟交重，罄嚢用度；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479722536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452339759661093"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兄動主生涯冷淡，破耗多端，更有生扶，則罄貲用度，無了日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫藏伏，蹙額追陪。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479722536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子孫爲福德喜悅之神。娼家雖不宜動，然不可空伏，主家宅不安，住居不穩，生涯不旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財化福爻，家出從良之妓；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479738920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜財動，動則妓女走失，若逢冲剋，或空動皆然。化子合應，妓有從良之志；化子生世，可稱錢𣗳子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官居刑地，門招惡病之人。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479738920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼帶刑爻生合世身，多招惡疾之人來往。與世生合，與財刑冲，須防妓亦沾染。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌動衰空，閑是閑非閑撓舌；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479755304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剋世之神，發動衰空，有制者，不過閑是閑非而巳，無制不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330615306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財興剋世，有財有利有驚憂。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479755304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡財爻旺相，不宜動來傷剋世爻，葢財乃生禍之端，必然因財致禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能將玄理以推詳，眞乃黃金而不易。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479771688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"船家宅章旣明住宅之根因，再看船居之奥妙。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479788072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍父母，祖代居船；白虎妻財，初當船戸，要識平居。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479804456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安穩須觀福德靑龍。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479820840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初是船頭，必須子孫興旺；六爲後舵，定宜福德交重。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479837224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母刑冲，必主風狂浪急；妻財剋陷，定然惹是招非。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479853608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢兄弟交重，怪木必須重換；但遇鬼爻臨用，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479869992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894446114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魘倒急宜祈祥。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479869992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二爲獵木，須要堅方；若遇騰蛇，必生怪異；但逢朱雀，口舌灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479886376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍利益加添，白虎損人招禍；玄武憂疑盜賊，勾陳耗散貲財。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479902760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三爲倉口，怕逢刑冲剋害；四爲桅杆，喜遇拱合生扶，五爲毛䌫，六爲櫓篷。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479919144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得相生，行船必定致富；如逢冲剋，船居多主災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479935528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻發動，宜棄舊而從新；應位興隆，宜世居而廸吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479951912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世臨玄武，盜賊相侵；持世勾陳翻船損舵，白虎防墮水不虞，靑龍主臨危有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479968296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇爻動，主暴病之憂；朱雀爻興，有斷桅之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834479984680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初位逢空，船頭破損；二爻","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480001064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947276299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇鬼，繩䌫損傷；三爻最忌刑冲，倉內平基作","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480001064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"祟四位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕逢凶煞，破篷發漏須防；五爲毛䌫，逢空必有；","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480001064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"憂疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六是舵門，遇煞定當修換。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480001064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能依此而推，船居","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480017448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他事何知章：何知人家父母疾，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480017448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻兼刑剋，何知人家父母殃，財爻發動煞神傷，何知人家有子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480017448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍福德爻中輪，何知人家無子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480033832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻不見福神，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480050216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292378988582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家子孫疾。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480050216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母爻動來相剋，何知人家子孫灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480066600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎當臨福德來，何知人家小兒死，子孫空亡加，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480082984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家兄弟亡，用落空亡，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480082984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家妻有灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480082984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎臨兄弟動傷財，何知人家妻有孕。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480099368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍財臨天喜神。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480115752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家有妻妾，内外兩財旺相決。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480132136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家損妻房，財爻帶。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480148520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼落空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家訟事休，空亡官鬼又休。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480164904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"囚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358444591894478882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家訟事多。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480181288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雀虎持世鬼來扶，何知人家旺六丁，六親有氣吉神臨，何知人家進人口。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480197672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍得位臨財守。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480214056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家大豪富，財爻旺相又居庫。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480230440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家田地増。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480246824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳入土子孫臨，何知人家進産業。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480263208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍臨財旺相說。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480279592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家進外財。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480295976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦龍臨財福來。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480312360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家喜事臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480328744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑龍福德在門庭。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480345128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家富貴昌强，財旺福靑龍上。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480361512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330648074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家多貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480377896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爻帶耗休囚見。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480394280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
