{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家無依倚，卦中福德落空死。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480410664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家竈破損，玄武帶鬼二爻悃。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480427048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家鍋破漏，玄武入水鬼來就。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480443432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家屋宇新，父入靑龍旺相真，何知人家屋宇敗，父入白虎休囚壊。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480459816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家墓有風，白虎空亡巽巳攻。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480476200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家墓有水，白虎空亡臨亥子，何知人家無香火，卦中六爻不見火，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480492584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947309067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家無風水，卦中六爻不見水。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480492584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家兩爨戸，卦中必主。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480508968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩重火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家不供佛，金鬼爻落空亡決。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480525352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知二姓共屋居，兩鬼旺相卦，","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480541736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中扵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知一家有兩姓，兩重父母卦中臨。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480541736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家雞亂啼，螣蛇入酉不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480558120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家犬亂吠，螣蛇入戌又逢鬼，何知人家見口舌。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480574504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀持世","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480590888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掇，何知人家口舌到。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480590888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中朱雀帶木笑。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480607272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291606066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家多爭競。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480623656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀兄弟推世應，何知人家小人生。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480640040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武官鬼動臨身，何知人家遭賊徒。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480656424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480672808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨財鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺扶，何知人家災禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480672808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼臨應爻來剋世。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480689192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家痘疹病，螣蛇爻被火燒定。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480705576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家病要死，用神無救又入墓。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480721960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家多夢寐？","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480738344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻帶鬼玄武欺，何知人家無牛猪。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480918568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑亥空亡兩位虗，何知人家無雞犬？","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480934952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌二爻空亡捲。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480951336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452127947341835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家人不來，世應俱落空亡排。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480967720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何知人家宅不寜，六爻俱動亂紛紛。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834480984104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仙人造出何知章，留與後人作飯嚢。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481000488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福吉凶真有驗，時師句句細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481016872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妖孽賦：乾蛇鬼巳冲刑，蓬頭赤脚夜驚人，化猪化馬作妖精。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481033256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多拮括宅不寧，匿璣賴鏡損人丁。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481049640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎蛇鬼午來冲，沒頭沒尾成何用，黒而矮又無踪。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481066024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拖漿弄水空聲門。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481082408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358446669974831144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇鬼若遇申，妖聲似犬夜𭈻𭈻，空中常拍手。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481098792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家鬼弄家人，狗作怪家業傾，拋磚弄瓦何曾定。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481115176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震蛇鬼酉冲刑，空中椅桌動，聞聲踢踏响似人行。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481131560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大蛇常出現，窑器响驚人。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481147944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桶箱作孽人丁病。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481164328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽蛇鬼亥又冲，雞聲報煬火，鬼怪起狂風。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481180712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縊死之鬼擾虗空，牀下响及房中。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481197096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離蛇鬼子來刑，鍋釡作妖聲，空中忽見火光熖。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481213480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌蛇鬼受卯刑，空中歎氣重而輕。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481279016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊出現囐嘴瓶。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481295400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"骨殖若暴露，刀石更成精。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481311784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"移南換北幼亡魂。","logicSentenceId":"7680051834481328168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捜鬼論子作怪鼠咬屋，黃昏忌火灾，小兒夜裡叫，□前禍鬼催。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040450595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑古","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040466979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"墓西北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方牛欄又接倉，開土有坟穴，㐲屍夜作殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040466979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040483363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496478271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇虎來作怪，六畜血財亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040483363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人口有病患，急須保安康。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040499747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，隔墻帶血鬼，作灾，母病牀破傘并橱櫃，及有死人牀。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040516131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳買得舊衣裳，亡人身上物。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040565283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作怪蛇入屋，防損豕牛羊。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040581667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午作怪䑕咬屋，不覺火燒裳。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040598051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急遣白虎去，人口却安康。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040614435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291638834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未小兒奴婢走，甑叫沸鍋湯。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040630819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外來門與厨，在家作禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040647203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申客亡鬼入屋，作怪在家堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040663587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃昏雞啼叫，枯木被風傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040679971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉家有䑕咬櫃，燈架不成雙。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040696355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竈有三處損，咒咀一女娘。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040712739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌飛禽來入屋，遺糞汚衣裳。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040729123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竈破并鍋漏，神燈被䑕傷。","logicSentenceId":"7680052519040745507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，","logicSentenceId":"7680052519 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496543807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十三古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒著，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922662952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦，男其龍、雲客、任用淵、潛菴門人謝朝柱巨材同較。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922679336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡鑑升明男其章琢軒。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922695720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292379021350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十八問答附占驗第一問：三傳","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922712104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日建。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋用，有一爻動來生，有一爻動來剋，亦謂貪生忘剋乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922712104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：寡固不可敵衆也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922728488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽如一爻生，一爻剋，又自化剋，皆不宜也，何况三傳助剋乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922744872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：或月剋日生，日剋月生，何如？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922761256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：匹也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922777640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再看動出一爻生是生，動出一爻剋是剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922794024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申化亥丑卯亥辰月丙申日，占弟病業，應乂世巳臨危，得旣濟之革卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922810408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄官父兄官子","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922826792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496576575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：此卦亥水兄弟爲用神，辰月剋之，甫日生之，又得申金動爻生之，臨危有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922826792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于本日酉時得明醫救活，亥日全愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922843176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922859560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥午辰寅午月丁未日，占弟被訟，應乂世吉凶何如，得困之恒卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922859560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子官父才斷曰：酉金兄弟爲用神，午月剋之，未日生之，似可相敵，但動出午火，月建相剋，大凶之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922875944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼云：凶在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922892328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：今歲辰年太歲相合，自是無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922908712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化退神","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922925096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330746378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于申，恐厄于午年申月，果至午年申月而被重刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922925096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳禾酉合卯巳未午月戊辰日，占妹，世應臨産吉凶，得晉卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922941480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父、兄才官父斷曰：酉金兄弟爲用神，月剋日生，許之無碍，明日卯時必生，母子平安。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922957864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應卯時者，酉金與辰日相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922974248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃金䇿云：若逢合住，必待冲開。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940922990632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此月剋日生，無增生剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923007016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月乙未日，一人占未","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923023400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳酉，化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923023400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496609343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，得大過之鼎卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923023400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乂世應才官父官父才斷曰：世爻亥水爲用神，未土動來剋世，酉金動來生世。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923039784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是謂貪生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忘剋化凶爲吉矣，但不宜日辰來剋，","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923056168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又逢月冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有酉金原神發動相生，如樹無根。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923056168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923072552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不起也。果卒于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯日，應卯日者，冲去原神之日，忌神共來剋害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923072552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923088936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊子日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占寅子戌、卯巳未墳地，得剝卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923088936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923105320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330779146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才子父才官父斷：","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923105320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰日辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世，月建生之，靑龍戲水，水必從左遶穴必近大水，不然長流之水到堂。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923105320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎臨卯木，子卯刑中帶生，是臨財爻爲無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923121704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應爲朝山，属火，被世剋，朝山不高。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923138088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世前戌土爲對案，土剋世，對","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923154472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案畧高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰一一皆是。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923154472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬後未出三年，二子皆發科甲。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923170856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二問：何以謂之回頭剋，剋者有吉凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923187240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：土爻動而變木，木爻動而變金，金爻動而變火，火爻動而","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923203624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496642111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變水，水爻動而變土，此是爻之回頭剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923203624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾兌卦之離離之坎坎之艮坤，艮坤之震巽，震巽之乾兌，此是卦之回頭剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923220008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇回頭剋者，徹底剋盡，原用二神遇之則凶，忌仇二神遇之反吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923236392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923252776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申化辰寅子卯月癸亥日，占家宅人乂乂世應口平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923252776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得需之乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923269160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才兄、子兄、官才斷曰：申金子孫持世，化午火，回頭之剋，乃自身及子孫皆受剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923285544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水財爻化戌土，回頭之剋財，爲","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923301928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358451292379054118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾奴僕，一家受剋之卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923301928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至午月，火旺剋世，助土剋財，財逢月破，一家數口被回祿俱死。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923318312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923334696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌、申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923334696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月辛酉日，占開世應乂店，得艮之明夷卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923334696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄子父兄斷曰：世臨寅木，得令當時，目下開張可許。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923351080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨嫌日主剋世，又化回頭之剋鬼臨世爻，須防疾病。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923367464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至六月世入墓時當防。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923383848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果至六月病。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923400232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至八月，店中財物被夥計盜盡，鳴之于官。","logicSentenceId":"7680041940923416616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

,"lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至子日有幾點小","logicSentenceId":"7680041941030993954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496707647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941030993954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于子日者，冲去午火仇神故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031010338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨小者，旬空無根也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031026722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031043106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031043106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031043106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月戊辰日，一人占父乂應乂、世乂","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031043106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官事得萃之同人卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子才官父，斷曰：外卦未土，卯月剋之，况土値春令，氣敗又會成亥卯未木局剋之，全無救助，必至重罪，後果斬。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031043106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月丁亥日，一人占僕，未","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031059490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥辰","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031059490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子何日回，得夬之履卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031059490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乂世應","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031075874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330811914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才兄、官才。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031075874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：亥水財爻爲用神，亥水雖是日建，不謂月破，但不宜重重土動傷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031092258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諺云：雙拳不敵四手不獨難望歸期，還要防途中不測。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031108642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至午月火旺，合未助土時，中途遇害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031125026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031141410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子，未化戌，酉化申，亥化丑，化午，辰卯化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月丙寅日，一人占世乂應乂自病，得離之坎卦，兄子才官子父，斷曰：離火化坎水，乃卦變回頭之剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031141410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火世爻化","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031157794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496740415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出子水回頭之剋，名爲反吟卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031157794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目今午月火旺之時，日王生扶，近來無碍，冬令防之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031174178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果死于戌月丁亥日。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031190562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應戌月者，世入墓之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031206946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥日者，剋冲世之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031223330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌、","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031239714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午辰，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031239714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳寅。卯月乙酉日，一人占索房價，得坎之坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應兄官父才官子，斷曰：坎卦變坤，亦是卦變回頭之剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031239714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世爻雖得日生，不宜兩重。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031256098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土動來傷，此卦甚凶，不但房價事小，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031272482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291704370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜防不測之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031272482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後于午月覆舟而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031288866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于午月者，辰戌土鬼出春令，遇火増威，世臨月冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031305250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此占房價，驗在其命，乃神之預報其凶，占此應彼，占輕應重也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031321634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031338018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未丑卯巳申月戊辰日，占具","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031338018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"題，得中孚之損卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031338018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父兄兄官父斷曰：五位巳火，生世化子水回頭剋，不宜具題。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031354402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：有害否？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031370786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：巳火雖不能生，幸卦中無動爻剋","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031387170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452828496773183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世，利害皆無。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031387170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後題而果不准行。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031403554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031419938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031419938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031419938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月丁巳日占慮大應乂世計，得旅之明夷卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031419938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才兄子斷曰：子孫持世，化回頭之剋，但嫌世位臨之，世爲自己，不宜受剋，雖有金局生扶伏官，難稱無恙，後果削職。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031436322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三問：生用神者，爲原神本主吉，吉中亦有凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031452706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：原神動來生用，用神出現旺相者，其吉更倍也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031469090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031485474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291737138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用神旬空衰弱，或伏藏不現，待用出旬得令値日，所求必遂也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031485474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用神旺相，原神休囚不動，或動而變剋、變絶、變墓、月破日冲，或仇神動剋原神，或被日月相剋，或化退神，皆不能生用，則用神根蒂被傷，不惟無益而反有損矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031501858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌冲申","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031518242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午亥丑卯申月戊辰日，妻占夫應世近病，得同人之離卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031518242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官子父斷曰：世爻亥水，夫星墓于辰日，其病若論，隨鬼入","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031534626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149389353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，豈不凶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031534626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸由金原神動來生用，又化出未土生助原神，又戌土暗動生助原神，是夫","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031551010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"星根蒂固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"深所嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031551010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水旬空，不受其生，必待巳日冲起亥水卽愈，果巳巳日全愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031567394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031583778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031583778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月甲寅日，占風應乂世","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031583778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水得困之節卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子、官父才。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031583778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：占祖塋必有他故，葬後因何事不亨？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031600162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031616546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事而問，明以吿我，方敢決斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031616546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：自葬後被","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031632930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291769906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸，年近五旬，尚無子息，是以卜此墳有何碍否？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031632930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"余曰：六合化合，風藏氣聚，但嫌亥水化申金被","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031649314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲之。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031649314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申乃水之原神，必然源流，水不歸漕之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031665698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若使水歸漕，不至旁流，巳年再拜丹墀，申年","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031682082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031682082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應巳年起用者，世上寅木化出官星之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031698466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申年生子者，亥水子孫化出申金。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031714850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"回頭之生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031731234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031731234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月戊子日，一人自占，應世","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031731234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"近病，得同人之旅卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官子父，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031731234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149422121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：自占病，世爲用神，世爻亥水子日拱之，又得申金原神動來生世，乃不死之症。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031731234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苐嫌申金化出未土，乃是月破旬空，則原神無根矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031747618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"目下無碍，恐危于春月。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031764002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至立春日果死。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031780386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應正月死者，申金原神亦逢月冲，春月木旺，未土又被剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031796770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉亥丑酉化亥寅丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月乙丑日，子占午父病，得","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031813154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"升之師卦，官父空才官父空才斷曰：亥水父爻爲用，雖値旬空，有酉金原神動來","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031813154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393745446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之，可許無碍，但不宜酉金化出午火，回頭一剋，此乃原神被傷，用神無根矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031813154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人果死于卯日卯時。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031829538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應卯日卯時者，生助午火，剋冲原神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031845922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第四問","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合八卦成局，何以斷之？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031862306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：原用二神局則吉，忌仇二神局則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031878690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成局者，結黨也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031895074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中動爻，誰敢制之？","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031911458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如三爻齊發，合成用神局，必有一爻用神合成原神局，必有一爻原神合成仇忌局，必有一爻仇忌宗其一爻有病關因者斷之，或遇日冲者，曰暗動，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031927842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言静而日冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰實","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031927842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言動而逢空，日辰冲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日破。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031927842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言月建冲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但其冲破也，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031944226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554215990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必待相合之期至，而應事之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031944226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一爻靜，二爻發。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031960610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，必待一爻靜者値日應事。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031976994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如一爻靜而逢空者，或動而逢空者，或化而逢空者，待其出空之期應事之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941031993378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如空而逢合，靜而逢合，動而逢合者，必待","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032009762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至而應事之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032009762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如自化合，或與日合；如自化墓或墓于日者，必待期冲；","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032026146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言三爻齊發，二爻無病，指自化者言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如自化絶，或絶于日者，必待期生。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032026146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦指一爻有病者而言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月丁巳日，兩村爭戽，巳","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032042530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032042530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑，玄化卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032042530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水闘毆，得離之坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032042530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032058914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330844682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子、才官子父，斷曰：内爲我村，外爲彼村。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032058914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦亥卯未爲木局，外卦已酉丑爲金局，金來剋木，幸衰金不剋旺木，又日主制金，不足畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032075298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况六冲化冲，不至爲非，其事卽散，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032091682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合成内外兩局，卽彼我之分。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032108066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不動不成局，卽看世應。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032124450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今且人衆同心，彼我合局，神之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032140834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月丁酉日，占逓呈圖戌","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032157218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032157218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子謀補缺，得乾之需卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032157218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032173602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554248758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官父、才子，斷曰：寅午戌三合官局生世，此缺必得，内少寅字發動，須待寅日逓呈可也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032173602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032189986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此虚一待用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032206370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌申午化，未辰寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月丙辰日，占選子","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032222754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"期，得乾之小畜卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032222754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官父、才子。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032239138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：此卦戌爻暗發寅爻，如明動者，必以午火官星化未土作合，合待冲開。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032255522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今不然，以午火明動，戌土暗動，三合官局，獨少寅動，借寅月建補成三合，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032271906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393778214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本月必選。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032271906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032288290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此虗一補用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032304674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未酉亥卯化，亥已化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月未丁亥日，占辨卯應乂世乂復，得萃之革卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032321058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、子才官父斷曰：已火官星持世，臨馹馬暗動，辨復在。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032337442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽内卦亥卯未合財局，原神生世，因于未土句空，必待未月，定蒙題允，卽得美缺，後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032353826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月者，實空之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032370210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月已卯日占父戌申","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032386594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子，午，化戊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032386594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032386594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554281526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急病，得乾之賁卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032386594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官父、才子。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032402978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：世爻戌土，父母爲用，近病","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032419362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜日合，幸寅午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌合成火局，生用犬象無妨，但戌爻被合，必待明日辰日合逢冲而病愈也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032419362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032435746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳化酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032452130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑亥，丑卯。丑月戊午日占嬸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應病，得離之","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032452130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明夷卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才官子父，斷曰：卯木父母爻爲用神，外卦已","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032452130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑合成金局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291802674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋之，目今丑土旬空，旬内無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032452130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032468514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑日防之，果于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑日酉時卒。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032468514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于丑日者，出句。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032484898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌由日占子何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世又應","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日歸，得暌之鼎卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子兄、官父，㫁曰：内卦已酉丑合成金局，作用神丑土係，","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必待立秋後甲子日到家。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032501282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032517666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032534050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"立秋後者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土月破，出月則出破矣，果于甲子日歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032534050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其破而逢令也。","logicSentenceId":"7680041941032550434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554314294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912915490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申，戌，化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子巳月丙申日，占父何㐅㢘㐅世日歸，得大畜之乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912915490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄兄、官才，斷曰：寅午戌三合父局，獨有寅字日冲又絶于申日，已亥日必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912931874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912948258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥日到者，此冲中逢合也，絶處逢生也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912964642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912981026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912981026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912981026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月戊辰日占防叅㐅世應㐅劾，得井之中孚卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912981026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父才官官父才。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970912997410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291835442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公因新換撫軍，防其叅劾。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913013794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：此卦甚奇，世空逢日冲，不爲空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913030178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世不受剋而暗動，雖無叅論，離任不免。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913046562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：旣無叅論，如何離任？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913062946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：世爻暗動，必主動揺。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913079330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦合金局生應，果知此位已属他人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913095714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因裁他處缺，上臺題留他處官，頂此公位，將此公赴京另補。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913112098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦少見少聞之事，知我者惟神明也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913128482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月戊午日，占地造葬寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913144866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化甲戌，化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子可否，得頥之无妄卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913144866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅㐅世應","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913161250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149454889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄父才才兄父斷曰：世父戌土，春天休囚，化午火子孫回頭之生，日辰月建，共成三合，青龍臨水，化申長生，水源極遠，必從左首而來。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913161250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但化月破戌土剋日辰冲散，此水有時乾否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913177634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：正是。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913194018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913210402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中日月世與。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913226786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫共成三合，自然亡者安，生者樂，葬之必發。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913243170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年下葬，酉年孫中亞魁，子年次孫又登鄕榜。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913259554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏卯空已月甲辰日占何日，已未酉酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913275938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913275938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291868210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨止，得鼑之暌卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913275938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世乂兄子才才官子，若執古法，父伏空無雨，才福動晴明。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913292322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今不然。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913308706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已酉丑合成財局剋父，父若不空受其剋，是無雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913325090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今伏而又空，謂之避剋，其雨不能止。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913341474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必待卯日出透，出空被剋，方可雨止。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913357858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至甲寅日，其雨更大，","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913374242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大晴。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913374242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其寅日雖出空，而寅未載卦中，不受其剋，果大雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913390626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合冲","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913407010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149487657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月辛卯日，古妻去摇戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913407010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913407010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑，㑹可得否，得恒之蠱卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913407010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅應世才官子官父才，若執古法，財動福生，此㑹必得也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913423394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今亦不然。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913439778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應上之財，非財也，乃隣友之妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913456162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌㑹成火局，生應剋世，卯月合應冲世，是謂出現無情于我，會局有情于他，必隣人之妻得會也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913472546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913488930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第五問：反吟之凶，有輕重分别乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913505314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：凡得反吟卦，用神不變冲剋者，事雖主反覆，亦主事就。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913521698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苐嫌用神","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913538082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453573291900978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化冲剋者，凡謀大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913538082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申卯","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913554466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉，已化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未卯月壬申日，占隨官上應㐅世㐅任如何？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913554466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得比之井卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913570850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才兄子官父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913587234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：世臨卯木，化酉金，剋冲内卦，乃爻之反吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913603618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此行不吉，不去爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913620002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後因官府掣籖得缺，近于賊營，辭而不去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913636386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至官府去後，又因他事而去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913652770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至七月城破，與官府一同被害。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913669154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢與官同被害者，世上官爻同受酉金之冲剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913685538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不去而又去者，此內卦","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913701922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554347062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反吟之故也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913701922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913718306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯亥，化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑丑卯巳卯月乙亥日占陞","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913718306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"㐅㐅應世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"選，得臨之中孚卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913718306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄兄官父。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913734690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：世臨卯，本月建官星得長生于日世與官星。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913751074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同臨旺地，許彼陞任。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913767458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于本月聞報，由江西陞任山東，未及一載，復任江西。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913783842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此外卦之反吟，去而復反也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913800226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月丁巳日，占嫂復病，寅","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913816610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌、卯已未，","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913816610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330877450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶如何？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913816610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得剝之坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913832994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應才子父才官父斷曰：外卦艮變坤，乃卦之反吟也，明是病愈而復病也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913849378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但不宜寅木用神化酉金回頭之剋，又墓于未月，日辰刑之，此病危于申日，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913865762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯已未","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913882146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子巳月戊申日，占往前處脫㐅應世貨有利否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913882146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得小畜之乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913898530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才兄父斷曰：小畜卦變乾，是卦之反吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913914914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所喜世與財爻","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913931298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554379830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生，","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913931298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"于日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"指此處占，以應爻作地頭臨午火，回頭","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913931298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生合比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前利息更倍。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913931298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後此人往返三次，俱得倍利。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913947682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913964066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉巳，化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥丑卯月戊子日，占墳地，得世巽之應升卦，兄子才官父才斷曰：世爲穴臨月建子日生之，是爲吉地，但不宜爻變反吟，子孫與世皆化剋冲，不可葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913964066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：重價已成久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913980450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地師皆稱美地。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970913996834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後竟葬之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914013218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四年内，二子一女并自身相繼而死。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914029602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393810982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六問：伏吟之凶，有輕重分别乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914045986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：伏吟者，憂鬱呻吟之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914062370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内卦伏吟，內不利；外卦伏吟，外不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914078754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡占皆不如意。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914095138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動如不動，懊惱呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914111522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占名久困，宦途淹留，仕","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914127906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"路占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利，本利消乏。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914127906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占墳塋宅舍，欲遷不能，守之不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914144290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"久病呻吟，婚姻難就，官事兠搭，出行有阻。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914160674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如問行人，恐他在外憂鬱。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914177058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如占彼此之勢，内則我心不遂，外則他意難安。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914193442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問吉凶，研究用神生剋，要知禍福，須詳用忌伏吟，","logicSentenceId":"76
