80042970914209826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申月乙卯日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兵到一家。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914209826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914226210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戊申，化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914226210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰，寅，化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子，","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914226210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554412598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當避何處？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914226210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得无妄之大壯。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914242594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世㐅㐅應才官子才兄父斷曰：內外伏吟，憂鬱未解。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914258978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所喜世爻午火子孫爲自己，應爻子水父母作父母，月建生應，日辰生世，世應安靜，父母與自己無碍。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914275362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苐嫌寅木兄弟爻伏吟，又是月破，昆仲有厄。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914291746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我父母在西方舍親家，得無妨否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914308130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：西方属金，生扶父母，萬無憂疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914324514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汝自己宜避于東方，東方木能生火，兄弟妻僕俱從汝走，子孫持世，可保無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914340898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼回，卽領家眷往","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914357282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393843750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方去。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914357282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後來覆我曰：平安。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914373666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟其弟牽念父母，往探之，行至半途，遭害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914390050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914406434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌，由化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉亥丑申月甲午日，占父在任，應世平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914406434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得姤之恒卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914422818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官兄、子父斷曰：獨嫌外卦伏吟，任上必有事故，不得意而呻吟也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914439202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼目：地方苗獞之變，可有碍否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914455586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：日辰生父，他事無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914471970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：今年歸否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914488354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：伏吟欲歸而不能。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914504738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來年辰月平靜，當裁缺，午月復補。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914521122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應辰月裁","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914537506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149520425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"缺者，戌父伏吟又逢破也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042970914537506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應午月復補者，日辰官星幇比生用，得時而旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017773071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017789455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰，寅，化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅月乙卯日，客外占家世㐅㐅應中安否，得无妄之乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017789455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才官、子才、兄父斷曰：内卦爲家中，已是伏吟，恐有變異。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017805839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤吟之事出彼口，當主何事？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017822223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：寅月卯日共來剋辰土財爻，恐是妻妾奴僕事耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017838607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是日，其人又占妻在戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017854991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戊申，化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、卯已未","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017854991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535138825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017854991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得豫之否卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017871375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅㐅應世、才官、子兄、子才斷曰：戌土財爻又是伏吟，月日相剋，令政必有大厄。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017887759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：應在何時？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017904143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：日辰合戌，目下雖寅卯皆剋，可許無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017920527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交辰月伏吟，又逢月冲，必難逃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017936911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于三月乃妻去世矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017953295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第七問：爻遇旬空，欲斷爲到底全空，却應乎填實欲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017969679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷作不空，却又到底空，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971017986063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：無生有剋者，到底空也；有生無剋者，待時用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018002447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之最凶者，喜用爻之","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018018831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358452303554461750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空；卦之最善者，忌用爻之旬空。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018018831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018035215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子巳月戊戌日占應世求財，得益卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018035215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才兄父，斷曰：辰土財爻持世，因値旬空，戌日冲之，謂之冲空則起，本日卽得。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018051599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018067983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于本日者，戌日亦是財星冲我也，此冲空有用是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018084367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏午火才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月甲子日占僕，未酉亥空，亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018100751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453503330910218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日回？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018100751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得革卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018117135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應官父、兄兄官子，斷曰：伏午火財爲用神，被日月之剋，問其吉凶否，凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018133519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今問何日回，世空者速至，忌神旬空句內，必到巳巳日必回。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018149903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018166287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗于巳日者，巳火亦是財星耳，冲其飛而露其伏也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018182671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃金策云：空下伏神，易于引㧞。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018199055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018215439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申月丁卯日占見戌申午亥空丑卯貴求財，得同人卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018231823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018248207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149553193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官子父，斷曰：亥水官星持世，旬空出旬亥日，必見月建財爻生世，財利如心。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018248207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018264591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此出空待用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018280975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018297359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午酉亥丑子月癸酉日，一人自㐅，應世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018297359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占婚，得恒之鼎卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才空、官子官父才，斷曰：世官應財，乃云得地。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018297359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今戌土財爻旬空，化巳火回頭之生，動生不空，次日求之，必允也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018313743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于次日巳時允婚。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018330127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222468123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018346511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未冲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018346511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月癸丑日，占病","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018362895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日愈，得萃之比卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018362895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子才官父，斷曰：卯木財爻爲用神，值旬空，有亥水原神相生，次日必愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018379279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旁人曰：卯爻旬空，宜斷卯日，何言寅日？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018395663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：汝不知其法。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018412047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交甲寅日，卯木巳出空矣，寅木亦是用星耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018428431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果先愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018444815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一日應甲寅日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018461199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月庚戌日，占子病何。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018477583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018493967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰，亥化寅，丑化子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日愈，得姤之无妄卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018493967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應㐅世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018510351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149585961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官兄子父。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018510351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：亥水子孫化寅木旬空，近病逢空卽愈，但嫌亥水化寅木旬空，則不能受酉金之生，必待寅日愈，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018526735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此化空出空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018543119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未辰空寅子未月庚子日，占求財應世，何日到手？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018559503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得小畜卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018575887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才、才兄父斷曰：未月持財，月内必有，今問何日到手？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018592271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中辰土旬空，必關因所現也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018608655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁其辰日得財，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018625039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018641423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393876518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捨未土之不空，而應辰土之空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018641423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018657807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑午","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018657807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018657807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉月庚辰日，占岳母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應㐅世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018657807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"近病，得師之升卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官才、官子斷曰：酉金父母旬空，近病逢空卽愈；日辰合之，近病逢合卽死，但不宜世持忌神剋之，此病必危。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018657807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：危于何日？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018674191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：午火自化旬空，旬内不能剋之，近病逢空不死，旬内不死。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018690575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日防之，果于乙酉日卯時而死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018706959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131577987126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏午火子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018723343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月壬辰日，占未酉亥酉亥丑子病，得大過卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018739727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應才官父、官父才。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018756111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：午火子孫伏世爻亥水之下，月建生助，亥水剋之，目下用神旬空，不受其剋，甲午日難逃矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018772495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果死于午日午時。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018788879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此謂伏無提㧞也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018805263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月乙巳日，一人占弟死，酉亥冲丑，辰寅空子，太湖屍首可見否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018821647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得復卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018838031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018854415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222500891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才、兄兄官才。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018854415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：凡占屍首，以鬼爻爲用神。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018870799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今寅木鬼爻旬空，而亥水乃得令之水，暗動合之，明明屍首在于大水之中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018887183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但寅木旬空被合，須待出旬逢冲，庚申日可見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018903567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至庚申日不見，直至丑月甲子旬内壬申日屍首浮起得見。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018919951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此意何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018936335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，寅鬼出旬，而亥水太旺，交丑建丑土制水，甲子旬亥水遇空，水空者如水退矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018952719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木在水中，非冲不起，故驗于甲子旬壬申日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018969103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非神之奇報？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971018985487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者不可不深究之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019001871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149618729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019018255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019018255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019018255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲丑月甲午日，一人占父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅㐅應世近","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019018255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病，得復之噬嗑卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才、兄兄、官才斷曰：巳火父母爲用神，値旬空，日辰拱之，近病，逢空不死，但不利于六合卦，六合卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019018255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予想用空六合可以相敵，獨不宜世上忌神暗動。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019034639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外卦巳酉丑合成金局，助水剋之，此病必凶，彼","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019051023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在何日？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019051023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：巳亥日剋冲巳火，巳火還在旬空，不妨，恐危于出旬辛亥日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019067407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果至其日而死。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019083791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應出旬","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019100175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又被冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222533659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019100175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未卯巳未未","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019116559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月戊戌，日因大旱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019116559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"占何日有雨，得觀卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才官父才官父斷曰：月建未土，父母爻爲用神，日辰幇比，有雨必大。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019116559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但巳火官爻爲原神，値旬空，安靜靜，必待冲空，必待出旬斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019132943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日得大雨，果至其日申酉時得雨五寸。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019149327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月戊戌日占交疎子戌申申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019165711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131578019894"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，何日來？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019165711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得蹇卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019182095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應子父、兄兄官父斷曰：凡卜至交朋友，以兄弟爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019198479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今卜交疎之人，當以應爻爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019214863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今應爻旬空，得日辰冲起，必待甲辰日到，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019231247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019247631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019247631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯。未月甲辰日，卜何日有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐅世㐅應","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019247631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大雨，得小過之革卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官兄官父斷曰：日辰辰土，父母爻爲用神，發動，月建幇之，又","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019247631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393909286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値土王用事，其辰土旺莫勝言，得雨決不小也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019247631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但不宜化卯木旬空，化卯木回頭之剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019264015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有申化酉金進神，剋木救土，而卯木旬空，空則謂之畏避避金之剋，致辰土父爻，終成病于卯木也，必至甲寅旬乙卯日，卯木出空値日，謂之出頭難避。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019280399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土暗動，助金剋之，而卯木巳受金剋，不能爲害辰土，必待甲寅旬乙卯日有雨也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019296783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至期竟無。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019313167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過立秋辛酉日申時方雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019329551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于立秋後酉日者，何日明現。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019345935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申化酉，即申月酉日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019362319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木出旬値日，到底被剋不盡。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019378703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131578052662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交申月剋之，酉日又冲之，方始得雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971019395087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子因此卦學間又進一層矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525283880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第八問：月破之爻，欲定其破爲無用，却又應于破；欲謂之不破，却又到底破而無用，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525300264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：神機現于破，禍福之基在于動，動而有生無剋之破爻，有出破、填實合破之法；安靜有剋無生之破爻，則到底破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525316648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑辰寅子戌月丁卯日，占應世訟事，得泰卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525333032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄兄官才","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525349416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535171593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：爻逢六合，官事必審，不宜戌建冲世，乃是月破，卯日剋世，必輸無疑，果被杖責。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525349416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應日剋月破故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525365800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525382184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525382184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月已丑日，占將來㐅世應","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525382184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有官否，得兌之訟卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子父才官斷曰：未土父母爻持世化進神，未土雖是旬空，日辰冲之，曰：實不爲空矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525382184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已火官星動而生世，化出寅木長生，顕然有官。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525398568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：應在何年？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525414952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：已年必","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525431336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149651497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然食祿王家也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525431336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于巳年得縣缺，應實破之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525447720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525464104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午辰寅子辰月戊子日，占父近出","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525464104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何日回，得乾之夬卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525464104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官父才子斷曰：父母持世，破而化空化退，若執死法，其父不能歸也，莫非轉往他方也，來而復返也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525480488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以朱雀臨爻，動而持世，卯日有信，未日必歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525496872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于卯日得信，乙未日到家。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525513256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應卯日得信者，破而逢合之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525529640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未日回家者，父化未土，旬空出空之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525546024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222566427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅子化巳戌，申，化卯午辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月癸卯日占後運世㐅應功，得名艮之觀卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525562408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄子父兄斷曰：寅木官星持世，申金動來剋之，今年七月，必有凶非。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525578792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：看因何事？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525595176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：應動剋世，必是仇家。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525611560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：碍于功名否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525627944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：若非子水動揺，去位必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525644328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸有子水，接續相生，本云是吉，嫌破而化空，降級。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525660712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不免，果于七月彼此揭叅，結成大非。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525677096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月事結，降級調用。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525693480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至子年四月，原品起用，連官二任。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525709864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525726248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131578085430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子水原神初時空破，無力生世，有此禍端。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525726248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至填實之年月，仍復有用之驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525742632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子戌申","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525759016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化午，午化辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅月甲午日，占子病","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525759016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應㐅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶，得艮之蒙卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525759016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄子父兄斷曰：申金子孫爲用，臨月破，不宜日建剋之，動爻剋之，又化回頭之剋，有剋無生，可急回家，汝子死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525775400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人未到家，一人報曰：令郎申時去世矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525791784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應填實之時受剋而死也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525808168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393942054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥申午辰丑月庚申日，占墳應世地風水，得咸卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525824552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子兄、官父斷曰：日辰臨靑龍持世，來龍由左而來，龍虎皆有氣，必然環抱。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525840936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苐嫌應上未土臨月破，應爲照山，世前一位爲朝案，喜亥水得申日生之，必有朝水。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525857320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜取水作朝，不宜取山作向。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525873704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間爻爲明堂，旺相，必濶大。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525890088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：一一果然，葬可好否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525906472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：依予取水作朝，棄山爲向，許必大發。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525922856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼果依㫁，葬後卽如所言。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525939240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457056149684265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525955624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯申月辛卯日，占買宅，世㐅應吉否，得革之夬卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525955624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父兄兄、官子斷曰：月建生世，酉金暗動生世，但不宜化寅木子孫臨月破，又受金剋，惟防損子。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525972008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼竟得此屋遷入，不半月，其子出花而死。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971525988392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後執此卦問予曰：子果死矣，此屋自後可居否？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526004776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：宜再卜可決。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526021160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第九問：用神不現，看伏神在何爻之下，得出不得出，何以論之？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526037544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：伏神得出者有四，葢日月生者，日月","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526053928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535204361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"持之者，一也；飛神生伏，動爻生者，二也；日月動爻冲剋飛神，三也；飛神空破休囚墓絶于日者，四也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526053928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者，皆有用之伏神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526070312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏神不得出者亦有四：休囚無氣，日月剋者，一也；飛神旺相，日月生助，飛神剋害伏神者，二也；伏神墓絶于日月及飛爻者，三也；伏神休囚，兼旬空月破者，四也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526086696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者，乃無用之伏神，雖有如無，終不得出。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526103080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用神旺相，如遇旬空、出空之日則出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526119464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月壬辰日占候文寅子戌亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526135848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526135848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358457983921045515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書何日領得賁卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526135848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世官才、兄才兄官斷曰：午火父母爲用神，伏于二爻丑土之下，又値旬空，許甲午日出空必領。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526152232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526168616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應出旬之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526185000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申申午","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526201384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏卩辰。辰月丁巳日，古。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應逃僕，得蹇卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526201384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子父兄兄官父斷曰：占僕以財爻爲用神，取兌卦二爻，卯木伏于本卦二爻午火之下，午火爲飛神，卯木爲伏神，今","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526217768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222599195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申金持世，剋制卯木，終不能逃。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526217768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但因伏去生飛，名爲泄氣，盗去財物，必盡費于爐火之家。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526234152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許甲子日拿獲，果于子日得信。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526250536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窩賭䥫匠之家，申時拿獲。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526266920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應子日者，冲剋午火之飛神，生起卯木之伏神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526283304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃金策云：伏無提挈終徒爾，飛不推開亦枉然。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526299688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦應驗是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526316072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526332456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑酉月丙辰日占","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526332456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子病，得升卦官父才官父才","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526332456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131578118198"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：午火子孫伏于世爻丑土之下，丑土旬空，易于引㧞，許午日必俞，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526332456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526348840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子卯月丙辰日，占應世父病，得","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526348840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"復卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄兄、官才，斷曰：巳火父母伏于二爻寅木之下，飛來","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526348840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生伏伏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇長生，許次日愈，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526348840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月庚申日，占大例桑子戌申亥","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526365224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏午丑卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葉價貴賤，得旣濟卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526365224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535237129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄官父兄官子斷曰：午火財爻爲用，伏于世爻亥水之下，","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526381608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申日生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶亥水，午火財爻又絶在亥，葉價主。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526381608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賤無疑也。旁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人曰：目今現價三錢，不爲賤論，如先生之言，必以三錢價爲賤論耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526397992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526414376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"目下尚早三錢之價。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之慮貴，是年規定價也。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526430760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今問大例","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526447144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"價必至大市。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526447144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁人曰：大市何日貴，何日賤？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526463528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答：","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526479912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰交甲子旬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水値空，惟巳午日好賣，交","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526479912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌旬亥，水値旬午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火財爻，永不得起，則漸漸賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526479912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526496296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"驗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456131578150966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未辰","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526496296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子寅月戊辰日占病，有何應？","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526496296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526512680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼神爲禍，得小畜卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才，才兄父斷曰：凡卜鬼神，以官爻爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526512680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今官鬼伏辰爻之下，與飛神作合，又得日辰合之。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526529064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予想伏合乃藏匿之象，酉金是正氣之神，第三爻爲房室。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526545448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽斷曰：汝家房中藏有神像作崇。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526561832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：仙哉！","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526578216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果有觀音軸藏于厨中，後送至寺內，病卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526594600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七月庚辰日亦得此卦，予亦如前斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526610984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有銅達磨祖師在匣中，命其","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526627368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535269897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"送于寺内，其病亦愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680042971526627368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535302665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十四古吳洞庭西山王維德洪緒著，壬午舉人，弟需遵時叅訂。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221220404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吳庠鍾英子燦，男其龍、雲客、謝朝柱、巨材、門人任用淵、潛菴同較。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221236788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡鑑升明男其章、𤥨軒。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221253172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222631963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十問：進退神乃動爻變出之神也，吉凶禍福，有喜忌之分，何以論之？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221269556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：吉神宜于化進，忌神宜于化退。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221285940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而進退之法有三：旺相者，乗勢而進，一也；休囚者，待時而進，二也；動爻變爻有一而逢空破冲合者，待期塡補，合冲而進，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221302324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"退神之法亦有三：旺相者，或有日月動爻生扶，占近事，暫時而不退者，一也；休囚者，卽時而退，二也；動爻變爻有一而逢空破冲合者，待期填補，合冲而退，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221318708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲月癸卯日占鄕，戌申","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221335092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221335092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535335433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"試，得恒之大過卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221335092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世才官子官父才斷曰：酉金官星持世，日冲暗動，又得九五爻官化進神拱扶，不獨今秋折桂，來春定占鰲頭，果登鄕榜，卽于次歲辰年聨㨗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221351476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢化進神者，今秋也，聨㨗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221367860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年者，冲而逢合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221384244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申辰寅，","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221400628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯子。酉月庚戌日，占何年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世生子，得屯之節卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221400628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄官父官子兄","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221417012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694393974822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：寅木子孫持世，化進神，寅木旬空，卯木空而且破，後至寅年卯月，妻婢連生二子。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221417012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卯木雖爲月破，得日辰合補，乃休囚待時而用也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221433396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221449780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子未化戌，酉化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221449780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月乙丑日，一人自占世應求婚，得噬嗑之比卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221449780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才官才兄父斷曰：財爻持世化進神，巳火子孫動而生世，但因巳火化子水回頭之剋，必待午日冲去子水，此是鍋底退薪之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221466164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午日又生合世爻，其婚必成，果","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221482548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535368201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于午日允婚。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221482548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：間爻酉金鬼動，豈無阻耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221498932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：月破化退神，雖有阻而無力也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221515316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑午","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221531700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化亥，辰化丑，寅化卯。酉月甲辰日，因被論占自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世陳如何？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221531700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得師之明夷卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221548084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官才官子，斷曰：世化回頭之剋，官星化退，子孫化進，內三爻皆非吉兆，果于次年二月拿問應卯月者，子孫出空填破之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221564468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月丁卯日占功名，終得戌","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221580852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221580852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535400969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出仕否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221580852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得同人之革卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221597236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世子才兄、官子父斷曰：若以子孫動而剋官，是終身無官也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221613620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子許辰年出仕，果于辰年得𨕖。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221630004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此理何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221646388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土忌神，化退神，不能剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221662772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯日合之，合待逢冲辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221679156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是有病有醫之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221695540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十一問：冲中逢合，合處逢冲，何以斷其吉凶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221711924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：合者，聚也；冲者，散也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221728308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲中逢合，先散後聚；先失後得，先淡後濃；合處逢冲，反是。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221744692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222664731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午酉","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221761076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯亥，化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午月丙辰日，占出外貿應世易如何？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221761076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得恒之豫卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221777460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才官子官父才斷曰：世上酉金化卯木相冲，正謂反吟卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221793844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而卯木有冲之能，無剋之力，得日辰辰土生合世爻，此謂冲中逢合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221810228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况變卦六合，又得戌土財爻暗動生世，此爲反吟，主反覆覓利也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221826612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221842996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月甲辰日，占借，酉合亥丑，卯空巳未銀有否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221859380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221875764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221892148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222697499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才、兄官父兄斷曰：應落空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221892148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃金䇿云：索借者失望。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221908532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今應爻旬空，又是六冲卦，本主不肯，妙乎！","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221924916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌建合應生世，辰日合世，此乃冲中逢合，先難後易，去借必有。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221941300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：前月去借，彼不允，今去再借，允否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221957684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：前月去借不允，明現六冲，今借必有，明現逢合。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221974068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：應于何日有？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365221990452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：卯木旬空，交甲寅，應已出空，寅日又合亥水財爻，卽允矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222006836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222023220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月戊戌日，占失銀物，卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222039604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化午，酉化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑，","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222039604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456939535433737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可復得否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222039604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得巽之訟卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222055988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應兄子才官父才。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222072372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：卦得六冲未土，財爻化午火，回頭生合，現失而復得之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222088756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁人曰：應持白虎金鬼，玄武臨財，難言復得。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222105140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：應是他人，被午火回頭剋制，財爲用神，冲中逢合，日主合世，𬋩許必得。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222121524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：應于何日？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222137908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：巳火靑龍，原神旬空，其病在己，必待乙已日，原神出空値日，當許復得果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222154292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月丁酉日自占，戌申午卯巳未，","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222170676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222730267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻成否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222170676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得否。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222187060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦應世父兄、官才官父，卦得六合，婚姻最宜。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222203444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今世被日冲，應爻月破，謂之合處逢冲，總就不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222219828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：年庚巳經送來筭命，又說甚佳。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222236212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：予屢占屢驗，故敢此斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222252596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于本月自得大病。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222268980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未月世財亦八墓，此女病故。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222285364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉冲申午辰，","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222301748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯月乙卯日占謀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222301748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"望求財，得旅卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才、才兄子","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222301748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694394007590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：此世應相生，卦逢六合，謀望本可成就，恒不宜卯月日冲應上酉金財爻，恐他人之財無綠夫望耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222301748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：有字來，約我明日去，豈有不成之理？","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222318132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果次日去，成議。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222334516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至壬戌日悔議，復不成應。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222350900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日成議者，辰日合應也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222367284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌日復不成者，世亦逢冲，是合處逢冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039365222383668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申丑卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738380288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲午月辛亥日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世師近病，得節卦兄官父、官子才。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738380288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942376969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：占近病，得六合卦，屢驗必死。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738396672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今世上巳火財爻，日辰冲之，是合處逢冲，臨危得救。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738413056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：危子何日，得救何日？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738429440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：金庫于丑丑日防險，甲寅日冲發應上用爻，則有救矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738445824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于丑日人事不知，寅日乃愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738462208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉合卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅月戊辰日占兄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應近病吉凶，得晉卦官父兄才官父。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738478592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：酉金兄弟爲用神，日辰合之，近病不宜逢合，","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738494976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942409737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸明日交卯月，節可卽愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738494976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738511360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦合處逢冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738527744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉亥丑卯，","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738544128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰未月丁巳日，占巳悔婚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應可復成否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738544128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得離之旅卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738560512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才、官子父。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738576896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：此卦六冲變成六合，屢驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738593280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"散而又成，離而復合，又得卯木動來生世，此婚一定可成。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738609664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于次歲寅年三月復成婚。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738626048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應辰月者，求婚以財爻爲用，得六冲卦，旣變六合，財爻又逢合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738642432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木化出之辰土，是卜時所現之機關也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738658816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年者，應爻暗動，合冲","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738675200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358456484222763035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738675200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十二問：四生墓絶，吉凶何以斷之？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738691584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：四生墓絶有三：生墓絶于日辰，一也；生墓絶于飛爻，二也；動而變出者，三也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738707968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌辰長生，禍來不小；用神墓絶，有救無凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738724352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定法如是，活變在人。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738740736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738757120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥丑卯，","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738757120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳月戊寅日，占何日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應得財，得離之豐卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738757120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才官子父斷曰：酉金財爻安靜，明曰：卯日必得。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738773504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：兄弟動","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738789888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942442505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而持世，何以得財？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738789888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：兄弟化八戌墓不能剋也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738806272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次日用靜逢冲，之曰：汝不知耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738822656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738839040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738855424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子午月已卯日，占妻","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738855424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病，得震之豐卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738855424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才官、子才兄父。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738871808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人執此卦問予曰：辰土發動，以辰土財爻爲用，化亥水，乃是臨官，斷其不死。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738888192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但辰土死于卯日，此卦將何斷之，還是將土死于卯，斷其必死耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738904576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：近病六冲不死。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738920960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：何日愈？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738937344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：辰土動來冲世，","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738953728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358453694394040358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世上戌土日合，必待次日辰日，冲發世上戌土財爻，卽愈，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738953728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
