{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738970112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌卯巳未寅月戊子日，占生㐅世應産，得剝之觀卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738970112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才子父、才官父斷曰：子水子孫化巳火，水絶在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935738986496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本日巳時，落草而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739002880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旁有知易者曰：靑龍臨子孫，如何此斷？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739019264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：且看驗否。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739035648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739052032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人又問子曰：子孫値日，靑龍附之，何如神斷？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739068416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：日辰子孫，今日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739084800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已時者，今","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739101184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932342834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739101184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"落草而亡者，吉神化絕化鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739117568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未申","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739133952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑午，化卯辰，化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月辛未日，占子病應世。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739133952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶得漸之中孚卦，官父兄子父兄斷曰：申金子孫持世，化出丑土，金庫在丑未日冲開，又得日辰與辰土動爻生之，今日午後愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739150336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739166720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739183104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申，申化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739183104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰月甲寅日占友。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世父病，得屯之震卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739183104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄官父官子兄。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739199488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942475273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人執此卦問予曰：申金父母爻爲用神，金絶于寅日，是絶耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739215872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：是絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739232256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土原神化申，乃化長生，生扶父母，是絶處逢生耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739248640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：是也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739265024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：某翁之父，病重無妨乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739281408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：今日午時難保。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739297792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼不言而去。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739314176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果午時夀終。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739330560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人又來問予曰：絶處逢生，竟無用耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739346944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：絶處逢生，屢試危而有救。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739363328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今申金絶于寅日，不宜寅日生助午火，回頭剋制。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739379712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌土生金，本云是吉，戍土乃是月破，無力生扶，雖化長生于申，申被日冲，又絶于寅日，故此凶斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739396096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251224074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子空戌","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739412480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化甲申，化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739412480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申月丙辰日占弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739412480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病，得旣濟之豐卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄官父兄官子斷曰：子水旬空，亥水不空，今捨寔從空，以子水兄弟爲用，墓庫于日，申金原神發動，又得戌土動來反生原神，而子水雖入墓庫，不過病重。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739412480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交甲子日，用神出空，冲去午火，則原神無傷，卽愈矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739428864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739445248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以入庫必死，螣蛇動主死，白虎動主䘮。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739461632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋令戌爻又是沐浴煞，病人最忌，今此病不死，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739478016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但凡看","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739494400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932375602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，用神推尊有生無剋最吉，助忌傷用最凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739494400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦卦研究其法，爻爻精察天機，細心變通，豈讓君平之卜易哉？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739510784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子戌丑","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739527168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739527168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申月癸丑日，占子在楚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世生理，何日回得損卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739527168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄兄官父斷曰：申金子孫伏于世爻丑土墓庫之下，本是不宜，豈可又墓于日辰，令郎恐有大患。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739543552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼日近有信至，內云八月起身，故占其來否。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739559936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：此卦難以斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739576320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932408370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其歸期，乃叔曰：我來占姪在外平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739592704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又得无妄之頥卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739609088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739625472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申化子，午化戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739625472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空破子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應才官子才兄父斷曰：前卦子孫不現入墓，後卦現而化墓，况寅木原神，乃是真破真空，並無生助，又申金月建官鬼臨于道路發動，兩卦並看，不祥之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739625472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：前日有口信來，說五月長江覆舟而死。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739641856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此信","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739658240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已的聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得卦理甚明，故戲卜之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739658240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251256842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739674624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申申冲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739674624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥月丙寅日，嫂占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739674624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"姑病，得咸之蹇卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子兄官父斷曰：姑乃夫之姊妹也，以官鬼爻爲用神，今午火官爻長生于日，亥水剋之，不宜亥水自化長生，又動出申金，助水來剋，此病必死。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739674624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後于乙亥日卒。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739691008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應乙亥日者，亥水旬空寔空之。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739707392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月乙未日，姑占弟婦：未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739723776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰寅，懷孕足月，因有病生産，應世","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739723776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251289610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739723776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得困之坎卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739740160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子官父才斷曰：弟婦乃弟之妻也，以財爻爲用神，今寅木財爻墓庫于未日，此現在病也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739756544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水化申金，得長生生合財爻，脫身平安。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739772928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼問：何日産，荅曰：亥水化申，動來合世。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739789312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明曰：必産。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739805696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果次日産，母子平安，生産後連舊病全愈。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739822080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉冲申午辰巳年巳月丁卯日，占應世劾奏他人，得旅卦兄子才才兄子。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739838464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942508041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我欲劾奏權奸，恐反遭其害，故占相煩直斷。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739854848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：應爻酉金，若無卯日冲之，當論其長生于年月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739871232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今得卯冲，當以巳年月剋論，謂之有傷無救。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739887616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼之權勢自今衰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739904000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問：有害于我否？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739920384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：子孫持世，何害之有？","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739936768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果題准究奸。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739953152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739969536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739969536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰未月戊申日，占，因誤軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應糧被叅，得豐之旅卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739969536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父才兄官子斷曰：世臨日辰，月建生之，動出戌土，又生官位，可","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739985920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942540809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"保無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935739985920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸人不以爲然，豈知因獲竒功，功名仍復。","logicSentenceId":"7680039935740002304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人曰：卯木子孫發動，如何無碍？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451879936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：木絶于日，又墓于月，如何碍之？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451896320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451912704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯卯月壬寅日占尋穴世應地，得革之旣濟卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451912704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父兄兄官子，斷曰：世爻亥水化申金，回頭之生，雖休囚逢生爲旺，所嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451929088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅日冲申，必待秋令，可得美地。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451945472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世化申生，地在西南，果于七月得地。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451961856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬後三子皆發科甲。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451978240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451994624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251322378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人問予曰：申金被冲，該斷已月合之，何應申月耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662451994624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：已可合申也，而亥世逢冲，豈能就乎？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452011008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十三問：六冲、六合，何以斷之？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452027392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：人之所惡者宜冲，所好者宜合。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452043776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟占病有近病、久病，論。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452060160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近病逢冲卽愈，久病逢冲卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452076544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合反是。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452092928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六冲卦，有日辰相合，變爻相合，謂之冲中逢合。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452109312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六合卦，有日辰相冲，變爻相冲，謂之合處逢冲。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452125696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如冲忌神合用神，名爲去煞留恩，般般有吉；冲用神合忌神，名爲留煞害命，件件皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452142080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251355146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452158464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452158464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉月壬子日，占姪有事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應被害，否得大壯之泰卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452158464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子父兄、才官斷曰：六冲卦事必主散。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452174848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世上午火父母爻被日辰冲之，令姪無害。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452191232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：回來，我自責之。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452207616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後有人解散，乃叔不至責姪。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452224000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應六冲卦又冲去忌神之驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452240384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午辰寅子，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452256768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳月丁酉，酉占文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應書何日到？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452256768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452273152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官父、才子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452289536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251387914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：應爻旬空，日辰相合，以辰爻父母爲用，至甲辰日必到。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452289536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452305920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六冲卦獨合用神，乃冲中逢合也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452322304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰日到者，寔空之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452338688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452355072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯申，化巳午，化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452355072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。午月丙子日，占開。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452355072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"店得大壯之巽卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子、父兄、官才斷曰：六冲卦變出，又是六冲，不開爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452355072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼日：業已成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452371456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：午火月建，當時化未土作合，日冲不散，恐今冬有變。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452387840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果冬底夥計有事而止。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452404224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932441138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452420608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉巳，化亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452420608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯亥，化巳丑。申月乙卯日，一人因自及。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世、應子俱被拿，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452420608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問得巽之坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才官父才。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452420608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：六冲卦每事主散，但不宜又變六冲，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452436992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"內外爻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見反吟亂冲亂擊，世與子孫皆化剋，其象不吉，果俱受重刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452436992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥丑卯，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452453376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化寅巳。未月乙亥日，占往買。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452453376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賣，求利，得兌之震卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子父、才官","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452453376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942573577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：六冲變六冲，又是卦反吟月建，當時持世，汝意必去，去必𧇊折。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452453376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：卽日起身。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452469760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：反吟卦立意買貨，貨少更改，他貨無利。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452486144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又問大平否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452502528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452518912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰兌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變震，有冲之力，無剋之能，平安可許此人去","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452518912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"買菉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豆地頭缺少，改買棉花，果𧇊折。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452518912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當知六","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452535296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452535296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，吉象吉爻，得生得合，俱云散矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452551680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉玄","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452568064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑卯巳，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452568064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未。子月巳巳日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452568064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"睹錢得坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官父兄","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452568064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942606345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：世剋應爻，乃爲我勝，但不宜巳日冲動，亥水反生應爻，與世無益，此去必輸。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452568064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幸六冲卦定不終局，果輪不多。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452584448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因爭錢而散。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452600832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不久者，六冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452617216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輸不多者，空財生應也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452633600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爭財而散者，朱雀臨財暗動也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452649984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452666368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452666368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰月庚午日占㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應試觀得之否。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452666368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦才官父才官父斷曰：未土持世，化出日辰午火，官星生合，鼎甲在掌，果中探花。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452682752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251420682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午辰寅子，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452699136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲動。寅月甲午日，占子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應久病，得大壯卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452699136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子父兄、官才斷曰：久病六冲即死。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452715520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今申金子孫用神月破，午火持世，日辰剋之，本日應該見凶，而卦中有子水暗動制火，乃因機所現，今日不死，明日子水受制，忌神遇合，次日當防。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452731904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果死于未日辰時。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452748288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月甲午日，占趕去戌申午、卯巳未寄信，可遇否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452764672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得否。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452781056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452797440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251453450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官才官父斷曰：卦得六合，凡事成就。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452797440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但明日未時淸明節，宜星夜趕去，必㑹，恐交淸明。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452813824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月建是辰，則應被月冲，冲卽去，不能㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452830208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果趕去寄之，次日卽開舟矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452846592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452862976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"破丑化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452862976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月戌甲日，有同鄕人應世占借貸，得復之豫卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452862976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄兄、官才。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452879360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：六合變六合，凡謀易就，久遠和同。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452895744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但亥水財爻月破酉金，原神旬空，世上子水財爻化未土回","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452912128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942639113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭之剋，又日辰剋辰土，暗動剋午火，生扶，應爻丑土剋，剋之太過，在借銀事内，須防不測。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452912128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：昨有友人約我同去，或不允，有之。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452928512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：那友何人？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452944896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：廣東人。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452961280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子正顔止之，不從，竟去借銀，回，不數里遭其害。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452977664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申午卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452994048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰，巳化寅、未，化子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月甲寅日，占延師應世訓子，得否之乾卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662452994048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官才、官父斷曰：以應爻爲用神，臨戌父，可稱飽學。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453010432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨嫌六合","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453026816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251486218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變六冲，其間恐有變局。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453026816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不久。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453043200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：因何事耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453059584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：卦中惟初爻未土父母化子水，子孫値旬空，父動剋水，防子孫灾變。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453075968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後至午月，子水逢月破，其子病，故卽辭師矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453092352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十四問：三刑六害，犯之必凶平荅曰：三刑者，寅巳申三全爲刑，子卯兩遇爲刑，丑未戌三全爲刑，辰午酉亥謂之自刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453108736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫三刑者，用神休，因有他爻之剋，內有兼犯三刑者，主見凶灾。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453125120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中三刑俱全不動，用神不傷損，有生扶，從無有驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453141504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六害屢試無驗，故不録出。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453157888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458764942671881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453174272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未，未化酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453174272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅月庚申日，占姪孫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453174272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病，得家人之離卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才父、才兄斷曰：巳火用神，月生日合，可治之症，但不宜月建寅，日建申，與巳爻㑹成三刑，恐危。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453174272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果死于寅日寅時。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453190656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453207040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戍亥，化辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453207040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰月戊午日，占夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應病，得離之頥卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453207040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才官子父","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453223424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458128251518986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：亥水夫星爲用，戌土生扶，酉金動來生，但不宜化入墓庫，又回頭化月建剋，又是午日，午酉亥自刑俱全，此病立見凶危。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453223424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果本日午時死。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453239808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453256192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化末未，化酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453256192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子亥月戊戌日，占妾近。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453256192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"病，得巽之大有卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才官父才斷曰：未土財爻爲用神，不宜化酉金官鬼又不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453256192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火原神値旬空月破，巳火又入墓庫于日辰，又丑戌未三刑見全，全無吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453272576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽日防之，果卒于本","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453288960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932473906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日未時。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453288960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453305344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453305344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌月庚子，占一冬生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453305344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"意得賁之家人卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才兄才兄官斷曰：卯木持世，月建合之，日辰生之，今冬必獲厚利。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453305344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：子日與子爻刑世，有何吉耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453321728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：凡看卦，世用推尊，生剋最重，今刑中帶生，謂之貪生忘刑。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453338112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後一冬果獲大利。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453354496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十五問：獨靜獨發，如何應驗？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453370880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：五爻俱動，惟一","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453387264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901623926810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻安靜，謂之獨靜；五爻安靜，惟一爻發動，謂之獨發。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453387264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卦中六爻，有一爻明動，又有一爻遇日辰冲者，非云獨發也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453403648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘六爻安靜，內有一爻日辰冲動者，亦云獨發也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453420032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然獨靜獨發，不過觀事之成敗遲速，至于凶吉，當推用神，如舍用神而決事者，迂且謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453436416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉辰寅","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453452800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑子。午月丙午日，占自去尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453452800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"父回，得大有之離卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官父兄父才子一友人知易，同問其父，執此卦對，予曰：寅木一爻","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453452800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932506674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨發，正月得見否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453452800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：非也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453469184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中父爻持世，被寅木剋制，自身不能動，父亦不見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453485568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲身動見父，必待冲剋寅木之年月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662453501952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命彼再占，一卦，合決之，得革之旣濟卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611263488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未酉亥","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611279872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯世應官父兄兄官子斷曰：此卦正合前卦，前卦應冲開寅木者，申也，此卦世化申金，回頭生亦應申也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611279872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于申年八月，尋父回家。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611296256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應于申年者，前卦冲去忌神，後卦化出甲","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611312640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459795684196378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金，父母用神生世也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611312640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉冲亥丑辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611329024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申月辛卯日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611329024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子嗣，得復卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄兄官才來占，人曰：我有一子，因亂失散，今無子，特問將來有子否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611329024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：子水持世，月建作子孫生世，有子之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611345408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第六爻酉金子孫暗動生世，亦云獨發。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611361792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在外卦動，所失之子必來之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611378176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問曰：何時得見？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611394560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：明歲。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611410944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰年與酉金相合，定得意而歸，後果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611427328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此用神","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611443712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932539442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨發，沖而逢合之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611443712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611460096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午、亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611460096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午月甲申日，占雨久傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世麥否。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611460096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得同人之革卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官子父一友執此卦問子曰：成二子孫，一","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611476480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻獨發昨日丙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌日定該天晴，如何還雨？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611476480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：爾憂麥水傷神，以子孫發動剋去世上之鬼，呌爾勿憂，非應晴也，決不傷損。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611492864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但戌土化退，不能剋盡憂心，故天還爾。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611509248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必待卯日合之，則大晴耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611525632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611542016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901623959578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未亥","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611558400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑卯申月甲午日，占開煤窑何應世時見煤，得家人之益卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611558400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才父、才兄斷曰：以辰土財爻爲用，此卦亥水獨發化出，明示辰月可見。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611574784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果至次年淸明後，始得見煤。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611591168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應獨發化出之用神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611607552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611623936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子未化戌，酉化申，午化申，辰，化午寅。寅月庚戌日，占女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世病，得未濟之蹇卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611623936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才兄子父。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611640320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932572210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦寅木獨靜，若不看用神，斷寅日生耶，寅日死耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611656704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦中土爲用神，得巳午火動來生之，未土子孫化進神，辰土子孫化回頭相生，卦象旣吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611673088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"許之寅日愈，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611689472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611705856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌，申化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午申","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611705856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑午，化卯辰，化巳。寅月甲辰日，占父遠出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世何日回，得遁之歸妹卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611705856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官兄、官父斷曰：外卦伏吟，在外，有憂愁之象。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611722240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：無害否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611738624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：內卦辰土父母化巳火，回頭之生世爻，午火化","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611755008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901623992346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木，助火生之，並無有害。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611755008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四爻午火獨靜，五月必歸也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611771392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後三四月，乃父在湖廣生理，不料省城兵亂，五月方歸。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611787776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
