{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十六問：卦得盡靜盡發者，何以㫁之？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611820544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：六爻安靜，無日主冲爻者，謂之盡靜；六爻俱動者，謂之盡發。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611836928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡靜者，如春花之含蕋，人未見其妙，一沾雨露，油然漸成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611853312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡發者，如百卉齊放，人多見其艶，一遇狂風，翻然而損矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611869696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故靜者恒美，動者常咎。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611886080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午月庚辰日，占僕近巳未酉、","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611902464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611902464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932604978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出，何日回？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611902464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得離卦世應。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611918848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒子才官子父斷曰：酉金財爻爲用，月剋日生，似可相敵，並無生剋。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611935232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一卦之中，惟酉金用神旬空日合，神機現此。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611951616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但旬空，必待出旬合空，雖有半用，須待冲發。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611968000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交小暑節辛卯日，則酉金値旬不空，冲發必至。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662611984384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于辛卯日來家。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612000768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應靜而逢冲也，合而逢冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612017152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空，待出空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612033536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月巳卯日，占今日酉空亥丑、卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612049920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624025114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有人還銀否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612049920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612066304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應子才、兄官父兄断曰：酉金原神旬空，日辰冲之，靜而逢冲曰起，况日辰臨應冲世，彼必今日巳時送還也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612082688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于本日巳時還一半。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612099072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日巳時還淸一半者，靜空冲起，有一半之力，而財亦有一半也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612115456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉日還淸者，已經冲起之神値日，是財之原神填足矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612131840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫喜悅之星還淸，豈不喜悅耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612148224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子月壬申日，占父在亂軍寅","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612164608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化未，子化酉，戌化亥，辰化卯，寅化巳，子化未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624057882"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中吉凶，得大畜之萃卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612164608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世官才兄兄、官才。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612180992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：六爻亂動，正亂軍中象也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612197376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以化出巳火父母爻爲用，月建剋之寅木原神又被日辰冲剋，恐性命難保。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612213760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果死無踪跡。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612230144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612246528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化酉，申化亥，午化丑，辰化卯，寅化巳，子化未。辰月甲子日，占造墳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應葬親，得乾之坤卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612246528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄、官父、才子斷曰：此卦甚凶，不必細論。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612262912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：墳已造成，卽候開","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612279296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459795684229146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金井落葬小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，以決吾房安否。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612279296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予力止之，曰：不可葬。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612295680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612312064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間有人來報曰：穴塲下俱是斗大石塊，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612312064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其數並無黙穴之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612312064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後有地師看之，則曰：背水走石，不成墳地也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612328448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第十七問用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神多現，何以取之？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612344832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：子屢驗者，舍其","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612361216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"閑爻而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用持世，舍其無權而用月日，舍其安靜而用","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612361216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"動搖舍其。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不破而田月破，舍其不空而用旬空，天機盡泄于有病之間，斷法總在于藥醫之處。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612361216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未月庚子日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳空，未辰空寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612377600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459795684261914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求財，得小畜卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612377600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世兄子才才兄父。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612393984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷曰：未土月建爲用，何以辰土旬空，空必關因，竟","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612410368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"斷月內辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日得財，果甲辰日巳時到手。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612410368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應出空之日時也，正是舍其不空而用空也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612426752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612443136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯亥，化巳丑，破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午辰空寅，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612443136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未月甲午日，占自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世陞遷，得師之渙卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612443136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄官才官子，斷曰：日辰世爻極旺，得月建作官星合世，但卦中","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612459520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624090650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩現官星，一空一破，將何爻爲用？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612459520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷其何年陞遷，則曰：今歲是卯年，來歲辰年，必以辰爻爲用，來歲可陞。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612475904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但外卦反吟，常得驗者，去而復來。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612492288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果辰年調至河南，五月又調回，十月開督府，一年兩調一陞，皆應寔空之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612508672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌申午卯巳","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612525056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化卯未，化巳。亥月丙午日，占子何日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612525056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"脫難，得豫之歸妹卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才官子兄子破才，斷曰：卦中子孫三現，俱生世爻，是必脫厄。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612525056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日建午","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612541440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624123418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻安靜，兩爻，巳火月破，許巳年脫厄，果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612541440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃用神多現，而用月破，驗在有病之爻，寔破之年也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612557824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612574208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子未化戌，酉化申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥丑","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612574208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化子未月丁丑日，占子久出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世何日回，得鼎之需卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612574208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才官子，斷曰：未土化進神，日辰冲之，丑土化子水，合住巳火，原神動來生用，化子水，回頭剋制，目下不來。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612590592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問日：終須來否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612606976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：午年必來。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612623360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果于午年午月到家。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612639744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應午年月者，未土動而日冲，是動冲逢合之年月","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612656128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358458882932637746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612656128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑土化子水合合要冲開之年月也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612672512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳火化子水之剋，冲去子水，是去煞留恩也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612688896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612705280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612705280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612705280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅月癸亥日，占子嗣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應多","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612705280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"否，得坤之艮卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子才兄官父兄，彼曰：婢妾三四，在三五年內，生者生，死者死，子有九人，並無一存，今後可有子否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612705280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予日：子化鬼，鬼化子，不但狼籍，後難許有。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612721664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果無子，以姪爲嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612738048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第十八問：卜者誠心，斷者精明，亦有不驗，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612754432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"答曰：","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612770816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624156186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此其故在卜者而不在斷者。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612770816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃卜者之意雖誠，或宻事難以語人，或問此，而意别有在也，所以有不驗之故耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612787200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612803584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612803584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"伏卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612803584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申日，占伯父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應世何","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612803584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日回，得旅之艮卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才兄子此卦若問伯父平安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612803584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木父母伏而不現，被日月動爻剋冲，必不安矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612819968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今問其回來否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612836352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不以此㫁，只可㫁用神伏藏受剋不來。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612852736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果不來，在外平安。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612869120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459874386116634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申酉","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612885504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑，","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612885504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化巳。申月乙亥日占家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612885504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宅得井之節卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父才、官官父才斷曰：應居二爻，謂之應飛入宅臨父母，必有外姓長者同居。","logicSentenceId":"7680040662612885504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：從無外人同舍。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320100864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內卦合成官鬼局，宅內不安。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320117248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：從無駁雜。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320133632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木兄弟月破伏藏，官局剋之，或昆仲家不利。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320150016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：吾占家宅，卽日欲同家業師鄕試，寔爲功名耳。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320166400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：功名與家宅，天遠地隔矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320182784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名以官鬼爲官星，家宅以見爲禍害。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320199168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320215552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459874386149402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占功名，兄之功名不許，令業師必高中也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320215552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：何以知之？","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320231936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：官局生應，不來生世，謂之出現無情，與我無于也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320248320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後果至八月。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320264704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉金寔空之月，此人自已頭塲貼出，其業師中式第四名。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320281088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅子戌、申午辰","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320297472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未月癸亥日占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320297472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"流年得艮卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官才、兄子父兄。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320297472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此人往軍前求名，說占流年，却不知占名以官爻爲官，最喜官星持世；占流年以鬼爻爲鬼，不宜","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320313856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624188954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼持世。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320313856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予以此理告之，彼曰：煩人援例，不知成否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320330240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：此卦官星持世，日辰生合，業已成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320346624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果壬申日文書寔收到應。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320363008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申日者，寅木官星，日辰合之，合待逢冲之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320379392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以流年㫁之，則謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320395776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子戌申辰寅子","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320412160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子月乙酉日，占現。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"世應任吉凶得需卦才兄子兄官才。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320412160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此公因本省有缺出，不便明問，故以現任吉凶而問。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320428544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知問缺之得否。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320444928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫持世不得，占現任之","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320461312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459874386182170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶；子孫持世，則休官。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320461312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予卽問明，彼曰：占陞遷，荅曰：此缺不得，果不得，在任甚安。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320477696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以占現任之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320494080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，休官必矣，豈非天淵耶？","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320510464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳未","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320526848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰寅子午月辛丑日，因母病占應世問流年，得益之无妄卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320526848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄子才才，兄父如買賣人。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320543232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問流年，自然以財父爲重。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320559616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卦旺財持世，未土之財化午火生合，卽許之發財。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320576000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼曰：我因老母有病，故來占之，欲占何日安否？","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320592384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"予曰：占求財，","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320608768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459901624221722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年與母病，是天淵矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320608768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁曰：令堂甲辰日危也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320625152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"果驗。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320641536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此應世爻辰土出句之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320657920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320674304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320674304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"化申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳未午月辛酉日，占功名，得萃之遁卦。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320674304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父兄子才冲官父，此子十二歲，乃父命其占名。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320690688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以官爻持世，夏火當令，未土父母爻爲文章化進神，功名有望。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320707072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知父呌子占，此心發于乃父之誠也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320723456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是父占子也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320739840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木不能剋父，則父動剋子也。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320756224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此子未月戌日而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320772608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7358459795684294682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜筮正宗卷之十四終","logicSentenceId":"7680040663320788992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
